18091495088660876.ingredients:
1 baguette, sliced and toasted
1 garlic clove
6–8 fresh figs, halved or quartered
1 tbsp olive oil
Pinch of flaky sea salt
1 cup Lifeway Farmer Cheese
Zest of 1 lemon
Freshly cracked black pepper
Aged prosciutto (optional, for topping)
Crushed pistachios (optional, for crunch)
Rosemary Hot Honey 🔥🍯 (comment Hot Honey and I’ll dm the recipe to you)
18091495088660876.method:
Slice and toast the baguette until golden and crisp. Rub each crostini with garlic.
Add hot honey to a skillet. Add figs cut side down, cook 2–3 minutes until caramelized.
Place a sprig of rosemary into the pan, and torch it until it’s smoking. Place the lid onto the pan to infuse the smoke flavor into the figs.
In a bowl, mix Farmer Cheese with lemon zest, a drizzle of olive oil, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Spread whipped Farmer Cheese on toasted baguette slices. Top with caramelized figs, crispy prosciutto, and pistachios if using.
Drizzle with Rosemary Hot Honey right before serving. Cheers!🍂

18146387797604301.ingredients:
2 cups whipped ricotta (10% M.F)
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
pinch of salt
garlic confit
honey (must!!!)
lemon pesto or lemon zest (must!!!)
sourdough toast
18146387797604301.method:
Blend olive oil and ricotta until smooth
Spread the garlic confit on the toasted sourdough, then spread or pipe the whipped ricotta on top
Drizzle with lemon pesto and honey

18035502020899937.ingredients:
Dates
Pistachio butter
Raspberry jam
Chocolate chips
Coconut oil
Flaky sea salt
18035502020899937.method:
Store in fridge or freezer:)
I just but roasted pistachios (unshelled). In a food processor or blender, start to blend the nuts. It takes a bit of time, but blend until smooth consistency.
In a sauce pan, add frozen raspberries. Allow to thaw. Start smashing once somewhat thawed. Add 3tbsp of chia seeds and mix well. Turn off heat and allow to cool. Then store in fridge!

18040873955838725.ingredients:
1 cup rajgira (amaranth) flour
1 cup whole-wheat flour (atta)
1 cup cottage cheese or grated paneer
1 cup boiled & mashed sweet potato
Fresh coriander leaves
1 tsp cumin powder
1 tsp ajwain powder
1 tbsp sesame seeds
Hing, black pepper & salt to taste
Water as needed
Ghee or oil for cooking
18040873955838725.method:
Mix all ingredients and knead into a soft dough using a little water as needed. Rest for 15–20 minutes.
Roll a dough ball, apply ghee or oil, fold and roll again.
Cook both sides on low-medium heat with ghee until golden. Apply a little butter if desired.
Pack with curd, chutney or homemade ketchup! ❤️

18080840567526815.ingredients: Cut 3-4 medium carrots into sticks and pack them in a clean jar
18080840567526815.method:
Cut 3-4 medium carrots into sticks and pack them in a clean jar
Add ½ tbsp mustard seeds, 4-6 garlic cloves, 3-4 green chillies and 1 tbsp pink salt
Pour in ½-1 cup apple cider vinegar
Fill the jar with lukewarm water
Optional: 1 tbsp jaggery or sugar to balance the acidity (I skipped it, but it's good)
Let it cool, close the lid, and burp the jar once in a while
Ready to eat after 24 hours. Store in the fridge.

18172845739456297.ingredients:
Sourdough bread
Butter
Thinly sliced onions
A little salt
Brown sugar
A splash of water for caramelising
Chilli oil
Pesto (recipe already on my profile!)
LOTS of mozzarella cheese
18172845739456297.method:
Sauté the thinly sliced onions in butter with a little salt, brown sugar, chilli oil and a splash of water.
Let them caramelise until soft, golden and beautifully jammy.
Spread pesto on your sourdough, layer on the caramelised onions and add LOTS of mozzarella.
Close the sandwich and toast until golden brown and crispy on the outside, with melty, cheesy goodness inside.

18120176459319372.method: Roll out the puff pastry dough and spread with a layer of cream cheese evenly over the surface. Then add a layer of jalapenos and shredded cheese. Roll tightly into a log (allow to set in freezer for 10-15 minutes if needed to firm up) and slice into 7-8 pinwheels. Place pinwheels on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Brush the tops with beaten egg, then bake at 400°F for 18-20 minutes until golden and flaky. Allow to cool slightly, drizzle with hot honey and enjoy! 😋

18095405213239654.ingredients:
1/4 cup miso paste
1/4 cup mirin
2 tbsp maple syrup or sugar
2 tbsp low sodium soy sauce
1 tbsp sesame oil
grated fresh ginger *optional
18095405213239654.method: Broil on middle rack for 10-15 mins. I like to turn my rack halfway through so it crusts evenly along the top.

18123830731841952.method: Whip together goat cheese + cream cheese until smooth. Then make the warm topping with butter, brown sugar, honey, pistachios + dried cherries. Spoon it all over the whipped goat cheese and finish with fresh orange zest. 🤌

18132897259741249.ingredients:
3 onions
1 cup Greek yogurt
1/4 cup mayo
1 tbsp white vinegar
Salt, pepper & pinch of cayenne (optional)
Chives or green onion for serving

18101211488302338.ingredients:
2 servings of frozen udon (1 just is not enough for me)
2 cloves of garlic, minced
1 small knob ginger, minced
1 heaped tbsp tomato paste
1 tbsp light soy sauce
1 tbsp black rice vinegar (or any other vinegar)
1 tbsp mirin (or 2 tsp sweetener of choice)
1 tbsp sesame oil
1 tbsp shoaxing wine (or any clear cooking wine, or skip)
1-2 tsp chilli oil (or as much as you like)
1 tsp chilli powder/gochugaru (or more if you want)
1 lime, juiced (or 1/2 lemon)
2 spring onions, finely sliced, to garnish
Handful of coriander, roughly chopped, to garnish
18101211488302338.method:
Prepare your noodles according to the package instructions. (I place my frozen udon in a colander and pour boiling water over it to soften).
Heat a large frying pan over medium heat with a drizzle of oil. Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 3 mins, until fragrant.
Add the tomato paste and fry for 2 mins. Add the chilli powder (or skip) and fry for another 2-3 minutes.
Add the sauce and bring to a simmer. Add the cooked noodles and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has been absorbed.
Turn off the heat. Add the lime juice and garnish with spring onions and coriander.
Serve :)

18145238710600807.ingredients:
3 tbsp fresh basil
1 garlic clove
4 tbsp grated Parmesan cheese
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
½ cup extra virgin olive oil
4 tbsp fresh lemon juice
1 tsp honey or maple syrup
Salt and black pepper, to taste
18145238710600807.method:
Add the basil, garlic, Parmesan, Dijon mustard, olive oil, lemon juice, honey, salt, and pepper to a large measuring cup or blender jar.
Blend with an immersion blender until smooth, creamy, and fully emulsified.
Alternatively, finely chop the basil and garlic, then whisk all of the ingredients together in a small bowl until well combined.
Taste and adjust the seasoning with additional lemon juice, salt, or honey if desired.
Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to use.

18129743437757714.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups rice
1 1/2 cups water
1 Japanese curry roux cube
1/2 cup frozen vegetables
1/2 cup tofu (any firmness), crumbled
18129743437757714.method:
Add everything to your rice cooker and cook on the regular (“white”) or “mixed” setting if your
rice cooker has one. That’s it!

17883587742689038.ingredients:
2 portions of cold cooked rice
2 diced chicken breasts
2 minced garlic cloves
Small chunk of grated ginger
2 eggs lightly beaten
2 spring onions, white and green parts separated
2 tbsp hoisin sauce
2 tsp light soy sauce
1 tsp dark soy sauce
1 tsp oyster sauce
1 tsp rice vinegar
1 tsp cornflour
1 tsp light soy sauce
1 tsp oil
17883587742689038.method:
Heat a wok add 1 tbsp oil, once hot add the chicken, stir fry for 3-4 minutes until golden and no longer pink. Remove to a plate.
Add a splash more oil, add the eggs and lightly scramble. Push to one side and add the white part of the spring onions, the garlic and ginger. Stir fry for 30 seconds.
Add the rice, break it up and stir fry for 1-2 minutes. Add the chicken back in.
Add the sauce and stir fry, toss for 2-3 minutes. Add the green part of the spring onions, stir fry, toss for a further 1-2 minutes. Remove from the heat and drizzle with optional sesame oil. Serve and enjoy 😉

18112842362602521.ingredients:
1/3 cup edamame
1/3 cup peas
1 tsp soy sauce
1 tsp rice wine vinegar
1 tbsp chilli crisp oil
18112842362602521.method: Mix it all together and that’s ittt 🫛

18184857907423268.ingredients:
1 tbsp neutral oil
1 14-oz block firm tofu
2 giant scallions (or 6 regular scallions), sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 1/2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tsp dark soy sauce
1 tbsp oyster sauce
1/2 tbsp corn starch
Salt to taste
1/2 cup water

18018040571714373.ingredients:
1 lb ground meat of choice ( i used ground boneless chicken thighs )
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp onion powder
1 tbsp red chili flakes
10 Mini tacos
Salt to taste
1 tbsp black pepper
1 cup mozzarella cheese
10 slices of cheddar cheese
4 tbsp oil for cooking
Red onion ( diced )
Tomatoes ( diced )
Lettuce ( diced )
Jalapeños
Banana peppers
1 cup mayonnaise
1/2 cup ketchup
1 tsp black pepper
1 tablespoons cajun seasoning
1/2 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp sliced jalapeños ( optional )
18018040571714373.method:
Season the minced chicken with salt, pepper, red chili flakes, garlic and onion powder. Mix and make small ball.
In a skillet add oil on medium high heat, place the chicken on the skillet and smash it down with the help of a flat surface. Flip after 3 minutes ,Add shredded cheese on top  of the burger patty and cover it with the taco. Press and let it cook for 5-6 minutes or until the patty is fully cooked.
Flip the taco , add cheese slices on top of the patty. Cover the skillet so the cheese can melt. Make sure the stove is on low heat otherwise the taco can burn from bottom.
Once cheese is melted, add lettuce, tomato , onion, jalapeños, banana peppers. Drizzle some burger sauce on top and enjoy!

18129181345668421.ingredients:
1 large onion, thinly sliced
4 garlic cloves, minced
2 tbsp chili crisp
1 cup of cream or coconut milk, room temperature
1 tbsp soy sauce, optional
1/2 cup fresh Parmesan cheese, grated
8 oz (225g) pasta of your choice
2 tbsp butter
1 tbsp olive oil
Seasonings (1 tsp each): paprika, garlic powder, salt, pepper, italian seasoning
18129181345668421.method:
Slice your onion like it owes you money, mince that garlic (use fresh please), and measure out all your seasoning. Bring a cup of cream or coconut milk to room temperature.
Heat 2 tbsp butter + 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium. Add in the onions and let them vibe for 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden and jammy. If they start sticking, hit ‘em with a splash of water.
While your onions are caramelizing like sweet little angels, boil a pot of salted water and cook the pasta until al dente. Drain, but don’t forget to save some of that pasta water — it’s liquid gold.
When the onions are deeply golden, stir in your minced garlic and all the seasonings. Let it all bloom for a minute, then add the chili crisp and saute for a minute. Pour in your cream (or coconut milk). Let it simmer and get cozy for a few minutes then add the grated Parmesan cheese.
Add your pasta to the sauce and toss to coat. Use that reserved pasta water to loosen things up if it’s too thick — you’re going for silky, not sticky.
Serve hot with an extra spoon of chili crisp on top for a spicy kick and maybe a sprinkle of fresh parsley if you’re feelin’ fancy.

18011552840928557.ingredients:
Avocado oil
1 small red or white onion sliced
1 tbsp balsamic vinegar pinch of salt
2 slices of sourdough bread or bread of choice
2 tbsp softened butter mixed with cinnamon & sugar
Fig jam
Sliced figs
Shredded Gruyere cheese about 1/2 cup
Sliced havarti cheese
Fresh thyme leaves
Flaky sea salt
Hot honey
Balsamic glaze
18011552840928557.method:
In a skillet on medium heat pour in the avocado oil about 2-3 tbsp. Put the onions in with a pinch of salt & turn to medium-low. You want the onions to cook low & slow here so they release their natural sugars.
Add a splash of water if the pan seems too try & stir every few minutes. Once the onions are soft about 10 minutes pour in 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar. Mix for a couple of min then turn off heat.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Butter opposite sides of bread then flip over to spread on the fig jam. Add the shredded cheese, caramelized onions, figs, thyme, sliced havarti, sea salt, hot honey & balsamic glaze. Carefully close the sandwich & transfer to a skillet on medium heat. Press bread down with the back of the pan & cook until golden then flip & cook the other side making sure the outer bread doesn’t burn. Transfer to the oven for 5 min to make sure it’s all cheesy. Slice in half & enjoy by itself or with your fave fall soup!

18102467153309496.ingredients:
1 small Lauki/Bottle Gourd
1/4 cup Paneer, grated
2 cups Rajgira flour
1 tsp cumin seeds
Sendha Namak, to taste
Pepper, to taste
1-2 green chillies, finely chopped
2 tbsp fresh coriander, finely chopped
1 tsp ginger, finely chopped
Lauki squeezed water, if required
2 tsp oil
1 tsp cumin seeds
2 sprig curry leaves
1 green chillies, chopped
Lemon juice from 1 lemon
18102467153309496.method:
Peel and grate lauki and squeeze out the water. Add in a bowl or paraat and mix in with paneer, rajgira flour, cumin seeds, rock salt, pepper, green chillies, fresh coriander, ginger and Lauki squeezed water as required.
Knead a soft dough and shape into muthiyas. Steam for 12-15 mins and the cool it down. Cut and keep aside.
Heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds, curry leaves, green chilli and add the muthiyas. Cook for 2-3 mins, add lemon juice and enjoy.

18440478235132309.ingredients:
1 ripe pear
4 generous spoonfuls of Pecorino
80g pasta
Freshly cracked black pepper to taste

18210049489342953.ingredients:
1 ½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs (or breasts), cut into 1-inch, bite-size pieces
⅓ cup sun-dried tomatoes in oil, roughly chopped (plus 1 tablespoon of the oil)
1 tablespoon tomato paste
1 teaspoon granulated garlic
1 teaspoons dried thyme
½ teaspoon smoked paprika
1 teaspoon kosher salt, divided
¼ teaspoon black pepper
1 ½ cups orzo (dry, uncooked)
3 cups low-sodium chicken broth
⅓ cup heavy cream
⅓ cup grated Parmesan cheese
2 cups baby spinach (optional, stir in at end)

18147547492606458.ingredients:
8 medjool dates, pitted
3 tbsp raw cacao powder
3 tbsp pumpkin seeds
2 tbsp tahini
Zest of 1 orange (save a bit for topping) + 1 tbsp fresh orange juice
Pinch of sea salt
40g 85% dark chocolate, melted (for drizzling)
18147547492606458.method:
Soak dates in boiling water for a 5 minutes to soften them then drain.
Blitz everything other than the dark chocolate in a food processor
Use a silicon spatula to press the mixture into an ice-cube tray (if you don’t have one, put in the fridge to firm up then roll into balls)
Melt the dark chocolate and drizzle over the top of your tray
Top with your orange zest and pop in the freezer to firm up
Once they’re set, pop out of the trays and sprinkle with flaky sea salt
Keep in the freezer for a pick me up whenever you want!

18118256075299955.ingredients:
2 medium rice paper sheets
1 extra large egg
1/4 tsp baking powder
2 - 3 tbsp thick Greek yogurt (flavored or plain)
A small handful or blueberries
A generous amount of honey or agave
18118256075299955.method:
preheat oven to 375 F
whisk the egg and baking powder together
soak one rice paper sheet quickly in the mixture and brush off any excess. Dip another sheet in and layer it on top of the soaked rice paper sheet.
spread Greek yogurt on to the rice paper sheet, add blueberries on top, and drizzle some honey. Fold 4 sides of the pastry in.
bake the pastries at 375 F for 20-25 minutes on parchment paper or air fry for 10 minutes

18192470470392274.ingredients:
minced shrimp (save extra whole shrimp if you want to do “chips”)
minced garlic
minced ginger
minced green onion
soy sauce
mirin
rice paper
18192470470392274.method:
mix all the ingredients together - wet rice paper and add shrimp filling in a small log
roll tightly and cut into mouth sized bites
lightly spray with oil
air fryer for ~20 mins on 400F until crispy
for chips: lay one wet rice paper on a flat surface, add 4-5 whole shrimp, add another wet rice paper on top, cut as needed, lightly mist with oil and air fryer the same as shrimp rolls

17968876950176305.ingredients:
½ cup white rice
1 cup water
1 cup whole milk + more if needed
½ tsp cinnamon
⅓ cup pumpkin purée
1–2 tbsp maple syrup
½ tsp vanilla
Pinch of nutmeg, optional
17968876950176305.method:
Lightly rinse the rice and add it to a pot with the water. Cover and simmer for about 10–12 minutes, until most of the water is absorbed.
Add the milk and cinnamon and cook uncovered on low for another 10–15 minutes, stirring often, until the rice is nice and soft and creamy.
Stir in the pumpkin, vanilla and maple syrup and cook for another 3–5 minutes. Turn off the heat. Add a little more milk if you want it creamier it thicken as it cools!
For younger toddlers, you can skip the maple syrup and mash in ½ a ripe banana instead. 🍌
You can also stir in some plain Greek yogurt once it has cooled down a little for some extra creaminess + protein.
This makes about 3–4 toddler servings.
Store leftovers in the fridge for up to 3 days. Just add a splash of milk when reheating since it gets thicker in the fridge.

17927834463323006.method:
2tsp black sesame paste per batch (or adjust to your preferences)
subbed in oat milk > milk
subbed in custard powder > milk powder
added 湯圓 for fun :)
air fried at 350F for 20 min, flipping halfway through

18642728488041228.ingredients:
Apples
Puff pastry
Lemon juice
Cinnamon sugar
1 egg for egg wash
Caramel sauce
18642728488041228.method:
Slice your apples into thick rounds and cut out the centers so they look like little donuts.
Lightly spray or brush the apples with lemon juice.
Coat each apple ring in cinnamon sugar.
Cut your puff pastry into long strips and wrap the strips around each apple ring until covered.
Brush the pastry with egg wash and sprinkle with a little more cinnamon sugar.
Bake according to your puff pastry package directions until puffed and golden brown.
Drizzle with caramel and try not to eat all of them immediately. 😂

17880665484534217.ingredients:
Sourdough or any thick bread
½ cup cottage cheese
1 jalapeño (chopped, plus extra slices for topping)
¼ cup cheddar cheese, grated
2 tbsp red onion, finely sliced
17880665484534217.method:
Mix cottage cheese with chopped jalapeño, grated cheddar and red onion.
Spread onto sourdough.
Top with more cheddar and extra jalapeños.
Air fry at 180°C (370°F) for 8 min until golden, bubbly, and crisp.

18147961045558332.ingredients:
500 g small shrimp (chemmeen)
1 tsp salt
1/2 tsp turmeric powder
1 tsp Kashmiri chili powder
3/4 tsp black pepper powder
4–5 tbsp coconut oil
1/2 tsp mustard seeds
4–6 garlic cloves, crushed
10–12 shallots, thinly sliced
Curry leaves
1 tsp crushed red chili flakes
2 cups cooked rice (day-old works best)
A pinch of fenugreek seed powder (uluva podi)
18147961045558332.method:
Marinate shrimp with salt, turmeric, chili powder, and pepper. Rest 30–45 minutes.
Heat coconut oil in an iron kadai and fry shrimp for 4–5 minutes until crispy. Remove and keep aside.
Keep about 2 tbsp oil in the pan. Splutter mustard seeds, add garlic and sauté till golden.
Add shallots and cook till golden brown. Add curry leaves and chili flakes.
Add cooked rice and mix well. Add fried shrimp and toss gently.
Finish with a pinch of fenugreek powder. Serve hot and enjoy.

18134037766729935.ingredients:
1 cup oats
2 cups water, divided
2 tbs kefir
1/2 tsp sea salt
2 tbs grass fed butter
18134037766729935.method:
Soak the oats in kefir + 1 cup of water, at room temp overnight (not in the fridge!).
The next morning, boil one cup of water. Add salt and butter until melted. Add the oats and stir, reduce to a simmer and simmer for ~10 minutes, until you have perfectly creamy oatmeal

17993333604049739.ingredients:
¾ cup milk of your choice
1 tbsp black sesame paste @clearspringuk
1 tsp honey
Pinch of fleur de sel
A little vanilla paste or extract
¼ cup hot water
17993333604049739.method:
Mix ¼ tbsp black sesame paste with the hot water until smooth.
Add the milk, remaining ¾ tbsp black sesame paste, honey, fleur de sel and vanilla to a frother @nespresso @nespresso.uk and froth until creamy.
Pour over the sesame mixture and top with black sesame seeds

18028712588909488.ingredients:
eggs (weigh these first in the shell)
flour (self raising OR plain with 5g baking powder per 100g)
sugar
butter
1tsp vanilla extract
18028712588909488.method:
Combine all ingredients a bowl until smooth
Top with a couple tablespoons of jam or golden syrup
Microwave until the batter stops growing and is just slightly shiny on top. Start with 2.5 minutes and burst for 30 seconds at a time until cooked. Keep an eye on it while cooking.
Leave to stand for 5 minutes while you whip up some @birdsinstantcustard for the most authentic experience

18023904332877228.ingredients:
Glutinous rice flour- 45g
Corn starch- 10g
@naturescharm Ube condensed coconut milk- 1/4 cup
Water- 2 tablespoons
Coconut oil- 1 teaspoon
18023904332877228.method:
In a non stick pan, Add all the ingredients and mix until it’s combined well.
Place the pan on the stove and cook the mixture on medium heat while stirring it constantly with a non stick spatula.
Cook it until a soft dough is formed.
Remove from the heat and let it cool for 5 minutes.
While it’s still warm, use hand gloves and knead the mochi by stretching it. Knead it until it becomes stretchy.
Divide it into small balls and coat them with corn starch to prevent sticking. Dust off the excess corn starch.
Dip the mochi balls in coconut condensed milk and cookie crumbs/ desiccated coconut flakes.

18047937671811596.ingredients:
1 lb boneless chickens breast
1 tsp salt
1/2 tsp black pepper
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp onion powder
1/2 tsp paprika powder
1 bay leaf
1 black cardamom
1 clove garlic, smashed
2 cups water
Boiled and shredded chicken
8oz cream cheese, softened
1/2 cups green onion, finely chopped
1 tbsp fresh garlic, finely chopped
1/2 cups freshly grated parmesan cheese
Salt to taste
1/2 tsp black pepper
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp onion powder
1 tsp smoked paprika powder
1/2 tbsp red chili flakes
1/2 tsp Italian seasoning
1 tsp parsley, freshly chopped
2 tsp lemon juice
Wonton wrappers
1/3 cups water water
Oil (for frying)
1/2 cups mayonnaise
1/4 cup sour cream
1/3 cup freshly grated Parmesan
1 small garlic clove, finely grated
1 tbsp lemon juice
1 tsp Dijon mustard
1/2 tsp garlic powder
1/4 tsp black pepper
1–2 tbsp milk or heavy cream, to thin
Salt to taste
18047937671811596.method:
Add chicken, seasonings, bay leaf, cardamom, garlic, and water to a pot. Bring to a gentle boil, reduce to medium-low, cover, and simmer 15–18 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F. Remove, cool slightly, and finely shred.
Mix the shredded chicken with cream cheese, green onion, garlic, Parmesan, seasonings, parsley, and lemon juice until well combined. Taste and adjust salt.
For the sauce, mix mayonnaise, sour cream, Parmesan, garlic, lemon juice, Dijon, garlic powder, and black pepper. Add 1–2 tbsp milk or heavy cream until creamy and your desired consistency. Adjust salt and refrigerate.
Place about 1 tbsp filling in the center of each wonton wrapper. Lightly wet the edges with water, fold over, and press firmly to seal. Bring the two outer corners together for a classic rangoon shape.
Heat 2–3 inches of neutral oil to 350°F. Fry wontons in batches for 2–3 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden and crispy. Transfer to a wire rack or paper towel-lined plate and allow the oil to return to 350°F before the next batch.
Serve immediately with the Garlic Parmesan sauce and garnish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan.

17991654360005654.ingredients:
1 bowl of instant oats
2 tablespoon chia seeds
1 whole mashed ripe banana
1 whole egg
1 tablespoon peanut butter
1 scoop protein powder (optional)
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
2 tablespoon unsweetened dark cocoa powder
1/2 teaspoon baking powder and pinch of salt
1 cup milk of choice
Garnish banana slices and dark chocolate chunks
17991654360005654.method: Mix everything together add the toppings and bake in the oven for 15 mins at 160°C

17996746350033180.ingredients:
1 cup bone broth
1 cup COOKED white rice/ or 40g instant oats
17996746350033180.method:
pop into microwave for 1.5 mins or simmer on low for 15 mins or until desired consistency
top w/ 2 soft boiled eggs, green onion, mushrooms, some soy sauce or salt + pepper

18127206334867428.ingredients:
2 cups of short or medium grain white rice, rinsed
1 to 2 boneless salmon fillet
4 tbsp of soy sauce
2 tbsp of mirin
1/2 cup of Asparagus, thinly chopped
2 cups of mushrooms, I used beech and shiitake
3 tbsp of furikake
2 tbsp of sesame oil
water, slightly below the 2 cup line as mushrooms will release water
Optional: 1 seafood stock powder or coin, crushed or dashi powder
18127206334867428.method:
Thoroughly rinse your short-grain rice until the water turns clear. Place the rinsed rice into the inner pot of your rice cooker and fill the water to right below the 2 cup line - you want to add a little less water as cooking mushrooms will release water.
Add soy sauce, mirin, and seafood stock or dashi powder and give it a good mix. Then add chopped asparagus, salmon fillet, and mushrooms and cook on your normal white rice setting.
When rice is done cooking, open the lid and give it a good mix while fluffing your rice and flaking the salmon. You can also remove the skin. Then add furikake, sesame oil and extra salt as needed.
Top with green onions and sesame seeds and serve with miso soup or you can also make it into an ongiri and serve! Enjoy!

18115849960856721.ingredients:
5 to 6 frozen dumplings (potstickers or gyoza)
1/2 cup chopped bok choy
1/4 cup canned full-fat coconut milk (add 1/2 cup if you want it more brothy)
2 tbsp Trader Joe’s Thai red curry sauce
1 tbsp Trader Joe’s Soyaki sauce
Chili crunch, for topping @momofukugoods
Fresh cilantro, chopped, for topping
Green onion, for topping
18115849960856721.method:
Preheat oven to 375°F.
Lightly spray 4 individual glass meal prep containers.
Add 1/2 cup bok choy to the bottom of each container.
In each container, pour in 1/4 cup coconut milk, 2 tbsp red curry sauce, and 1 tbsp soyaki (or substitute).
Stir gently to coat the bok choy.
Layer 5 to 6 frozen dumplings on top.
Cover containers tightly with foil or lids.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until dumplings are tender and sauce is bubbling.
Remove foil, then top with chili crunch, cilantro, and green onion.
Microwave 1 to 2 minutes, covered.
Stir gently before eating to coat dumplings in sauce.

18112543945957051.ingredients:
2 rice cups (1 japanese rice cup = 180 mL) Japanese short-grain rice
200g chicken thigh
1/4 cup frozen edamame
1/4 carrot, julienned
1/2 pack shiitake mushrooms
1/2 tsp salt
2 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp sake
2 tbsp mirin
2 tsp hondashi
18112543945957051.method: Add water as directed by rice cooker after adding the seasonings

17961009921138349.ingredients:
1 tbsp olive oil
1 potato
2 eggs
1/2 cup cheddar cheese
Salt and pepper
17961009921138349.method:
On a medium heat add the oil to a non stick pan and slice the potato with a peeler and form a thin layer. Add salt. When the edges turn golden and crispy, flip the potatoes over. Break eggs on them. Add black pepper and salt. Let it cook for a minute.
Add the cheese and cover until cheese has melted. Fold the omelet. Slice and serve.

18071464901774940.ingredients:
2 eggs
1 grated courgette with liquid squeezed out
1 cup cheddar cheese, grated
1 cup self raising flour
1tsp baking powder
1/2 cup of milk
18071464901774940.method:
grate your courgette and squeeze out the excess liquid
add all your ingredients to a bowl and mix well (I also added 1tsp of salt and some black pepper at this point)
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 35-45 minutes or until golden and cooked through.

18102354902202181.ingredients:
8 medjool dates, pitted (if you can’t find medjool get large ones and pre-soak)
3 tbsp cacao powder
3 tbsp black sesame paste (or black tahini)
50g cashews
30g oats
100g 85% dark chocolate
1 tsp coconut oil (optional)
Pinch flaky sea salt
Sesame seeds to top
18102354902202181.method:
Blend together dates, cacao, black sesame tahini, cashews, oats and 25g of the dark chocolate
Press mixture into ice cube tray (I used one with 24 mini cubes). If you don’t have one then press into the base of a small baking tin
Melt remaining 75g dark chocolate with 1 tsp coconut oil (optional but makes the topping a bit softer)
Pour over the black sesame base and top with black sesame seeds and a sprinkle of flaky salt then put in the fridge to set solid
Once they’re set they’re ready to eat!

17906556261554915.ingredients:
1 ½ cups all-purpose flour
¼ cup cocoa powder (Dutch-process is preferred)
1 teaspoon baking soda
¼ teaspoon baking powder
½ teaspoon kosher salt
½ cup coconut sugar
⅓ cup coconut oil (softened but not melted)
¼ cup runny tahini
⅓ cup 2% plain Greek yogurt
1 large egg
2 teaspoons vanilla extract
1 teaspoon instant espresso powder
½ cup semi-sweet chocolate chips
½ cup chopped dark chocolate
Flaky sea salt (for finishing)
17906556261554915.method:
Preheat the oven to 350°F and line a baking sheet with parchment. In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, baking powder and salt. In a separate large bowl, beat the softened coconut oil and coconut sugar until well combined and slightly fluffy. Mix in the tahini, Greek yogurt, egg, vanilla and espresso powder until smooth. Combine ingredients and don’t over mix!!!
Scoop the dough into roughly 2-tablespoon portions, flatten lightly with your fingers. These spread a little during baking time. Press a few extra pieces of chopped chocolate into the tops. Bake for 9–11 minutes, or until the edges are puffed and set but the centers still look slightly soft and underdone. Don’t wait for the centers to look completely baked. Sprinkle immediately with flaky sea salt and enjoy!!

18107170925112501.ingredients:
2pcs quarter fillet or 3pcs chicken thigh fillet
1 tbsp soy sauce
½ tbsp oyster sauce
1 tbsp garlic powder
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp pepper
6 garlic cloves, minced
1 ½ tbsp Butter
1 tbsp Soy sauce
1 ½  tbsp honey
3 tbsp cornstarch + ½ tsp baking powder
18107170925112501.method:
Air fry for 10 mins or until garlic is cooked and fragrant
Air fry chicken (skin side down) for 8 mins, flip, then air for another 8 mins or until chicken is golden, crispy, and cooked through.
Temp: 190c

17979402428904175.ingredients:
500g chicken thighs, bite-sized (breast or a mix of both also works)
2 tbsp white miso
2 tbsp honey
1.5 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tsp fresh ginger, grated
2 garlic cloves, minced
1–2 tbsp water
1 tsp sesame oil, optional
black pepper
green onion, optional
17979402428904175.method:
mix all the marinade ingredients together.
add the chicken and coat well. Marinate for at least 30 minutes, or overnight for more flavour.
heat a pan over medium-high heat and add the marinated chicken. If using chicken thighs, you don’t need to add extra oil, let the chicken render its own fat as it cooks.
cook until the chicken is cooked through, then let the sauce caramelise around the chicken. Avoid very high heat as the honey and miso can burn.
season with black pepper and top with green onion, if using.

17957893059236810.ingredients:
Zucchini
Edamame
Ragi flour
All-purpose flour
Olive oil
Red pepper flakes
Red chilli powder
Dried basil
Salt
17957893059236810.method:
Boil the zucchini and edamame until tender and blend them into a smooth paste. Save that cooking water!
Mix ragi flour and all-purpose flour with salt, then gradually add the zucchini-edamame paste to form a soft dough. I did not use any water to knead, just the paste.
Roll into tiny balls and press the center to make little button shapes, almost like making tiny dhoklis!
Boil the buttons in the same reserved veggie water until cooked.
For the sauce, heat a little olive oil with red pepper flakes, red chilli powder and basil. Add the remaining zucchini-edamame paste and cook it down until creamy.
Toss in the cooked button noodles and let everything come together. Finish with a drizzle of olive oil, chilli flakes and basil.

18130625350740791.ingredients:
2 lb ground pork
2 tsp kosher salt
1 tbsp paprika
1–2 tsp ancho or regular chili powder
2 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp onion powder
1 tsp cumin
1 tsp dried oregano
1/2 tsp ground coriander
1 tbsp tomato paste
1/3 cup water
3 cups shredded Mexican-style cheese
30–35 tortillas, preferably a corn/masa + flour blend
1 egg + 1 tbsp water
Oil spray
18130625350740791.method:
Brown the pork over medium-high heat, breaking into small crumbles. Add salt and spices, cook 30–60 seconds.
Stir in tomato paste, cook 30 seconds, then add the water. Simmer until mostly cooked down and moist but not wet.
Off heat, sprinkle cheese evenly over the pork. Let sit a few minutes so it melts and binds the filling.
Wrap tortillas in a damp towel and microwave about 2 minutes until soft and pliable. Keep covered while you work.
Whisk the egg with 1 tbsp water. Add 2–3 tbsp filling to each tortilla with a slotted spoon, letting excess grease drip off. Roll tightly, brush the final edge with egg wash, and seal.
Place seam-side down on a sheet pan and freeze about 2 hours until firm. Transfer to a freezer bag. Freeze up to 3 months.
Preheat to 350°F for 2 minutes. Spray taquitos lightly with oil and cook 5 minutes. Flip, spray again, and cook another 5–7 minutes, until crisp, golden, and heated through.

18614376961006915.ingredients:
Almond flour — 150g (approx. 1.5 cups)
Cocoa powder — 30g (approx. 1/3 cup)
Sugar-free maple syrup — 30g (approx. 2 tbsp)
Coconut oil — 20ml (approx. 1.3 tbsp)
Unsweetened almond milk — 3 tbsp
Vanilla extract — 5ml (approx. 1 tsp)
Light cream cheese — 250g (approx. 1 cup)
Sweetener — 10g (approx. 2 tsp)
Vanilla extract — 1 tbsp (approx. 15ml)
Lemon juice — a squeeze
Cocoa powder — 40g (approx. 2/5 cup / ~5 tbsp)
Sugar-free maple syrup — 20g (approx. 1.3 tbsp)
Coconut oil — 1 tbsp (approx. 15ml)
Unsweetened almond milk — 2 tbsp
18614376961006915.method:
Brownie Base: Mix the base ingredients together, press into a lined tray, and freeze for 10 minutes.
Cheesecake Layer: Mix the cheesecake ingredients together, spread over the base, and freeze for 45 minutes.
Chocolate Topping: Mix the topping ingredients together, spread over the top layer, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Slice into 6 decent-sized bars and enjoy.

18111619552980030.ingredients:
300 grams cauliflower florets, approx. 3 cups, cut into 1 inch size florets
1 ½ teaspoons ginger garlic paste
⅛ teaspoon turmeric powder
1 tablespoon + ¾ teaspoon kashmiri chilli powder
¾ teaspoon coriander powder
¼ teaspoon cumin powder
¾ teaspoon salt
¾ teaspoon sugar
2 sprigs curry leaves, finely chopped
2 ¼ tablespoons curds / yoghurt, whisked
3 tablespoons maida
1 ½ tablespoons corn flour
1 ½ teaspoons groundnut oil or any neutral cooking oil
1 tablespoon water
2 tablespoons groundnut oil or any neutral cooking oil, divided
1 teaspoon finely chopped garlic
1 teaspoon finely chopped ginger
2 green chillies, halved
½ teaspoon kashmiri chilli powder
¼ teaspoon fennel powder
2 sprigs curry leaves

17976240278917437.ingredients:
Plain Greek yogurt (high-protein / 0%) — 1 cup (approx. 225g)
Large egg — 1 egg
Honey — 2 tbsp (approx. 30g)
Vanilla extract — 1/2 tsp
Salt — A tiny pinch
17976240278917437.method:
Mix everything really well together in a bowl until completely smooth.
Pour the mixture into a lightly greased small ramekin or oven-safe dish.
Bake at 325°F (approx. 165°C) for 20 minutes. The edges should be set while the center still has a slight jiggle.
Let it cool completely, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours (overnight is even better) to firm up and get that cold, creamy cheesecake texture.
Top with fresh berries and enjoy!

18093308912080681.ingredients:
½ cup California walnuts, toasted and cooled
¼ cup cilantro, tender leaves and stems
1 tbsp chili oil
1 tbsp soy sauce
2 cloves garlic
2 tsp sesame oil
½ a lime, juiced
2 tsp honey
Pinch of salt
6 carrots
18093308912080681.method:
Chop the walnuts into bite size pieces, toast them on a skillet carefully on low heat until they are fragrant then let them cool.
Add walnuts, cilantro, chili oil, garlic, sesame oil, lime juice, honey and salt into a small food processor and pulse until the everything looks like a uniform crumble. This will resemble a thicker pesto vs a typical dressing. Set aside.
Wash the carrots & peel off the outer skin.  Use a vegetable peeler to create ribbons and place into a large mixing bowl.
Add the walnut mixture to the carrot ribbons and toss gently with your hands. Taste and adjust (you can add more chili oil for spice or a squeeze more lime for more acidity).
Serve immediately for the crunchiest texture but it will keep well for a few days in the fridge as it softens slightly.

18116160334764249.ingredients: For the chicken, mix minced chicken with finely chopped onion, crushed garlic and green chillies, then season with salt, pepper, chilli powder, chilli flakes, lemon juice, and fresh coriander. Feel free to add any other spices you like.
18116160334764249.method:
For the chicken, mix minced chicken with finely chopped onion, crushed garlic and green chillies, then season with salt, pepper, chilli powder, chilli flakes, lemon juice, and fresh coriander. Feel free to add any other spices you like.
For the coleslaw, shred some cabbage and carrots and mix with mayo or greek yogurt, salt, pepper and a little lemon juice.
Take a tortilla (homemade version recipe is in the pinned comment) or chapati and spread the chicken evenly over one side. Place it chicken-side down on a hot pan and cook for 2–3 mins. Flip and cook until the tortilla is crispy, then add cheese, fold and let it cook until the cheese melts. Top with the coleslaw and you’re done!

18107810747582247.ingredients:
2 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces
Salt to taste
1 tsp black pepper
1 tbsp garlic powder
1 tsp onion powder
2 tsp paprika powder
1/2 tsp cumin powder
1 tbsp lemon juice
1 tbsp oil (for marinating)
1 small yellow onion, diced
1 red bell pepper, diced
2 tbsp oil for cooking
1 tbsp butter
1 tbsp garlic, minced
1 1/2 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream
1 tbsp cream cheese
Salt to taste
1/2 tsp black pepper
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp red chili flakes
1 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated
1 tsp parsley , finely chopped
9-10 small flour tortilla wraps
1 cup mozzarella cheese
Oil for pan frying
18107810747582247.method:
Season chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cumin, lemon juice, and oil. Mix well.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken until fully cooked and lightly golden. Add diced onion and bell pepper and sauté for 2–3 minutes until softened. Set aside.
For the sauce, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds. Add heavy cream, cream cheese, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and red chili flakes. Whisk until smooth and simmer until slightly thickened.
Lower the heat and stir in Parmesan until melted and smooth. Turn off the heat and add parsley.
Reserve half the sauce for dipping and mix the remaining half with the chicken. Let cool slightly.
Add a few spoonfuls of filling to each tortilla and sprinkle with mozzarella. Fold in the sides and roll tightly.
Lightly oil a skillet over medium to medium-low heat. Place rolls seam-side down and cook, turning until golden and crispy on all sides. Add more oil as needed. Avoid high heat so the tortilla doesn’t brown before the cheese melts.
Sprinkle with fresh parsley and Parmesan and serve immediately with the reserved garlic Parmesan dipping sauce.

18085625447218082.ingredients:
2 cups rice, rinsed
2 cups water
2 tbsp mirin
2 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp sesame oil
½ onion, sliced
3 chicken thighs
3 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp mirin
3 tbsp minced garlic
Salt and black pepper
18085625447218082.method:
I marinated the chicken for about 20 minutes to maximize flavor, but if you don’t have time, just adjust the seasoning at the end with extra salt or soy sauce.
Add the rice, water, mirin, soy sauce, sesame oil, and sliced onion to your rice cooker. Place the chicken thighs on top and cook on the regular white rice setting.
Once everything is done and the chicken is fully cooked, cut it into smaller pieces. Add ginger scallion sauce, mix it all together, and serve.

18431132914183059.ingredients:
3 cups almond flour
1 cup tahini (make sure it’s made of 100% sesame)
1/2 cup pure maple syrup or raw honey
1/2 teaspoon baking soda
sprinkle of sea salt
Optional: sesame seeds for topping
18431132914183059.method:
Preheat oven to 350 F
Mix all ingredients in a bowl until it looks like cookie dough (if it feels too crumbly then add some more tahini)
Shape into balls and place on parchment-lined baking sheet
Press them down with your fingers or a fork and top with sesame seeds if using
Bake for 7 minutes

17946812655313643.ingredients:
Chicken thighs, about 300g, cut into small pieces
A handful of Thai basil 🌿 (or any basil)
Soy sauce, about 1 tsp (Lee Kum Kee)
Sesame oil, about 1 tsp (Ottogi)
White pepper powder, about ¼ tsp
Potato starch, about 1 tsp
3 cloves garlic, minced
Minced ginger, about 1 tbsp
3 shallots, sliced
¼ onion, chopped
Doubanjiang, 1 tsp (Lee Kum Kee)
White miso, 1 tsp (Hikari)
Soy sauce, about 1 tsp (Lee Kum Kee)
Sweet soy sauce, about 1 tsp (Lee Kum Kee)

17893365327673401.ingredients:
400g soaked chickpeas (soaked weight)
3 tbsp peanut butter
1.5 tbsp honey
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
30g dark chocolate chips
17893365327673401.method:
Blend everything nicely until smooth.
Mix the chocolate chips in nicely.
Now divide the mixture and shape it into 10 cookies.
Air fry at 170°C for 12 min.
Take them out, let them cool slightly and they’re ready to serve!

18114000817819153.ingredients:
1 tbsp ghee
1/2 cup coconut (desiccated)
1/2 cup jaggery (crushed)
12 rice paper rolls
250 mls coconut milk
1.5 tbsp sugar
Saffron strands soaked in 2 tsp water
2 tbsp cornflour slurry

17987415764860202.ingredients:
4 tbsp Sriracha
3 tbsp Light Soy Sauce
2 tsp Dark Soy Sauce
1 tbsp Honey
1 tbsp Rice Vinegar
Sprinkle of Red Chilli Flakes (optional)
2 Garlic Cloves ~grated
2 tsp Ginger Paste
75ml Water

18354951898216641.ingredients:
2 large ripe bananas, mashed (about 1 cup) and 1 more on the top(optional g
½ cup cottage cheese (blend until creamy if desired)
2 eggs
¼ cup maple syrup( sugar free) or honey
¼ cup unsweetened almond milk (or any milk)
1 tsp vanilla extract
1½ cups whole wheat pastry flour or gluten-free all-purpose flour
½ cup almond flour
1 tsp baking powder
½ tsp baking soda
½ tsp cinnamon
pinch of salt
optional: ⅓ cup dark chocolate chips or chopped walnuts
18354951898216641.method:
In a large bowl, mix mashed bananas, cottage cheese, eggs, maple syrup, almond milk, and vanilla.
In a separate bowl, combine flour, almond flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt.
Gradually fold dry ingredients into wet ingredients until just combined — don’t overmix.
Fold in chocolate chips or nuts if using.
Pour batter into a loaf pan and bake for 55-65 minutes 350 F, until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

18096977915072025.ingredients:
1 tbsp ghee
3 cloves
3 small cinnamon sticks
2 cardamom
1 inch ginger (10g), finely chopped
4 cloves garlic, finely chopped
2 sliced green chillies
400g chicken mince
1 boiled onion
10 boiled almonds (remove the skin after boiling)
2 tbsp yogurt
1 tsp cumin powder
1 tsp coriander powder
1 tsp garam masala
1 tsp black pepper
1 tsp salt
200ml warm water
1 tbsp fresh cream
1 tsp Kasuri methi
A handful of coriander
18096977915072025.method:
Let this fry for a minute.
Now add 400g chicken mince and cook on high flame for 5 minutes.
Blend it into a smooth paste and add it to the chicken.
Mix everything nicely and let it cook for 10 minutes.
Then add 200ml warm water and mix well.
Cover and bring the flame to low.
10 minutes later, remove the lid and add
Give it one final mix and it’s ready to serve! 🤌

18091029638439045.ingredients:
blend 16oz tub cottage cheese (@good_culture or @nancysyogurt)
add 4 eggs, 1 tsp vanilla, 2 tsp honey
mix 1 1/4 c flour w/ 1 tbs baking powder
18091029638439045.method:
blend 16oz tub cottage cheese (@good_culture or @nancysyogurt)
add 4 eggs, 1 tsp vanilla, 2 tsp honey
mix 1 1/4 c flour w/ 1 tbs baking powder
then add all together and fry on a buttered pan

18107609675111917.ingredients:
500 g chicken, cubed
Salt, to taste
2 tbsp all-purpose flour
2 tbsp corn flour
1 egg
1 chicken stock cube, optional
18107609675111917.method:
Marinate everything together and keep aside for 15 minutes. Deep fry the chicken until golden and crisp.
Heat a little oil in a kadai. Add finely chopped garlic, green chillies and curry leaves. Sauté on high flame.
Add about ½ cup cream and sauté well.
Add 1 cup finely chopped fresh coriander leaves and toss on high flame. Check and adjust the salt.
Add the fried chicken and 1 cube of butter. Toss everything together until well coated.
Serve hot! 🤌🏻💚

17906281326551630.ingredients:
1 lb skinless, boneless, chicken thighs, raw
1/2 tsp white pepper
1 tsp Chinese five spice powder
1.5 tbsp minced garlic
1 tbsp minced ginger
1 tbsp Shaoxing wine
2 tbsp soy sauce
3/4 cup coarse potato starch
1 egg (egg white only, no yolk)
1 second spray cooking oil
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 tsp five spice powder
1/2 tsp brown sugar
1/2 tsp white pepper
1 cup Thai basil
17906281326551630.method:
Dice your chicken thighs into small 1 inch pieces.
In a bowl, mix together white pepper, Chinese 5 spice powder, minced garlic, minced ginger, Shaoxing wine, soy sauce, and the egg white of an egg (no yolk) to make your marinade.
Add your chicken pieces into the marinade and set aside for 30 minutes or overnight in the refrigerator.
Pour your potato starch onto a plate and fully coat your chicken pieces into the potato starch.
Coat your air fryer tray with spray oil, place your chicken coated with potato starch into the tray, and lightly spray your chicken with more oil.
Cook in your air fryer at 390°F for 13-15 minutes, flipping halfway through or until crispy and golden brown.
Add in your Thai basil on top of the cooked chicken and air fryer for another 2-3 minutes.
In a bowl, mix together salt, 5 spice powder, brown sugar, and white pepper and sprinkle the seasoning mix on top of your cooked chicken and enjoy!

18107687480597529.ingredients:
1 cup full-fat @good_culture cottage cheese
1/2 cup cocoa powder
3 Medjool dates, pitted
1/4 cup almond milk
Pinch of flaky sea salt
18107687480597529.method:
add all ingredients to a food processor.
blend until extra smooth + creamy.
serve chilled with greek yogurt, chocolate chips, fresh raspberries or a little flaky sea salt on top.

18084936140689475.ingredients:
2 chicken legs + 2 chicken thighs
20 g ginger
25 g scallions
15 g coriander
1–2 whole red chillies
1 tbsp chilli oil
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp oyster sauce
½ tsp white pepper
Salt, to taste
Cooked rice
Half cube of Stock
18084936140689475.method:
Place an inverted small bowl inside a larger bowl and arrange the chicken over it. Add ginger, scallions and red chilli.
Place the bowl in a water bath, cover and steam for 15–20 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely chop ginger, scallions and coriander and mix with chilli oil.
Remove the chicken, then carefully take out the inverted bowl and save those juices — that's the liquid gold. Shred the chicken into strips.
Add 100Mls of hot water and mix it with half a cube of stock and mix it well in the broth.
Mix the flavour bomb with salt, white pepper, soy sauce and oyster sauce. Add the shredded chicken and finish with the hot broth.
Serve over hot rice and enjoy! 🍗🔥

17950369476257666.ingredients:
2 big scoops of Greek yog
2 tbsp of runny tahini (@belazu_co is the best)
a drizzle of runny honey
2tbsp of chopped toasted hazelnuts
Fruit optional (sometimes I added quince/berries/apple)
17950369476257666.method: Add the Greek yoghurt to a bowl & drizzle the tahini and honey on top. Top with the hazelnuts and if you like, some fruit!

18220256359337219.ingredients:
500g thick Greek yoghurt
2–3 tbsp honey, plus more to taste
200g Medjool dates, pitted
1 tbsp tahini
Pinch of salt
Extra caramelised dates
Extra virgin olive oil
Flaky salt
18220256359337219.method:
Mix the Greek yoghurt with the honey. Spread in a relatively thin, even layer over a lined baking tray or dish, then freeze for around 2–3 hours, or until completely firm.
Meanwhile, halve the dates. Warm some olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat, then add the dates and cook for a few minutes, until soft, sticky and beginning to caramelise. Remove from the heat and allow to cool completely.
Set aside a few of the caramelised dates for serving, then add the rest to a high-powered blender or food processor with the tahini and a small pinch of salt. Blitz until a crumb is formed.
Break the frozen yoghurt into shards and add to the blender. Blitz until thick, smooth and creamy, but with little pieces of caramelised date still running throughout. You may need to stop and scrape down the sides a few times.
Taste and adjust with a little extra honey or salt if needed, then spoon into a freezer-safe dish. Cover and freeze for another 1-2 hours, or until firm but scoopable.
Scoop into bowls and serve with a couple of extra caramelised dates, a good glug of olive oil and a pinch of flaky salt.

18100008829756505.ingredients:
1 cup broccoli florets
½ cup hung curd
1 tsp ginger–garlic paste
1 tsp crushed green chillies
2 tsp cornflour
2 tsp mozzarella cheese (grated)
1 tsp lemon juice
2 tsp fresh cream
½ tsp black pepper powder
1 tsp chaat masala
½ tsp salt (or to taste)
1 tsp kasuri methi (crushed)
1 tsp chilli flakes
1 tsp oregan
18100008829756505.method:
Step 1: In a bowl, mix all the ingredients to make a smooth marinade.
Step 2: Add the broccoli florets and coat them evenly with the marinade.
Step 3: Preheat the air fryer and cook at 180°C for 10–12 minutes.
Step 4: Once soft and lightly golden, remove from the air fryer.
Step 5: Serve hot and enjoy your Creamy & Healthy Malai Broccoli

18116837512934008.ingredients:
1/3 cup brown sugar (you can use white sugar)
1 cup flour (you can use gf flour)
1 tsp baking powder
1/3 cup cocoa
Pinch of salt
1 egg (or 1 flax egg/ grated apple)
1/2 cup milk (use any milk you like)
3 tbsp oil or melted butter
1/4 cup cocoa powder
3/4 cup brown sugar
2 cups boiling water
18116837512934008.method:
Heat oven to 180 degrees celcius.
Mix together sugar, flour, baking powder, cocoa, and salt.
Add in the egg, milk and oil and stir until combined.
Place in an oven proof dish.
In another bowl combine the cocoa and sugar. Sprinkle over the top of the batter.
Pour over the hot water.
Bake for around 35 minutes - the cake should rise to the top and the sauce will be underneath! Serve hot! You can also reheat this ❤️

18443398966126562.ingredients:
250 g / 9 oz ready cooked udon noodles
50 g / 1 3/4 oz smooth peanut butter
1 tbsp white miso
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp rice vinegar
2 tbsp lime juice
2 tsp honey or maple syrup
1 tsp fresh ginger, grated
70 to 100 ml / 2 1/2 to 3 1/2 fl oz warm water
400 g / 14 oz lean ground chicken breast
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 garlic cloves, grated
1 tsp fresh ginger, grated
1 tbsp gochujang
1 tbsp reduced sodium soy sauce
2 tsp rice vinegar
2 tsp honey or brown sugar
1/2 to 1 tsp chili flakes
300 g / 10 1/2 oz cabbage, finely shredded
1 large cucumber, about 300 g / 10 1/2 oz, thinly sliced
4 scallions, sliced
20 g / 3/4 oz cilantro, chopped
10 g / 1/3 oz mint, torn
Juice of 1/2 lime
2 tsp rice vinegar
Pinch sea salt
25 g / 1 oz roasted walnuts, crushed
Extra cilantro, mint, lime and chili flakes
18443398966126562.method:
Whisk peanut butter, miso, soy, vinegar, lime, honey and ginger with 70 ml / 2 1/2 fl oz warm water until glossy, adding more water if needed.
Combine cabbage, cucumber and scallions. Keep herbs, lime, vinegar and salt separate until serving.
Mix garlic, ginger, gochujang, soy, vinegar, honey, chili and pepper. Heat oil in a wide skillet, press chicken into a thin layer and leave untouched 2-3 minutes until deeply golden.
Break up chicken, cook 2 to 3 minutes more, then add the gochujang mixture and toss 1 to 2 minutes until sticky and caramelized.
Prepare udon according to package directions, drain, then toss in the same skillet with peanut sauce for 1-2 minutes until glossy.
Toss slaw with herbs, lime, vinegar and salt. Divide noodles between bowls, top with chicken and slaw, then finish with peanuts, herbs, chili and lime.

18102979451524423.ingredients:
3 portions of knife cut noodles
200g prawns
Greens ends of 4 bunches of green onions/scallions
4 tbsp of minced ginger
2 tbsp dark soy
2 tbsp sweet soy (kecap manis)
1 packet of ramen seasoning of your choice (or bullion seasoning)
150ml sesame oil
18102979451524423.method:
Heat up water in a pot until it starts boiling. Add in your noodles and cook until softened.
Heat a pan under a medium flame and add in sesame oil. Once it’s hot, add your scallions and ginger. Cook until slightly charred.
Add in your shrimp, cook until pink (2-3 mins) then add your dark soy, sweet soy and ramen seasoning.
Add in your noodles, mix and garnish with some chopped scallions.

17972055581934609.ingredients:
175 g / ¾ cup Greek yogurt
1 garlic clove, minced
Juice of ½ lemon
2–3 tbsp olive oil
A small bunch of parsley, chopped
Salt and pepper
2 soft-boiled eggs, halved
½ avocado, sliced
5–6 cherry tomatoes, halved
20 g / 1½ tbsp butter
1 tsp paprika
½ tsp chilli flakes
1 tsp turmeric, optional
17972055581934609.method:
Mix the yogurt with the garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, parsley, salt and pepper. Spread it over a plate, then add the eggs, avocado and tomatoes.
Melt the butter over low heat. Add the paprika, chilli flakes and turmeric, then let the spices gently infuse for 1–2 minutes without burning.
Drizzle the warm spiced butter over everything and serve with plenty of bread for dipping.

17918026740404302.ingredients:

meanwhile, place the raspberries, lemon juice, chia seeds and honey in a small saucepan and place on a medium to high heat.
as soon as the raspberries begin to thaw and release their juices, lower the heat and keep stirring until you form a jam. remove from the heat.

begin to assemble your yogurt bowl by placing your yogurt of choice first and make a small well in the centre.

Bring a small pot of water to a boil. Carefully lower in 2 eggs and cook for 6½ to 7 minutes for jammy yolks. Transfer immediately to an ice bath, peel, and cut in half.

18158261830458221.ingredients:
Filling:
1 lb. Ground Chicken (96% lean, not fat free)
8 oz. Peeled and Deveined Shrimp, diced small
1/2 Cup Red Cabbage, finely chopped
1/2 Cup Carrot, finely chopped
3 Scallions, sliced

1+1/2 tsp Kosher Salt
1/2 tsp Pepper
1 Egg
Sauce:
1/4 Cup Warm Water
1 Tbsp Fish Sauce
1 Tbsp Sugar
1 Tbsp Fresh Lime Juice
1 Tbsp Finely Chopped Carrot
1 Tbsp Finely Chopped Fresh Cilantro
Dumplings:
16-18 Sheets Rice Paper
2 Tbsp Neutral Oil, plus more as needed
18158261830458221.method:
1. In a large bowl, add all the ingredients for the dumpling filling and mix.
2. In a small bowl, add all the ingredients for the sauce. Mix until the sugar dissolves and set aside.
3. Fill a pie dish (or large bowl) with warm water and line a cutting board with damp paper towels. Working one sheet at a time, soak the rice paper in the water for 10 to 15 seconds (it will continue to soften as you work), then place it on the paper towel-lined cutting board. Add about 3 Tbsp of filling to the bottom third of the rice paper and spread it into a rectangle, leaving room along the sides and bottom edge. Fold the bottom edge up over the filling and roll once more so the filling is fully enclosed. Fold in the sides, then continue rolling until sealed. Repeat with the remaining rice paper and filling.
4. In a large nonstick skillet, heat 2 Tbsp oil over medium heat. Working in batches, add the rolls to the skillet, rubbing the bottoms in the oil and leaving space between each. Cook until golden brown on the first side, 5 to 7 mins. Flip and cook on the second side until golden brown and the internal temperature reaches 165°F, 2 to 4 mins more. Transfer to a plate and repeat with the remaining rolls, adding more oil as needed. The rolls may cook faster as the skillet heats up, so check the bottoms frequently to monitor their progress.
5. Serve with sauce spooned on top and enjoy!

18000168428791446.method:
1. Prepare the chillies
Remove the stems from the dried chillies. Remove most of the seeds if you don’t want it extremely spicy.
Cover with boiling water and soak for 15–20 minutes until softened.
Drain thoroughly, but keep a little soaking water aside.
2. Toast the spices
Add the coriander seeds, cumin seeds and shah jeera to a dry pan.
Toast over low-medium heat for about 60–90 seconds, just until fragrant. Don’t let them burn.
3. Make the harissa
Blend together:
softened chillies + toasted spices + garlic + smoked paprika + black pepper + salt + olive oil + lemon juice + lemon zest.
Blend into a thick, slightly textured red paste.
If it’s too dry to blend, add 1–2 tsp of the chilli soaking water. Don’t make it runny.
Taste and adjust salt/lemon.
4. Marinate
Coat the chicken thighs thoroughly in the harissa.
Marinate for at least 30 minutes, but 1–2 hours would be better.
5. Air fry
Preheat the air fryer to 190°C for 3 minutes.
Arrange the thighs in a single layer.
Air fry at 190°C for 12–15 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Then increase to 200°C for 2–3 minutes to develop those dark, slightly charred edges.

18094876385062362.ingredients:

3 eggs
½ cup butter
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp oregano
1 and 1/2 cups chopped veg
3 cups Greek yoghurt
2 cups grated cheese (mix 1½ cups into the batter and sprinkle ½ cup on top.
18094876385062362.method:
1. Preheat oven to 180°C fan-forced. In a large bowl, combine flour, oregano and garlic powder.
2. In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, butter and 3 cups of the yoghurt.
3. Add the yoghurt mixture to the flour mixture and gently fold to combine.
4. Fold through veggies and 1 1/2 cups of the cheese.
5. Spoon mixture into 2 greased 12-hole muffin pan. Top with the remaining ½ cup cheese.
6. Bake for 20 minutes, or until golden.

17927626422388328.ingredients:
Shrimp Filling:
1/2 lb shrimp, finely chopped
2 tsp cornstarch
1 tsp sesame oil
1 tsp soy sauce
2 garlic clove, grated (or 1/2 tsp garlic powder)
2 tbsp chopped green onion
Salt and black pepper, to taste
Wraps:
1-2 large rice paper sheets
Avocado oil spray
Spicy Yogurt Sauce:
2 tbsp plain Greek yogurt
1 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tsp Sriracha
1 tsp honey
1/2 tbsp lemon juice
1/4 tsp garlic powder
Salt, to taste
For Serving (Optional):
Sliced green onion
Chili crisp or chili oil
Sesame seeds
17927626422388328.method:
Make the filling: In a bowl, combine shrimp, cornstarch, sesame oil, soy sauce, garlic, green onion, salt, and pepper.
Wrap: Dip a rice paper sheet in warm water for 3-5 seconds. Add shrimp filling and roll tightly, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
Air Fry: Lightly spray with avocado oil. Air fry at 390°F (200°C) for 14–16 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden brown and crispy.
Make the sauce: Stir together Greek yogurt, mayonnaise, Sriracha, honey, lemon juice, garlic powder, and salt until smooth.
Serve: Top with green onion, and sesame seeds. Serve with the sauce.
Pat the shrimp dry before chopping so the filling isn’t watery.
Don’t oversoak the rice paper, it should still feel slightly firm before wrapping.
Spray generously with oil for an evenly crisp, blistered finish.

18092790065528444.ingredients:
75g dry soya chunks
75g low-fat paneer
3 tbsp thick curd
4–5 cashews
4 garlic cloves
1-inch ginger
1 small onion
1 green chilli
Handful of fresh coriander
½ tsp black pepper
1 tsp chole masala
½ tsp garam masala
Salt to taste
1 tsp oil
Hot water as required
½ tsp kasuri methi
1 tbsp fresh cream
½ tsp pickle oil
18092790065528444.method:
1. Soak the soya chunks in hot water for 15–20 minutes. Drain and squeeze out as much water as possible.
2. Heat a pan and sauté garlic, ginger, onion, green chilli, cashews and fresh coriander until the onion softens.
3. Let it cool slightly, then blend it with the paneer and a little water until you get a smooth, creamy paste.
4. Add the soaked soya chunks to a bowl. Add curd, the prepared paneer paste, salt, black pepper, chole masala and garam masala. Mix until the soya is well coated.
5. Heat oil in a kadai and add the marinated soya chunks. Sauté briefly, then add a little hot water.
6. Cover and cook on low flame for 3–4 minutes, or until the gravy reaches your preferred consistency.
7. Finish with crushed kasuri methi, fresh cream and a little pickle oil.
8. Serve hot with roti, paratha or rice.

18417882574177440.ingredients:
500g chicken mince
2 tbsp red curry paste
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp honey
1/2 lime, juiced
1/2 tbsp grated ginger
1 garlic clove, grated
2 tbsp chives, finely chopped
8 rice paper wrappers
Oil spray
Dipping Sauce
1/3 cup Kewpie mayonnaise
1 tbsp red curry paste
1 tbsp lime juice
1 tsp honey
1 tsp soy sauce
1 tsp rice wine vinegar
To Serve
Chopped coriander
Chilli crisp
18417882574177440.method:
1. In a bowl, combine the chicken mince, red curry paste, soy sauce, honey, lime juice, ginger, garlic, chives until well mixed.
2. Fill a shallow bowl with warm water. Dip one rice paper wrapper into the water until just softened.
3. Spoon a log of the chicken mixture along the bottom third of the wrapper. Fold in the sides and roll tightly into a sausage shape.
4. Using kitchen scissors, snip the roll into bite-sized pieces.
5. Arrange the pieces in a single layer in an air fryer basket. Spray generously with oil and air fry at 200°C for 12–15 minutes, turning halfway, until the chicken is cooked through and the rice paper is golden and crispy.
6. Meanwhile, whisk together the Kewpie mayonnaise, red curry paste, lime juice, honey, soy sauce and rice wine vinegar until smooth.
7. Top the crispy chicken bites with chopped coriander and chilli crisp, then serve with the dipping sauce.

18104437142328732.method:
In an instant pot combine 1 cup of rinsed whole green moong dal, with 1 tsp salt, 2.5 cups water and 1/8 tsp turmeric powder. Mix and set the IP for 10 minutes on High Pressure and let it naturally release.
Next, in a mixing bowl whisk together 1/2 cup greek or regular yogurt, 1/2 cup water and 2 tbsp besan.
Heat 1.5 tbsp ghee in a large pot over medium heat and once the oil is hot, add 1 tsp mustard seeds. When they pop add 2 tsp cumin seeds, 2 finely chopped green chilis, 6 curry leaves, 1/4 tsp turmeric powder, and 1/2 tsp red chili powder. Swirl that around so it doesn’t brown. Add 1 tsp finely grated ginger, 1 tbsp chopped garlic, and cook for a couple minutes then add the yogurt- besan mixture and cook over a low flame for about 5 minutes while stirring. Once it has slightly thickened, add the cooked moong dal, along with 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp coriander powder and 1/4 tsp garam masala. Let this simmer gently for about 10-15 minutes on low heat. Remove from heat and enjoy! Taste and adjust salt or spice as needed.

18063937157738233.ingredients:
(for the lemon oats)
1/2 cup oats
1 egg
zest of 1 lemon
1tbsp honey
1 cup (240ml) any milk
(for the raspberry chia jam):
1/2 cup (about 75g) fresh / frozen raspberries
juice of 1/4 of a lemon (or more if you prefer)
2tsp chia seeds
1tbsp honey
(to serve):
any yogurt you like!
chopped pistachios
18063937157738233.method:
1. begin by placing the oats, egg, lemon zest, honey and milk in a small saucepan and place on a medium heat.
2. begin by whisking vigorously to ensure the egg is completely incorporated.
3. as soon as you start to see a little steam, lower the heat to low.
4. keep whisking continuously as the oats cook (this will take between 5-10 minutes).
5. meanwhile, you can place the raspberries, lemon juice, chia seeds and honey in a small bowl and microwave for 90 seconds.
6. stir and leave to one side.
7. keep whisking the oats until they have thickened nicely and the mixture is creamy and glossy.
8. remove from the heat and pour the oats into your serving bowl.
9. spoon over the raspberry chia jam wherever you like.
10. finish with a generous dollop of greek yogurt and a sprinkle of pistachios.
11. drizzle some extra honey / maple syrup if you like it sweeter…

17893322382540210.ingredients:
almond Flour: 2 cups (super-fine blanched)
Pistachios: ½ cup (shelled and finely chopped)
Ground Cardamom (Elaichi): ½ tsp
Liquid Sweetener (Choose ONE): ⅓ cup pure maple syrup OR ⅓ cup raw honey
Healthy Fat: 3 tbsp melted ghee (or melted butter / coconut oil)
17893322382540210.method:
1. Prep the Oven: Preheat your oven to 350°F (180°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. Mix the Dry Ingredients: In a bowl, mix the almond flour, ground cardamom, and most of the chopped pistachios (save 1 tablespoon of the pistachios for the top).
3. Add the Wet Ingredients: Pour in your chosen liquid sweetener (maple syrup or honey) along with the melted ghee. Stir thoroughly until a soft, uniform cookie dough forms.
4. Shape Your Size: Divide the dough and roll them into balls, then shape them into your preferred size—either round discs or long bakery-style rectangles like in image.png. Use a fork to gently press lines on top for that classic bakery look.
5. Top & Bake: Press the remaining chopped pistachios firmly onto the top of each biscuit. Bake for 12–14 minutes just until the edges turn a light golden brown.
6. Cool Completely: Let them cool on the baking sheet for 10 minutes before moving them. Almond flour treats are delicate when hot but firm up into a perfect crumbly texture once fully cooled!

17920336545161512.ingredients:
1 tsp sesame oil
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp fresh ginger, grated
2 cups chicken or bone broth

6–8 chicken dumplings (frozen works great)
Optional: chili oil or sesame seeds for topping
17920336545161512.method:

2. Add garlic, Shalots and ginger and sauté until fragrant (about 30 seconds).
3. Add bok choy and cook for another minute.
4. Pour in broth and coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
5. Add dumplings and cook according to package instructions (usually 4–5 minutes).
6. Stir in miso paste and gochujang until dissolved.
7. Add tofu and let warm through.
8. Top with green onions, sesame seeds, or chili oil.

18067683077397733.ingredients:
For the Outer Cover: 1/2 cup boiled sweet potatoes , 2 tablespoon of whole wheat flour, pinch of salt.
For the Sweet Filling: 1/4 cup of freshly grated coconut, 1.5 tbsp of coconut sugar, and pinch of Cardamom powder , 1/4 tsp poppy seeds ( optional)
For Cooking: Akshayakalpa organic Cow ghee
18067683077397733.method:
Prepare the Stuffing : Heat ghee in a pan over a low flame, add poppy seeds, grated coconut, jaggery, cardamom powder. cook until the jaggery melts completely. transfer the mixture to a bowl to cool completely.
Make the Dough: Wash, cook and peel the sweet potatoes. Mash them thoroughly to ensure there are no lumps, then knead in the wheat flour, pinch of salt to form a smooth, soft dough without adding any water.
Shape the Nevris: Divide the dough into small, lime-sized balls. Flatten each ball on a ghee greased sheet/ banana leaf, place a spoonful of the coconut-jaggery stuffing on one half, fold it over into a crescent shape, and firmly press the edges to seal.
Fry to Golden Perfection: Heat a flat pan or tawa, apply a generous drizzle of ghee, and shallow-fry the dumplings on low-to-medium heat. Flip them gently until both sides turn fragrant and beautifully golden brown.

17910753156390626.ingredients:
1 tbsp sesame oil
4 cloves garlic, peeled, sliced
4 spring onions, thinly sliced, extra to serve
1 cup jasmine rice
200g mixed Asian mushrooms, torn and cut into pieces
Soy sauce, sesame seeds, chilli oil, to serve
Chicken stock
1 large piece of ginger
1.6kg whole chicken
4 spring onions, halved
1 bulb garlic, unpeeled, halved
2 eshallots, unpeeled, halved
⅓ cup fish sauce, extra to serve
17910753156390626.method:
To make the chicken stock, thickly slice half of the ginger, set aside the remaining half for later. Place the ginger slices in a large saucepan with the remaining “stock” ingredients and fill with water until the chicken is submerged. Simmer the chicken over a low heat, covered, for 3-4 hours or until the meat is falling off the bone.
Remove the chicken and garlic from the pan and strain the chicken broth measuring out 9 cups of liquid. Discard the other solids. When cool enough to handle, pick the chicken meat into chunks and squeeze the garlic from the skin.
When ready to cook the congee, peel and finely grate the remaining ginger. Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat, add the ginger, cooked garlic, fresh garlic and spring onions and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant. Add the rice and stir until coated by the oil and other ingredients.
Add the reserved broth to the pan and bring to the boil, reduce heat to low, cover with lid and cook slowly for 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Turn off the heat and stir through the mushrooms and chicken. Allow the pot to sit, covered for 15 minutes. Season with salt and extra fish sauce, to your liking.
Spoon into bowls and top with any or all of the following; soy sauce, sesame seeds, chilli oil, fish sauce, extra spring onions.

18194008150371520.ingredients:
200g high-protein low-fat paneer, cubed
2 tsp coconut oil
1 tsp fennel seeds
4–5 shallots, sliced
1 sprig curry leaves
Crushed paste: 5–6 kanthari (bird’s eye) chillies, ½-inch ginger, 3 garlic cloves
¼ tsp turmeric powder
1 tsp coriander powder
½ tsp garam masala
Salt, to taste

Coriander leaves, to finish
18194008150371520.method:
1. Heat the coconut oil and splutter the mustard seeds.
2. Add the sliced shallots and curry leaves; sauté for a few minutes till softened.
3. Stir in the crushed chilli–ginger–garlic paste and cook till the raw smell goes.
4. Add turmeric, coriander powder and garam masala; cook for a minute.
5. Pour in the coconut milk, add salt and sugar, and let it come together.
6. Add the paneer cubes and simmer gently till the paneer softens and soaks up the masala.
7. Finish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot.

18098840956978971.ingredients:
Mutton paya (trotters)
Water (just enough to cover)
1–2 tsp apple cider vinegar
Bay leaf
Cinnamon stick
Cumin seeds
Turmeric
Optional (for extra nutrition & flavor):
Onions
Garlic
Drumsticks (moringa)
Carrots
18098840956978971.method:
1. Initial clean boil:
Add trotters to hot water + a little apple cider vinegar.
Boil for 5–10 minutes to remove impurities.
Discard this water completely.
2. Slow cooking:
Transfer cleaned trotters to a slow cooker.
Add fresh drinking water just above the pieces.
3. Add flavor:
Add bay leaf, cinnamon, cumin seeds, turmeric.
Add veggies if using.
4. Important tips:
Do not add more than 1–2 tsp apple cider vinegar (can turn sour).
Do not add salt or garam masala at this stage.
5. Cook low & slow:
Let it cook for 20–24 hours.
6. Final step:
Strain the broth, let it cool, and refrigerate.
It will turn thick and jiggly — that’s your natural collagen

18580245538054514.ingredients:
10 cashews
10 almonds
1 cup milk (for soaking)
5 tbsp ghee
2 tbsp ginger garlic paste
2 small cinnamon sticks
3 cardamom pods
1 tsp whole black peppercorns
1 tsp kabab chini
3 cloves
1 tsp shahzeera
4 green chilies, chopped
½ onion, sliced
650 g lamb or mutton (bone-in), medium pieces
¼ tsp turmeric powder
salt, to taste
½ cup plain yogurt
6 cups water, divided
a pinch of saffron
1½ tsp black pepper powder
1 tsp garam masala powder
¼ cup chopped mint
¼ cup chopped cilantro
½ cup heavy cream
18580245538054514.method:
1. Soak the cashews and almonds in 1 cup milk for 30 minutes. Blend into a smooth paste and set aside.
2. Heat the ghee in a large pot. Add the ginger garlic paste, cinnamon sticks, cardamom pods, whole black peppercorns, kabab chini, cloves, and shahzeera. Sauté for 2–3 minutes until fragrant.
3. Add the chopped green chilies and cook for another 1–2 minutes.
4. Add the sliced onion and cook for about 3 minutes. Add the lamb or mutton and stir well.
5. Add the turmeric, salt, yogurt, and 3 cups water. Cover and cook until the meat is tender. If using a pressure cooker, cook for 3–4 whistles, then simmer for 15 minutes. Check the meat and cook longer if needed.
6. Once the meat is tender, stir in the cashew and almond paste along with the remaining 3 cups water. Bring to a gentle boil.
7. Add the saffron, black pepper powder, garam masala, mint, cilantro, and heavy cream. Mix well.
8. Simmer on medium-low heat for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
9. Serve hot with soft naan.

18317368618287716.method:
Soak 3/4 Cup / 150 gms Moong Daal 2-3 hours. (Remove 2Tbsp Aside to add later)
To Soaked Moong Daal, Add 2 Garlic Cloves, 1 Small Pc Ginger & Grind it into a paste.
With the help of a spoon, Mix the batter well so it becomes light and fluffy.
Then add, Soaked Moong Daal, 2 Tbsp Sooji, Salt, 1 Tsp Red Chilli Powder, 1/4 Tsp Turmeric Powder, 1 Tsp Red Chilli Flakes, 1/2 Tsp Dried Fenugreek Leaves, 1/2 Tsp Garam Masala Powder, 1 Tbsp Crushed Coriander Seeds, 1 Tsp Cumin Seeds, Coriander Leaves
Mix well. Cover and let this rest for 15-20 mins. Then add 2 Tbsp Chopped onions to this and mix well.
Place green chilli (Light green one, less spicer) in the middle of the batter. Coat it and fry it in hot oil.
Keep the flame from medium to low to make sure it cooks thoroughly.
Serve with ketchup, chutney and enjoy ❤️

1 tsp garam masala
1 tsp Kashmiri chilli powder (for colour + mild heat)
Salt to taste
2 tbsp besan (gram flour) or breadcrumbs
1 egg (slightly beaten)
1 tbsp lemon juice
2 tbsp oil (for cooking)
1 tbsp soy sauce
18081207311570908.method:
In a large bowl, combine the chicken mince with onion, garlic, ginger, chilli, herbs, spices, besan/breadcrumbs, egg, and lemon juice. Mix really well your hands are best here to help everything bind together.
Cover and rest the mixture in the fridge for at least 20–30 minutes. This helps the flavours deepen and makes shaping easier.
With slightly damp hands, shape the mixture into small round koftas, similar to meatballs.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Cook the koftas in batches, turning gently, until golden brown on all sides and cooked through (about 8–10 minutes).
You can also Air-fry these at 180C for 10-12 mins. Turning them over halfway.
Rest for a couple of minutes before serving this keeps them juicy.

17889710319510509.ingredients:
4 cups (1 litre) milk
½ cup sugar
1 cup almonds(soaked and peeled) + ¾ cup milk
1 tbsp custard powder + 2 tbsp milk
2 tsp saffron strands + 2 tbsp milk
½ tsp cardamom powder
3 tbsp pistachios, slivered
3 tbsp almonds, slivered
17889710319510509.method:
Soak ¾ cup almonds in water overnight.
Peel the almonds and blend them into a thick paste along with ¾ cup milk.
Now, set a large pot on medium heat and add 1 litre milk to it.
Once it starts to simmer, add sugar, almond paste, custard powder slurry, saffron infused milk and cardamom powder.
Bring it to a boil and heat until the milk thickens a bit.
Add slivered almonds and pistachios and mix well.
Let it come to room temperature before storing in bottles. Serve chilled.

18404893189145498.method:
Mix 150 gms minced chicken with 1 medium finely chopped onion, fresh coriander, grated ginger, garlic powder or minced garlic, salt to taste, black pepper, light soy sauce, and paprika/chilli flakes
Dunk rice paper in water for 15 seconds and place the filling in the middle
Roll as shown into spring rolls and cut them into bite sized pieces
Preheat the air fryer for 5 min at 180
Air fry with a spray of oil for 15-20 min at 180-190 degrees
Drizzle some chilli oil or hot sauce and dive in✨
you can also add 1 egg to the mixture if it becomes a lil dry 💯

17994665123917948.ingredients:
For the chicken:
1 lb boneless chicken thighs, minced
1 large yellow onion, finely grated and excess water squeezed out
4 garlic cloves, finely grated
1 tbsp parsley, chopped
Salt to taste
1 tsp smoked paprika powder
1/2 tsp chili powder
1/2 tsp ground coriander
1 tsp cumin powder
1 tbsp garlic powder
For the salad:
1 red onion, diced
2 tomatoes, seeded and diced
1 cucumber, diced
1 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped
Squeeze of lemon juice
Salt to taste
1 tsp sumac
1 tbsp lemon juice
1 tbsp olive oil
For the garlic sauce:
1/2 cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp sour cream
Salt to taste
1/2 tsp black pepper
1 tsp smoked paprika powder
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tbsp lemon juice
1 tbsp olive oil
To assemble
12 mini flour tortillas
1 cup Shoestring potatoes
Oil for frying the tortillas
17994665123917948.method:
In a bowl, combine minced chicken, salt, pepper, smoked paprika powder, garlic powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, grated onion, fresh garlic, and parsley. Mix everything until well combined.
Prepare the salad by combining red onions, tomatoes, cucumber, and parsley in a bowl. Add sumac, salt, olive oil and lemon juice.
Make garlic sauce by whisking together mayonnaise, sour cream, garlic powder, paprika, pepper, salt, and lemon juice. Adjust seasoning to taste. Refrigerate for at least 20 minutes for best flavor.
Lay tortillas flat on a clean surface.Spread one portion of the chicken mixture evenly over one side of each tortilla, pressing it into a thin layer that reaches the edges.
Heat a skillet or over medium-high heat and lightly grease it. Place the tortilla chicken side down onto the hot skillet. Press gently to ensure even contact. Cook for 3–4 minutes until the chicken is golden and cooked through. Flip and cook the tortilla side for 1–2 minutes until crispy and golden. Repeat with remaining tortillas.
Spread garlic sauce over the crispy chicken side.Add spoonful of sumac salad. Top with crispy shoestring potatoes. Fold and serve immediately

17871384129512566.ingredients:
500g chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized cubes
1-2 tbsp lemon juice

½ tsp turmeric

½ tsp red chilli powder or 1 tsp paprika
2 tsp onion powder
1 tsp salt

For the glaze:

Lemon zest
