Lots of chopped coriander

18134524126544084.ingredients:
FOR THE PASTE
10–12 garlic cloves
1 tbsp Kashmiri chilli powder
2 tsp coriander powder
Salt to taste
Splash of water
FOR THE STIR FRY
1 tbsp oil
1 tsp mustard seeds
2 sprigs curry leaves
1 medium onion, sliced
250g prawns, diced
350g cooked shirataki rice (or 350g cooked white/basmati rice — approx. 130g raw)
Salt to taste
Fresh coriander leaves, chopped (to finish)
1.5 tbsp lemon juice (to finish)
18134524126544084.method:
Mix 100g dry shirataki rice with equal parts water (100ml) and microwave on high for 2 minutes.
Blitz or pound the garlic, Kashmiri powder, coriander powder, salt, and a splash of water into a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a pan, splutter the mustard seeds, then add curry leaves and sliced onion. Sauté till the onion softens and turns translucent.
Add the spice paste and cook on medium for 2–3 minutes till the raw smell disappears and the oil separates.
Add the diced prawns, mix well, and cook for about a minute till they just turn opaque — don’t overdo it or they’ll go rubbery.
Add the cooked shirataki rice (or regular cooked rice), toss everything together, and let it warm through for another minute so the masala coats every grain.
Check salt, finish with chopped coriander leaves and a generous squeeze of lemon. Divide between 2 plates and serve hot.

18074190608442885.ingredients:
Ingredients for the Podi:
1 tbsp coconut oil
Curry leaves
4–5 dry red chillies
2 tbsp urad dal
1 tbsp chana dal
1 tbsp sesame seeds
A pinch of hing
Salt to taste
¼ tsp turmeric
For the Eggs:
Eggs
Ghee
Curry leaves
Fresh coriander
Freshly made podi
18074190608442885.method:
Method — Podi:
Heat coconut oil in a pan and sauté curry leaves and dry red chillies for a minute. Set aside.
In the same pan, add some more coconut oil followed by urad dal and chana dal. Sauté till lightly golden.
Add sesame seeds and sauté a little more.
Transfer everything to a mixer with hing, salt, and turmeric. Grind into a fine podi.
Method — Eggs:
Steam the eggs in an idli mould and gently demould once done.
Heat ghee in a pan and add curry leaves along with the freshly made podi.
Toss in the steamed eggs till beautifully coated.
Garnish with fresh coriander and enjoy! 🌿

18079918271158481.ingredients:
200 g butter (cold from the fridge)

2 g salt

18079918271158481.method:
Beat the butter, sugar and honey until whitened and fluffy
Add the egg and beat until completely combined
Add the dry ingredients just until combined, you can do this step by hand to avoid over mixing
Make balls of 50 g each
Place 5 balls per tray (as shown in the video)
Bake at 180°C for a maximum of 14 minutes
Reshape them with a ring right after baking
Sprinkle with salt
Enjoy!! 🍯

1 tsp vanilla extract
1 tsp honey
sprinkle of salt

1 tbsp chilli flakes
1 tsp chopped garlic

2 tsp dark soy sauce

18013525505700319.ingredients:
For the sauce:
6 dry red chillies (soaked in hot water for 10 mins, drained)
50g ripe mango
5 garlic cloves
1 stalk spring onion
½ tsp honey
1½ tbsp light soy sauce
2 tsp lemon juice
Salt to taste
2–3 tbsp water (to blend)
To cook:
200g low-fat, high-protein paneer, cubed
60ml light coconut milk
Salt, black pepper, and chilli flakes (for the paneer)
To finish:
1 tbsp crushed roasted peanuts
Fresh coriander, chopped
Steamed rice, to serve
18013525505700319.method:
1. Soak the dry red chillies in hot water for 10 minutes until soft. Drain.
2. Blend the soaked chillies with mango, garlic, spring onion, honey, soy sauce, lemon juice, salt, and water until smooth.
3. Pour the sauce into a non-stick pan and cook on medium heat for 4–5 minutes, until the raw smell of garlic and onion disappears and it thickens slightly. Splash in a little water if it sticks.
4. Stir in the coconut milk and simmer for 2 more minutes until creamy and glossy.
5. Meanwhile, season the paneer cubes with salt, pepper, and chilli flakes. Dry-grill on a hot non-stick pan until charred on the edges.
6. Add the grilled paneer to the sauce and toss to coat.
7. Finish with crushed peanuts and coriander. Serve hot with steamed rice.

18523199380066040.method:
Add all sauce ingredients to a blender or food processor and blend until smooth.
Coat fish with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Pour sauce over fish.
Roast at high heat until cooked through (I do 485°F for ~10-20 minutes, depending on thickness).

18350320993215133.ingredients:
For the Drink
1/2 cup mango puree
Water
Soda water
2 jalapeño slices
1 tsp hot honey
Lime juice
Ice cubes
Mint leaf or fresh red chilli for garnish
Hot Honey Recipe
2 tbsp honey
1 tsp red chilli flakes
1 tsp apple cider vinegar
18350320993215133.method:
1. In a small pan, simmer the honey on low heat.
2. Add the red chilli flakes and let it infuse while simmering.
3. Add the apple cider vinegar and mix well.
4. Let it infuse for about 5 minutes.
5. Remove from heat and allow it to cool slightly.
1. Rim your serving glass.
2. In a shaker, muddle the jalapeño slices with lime juice and hot honey.
3. Add mango puree, a splash of water, and ice cubes.
4. Shake well until chilled.
5. Fill the prepared glass with fresh ice.
6. Strain the drink into the glass.
7. Top with soda water.
8. Garnish with a mint leaf or a fresh red chilli.
Serve chilled.

Add the coconut milk and let it simmer on a low flame.
Stir in the lemon juice and sesame oil once off the flame.

strain the noodles once done and rinse under cold water

toppings of your choice

In a small pan off the heat, add the milk, egg, vanilla and honey. Whisk well to make sure it’s fully combined.
Add the oats.

It’s ready when it’s thick and creamy. Add whatever toppings you like and enjoy!

18578750302040777.ingredients:
2 cups chapatti (whole wheat) flour
1½ cups tofu, grated
1 Tsp homemade chilli paste
2 Tbsp oil (plus extra for cooking)
2 Tsp salt
1 Tsp Turmeric powder
¼ Cup sesame seeds
1 small bunch fresh fenugreek leaves (stems removed, finely chopped)
~150 g hot water (as needed)
18578750302040777.method:
1. In a large bowl, combine the flour, salt, turmeric powder, and sesame seeds. Mix well. Add the oil and rub it into the flour mixture. Add the grated tofu and mix thoroughly.
2. Stir in the chilli paste, followed by the chopped fenugreek leaves. Mix until evenly combined.
3. Gradually add hot water, mixing as you go, until a soft dough forms. Cover and let the dough rest for a few minutes.
4. Divide the dough into small portions and roll each into a thin flatbread (thepla).
5. Heat a skillet (tawa) over medium-high heat. Place a rolled thepla onto the hot skillet.
6. After about 10 seconds, flip it. Lightly spread oil on the cooked side, then flip again and apply oil to the other side
7. Cook, flipping a few times, until both sides are golden and cooked through.
8. Remove and place on a plate. Enjoy warm on its own or with yogurt, pickle, or chutney.

17922212757123948.ingredients:
2 large eggs
1/2–1 tbsp orange zest

1/3 cup (73 g) olive oil
1 tsp (5 g) vanilla extract
1/4 cup (85 g) honey
2 cups (192 g) almond flour
1/4 cup (30 g) almond meal
1/2 tsp (2 g) baking powder
1/2 tsp (2.5 g) baking soda
17922212757123948.method:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease 6”x3”3” loaf pan or a 8-inch round cake pan.
2. In a large bowl, whisk the eggs until lightly frothy. Add the orange zest, orange juice, olive oil, vanilla, and honey. Whisk until smooth and fully combined.
3. In a separate bowl, combine the almond flour, almond meal, baking powder, and baking soda.
4. Gently fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until just incorporated. Do not overmix.
5. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top with a spatula.
6. Bake for 30–35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
7. Allow the cake to cool completely in the pan before slicing.

1 teaspoon dark organic miso paste
a good pinch of dried thyme
a good pinch of flaky sea salt + freshly ground black pepper
1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder
a squeeze of fresh lemon

18045292427759594.method:
Place a small pot over medium heat + add frozen peas. Create a small space in the centre of the peas, add olive oil + follow immediately with cumin seeds. Stir-fry amongst the peas for 1 minute until fragrant. This “blooms” the spices for maximum bioavailability + flavour depth.
Pour in boiling water, then add tahini, miso paste, thyme, salt, + turmeric. Gently fold everything together until the miso + tahini have fully integrated into the liquid.
Cook for 2 more minutes. Watch as the water reduces + evaporates, transforming into a deep, rich, + incredibly creamy golden sauce that coats every pea.
Remove from the heat + stir through a generous squeeze of fresh lemon to brighten the umami notes + support digestion.
Dollop the mixture onto hot buttered sourdough toast. Finish with a heavy grind of black pepper + an extra pinch of flaky sea salt for that essential crunch.

basically i mix handvo flour + yogurt + spices (turmeric, ginger, serrano, salt) with a little hot water until it’s like pancake batter → let that sit out to ferment

Fresh strawberries or berries
18145424221431321.method:
Add the banana, cacao powder, soy milk, silken tofu, and maple syrup to a blender. Blend until completely smooth.
Pour the mixture into a small saucepan and cook over a low heat for around 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until the mixture is gently bubbling and has thickened slightly.
Before pouring into your serving jars or moulds, add a small splash of water to the base of each container — this prevents the pudding from sticking and makes it easier to turn out without breaking. Pour in the pudding mixture and leave to cool to room temperature, then transfer to the fridge for at least 3 hours until fully set.
To serve, run a knife gently around the edge of each mould and turn upside down onto a serving plate. Dust with raw cacao powder or top with shaved dark chocolate, and serve with fresh strawberries or berries.

17916754563144964.ingredients:
3 mashed very ripe bananas
1/4 cup olive oil or melted coconut oil (60 ml)
2 eggs
1/2 cup full-fat Greek yogurt (120 ml / 125 g)
(optional: if you like want your banana bread to be sweeter, add 2 tablespoons maple syrup)

dark chocolate chips
17916754563144964.method:
1. Mix the wet ingredients together
2. Add the flours, cinnamon and baking powder and stir
3. Fold in the chocolate chunks
4. Pour into a loaf pan lined with parchment paper
5. Bake at 180 Celsius / 350 Fahrenheit for about 45 - 50 minutes
6. Store in an air-tight container in the fridge

18136754164457701.method:

Add steamed veg to a blender with:

17972961710863221.ingredients:
The batter:
2 eggs
40g coconut sugar
1/2 tsp vanilla powder
1 tbsp coconut oil
70g almond powder or flour
1 tbsp cornstarch
1 tsp baking powder
10g chocolate chips
The toppings:
Extra chocolate chips
Crushed hazelnuts
17972961710863221.method:
In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the coconut sugar and vanilla until well combined.
Pour in the coconut oil and whisk again.
Gently stir in the almond powder, cornstarch, and chocolate chips until you have a smooth batter.
Pour the mixture into buttered mini cake molds.
Top with extra chocolate chips and crushed hazelnuts for that perfect crunch.
Bake at 180°C for about 15-18 minutes (until a toothpick comes out clean). Let them cool before enjoying! 😍

18032196581792183.method:
In a bowl add 2 cups besan. Add 2 tbsp ghee and 2 tbsp milk, mix until crumbly and sieve.
In a pan, heat 1/2 cup pure ghee and add the mixture. Cook on low flame for 15–20 minutes until soft and aromatic.
Transfer to a bowl, add 1 cup sugar (or boora) and cardamom powder. Mix well.
Shape into laddus and garnish with pistachios.
Soft, rich and delicious Besan Laddus are ready 😋

18095200199031663.method:
Soak these in 1/2 a cup of water for 2 hours
Once they are soaked and plump up, cook them in 1/2 cup coconut milk + 2 Tbsp of water- use thick coconut milk, else it will split once the khareek is added
Add 1/3 cup khareek, chopped into small pieces
You need to cook this till it reaches a pudding my consistency- about 10 mins. Cook on low heat, while constantly stirring, else the milk can split after adding Khareek.
Add some cardamom powder and turn off the flame. I recently added some saffron strands, and loved the flavour- you can try that too.

18345133411200699.method:
1. Dry roast 1 cup Aliv seeds + 1 cup whole black urad dal + 1/2 cup sesame seeds separately untill it's well roasted.
2. Add all these 3 together in a blender along with some jaggery & powder it well.
3. Jaggery will bind all the ingredients.
4. Roll out medium size ladoo's & store it in airtight container, consume 1 ladoo everyday .

17952290625051173.ingredients:
½ cup black sesame seeds, lightly roasted
½ cup white sesame seeds, lightly roasted
1 Tbsp nigella (kalonji) seeds, toasted 30 sec
2 Tbsp amaranth flour, lightly roasted (natural binder, gluten-free, low-glycemic)
1 Tbsp cold-pressed virgin coconut oil(extra virgin olive oil is an option too)
¼ tsp cardamom
¼ tsp dried ginger (optional anti-inflammatory)
Pinch mineral salt
2 pc dates
2 tsp allulose powder
17952290625051173.method:
Lightly toast seeds all on a pan on medium flame . Coursely grind mix with amaranth flour, allulose, dates, salt, coconut oil.
Make 22 ladoos using a tablespoon measure 10 gms each.
Tip: roll in lightly toasted whole sesame before storing.

17842792398687283.ingredients: Amla (10 grated), Sesame seeds (1 cup), Dry coconut (1 cup), Ghee (1 tbsp), Cashew, Almond, Pistachio, Walnut, Sunflower seeds, Watermelon seeds, Dates (10-15), Raisins, Palm jaggery (1 cup), Cardamom powder, Dry ginger powder
17842792398687283.method:
Dry roast sesame & coconut.
Roast nuts and seeds in ghee and keep aside.
Roast chopped dates & raisins.
Add grated amla and sauté 5 mins.
Add powdered sesame-coconut mix. Add powdered sesame-coconut mix.
Add palm jaggery and cook till thick.
Add cardamom, dry ginger, roasted nuts.
Cool slightly and make laddus.
Stays 15-20 days in fridge.

17941160655031825.ingredients:
2 cups organic black sesame seed
2 tablespoons of organic maple syrup
milk of choice

18098277635313772.ingredients:
1/2 cup (120 g) tahini, well stirred
2 tablespoons (30 g) black sesame paste
1/4 cup (60 ml) maple syrup
2 tablespoons (28 g) melted coconut oil, cooled to warm (not hot)
1 large egg, room temperature
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 1/4 cups (125 g) almond flour
1/2 teaspoon baking soda
1/3 cup (50 g) macadamia nuts, roughly chopped
1/3 cup (55 g) vegan white chocolate chips
Pinch flaky sea salt
18098277635313772.method:
Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, whisk tahini, black sesame paste, maple syrup, coconut oil, egg, and vanilla until smooth and glossy.
Stir in almond flour and baking soda until a dough forms. Fold in the chopped macadamia nuts and white chocolate chips.
Scoop into 12 portions, flatten slightly, and bake for 11–13 minutes until set at the edges but soft in the center.

17890831248435401.ingredients:
1 cup (100 g) almond flour
1/2 cup (90 g) pitted dates
1/4 cup (60 g) black sesame paste (see previous post for recipe)
2 tablespoons (30 g) tahini
1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
Pinch sea salt
Optional coating: black and/or white sesame seeds, or raw cacao nibs
17890831248435401.method:
Add all ingredients except for the coating to a food processor and process until smooth and sticky, scraping down the bowl as needed. If the mixture feels dry or crumbly, add 1 teaspoon of water at a time until it rolls easily.
Use a cookie scoop or roll about 1 tablespoon of the mixture between your palms to form balls and place on a parchment paper-lined plate.
Store the truffles in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 7 days. For longer storage, freeze for up to 2 months and thaw in the fridge before serving.

18346641058226724.ingredients:
1 cup black sesame seeds
¾ cup pumpkin seeds
½ cup sunflower seeds
½ cup walnuts
To sweeten & bind:
1 cup deseeded dates (Medjool or any soft variety)
1–2 tsp ghee (as needed)
Add-ins:
2–3 tsp moringa powder
Optional variation:
Fresh moringa leaves (see method below)
18346641058226724.method:
1. Dry roast black sesame, pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds and walnuts on low–medium heat for 5–7 minutes, stirring continuously. Let cool completely.
2. Pulse the roasted seeds and nuts in a blender till you get a coarse powder. Remove half of this mixture into a bowl.
3. To the remaining half in the blender, add the deseeded dates and blend till sticky and well combined.
4. Transfer this mixture to the bowl. Add 2–3 tsp moringa powder and 1–2 tsp ghee (as needed) to bind.
5. Mix well, shape into laddus, and store in an airtight container.
Optional: Using Fresh Moringa Leaves
Wash the leaves thoroughly and pat dry with a cotton towel.
Dry roast them separately till crisp.
Cool, then blend along with the roasted seeds.

18111887320579379.ingredients:
¾ cup water

½ cup amaranth (dry, not puffed), washed
2 cloves

⅔ - 1 tsp cacao powder
pinch of salt

top:
persimmon

tahini
extra oat milk (for drizzle)
18111887320579379.method:
bring water + oat milk + cloves + cinnamon + salt to a simmer. add amaranth + cacao and cook for ~20–25 min, stirring occasionally, until thick and creamy. off the heat, add honey and more milk if desired.
assemble and enjoy your warm, nourishing breakfast 🤎

17937782274177803.ingredients:
Amaranth
1 cup amaranth (≈ 190 g)
4 dried apricots
1½ tbsp cashew butter (≈ 24 g)
1¾ cups water (≈ 420 ml)
pinch salt
½ tsp cinnamon
½ tsp vanilla
pinch cardamom
Compote
1 cup raspberries (≈ 125 g)
zest ½ blood orange
juice ½ blood orange
a few blood-orange segments
Topping
1–2 tbsp pumpkin seed butter
1–2 tbsp pistachios, chopped
17937782274177803.method:
1. Soak the amaranth in plenty of water for 8–12 hours, then drain and rinse. This can reduce phytates and improve mineral availability, including iron.
2. Blend apricots, cashew butter, water, salt and vanilla until completely smooth.
3. Add amaranth, cinnamon and cardamom to a saucepan. Pour in the apricot–cashew mixture and simmer 18–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until creamy.
4. Blend about ¼ of the cooked porridge briefly, then stir it back in. (Makes it extra creamy)
5. Simmer raspberries with the blood-orange zest for about 2–3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the blood-orange juice and segments. ( Vitamin C is heat sensitive)
6. Divide the amaranth into bowls, top with the compote and finish with pumpkin seed butter and pistachios.

18103535647910442.method:
Soak half a cup of amaranth in water overnight . This isn’t necessary, but it reduces phytic acid and makes iron more bioavailable for the body.
Blend 3/4 cup milk of choice with 3-4 dates. Cook the soaked amaranth grains in 1 cup water + this blended milk of choice.
Once almost cooked, you can optionally add some nut butter (I’ve used cashew butter).
Sprinkle some cinnamon.
Cook some blueberries with 1-2 tbsp of water and add on top the porridge. You can use any fruit of choice - strawberries, apples, pomegranate etc.
Enjoy this wholesome meal 🧡

18124516798599873.ingredients:
Japanese sweet potato
Milk

Cashews

Heavy whipping cream
Ghee / oil
18124516798599873.method:

2. Roast in a little ghee/oil until aromatic

9. Mix and serve warm

17883735282469591.ingredients:

18095032663965906.ingredients:

18399474202176411.method:

Mix instant coffee with hot water and honey and froth it with the help of a frother.
In a glass scoop out ice and pour over the date and milk mixture.
Top it up the frothed coffee mixture and enjoy

17999710691904456.ingredients:
1 tbsp chia seeds / basil seeds (soaked for 15 minutes)
1 tbsp gond katira (soaked overnight)
2 tbsp fennel seeds (soaked overnight in a separate glass)
Juice of 1 lemon

A pinch of salt
2 glasses water
17999710691904456.method:
1. Strain the soaked fennel seeds and keep the fennel water.
2. In a glass, add soaked chia seeds, soaked gond katira and the fennel water.
3. Add lemon juice, honey and a pinch of salt.
4. Mix well and enjoy chilled or at room temperature on an empty stomach.

18037753496563386.ingredients:
Green gram – ½ cup
Turmeric – a dash
Black pepper powder – a pinch
Salt - As per your taste
Ghee/oil – for tempering
Cumin (jeera)
Mustard seeds
Curry leaves
Red chilli powder
Amchur powder (or lemon juice)
Ginger – grated
18037753496563386.method:
Wash and soak the green gram overnight or for at least 6 hours. Transfer it to a pressure cooker with 1½ cups of water, turmeric, and black pepper powder. Cook on a low flame for 2 whistles.
For tempering, heat ghee in a small pan and add cumin, mustard seeds, and curry leaves. Turn off the flame, then add grated ginger, red chilli powder, and amchur. Mix well and pour this tempering over the cooked curry. Mix and serve.

18109678537704253.ingredients:
2 tbsp mustard oil (divided)
A handful of peanuts
1 cup poha
2 onions (1 for tadka + 1 raw for garnish)
2 green chillies (1 for tadka + 1 raw for garnish)
1 cup mixed sprouts
1 tbsp coriander powder
½ tbsp red chilli powder
1 tsp turmeric
½ tbsp amchoor powder
Salt to taste
Fresh coriander & lemon juice for garnish
18109678537704253.method:
1. Heat mustard oil, roast peanuts 3–4 mins.
2. Add poha, cook until golden & crispy. Remove & keep aside.
3. In the same pan, add oil, sauté onion & green chilli for 2–3 mins.
4. Add sprouts, cook 2–3 mins.
5. Mix in salt, coriander powder, red chilli, turmeric. Add ½ cup water & cook 7–8 mins.
6. Stir in amchoor, mix well & turn off the flame.
7. Combine masala sprouts with crispy poha.
8. Garnish with raw onion, green chilli, coriander & lemon juice.
9. Serve immediately while it’s hot & crunchy!

17869151388575717.ingredients:
200 gm lobiya (black-eyed peas), soaked overnight
200 gm mushrooms 🍄
4 onions, sliced 🧅
7–8 garlic cloves 🧄
1 inch ginger
4–5 green chillies 🌶️
handful of cashews 🥜
2 tbsp ghee or oil 🧈
1 tbsp red chilli powder 🌶️
1 tbsp coriander powder
½ tbsp amchoor
2 tsp garam masala
salt to taste 🧂
fresh coriander 🌿
2 tbsp besan (gram flour)
17869151388575717.method:
1. pressure cook soaked lobiya with salt for 3 whistles. let pressure release naturally.
2. boil mushrooms in water for 5 mins, then drain.
3. heat ghee in a pan, sauté onions for 3–4 mins.
4. add garlic, ginger, green chillies, and cashews. cook till onions are soft and golden.
5. add salt, red chilli, coriander powder, amchoor, and garam masala. mix well and cook for 3–4 mins.
6. add fresh coriander, cook for 2–3 mins more. let it cool.
7. in a blender, add lobiya, mushrooms, and the cooked onion mix. blend to a coarse paste. add a splash of water only if needed.
8. transfer to a pan, add besan, and cook for 4–5 mins until thick and dough-like. cool completely.
9. shape into kebabs, brush ghee on a pan, place kebabs, brush a little ghee on top too, and cook until golden on both sides 🔥
10. serve hot with green chutney and lemony onions 🧅🍋
freeze the shaped kebabs raw — perfect for busy days or party prep 💡

18067709504277400.ingredients:
2 tbsp ragi flour
3/4 cup water ( to make ragi paste)
2 cups water (to make butter milk)
1 cup curd
3 cups water (to make ragi slurry)
Salt, to taste
1 small onion, chopped (optional)
1 tbsp coriander leaves, finely chopped
For tempering -
1 tsp ghee
1/2 tsp mustard seeds
1/2 tsp cumin seeds
3/4 tsp ginger, finely chopped
1-2 green chillies, finely chopped
Curry leaves
18067709504277400.method:
Mix 2 tbsp ragi flour and 3/4 cup water and mix well. Once done, heat 2 cups of water in a pan. When it comes to a boil, add the ragi flour slurry and keep whisking. Make sure there are no lumps.
Cool for 4-5 minutes and keep aside to cool down.
In a bowl, add curd, water and whisk it well. Add the cooled ragi mixture, salt and whisk well. Add a tadka of cumin seeds, mustard seeds, ginger, green chillies and curry leaves. Mix well.
Add onions, coriander and enjoy.

18087457766296793.method:
Soak one cup of soya chunks in hot water for 10 minutes or till they double in size.
Squeeze out the water and blend into a paste.
Add 3 to 4 tbsp mustard oil to the pan with cardamom, cinnamon and cumin seeds.
Once aromatic add in 2 big diced onions with 1 tsp sugar.
Let the onion caramelise before adding 1 tbsp ginger garlic paste, cook for a few minutes and add in one chopped tomato and a pinch of salt.
Once the tomato softens add in 1/2 tsp turmeric, 1 tbsp Kashmiri red chilli, 1/2 tbsp red chilli powder, 1/2 tbsp coriander powder, 1 tsp garam masala.
Cook the spices on medium to low heat for a few minutes then add 1/2 cup beaten curd on low flame.
When you see oil resurface add in 1/2 tbsp toasted besan for texture along with the soya paste.
Mix it nicely and then add about 1 cup of water, salt to taste ano cook covered till you achieve a thick texture.
Finish with a sprinkle of kasuri methi, chopped coriander, slit green chillies and julienne ginger.

18083102534240149.ingredients:

Cucumber
Pomegranate

18099014030301380.method:
1. Take fresh coconut water in a bowl or shaker.
2. Add 1 tsp sabja seeds (basil seeds) that have been soaked for about 15 minutes.
3. Squeeze in the juice of 1 lemon.
4. Add ½ tsp sugar and ½ tsp salt.
5. Add 1 slit green chilli for that classic kuluki flavor.
6. Shake it well (kuluki means shake).
7. Pour the mixture into popsicle molds.
8. Freeze for 6–7 hours or overnight.
9. Unmold and enjoy these refreshing electrolyte popsicles.

18092949343863982.ingredients:
For the Garlic Sauce:
2 Amul cheese cubes
½ cup yogurt
3–4 tbsp water
1 tsp honey
3–4 garlic cloves
Salt to taste
½ tsp black pepper
For the Gravy:
2 tbsp oil
1 medium onion, sliced
1 tsp ginger-garlic paste
1–2 green chillies, chopped
½ cup yogurt
½ tsp garam masala
1 tsp coriander powder
¼ tsp haldi (turmeric powder)
1 tsp chilli flakes
200 g paneer, cubed
Fresh coriander, chopped (for garnish)
18092949343863982.method:
Heat oil in a Kadhai and add sliced onions. Sauté until soft and lightly golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and chopped green chillies. Cook for a minute until fragrant. Add yogurt and mix well on low flame so it doesn’t split. Stir in garam masala, coriander powder, haldi, chilli flakes, and salt. Add paneer cubes and cook until the gravy thickens and oil starts to float on top. Meanwhile, blend the garlic sauce ingredients (cheese cubes, yogurt, water, honey, garlic, salt, and pepper) until smooth. Pour the garlic sauce over the paneer gravy, cover, and cook for 2 minutes on low heat. Garnish with chopped coriander. Serve hot with roti or naan and dig innn❤️
Cooking with dahi can be tricky, so here’s what I do: switch off the heat and let the pan cool slightly for 2 minutes before adding the dahi. Keep stirring continuously, then turn the heat back on. Don’t stop mixing until it comes to a boilthis prevents splitting. Once it boils, it’s stable and you can continue with the recipe.

18106839679691064.ingredients:
1 cup flax seeds
½ cup pumpkin seeds
½ cup black sesame seeds
Dates (as needed for binding)
18106839679691064.method:
Dry roast all seeds together on low flame for 1 minute (do not burn)
Let cool completely
Add seeds and 7 dates to a blender
Pulse 8–10 times, then blend until slightly sticky
Store in an airtight glass jar

18098755943509010.ingredients:
granola:

nuts

nuts

almond butter & strawberries 🍓

18118112509717138.ingredients:
150g dried red lentils
2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
2 tablespoons yoghurt
1 teaspoon salt
1 teaspoon paprika
1 teaspoon garlic powder
1 teaspoon mixed herbs
1 teaspoon baking powder
20 g psyllium husk powder
18118112509717138.method:
1. Add the lentils to a bowl, cover with water and let them soak for 2 hours. Drain and rinse them under cold water.
2. Preheat your oven to 180°C (356°F).
3. In a blender or food processor add the soaked lentils, olive oil, yoghurt, salt, paprika, garlic and mixed herbs. Blend until a thick batter forms.
4. Transfer the batter to a large bowl and add baking powder and psyllium husk. Mix all together.
5. Form 1 large bun with wet hands and arrange it in a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and bake for 25-30 minutes. Enjoy!

18102217282750420.ingredients:

handful of pistachios/walnuts
1 medium apple
3 tbsp hemp seeds

17993784833880796.ingredients:
1.5 cup approx almond flour (140g) ( I used homemade almond-flour ground with the skins)
¼ tsp baking powder
2 tbsp melted salted butter 🧈
2 tbsp honey
½ tsp vanilla extract
3 tbsp chocolate chips
17993784833880796.method:
1. Preheat oven to 160°C (320°F) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a medium bowl, mix almond flour and baking powder.
3. Add melted butter, honey, and vanilla to the dry mixture and combine until the dough has a crumbly texture.
4. Fold in chocolate chips evenly.
5. Shape the dough into small balls, press and gently flatten them, and place on the prepared baking sheet.
6. Bake for 12-15 minutes, until the edges are golden (the center may still be soft).
7. Let cookies cool on the sheet for 5-10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to crisp up completely.
8. Enjoy your crispy, chocolaty, treat ✨🍃

17953690131059568.ingredients:
1 cup green moong - washed and soaked for 4-5 hours or overnight. Then strain the water
1/2 inch ginger, 4 garlic cloves and 1 green chilli chopped
1/2 cup finely chopped green garlic

17953690131059568.method:
Make a course paste with above ingredients and then add
Preheat airfryer for 5mins @180C then put small small bhajias in basket like you would do in a kadhai(while deep frying). Your basket should be brushed with little oil. Airfry for 10mins @180C tossing midway and brushing bit of oil.

17845727388675670.ingredients:
1 cup black sesame seeds (toasted)
½ cup almond pulp (very well squeezed. sub: almond flour + 2 extra tbsp of ghee or oil)
6 Medjool dates

18109402396688846.ingredients:

Chopped coriander

Oil for roasting
18109402396688846.method:
Mix everything from 1-8.
Make cultets and put them in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.
Shallow fry on low-medium heat in some oil from both sides till it turns golden brown.

18110096860665783.ingredients:
Wholewheat Flour: 120g
Salted Cold Butter: 60g (cut into small cubes)
Grated Cheese: 120g (I used Mozzarella, you can use cheddar or any cheese block)
Salt: A pinch
Cold Milk: 2-3 tbsps
Optional Add-ins:
Garlic Powder
Chilli Flakes
Oregano
Fresh Cut Methi or Kasuri Methi
White & Black Sesame Seeds (for sprinkling on top)
18110096860665783.method:
The Crumble: Add cold cubed butter to the wholewheat flour. Smash and mix with your fingers until the flour looks like wet sand. 🖐️⏳
Season: Add salt and spices, then mix well. 🧂🌶️
Form the Dough: Add the cheese and combine. If it’s very dry, add milk to bind it into a dough. 🧀🥛
Roll & Cut: Divide the dough in two. Roll the first half between 2 sheets of parchment paper to a uniform thickness. 📜
Cut into a big rectangle.
Sprinkle sesame seeds on top and press slightly with a rolling pin. 🥨
Cut into equal-sized sticks (not too thick, not too thin!). Repeat with the other half. 🔪
Chill: Arrange them on a tray with parchment and freeze for 20 mins. ❄️⏲️
Bake: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Bake for 15-20 mins until they turn golden brown and feel firm when lifted. 🌡️🔥
Cool: Take them out, let them cool completely, and store in an airtight container. 🫙💨
Enjoy! 😍🙌

18092934779042264.ingredients:

For the Mug Cake
¼ cup almond flour or powdered oats
¾ tbsp cocoa powder

¾ tsp vinegar
1½ tbsp milk

For the Milk - Hot Chocolate Mix
1 cup milk (skim or regular)
1 tsp cornflour
Vanilla essence
2 small blocks dark chocolate (9-10 g)
18082875164028825.method:
1. Mug Cake
1. In a mug, mix almond flour/oats, cocoa powder, sweetener, and baking soda.
2. Add Greek yogurt, vinegar, milk, and vanilla.
3. Mix well and microwave for 60–90 seconds until set.
2. Milk-Hot Choc
1. Heat milk with cornflour and vanilla until slightly thickened.
2. Remove half — this is your plain milk.
3. To the remaining half, add dark chocolate and whisk until melted — this is your chocolate milk.

17950664373072799.ingredients:
Whole-Food Berry Jam Recipe
3 lb frozen mixed berries
½ cup honey
juice of 1 lemon
Peel of 1 lemon (organic)
3 tbsp chia seeds
Whole-Food Nutella Recipe
1½ cups raw hazelnuts
1 cup pitted dates
½ cup + 1 tbsp unsweetened nut milk
3 tbsp raw unsweetened cacao powder (or cocoa)
1 tsp vanilla extract
¼ tsp sea salt
Whole-Food Biscoff-Style Spread Recipe
1 cup raw almonds
1 cup raw cashews
2 tbsp maple syrup
2 tsp vanilla extract
1 tsp Ceylon cinnamon
½ tsp ginger
¼ tsp cloves
¼ tsp nutmeg
⅛ tsp salt
Whole-Food Caramel Sauce Recipe
2 cups Medjool dates
½ cup cashew butter

½ tsp sea salt
¾ tsp white miso paste
½ cup boiling water
17950664373072799.method:
Whole-Food Berry Jam Recipe
Simmer the berries and honey until soft. Throw the lemon peel while simmering to release natural pectin. Mash the fruit, remove the lemon peel, add lemon juice, then stir in chia seeds. The jam thickens as it cools.
Whole-Food Nutella Recipe
Roast hazelnuts at 350°F for 15 minutes. Rub off the skins while warm and let cool. Blend into a smooth nut butter. Blend dates with ¼ cup nut milk until smooth, then add hazelnut butter, remaining milk, cacao, vanilla, and salt. Blend until creamy.
Whole-Food Biscoff-Style Spread Recipe
Roast almonds and cashews at 350°F for 20 minutes. Let cool slightly, blend until smooth, then add remaining ingredients and blend until creamy.
Whole-Food Caramel Sauce Recipe
Soak dates if needed, then blend everything until completely smooth.

18057916279940829.ingredients:
Kathal: 500g
Rice: 1.5 cups (soaked for 30 mins)
Yogurt: 1 cup
Water: 1.25 liters
Bay leaf: 1, Star anise: 2, Cinnamon sticks: 2, Green cardamom: 3-4, Black cardamom: 2, Cloves: 3-4
Onions: 4-5 (2 puréed, rest for frying)
Ginger-garlic paste: 2 tbsp
Red chili powder: 1 tsp, Turmeric powder: 1 tsp, Biryani masala: 2-3 tbsp
Salt: to taste
Desi ghee/Oil: for cooking
Cumin seeds: 1 tbsp
Coriander & mint leaves: a handful
18057916279940829.method:
1. Boil water with bay leaf, star anise, cinnamon (1 stick), cloves (2), and cardamoms (2). Add kathal and boil for 10-12 mins until 90% cooked. Strain the kathal and reserve the water (yakhni).
2. Heat ghee in a handi. Add cumin seeds and remaining spices, then sauté with ginger-garlic paste.
3. Add onion purée, cook till golden, then mix yogurt, chili powder, turmeric, salt, and biryani masala. Cook until oil releases.
4. Add boiled kathal, simmer for 5 mins, then mix in rice and strained yakhni. Cover and cook on low until rice is done.
5. Garnish with fried onions, coriander, and mint. Let rest for 10 mins before serving.
6. Serve warm with fried cashews and your favorite raita.

18078801074210916.ingredients:
1 tub 2% cottage cheese (16 oz)
5-6 tbsp unsweetened cacao powder (I use 6)
1/2 to 3/4 cup powdered monkfruit or preferred powdered sweetener - make sure its POWDERED
Melted Lily’s milk chocolate chips (I used 2 tbsp to keep this lighter)
Crushed hazelnuts (I used 2 tbsp, too, but use however much you like)
18078801074210916.method:
1.Add your cottage cheese, cacao powder, and powdered sweetener to a small food processor. Important: the sweetener must be powdered or the texture will be gritty. Blend for 30 seconds until completely smooth and creamy. Pause, mix with spoon, and go another 20-30 seconds. You’ll want to get rid of all the curds and for it to be completely smooth. Taste and adjust sweetness if needed.
2.Transfer to a container and refrigerate for 1-2 hours. You can eat it right away, but chilling thickens it and makes the texture even better.
3.Melt the chocolate chips (you may want to add 1 tsp coconut oil) in the microwave for 15 seconds, stir, then another 15 seconds until smooth.
4.Spoon your dessert into bowls, drizzle the melted chocolate on top, and sprinkle with crushed hazelnuts. Chill briefly if you want a crackable chocolate layer.

2 tbsp gingelly oil (Sesame oil)
Vegetable

1.5 tsp mustard seeds

3–4 dried red chillies
8–10 curry leaves

18066789830148934.method:

Grind everything under Daal Paste into a smooth, fine mixture. Grease a steam pan generously with gingelly oil (Sesame oil), pour in the paste, and drizzle another 2 tbsp of gingelly oil (Sesame oil) over the top. Swirl gently so the oil spreads evenly.
2. Steam the dal
Pressure cook for 5 whistles or steam for 30 minutes until the dal is firm and fully cooked. Scoop it onto a plate and let it cool completely.
Once cool, grind into a fine lentil crumble.
3. As the daal cools, steam/cook the beans with a little salt
Steam the chopped beans with a little salt until just tender, then set aside.
4. Temper and combine
Heat gingelly oil (Sesame oil) in a pan. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter. Add urad dal, dried red chillies, curry leaves, and hing.
Once aromatic, add the lentil crumble and sauté for a minute. Add the cooked beans, mix well, and adjust salt if needed.

Step 1: Prepare the Soya Chunks
1. Boil water with salt, a pinch of sugar, and ½ tbsp ginger-garlic paste.
2. Add soya chunks and boil for 5–6 minutes.
3. Drain the water (do not squeeze).
4. Add 1 tbsp soya sauce mixed with 3 tbsp water, black pepper, and rice flour. Mix well.
5. Pan-fry in ½ tbsp oil for 7–8 minutes until slightly crispy
(or air-fry until crisp).
Step 2: Make the Gravy
1. Heat ½ tbsp oil in a pan.
2. Add onion, garlic, ginger, and green chilies. Sauté for 4–5 minutes.
3. Add 1 tbsp soya sauce mixed with 2 tbsp water.
4. Add chili tomato sauce and black pepper. Cook for 2–3 minutes.
Step 3: Combine & Serve
1. Add the cornflour slurry and stir until the gravy thickens.
2. Add the crispy soya chunks and mix gently.
3. Cook for 4–5 minutes.
4. Garnish with spring onions and serve hot 🔥

18137566882414080.method:
Prep the lauki:
Cut lauki into thick round pieces, boil for 7–8 mins, and drain. Scoop out the center.
Make the paneer stuffing:
Sauté 1 chopped onion + 2-3 green chillies in ghee. Add 150g grated paneer, salt, and chopped coriander. Let it cool.
Stuff & pan-sear:
Fill the lauki rings with the paneer mix. Cook in a ghee-brushed pan until golden on both sides.
Make the gravy:
Sauté 1 chopped onion in ½ tbsp ghee, add 3 tomatoes, 4-5 dried red chillies, 8-10 cashews, salt. Cook till soft.
Add 1 tbsp coriander powder, ½ tbsp red chilli powder, 1 tsp haldi, 1 tbsp kitchen king masala, 1 tsp garam masala. Cook well.
Cool and blend with 50g paneer + 1 cup water until smooth.
Simmer:
Transfer back to the pan, adjust water, add more red chilli powder and kasoori methi. Bring to a boil.
Assemble & serve:
Pour gravy into a bowl, place stuffed lauki on top. Garnish with curd, chilli oil, and fresh coriander.

18101825077748263.ingredients:
1 sweet potato - steamed
1/4th cup chickpeas- soaked overnight and boiled
1/2 a medium onion -  diced
1 tomato - diced
1/2 raw mango -  diced
2 tbsps coriander leaves
2cup murmura
1/2tbsp ghee
2 spicy green chillies - slit
1 tbsp lime juice
1 tbsp imli chutney
1 tsp jeera powder
1/2 tsp chaat masala
1/2 tsp black salt
1/2 tsp chilli powder
1/2 tsp anardana powder
Salt to taste
Pomegranate kernels & sev to garnish
18101825077748263.method:
Wash and cut the sweet potatoes into big chunks. Steam them for about 15-20mins or until cooked.
Once cooked, let it cool. Peel the skin off and cut into medium sized dices.
In a pan add ghee along with murmura, green chilies and saute until crispy.
Once crispy add the boiled chickpeas, diced sweet potatoes along with onion, tomatoes and raw mangoes.
Add the tamarind chutney,lemon juice, black salt and all the dry masala’s.Toss it well with the help of spoon.
Serve it in a bowl and garnish it with pomogrenate kernels, sev and chopped coriander.

17883351783430425.ingredients:
Jowar 1 cup
Urad dal 1/2 cup
Chana Dal 2 tbsp
Methi seeds 1/2 tsp
Flattened rice/poha 1/4 cup
17883351783430425.method:
Wash jowar, urad dal, chana dal, and fenugreek seeds thoroughly.
Soak them together in enough water for 8 hours.
After 8 hours, rinse once again and transfer the soaked ingredients into a mixer jar.
Add poha (flattened rice) soaked for 10 minutes.
Add water gradually and grind into a smooth, soft batter.
Transfer the batter to a bowl and allow it to ferment for 8 hours or overnight.
The next morning, add salt as required and adjust the batter consistency by adding water if needed.
Heat a dosa pan, pour a ladle of batter, and spread it gently to make dosas.
Cook until crisp and golden.
Serve hot with your favorite chutney.

18138884629478664.ingredients:

17887455126262165.ingredients:
1.25cups Makhana (25g)
12-15 Almonds (soaked and peeled)
15-18 Cashews
1+1/4cup Hot Milk
10-12 Saffron strands
1tsp Vanilla Extract
Fruits and Nuts of Choice
2-3tbsp Honey/Maple syrup/Monk fruit sweetener
17887455126262165.method:
1. Add Makhanas, Cashews, Almonds, Saffron and Vanilla with boiling hot milk and soak for 1-2 hours.
2. Once soaked blend it really well till its creamy and smooth and refrigerate it till chilled (if required you can add more milk to adjust the consistency as per your preference)
3. Then add your favourite chopped fruits and nuts (I used Apple, Banana, Pomegranate, Cashews, Raisins) with some sweetener or you can skip if you are okay
4. Mix it well adjust consistency and serve it chilled!

18497677270073695.ingredients:
Condensed milk – 1 tin
Yogurt – 1 tablespoon
Ghee – 1 tablespoon
18497677270073695.method:
Take a microwave-safe bowl.
Add condensed milk + yogurt + ghee into the bowl.
Mix well until smooth.
Place the bowl in the microwave.
Microwave on high for 2–3 minutes, stop, and stir.
Microwave again for another 1–2 minutes.
Once thickened slightly, let it cool for a few minutes.
U can serve hot or cold

17905111425320535.ingredients:
8 to 9 medium sized amla or indian gooseberry
1 medium sized beetroot peeled and cut into cubes
1 big carrot peele cut into cubes

18074536091196002.method:
Blend → pour → crisp up → enjoy with chutney or sambar 🤌🔥
You can make the dosa right away although it’s nice to rest for 30 minutes to an hour.

18095319571924707.ingredients:
100 gms gond
350 gms Khareek, cut into small pieces (you get pre-cut one online)
100 gms of de-seeded dates
18095319571924707.method:
Fry the gond, in ghee in batches. Slot aside
We needed ~200 gms ghee in total for this recipe.
In the same residual ghee, toast
100 gms Makhana till crisp- set aside. This step can also be done in the microwave/ oven
Toast 100 gms of khobra/ dried coconut. Slot aside
In the same Kadhai, toast
200 gms almonds
Add the Khareek and keep tossing till the Khareek is warm
Now combine the Makhana, almonds, khareek, gond and toasted coconut in a large paraat/ container
Grind it, in batches, by adding 5-6 dates each time
NOTE: you have to grind it till very fine, and till the mixture can make a ball when you press it together.
Taste and see if you need it to be more sweet- if you do, add more dates.
Once everything is ground, add raisins, chopped cashews as well as cardamom powder and shape into ladoos.
If it’s difficult to shape into ladoos, simply transfer to an airtight jar and have 2-3 Tbsps everyday- it was taste just as good & do you good!

17966674457978327.ingredients:
For the blended paste
1 medium onion, chopped
2 medium tomatoes, chopped
6–7 garlic cloves
1 small piece of tamarind
For aromatics (tempering)
3 tbsp oil
1 tsp jeera (cumin seeds)
1 tsp urad dal
A pinch of hing (asafoetida)
1 dried red chilli, chopped
Masala mix
1 tbsp red chilli powder
1 tsp haldi (turmeric powder)
½ tbsp coriander powder
Other ingredients:
1 big cup chopped palak (spinach)
Salt to taste
17966674457978327.method:
1. Add onion, tomatoes, garlic, and tamarind to a blender and grind into a smooth paste.
2. Heat oil in a pan, add jeera, urad dal, hing, and red chilli. Let it turn lightly golden.
3. Add the masala mix and sauté for a few seconds until aromatic.
4. Add the blended paste, mix well, and cook for about 3 minutes until oil releases.
5. Add chopped palak and salt, mix well, cook for 5 minutes, and turn off the heat. Serve hot with rice and papad! Enjoy!

18090620848805283.method:
Pound 1/2 inch ginger, 8-10 garlic cloves, 1 green chilli, & 1-2 lime leaves coarsely
Heat 2 tsp butter & add 1 bay leaf, cardamom, a sprig of curry leaves, pounded paste & 1 small chopped onion
Sauté till the onions are slightly brown
Add 500 gms chicken (bone-in)
Season with salt & lots of freshly cracked black pepper and roast the chicken till slightly golden brown
Add 1 cup of water & 1 cup coconut milk
Mix & simmer with a lid on, on low flame till the chicken is fully cooked
Add a splash of fish sauce (optional) & turn off the heat
Serve hot with your fav toppings (stir fried broccoli, mushrooms, noodles), a scrunch of pepper & a drizzle of lemon juice and enjoy!🥰

18219505636308638.ingredients:
½ cup +1 tsp ghee, divided
⅔ cup gond, 50 gms

¼ cup + 1 tablespoon chopped almonds, 50 gms

18138493318467263.ingredients:
Cake ingredients:
150 g millet flour (single or mixed),25–30 g almond flour, 1 tsp baking powder, ½ tsp baking soda, 1 cup milk, 1 tsp vinegar, 1 tsp cinnamon powder, 60 g monk fruit sweetener, 20 g desi khand, 70 g extra virgin olive oil, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2–3 grated carrots, 1 cup chopped walnuts, Zest of 1 lemon (only yellow part) + a pinch of sugar
Frosting:
1 tbsp cream cheese, 2 tbsp melted butter, 1 tbsp condensed milk
18138493318467263.method:
Add vinegar to lukewarm milk, keep aside for 5 mins.
In a bowl, mix monk fruit, khand & olive oil. Add milk mixture + vanilla, whisk well.
Sieve in millet flour, almond flour, baking powder, baking soda & cinnamon powder. Whisk till smooth.
Fold in grated carrots, lemon zest & walnuts.
Pour batter into lined & greased dish.
Microwave at 900W for 10 mins. Check with toothpick.
Frosting:
Whisk cream cheese, butter & condensed milk till smooth and fluffy.
Assemble:
Cool cake completely, flip, frost evenly, top with walnuts

18319818316219113.ingredients:
Brownie Batter
Dark chocolate – 575 g
Unsalted butter – 115 g
Condensed milk – 665 g
Milk – 70 g
All-purpose flour – 180 g
Cocoa powder – 45 g
Milk chocolate chips – (200- 225) g
18319818316219113.method:
METHOD
1. Melt the chocolate
Melt the dark chocolate and butter together over a double boiler or in short microwave bursts until smooth, glossy, and fully melted.
2. Add condensed milk
While the chocolate mixture is still warm, mix in the condensed milk until fully emulsified.
(This step is essential for the shiny crinkle top.)
3. Add dry ingredients
Sift the flour and cocoa powder together.
Fold gently into the batter — do not overmix.
4. Adjust consistency
Add the milk and mix just until the batter becomes smooth and cohesive.
5. Fold in chocolate chips
Gently fold in the milk chocolate chips, keeping them intact.
ASSEMBLY
1. Line a 9-inch square tin with parchment paper.
2. Pour the brownie batter into the tin and spread evenly.
BAKING
Bake at 170–180°C
(Choose the temperature based on how strong your oven is.)
Baking time: 30–35 minutes for extra fudgy brownies
Up to 40 minutes for a slightly more set centre
Doneness guide:
Edges should be set
Centre should be soft but not liquid
Toothpick should come out with thick fudgy crumbs, not wet batter
COOLING
Allow brownies to cool completely in the tin
Chill briefly before slicing for clean, sharp edges

18092472988901217.ingredients:
Soup ingredients (serves 2)
Olive oil
1 medium onion finely chopped
3 to 4 garlic cloves chopped
1 packet(200g) button mushrooms sliced
1 tbsp jowar flour
8 to 10 raw cashews soaked 15 to 20 minutes in hot water then drained
Fresh thyme plus more to finish
Chilli flakes optional
Salt and black pepper to taste
Water or veg stock as needed
Rice wine vinegar or lemon juice optional added at the end
Mushroom topping
1 tbsp olive oil
Shimeji or any mushrooms
1 small garlic clove finely chopped
1 to 2 tsp tamari or soy sauce
Fresh thyme leaves added at the end
Black pepper
18092472988901217.method:
1 Soak cashews. Heat oil in a pot. Cook onion till soft. Add garlic 30 seconds.
2 Add mushrooms and a pinch of salt. Cook on medium high 5 to 10 minutes until they release water then turn glossy and deeper.
3 Mix in jowar flour 30 to 45 seconds. Add cashews chilli flakes thyme and pepper.
4 Add water or stock. Cover and simmer 10 to 12 minutes.
5 Cool slightly then blend silky smooth. Reheat. Adjust salt pepper and thickness with a splash of water.
6 Off heat stir in vinegar or lemon optional. Taste and adjust.
Topping
7 Heat oil. Add shimeji and cook without salting until moisture cooks off and they turn golden.
8 Add garlic 30 seconds then tamari. Toss till glossy. Add thyme leaves and pepper at the end.
Serve
Pour soup. Top with golden mushrooms thyme cracked pepper and a little extra virgin olive oil.

18069607832108049.method:
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a pot. Add 1 small onion (chopped) and 2 garlic cloves (chopped). Sauté till soft and translucent.
Add ¾ cup zucchini (diced), 1 cup broccoli florets, ½ cup green peas, and 3 cups spinach along with a pinch of salt. Cook 3–4 minutes till everything softens and the spinach wilts fully.
Add 2 tbsp soaked cashews and 1½ cups vegetable stock or water. Cover and simmer for 8–10 minutes till vegetables are completely tender.
Blend till absolutely smooth and velvety with ¼ cup thick yogurt and a small splash of milk if needed for silkiness.
Return to low heat. Season with salt, ½ tsp freshly cracked black pepper, and 1–2 tsp lemon juice. Finish with 1 tsp olive oil or butter. Do not boil.

17867180034504121.method:
Chop 250 gms / ~2 cups of ripe pumpkin, transfer to a cooker-safe container and pressure-cook till tender. Don’t add any water to the container holding the pumpkin.
Cool, then gently press the cooked cubes with your palms to get rid of some of the water released from the pumpkin- especially important if you want a thicker consistency for the dip. You could totally leave the water in, the consistency will be thinner.
Now, mash the cubes with
2 green chilies, ground
Salt, to taste
1/2 tsp sugar/ as per taste
Add
~1/4 cup of thick yogurt- best if it’s tart
1/3 cup of grated coconut/ roasted peanut powder
Mix well.
Transfer to a bowl.
traditionally, we top this with this tempering
heat 1 Tbsp ghee and add
1/2 tsp Cumin seeds
1 finely chopped green chilies
Set aside to cool.
Before serving, mix in the tempered ghee, check for salt/ sugar balance.

18098761675795120.ingredients:
Grated carrots
Ghee (optional)
Soaked cashew
dates
Paneer
Nuts (to garnish )

17865566154433093.ingredients: Boiled sweet potato, ghee, grated jaggery, sesame seeds, chilli flakes, black salt, lemon juice.
17865566154433093.method:
Pan-fry sweet potato in ghee till crispy.
Add sesame & chilli flakes.
Lower flame, add jaggery and toss.
Switch off, add lemon juice & black salt.
Serve hot — desi honey-chilli taste! 🔥

17967308600979519.ingredients:
1/2 cup Aleev seeds- soaked in just enough  water to submerge the seeds for 3 hours
1.25 cups of jaggery
2 cups packed freshly grated coconut
3/4 tsp cardamom powder
17967308600979519.method:
Add 1 Tbsp of water to a heavy-bottomed pot, followed by the soaked Aleev seeds and jaggery.
Mix well to combine for 2 mins- then add the grated coconut.
Keep mixing/ stirring for ~15 mins till the mixture comes together- this needs some patience/ arm strength.
Add the cardamom powder, mix well, take it off the heat and shape into ladoos while warm.
Store these in the fridge- since they have coconut, they spoil if left unrefrigerated for more than 3-4 days.

17969576063988641.ingredients:
4 cups cooked rice (cook it a little mushy)
2.5 cups milk
1/2 cup curd
1 inch grated ginger
A handful of chopped coriander
1 tbsp butter (unsalted or white butter)
2 tbsp gingelly oil
1 tsp mustard seeds
1 tsp cumin seeds
2–3 dried red chillies
2–3 green chillies, slit
7–8 curry leaves
1 tsp hing
Salt to taste
17969576063988641.method:
1. In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked rice with milk and curd. Mix well, squeezing the rice lightly so it becomes soft and creamy.
2. Add the butter and mix again. Then add grated ginger and coriander leaves. Season with salt and combine thoroughly.
3. For the tadka, heat gingelly oil and add mustard seeds and cumin seeds. Once they splutter, add the red chillies, green chillies, curry leaves, and hing.
4. Pour the tadka over the curd rice and mix well.
5. Let it rest in a cool place/refrigerate for about an hour before serving for the best flavour and texture.

18047796416405569.method:
Heat 2 tsp oil and fry 6–8 lightly crushed garlic cloves until light golden. Cool.
Crush the fried garlic into a coarse paste.
Whisk 1 cup thick curd until smooth.
Mix in the garlic paste, ½ tsp roasted cumin powder and ½ tsp salt.
Chill for 30 minutes.
Garnish with chilli powder and coriander before serving.

17977511375785915.ingredients:
2 Tsp Ragi Flour ( Finger millet)
2-3 Drumsticks(optional)
Choice of veggies(Carrot, beans, green peas etc)
Salt ( 12 months+)
1 Tbsp Moringa powder
2 cups water
Spices(Ginger
Pepper
Cinnamon
Jeera) adjust as per requirement
17977511375785915.method:
1. In a bowl add ragi flour and water and prepare slurry without lumps
2. Add spices in mortar and grind well
3. Steam Drumstick & veggies until soft
4. Extract drumstick pulp
5. In a pot add boiled veggies and drumstick pulp and roughly mash with masher
6. Now add grounded spices, ragi slurry, water, moringa powder, salt
7. Mix well & cook until it becomes thick
8. Add lemon juice when serving

18076799426273651.ingredients:
400 g paneer, cut into cubes
2 cups spring onions, chopped
250 g baby corn, chopped
2 tbsp ginger–garlic paste
2 tsp jeera powder
2 tsp garam masala
1 tsp black pepper
1 tsp jeera seeds
1.5 tsp kalonji (nigella) seeds
3–4 tbsp ghee
Salt to taste
I’ve used 1 large cup (approx 250 g) of raw basmati rice, cooked with 1 tsp turmeric powder.
18076799426273651.method:
1. Heat ghee in a large kadhai. Add the jeera seeds and kalonji; let them crackle.
2. Add the baby corn and cook on medium heat until golden brown.
3. Add the ginger–garlic paste and sauté for a minute.
4. Add the spring onions, jeera powder, garam masala and pepper. Sauté for 2–3 minutes.
5. Add the paneer and cook for another 2–3 minutes.
6. Add the cooked turmeric rice and salt. Toss gently until everything is well combined.
7. Finish with lime juice. Serve hot with raita and potato chips.

18066371840219127.method:
Add 1 cup soaked rice, 1/4 cup fresh coconut, salt to taste and 1/2 cup ragi flour in a blender and blend till it’s slightly coarse. Once done, keep aside.
Heat 1 tbsp oil, add 1 tsp mustard seeds, 1 tsp urad dal, 1 tsp chana dal, 3-4 cashews (broken), 2 dry red chillies (crushed), 2 sprig curry leaves and 1/4 cup fresh coconut (grated).
Add in the prepared ragi rice batter and cook on low heat until it becomes thick. Now make it small balls and steam for 8-10 minutes. Serve with your favourite chutney.

17911724721236257.ingredients:
Black Urad Dal - 1/3 cup
Garlic - 4 big cloves
Cumin - 1 tsp
Asafoetida / Hing - 1/2 tsp
Pepper Powder
Chopped Coriander
Salt
17911724721236257.method:
Wash and soak the black urad dal overnight.
Add it to the pressure cooker, garlic, cumin and cook this for 3 to 4 whistles.
Blend this smooth and add chopped coriander, hing, salt , pepper powder, bring it to boil, bring it to boil and it’s ready!

18084540898982471.ingredients:
4-5 Drumsticks - peeled and cut in 3 inch pieces
1/4 cup raw moong dal (Washed and soaked for atleast 6 hours)
Salt to taste
1/2 tsp turmeric powder
Tadka
1 tbsp ghee
1 tbsp cumin seeds
5-7 garlic cloves chopped
8-10 chopped curry leaves
1/2 tsp dry ginger powder
1/2 tsp black pepper powder
Coriander leaves and lemon juice for garnish
18084540898982471.method:
Wash the moong dal 2-3 times of till the water is completely clean and soak for 6-8 hours
Wash and peel the drumsticks and cut in 3 inch pices
To a pressure cooker add the drumstick, moong dal, salt and turmeric with 750 mls of water and pressure cook on high heat till 3 whistles, then lower the heat and let it cook for 8-10 min
Turn off the gas / induction after 10 min and let the cooker cool down
Once the cooker is cool, open the lid and strain the dal and drumstick mixture into a kadhai
Mash it well to extract all the pulp from the drumstick
Pour another 750 mls of water from the strainer so that all the leftover dal and drumstick pulp is strained into the Kadhai and throw / compost the leftover fibre of the drumstick.
Set the Kadhai on medium heat and bring it to a boil
In the meantime prepare the tadka - heat ghee, add cumin seeds, once they crackle add the garlic and curry leaves and cook them for a 45-60 seconds and add the tadka to the soup
Add dry ginger powder and black pepper powder
Simmer the soup till the water and the dal and drumstick pulp are a cohesive blend
Adjust salt
Serve with fresh coriander leaves and a dash of lime juice

17983307777919594.ingredients:
Oil of your choice
Cumin seeds ½ tsp
1 medium onion, chopped
4 to 5 garlic cloves, sliced
1 small or medium potato, diced small
Water to just cover
1 bay leaf (I forgot to add it during the shoot. Do add it for gentle aroma.)
Shelled green peas 200 to 250 g
Baby spinach 100 g
Fresh mint leaves
Lemon zest of one lemon
Lemon juice to taste
Salt to taste
Black pepper to taste
Extra virgin olive oil for finishing
Pistachio sesame dukkah:
Pistachios about 3 tbsp
White sesame seeds about 1 tbsp
Lemon zest ½ tsp
Pinch salt
Black pepper optional
17983307777919594.method:
1. Warm oil in a heavy pot. Add cumin seeds until they crackle. Add onion with a pinch of salt and cook until soft and sweet.
2. Add garlic and cook briefly.
3. Add potato and enough water to just cover. Add the bay leaf. Simmer gently until the potato is tender.
4. Add peas and cook 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in spinach to wilt for 30 to 60 seconds. Turn off the heat.
5. Strain and reserve the cooking liquid. Let things cool slightly. Add mint leaves and lemon zest and blend right away until silky and bright.
6. Loosen with the reserved hot liquid to a smooth pour. Season with salt, black pepper, and lemon juice to taste.
7. For the dukkah toast pistachios and sesame on low heat until fragrant. Cool slightly, then crush to a coarse mix with lemon zest and a pinch of salt. Add black pepper if you like.
8. Rewarm the soup gently. Bowl it, drizzle extra virgin olive oil, spoon over the lemony pistachio sesame dukkah, and finish with a few mint leaves.

18108035320607025.ingredients:
1/4 cup ghee
1 bay leaf
2 cardamon pods
2 cloves
1 tsp cumin seeds
1/2 stick of cinnamon
1 onion – roughly chopped
2 green chilies – roughly chopped
4 cloves garlic – roughly chopped
1/2 inch ginger nub
1 large tomato – roughly chopped
1/4 cup cashews
2 tsp each: turmeric, red chili powder, ground cumin
3 tsp each: garam masala, ground coriander
1/4 heavy cream
1/3 cup frozen peas
1 bunch methi, around 1/3 cup – chopped and rinsed
2 tsp dried fenugreek
1 cup grated paneer
salt to taste

18072621050255323.ingredients:
1 cup roasted vermicelli
4 cups full-fat milk
1 cup condensed milk
2 tbsp ghee
10 cashews
8 almonds (chopped)
8 pistachios (chopped)
3 medium-sized sitaphal (custard apples)
2–3 cardamoms (crushed)
18072621050255323.method:
1. Roast the nuts:
Heat ghee in a pan. Add cashews, almonds, and pistachios. Fry until golden brown. Remove and keep aside.
2. Cook the vermicelli:
In the same pan, add 1 cup roasted vermicelli to the remaining ghee. Sauté for a minute.
3. Add milk:
Pour 4 cups of milk and bring it to a boil. Let the vermicelli cook completely in milk.
4. Sweeten and flavor:
Add 1 cup condensed milk and crushed cardamom. Mix well and simmer for 2–3 minutes.
5. Cool it down:
Let the payasam cool until it’s warm (not hot).
6. Prepare sitaphal pulp:
Scoop out the pulp from 3 medium-sized custard apples. Lightly pulse in a manual chopper 3–4 times to loosen the seeds. Remove seeds carefully and keep the pulp ready.
7. Mix and serve:
Once the payasam is warm, add the sitaphal pulp and roasted nuts. Mix gently.
8. Serve:
Enjoy chilled or at room temperature — every spoon is a creamy, nutty, fruity delight!

17953645782045800.ingredients:
Dahi (Curd)- 1 cup
Ginger garlic paste- 1 Tbsp
Green chillies- 2 pcs
Cashews (Kaju)- 8-10 pcs

Season with salt, haldi, coriander powder, and red chilli powder
Mix & add a splash of water
Cover & cook for 8-10 min till the tomatoes are done

Garnish with fresh coriander and its ready!☺️

18078625865005631.method:
1. SEED CRACKERS 🌰
Take about 3 tbsp of ground flax seeds. Add water till you get a thick mixture. Add a pinch of salt, a handful or more of pumpkin seeds, sesame seeds, and other seeds of choice. It should be very thick and you should be able to form a shape without it breaking apart.
Shape into crackers on wax paper, and then bake at really low temperature (around 70-80 degrees celcius) for a realllly long time (around 30, 45 minutes). Check so that it doesn't burn.
2. CHOC GRANOLA 🍫
Add around 1.5 cups of rolled oats to a bowl. Add a quarter cup of pumpkin seeds, quarter cup of chopped almonds, pinch of salt.
In a separate bowl, add 3-4 tbsp maple syrup, 1 tbsp tahini, 1 tbsp coconut oil, and 1-2 tbsp cocoa powder. Mix. Pour into the oat mixture and make sure everything is coated well.
Transfer to a greased baking tray and bake at 150 celsius for about 25 minutes. Let cool and add chopped chocolate.
3. MAKHANA 🧈
Roast 2 cups makahana in the oven until crunchy. In a bowl, mix 3 tbsp ghee, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp salt, and a pinch of black pepper. Drizzle onto the makhana and mix together.
4. DATE LADDOOS 🥥
Soak 3 medjool dates for a few hours. Add to a food processor with a handful of walnuts, 2-3 tbsp shredded coconut, 1 tbsp peanut butter. Blitz until you get a dough. Shape into ladoos.

Soup:
2 tbsp olive oil

17887468365240360.method:
Set the oven to 190C. Place butternut squash, onion and garlic into a roasting tin and season with thyme, chilli powder, salt, pepper and drizzle with olive oil. Mix everything together and place in the middle (not top) of the oven until golden (approx 18 mins)
Place a dutch oven/ deep saucepan on a medium heat and drizzle the base with olive oil. Add the sliced garlic followed by salt, rosemary, thyme, sage leaves and parmesan rind. Let this all infuse for a couple of minutes but don’t let the garlic burn.
Pour in the stock, add the lemon zest, lemon juice, sherry vinegar and season with salt and pepper. Return the lid and let this simmer gently for a couple of minutes.
Add the pasta. You can remove the sprig of thyme and rosemary at this point but keep the sage leaves they are delicious!
When the pasta is al dente add the cavolo nero and let this cook for a couple of minutes.
Remove from the heat and add  the roasted veggies to the soup. Squeeze in the roasted garlic don’t waste it! You need to season again at this point and you can add more lemon juice if needed.
Stir in the cream and parmesan.
Serve instantly in bowls with a grating of parmesan, some black pepper and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.

18062356730346960.method:

18070255693917957.method:

Add chopped tomatoes to the boiling mixture.
Let them cook until very soft (about 5 minutes).

3. Add dal mixture
Stir in the blended dal-water mixture and 1–2 cups of extra water to adjust consistency.
Allow the rasam to froth. (do not let it boil hard).

Heat groundnut oil or ghee in a small pan.
Add mustard seeds, let them splutter.
Add cumin, dried red chillies, curry leaves, and hing.

Switch off the flame (rasam should just be frothing, not boiling).

17980521332889594.method:
Step 1 – Rice Flour Preparation
Take 1 glass rice and soak it overnight.
Next morning, wash the soaked rice well.
Strain the water completely and spread the rice on a cloth for about 5 minutes.
Grind the rice into a smooth powder in a mixer.
Sieve the ground rice – soft rice flour is ready.
Soak sago in water for 1 hour and keep aside.

Step 2 – Dough & Jaggery Syrup
Heat a kadai, add 2 tbsp jaggery and 2 tbsp water.
Once jaggery melts, switch off the stove.
Add rice flour to this and mix well to make dough.
If the dough is too loose, add some more rice flour.
If it is too tight, sprinkle little water and adjust.
For syrup: take 1 cup jaggery + ½ glass water, melt it completely, switch off the stove and keep aside.

Step 3 – Cooking Pala Thalikalu
In a kadai, add 1 cup water + 2 cups milk.
Allow it to boil well.
Add the soaked sago and cook for 2 minutes.
Now take the prepared rice dough, press it through a sev/Janthikalu maker directly into the boiling milk to form “thalikalu”.
Cook for 10 minutes until the thalikalu become soft.
From the flour kept aside earlier, add little water and make a smooth paste without lumps.
Slowly pour this paste into the milk – it helps to thicken the consistency.
Add cardamom powder for flavor.
Switch off the stove and pour the melted jaggery syrup.
Fry cashews in ghee and add them on top.

18034031285265030.method:
To a large mixing bowl, add flour, baking powder, and salt. Whisk until combined and set aside.
To a small blender, add all wet ingredients except blueberries. Blend until completely smooth, about 20-seconds.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients. Use a wooden spoon or spatula to gently stir until a batter forms. Then, gently stir in your blueberries. Let your batter sit for 5-minutes while your pan heats (it needs this time to thicken), but no longer than 10-minutes.
Heat a non-stick pan to slightly below medium. Coat with a thin layer of butter. If the pan is too hot, the outsides will burn and the insides won’t cook through.
Pour batter on to the pan, about ¼ cup per pancake, making sure they don’t touch. Cook for 3-4 minutes untouched, or until the tops have lots of bubbles and the bottoms are golden brown. Flip, and cook for a few more minutes or until cooked through. -Repeat until all batter has been used, adding more butter to the pan as needed.

17957827631860405.method:
heat a generous pool of coconut oil (because flavour, my friend), toss in roughy crushed ginger (half an inch), garlic (6-8 cloves or more!), a tsp of fennel seeds, 2 slit green chillies, and a tsp of peppercorns. let them sizzle.

next, onions—four big ones, sliced thin. patience is key here. you want them brown, caramelized, almost weeping with joy. add salt, curry leaves, and give it a good stir.

kashmiri chilli powder 1 tablespoon, turmeric 1 tspn, coriander powder 1 tablespoon, and half a tspn garam masala. feeling extra? throw in tablespoon of eastern chicken masala—yes, even though it’s egg roast. trust me.

in goes a chopped tomato. let it melt into the masala. splash in some hot water and let it all simmer into a thick gravy.

finally, your boiled eggs. slice them slightly so they soak up the masala, then let them roast till they get that glorious coat of spice.

taste, adjust salt, maybe a sneaky pinch of sugar, and boom—you’ve cracked the code to the perfect kerala egg roast.

17875534923220034.ingredients:
1.5 cups Dry Sabudana
2 Thai green chilis, finely diced
4 tbsp oil
6 Curry Leaves
1 tsp cumin seeds
1 potato, diced small (leave the diced potato in a bowl of water until ready to use to prevent browning- and then drain when ready)
1 tsp chili powder
2 tsp sugar
2 tsp salt
1/2 lemon juiced
2 tbsp finely chopped cilantro
1/4 tsp turmeric powder
17875534923220034.method:
Rinse the sabudana until water runs clear. Then soak in water in a large bowl and let sit over night covered or upto 4 hours. If you’re short on time, you can submerge the Sabudana in boiling hot water for about 30 minutes until they are soft when squeeze between your finger tips. Drain all the water.

In a wide skillet over medium heat the oil and add the cumin seeds and green chilis and let splutter for a few seconds. Add the curry leaves followed by the diced (and drained if you soaked them) potatoes.  Reduce the heat, Add 1 tsp of salt, stir and cover the potatoes for about 8 minutes until potatoes are fork tender.

Next add the drained sabudana, chili powder, sugar, lemon juice and remaining salt. Stir well and continue to heat through and cook for an additional 4-5 minutes while stirring occasionally. You can cook longer at this step if you feel your sabudana are too firm or remove from heat if the sabudana are too soft. Cooking longer will give you a chewy texture.

Add the cilantro for garnish, mix well and remove from heat. Serve hot with a big dollop of yogurt if you like !

18029595938118619.ingredients:
2 cod fillets (about 6 oz each)
1 can (14 oz) coconut milk
1 lemon, thinly sliced
3 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped
4 cloves garlic, smashed
1 teaspoon ginger, grated
Salt and pepper to taste
1-2 tablespoons olive oil
Garlic chili oil for garnish
Cooked jasmine rice or orzo for serving
18029595938118619.method:
Pat the cod fillets dry with a paper towel and season both sides with salt and pepper.
In a large skillet or shallow pan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add smashed garlic and grated ginger, sautéing until fragrant and slightly browned.
Add about 4 slices of lemon to the base of the pan, then place the cod filets on top of the lemons.
Pour in the coconut milk, add the dill, and gently stir to combine the flavors. Bring the coconut milk to a gentle simmer.
Let the cod simmer in the coconut milk for 8-10 minutes or until the fish is opaque and easily flakes with a fork. Baste the fish with the coconut milk occasionally/as needed.
Adjust the seasoning if needed. Squeeze a bit of fresh lemon juice over the poached cod just before serving.
Serve the poached cod over a bed of rice or orzo, spooning some of the coconut milk sauce on top. Garnish with additional fresh dill and chili oil.

18350878264121827.ingredients:
1 small Focaccia bread
Burrata
Basil chutney (recipe below)
Tomatoes marinated in salt, pepper, olive oil and balsamic vinegar
1/4th cup Basil
2 cloves garlic
1/4th cup coriander
3-4 cashews- soaked in hot water
1 tbsp lime juice
2 spicy green chillies
Salt & Pepper to taste
18350878264121827.method:
Soak the cashews in hot water for 10-15 minutes
Add everything to a blender - basil, coriander, garlic, cashews, lime juice, salt & pepper and blend till slightly coarse
Pre heat the oven to 200 C
Slice the focaccia in half , drizzle with olive oil and toast in the oven for 6-7 minutes
Toss the sliced tomato in salt, pepper, extra virgin olive oil and balsamic vinegar
To assemble, start with the bread, spread the chutney, add the tomatoes & burrata
Serve and enjoy!

17999168306726656.ingredients:
25g Soya Chunks
1/2 Cup Peas
Handful of Methi
Masalas - Salt, Red Chilli Powder, Aamchur, Pepper, Pinch of Haldi
2 tbsp onion
2 green chillies chopped
2-3 cloves of garlic crushed

17999168306726656.method:
Grind boiled soya chunks, boiled peas, methi, onion, garlic, chillies and masala in a mixer jar.
In a bowl, add wheat flour and this mixture along with 1 tsp ghee
You don’t need water as this mixture is already moist. If needed you may add a little more flour to knead it properly. Let this dough rest for 10 mins in the fridge
IMP - Apply oil on the rolling board and pin and also dust your roti dough with a little flour so it does not stick to the bottom.
Make mini theplas, garnish with the sesame and kalaunji mix and cook it on a tava
Once the theplas cook on both sides then apply very little ghee and its ready!

18016720211660008.ingredients:
3/4 cup jowar flour

Salt

18016720211660008.method:
Mix all the ingredients make watery batter consistency.
Grease the pan, pour it on hot tawa.Drizzle little oil, let it cook.
Grate some paneer and enjoy with chutney.

18048594794233247.method: Preheat your oven to 410°F. 2️⃣ Cut 1 large butternut squash (or 2 honey nut squash like I did) in half and scoop out the seeds. Carefully score the flesh with a knife to help it cook evenly and soak up all those spices. Place it on a large baking tray. 3️⃣ Add 1 large red onion, cut into eighths, to the tray. 4️⃣ Grab 12-14 mini red peppers (or 2 red bell peppers), slice in half, remove seeds, and add to the tray. 5️⃣ Drizzle or spray 1 tbsp oil, 1 tbsp onion powder, 1 tbsp thyme, and 1 tbsp smoked paprika over the veggies. 6️⃣ Slice the top off a garlic bulb, drizzle with 1 tbsp olive oil, wrap in foil or parchment, and add to the tray. Roast everything at 410°F for 45-50 minutes. 7️⃣ Once roasted, scoop the squash away from the skin, then toss it in a blender with the roasted onion and peppers. Squeeze out the garlic from the bulb and add that in too. 8️⃣ Pour in 17 oz bone broth (chicken, veggie, or beef—your choice) and 3.5 servings of cottage cheese (around 3/4 of a tub). 9️⃣ Blend until it’s super creamy and smooth. 🔟 Serve it up hot or save for later!

18037248014582841.ingredients:
1 pound chicken tenders or cut of choice, cut into thin strips
1 cup low-carb breadcrumbs (or crushed pork rinds)
2 large eggs
1 tsp smoked paprika
Pinch of salt & pepper

Sauce Ingredients:
1/4 cup low sugar or regular honey
2 to 3 tbsp sriracha
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp soy sauce
1/2 tsp garlic powder
18037248014582841.method:
In a bowl, whisk 2 eggs. In another bowl, combine the lowcarb breadcrumbs (or crumbs) with smoked paprika, a touch of salt & black pepper.

2. Dip each chicken tender into the whisked egg, allowing any excess to drip off, then coat it with the seasoned breadcrumbs.

3. Place the breaded tenders in a single layer in the air fryer basket. Spray them lightly with avocado oil for a crispy finish. Air-fry or bake for 12 mins, flip, and airfry for another 3-5 mins until golden brown and cooked through (internal temp should reach 165F - time varies by airfryer + thickness, so it may be longer for you.

4.While the tenders are going, bring a pan to LOW heat, add 1/4 cup low sugar honey or regular honey, 2 to 3 tbsp sriracha, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp soy sauce, and 1/2 tsp garlic powder. Mix well.

5. Add the sauce into a bowl and carefully dip both sides of the tenders, or you can spoon it over. Top with sesame seeds. Serve with your favorite dipping sauce.

18483661279008853.ingredients:

15-20 Almonds

Grind all the above ingredients along with ghee, dates and anjeer until everything is sticky and well combined
Shape into laddus and dig in

18136800241352011.ingredients:
2-3 green chilies
6-7 cloves of garlic
7-8 curry leaves
1.5 cups of coriander leaves
1 heaping Tbsp Khobra
2 Tbsp oil (groundnut) with
1/4 tsp mustard seeds
Heeng
18136800241352011.method:
Dry roast 1/2 cup split urad dal (with skin), and then pressure cook it with 1.5 cups of water

While the dal is cooking, grind together
2-3 green chilies
6-7 cloves of garlic
7-8 curry leaves
1.5 cups of coriander leaves
1 heaping Tbsp Khobra

Grind without water/ just a Tbs or so if needed

Now, once the dal cooks, muddle it till uniformly mashed and then,
in a kadhai, temper

2 Tbsp oil (groundnut) with
1/4 tsp mustard seeds
Heeng

Tip in the spiced herb paste, and sauté for 2-3 mins

Now add
Scant 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

Followed by the cooked mashed udid dal

Add water as needed- Urad dal is dense, so I like the Ghuta to have a looser, flow consistency

Also add Salt

Let it simmer for 5-7 mins to let the flavours combine, and then serve over crushed bhakri/ hot rice.

17885980830017212.ingredients:

17997464402521908.method:

2. Toss with spice mixes and set aside.

18071967256669730.ingredients:

18071967256669730.method:

18331794379159236.ingredients:

17893177254050508.method: Blend these ingredients for a bold thecha, toss it with paneer, and enjoy with roti or rice

18000329543702171.method:
Boil red potatoes till fork tender. Peel and let them cool completely.

While the potatoes cool, make a garlic paste by mixing garlic, red chillies and timur or szechuan peppercorns. Set aside.

Mash the potatoes and transfer them to a mortar and pastel. Use a wooden mortar and pastel if you have one to pound the potatoes. The potatoes need to have a cheese pull-like consistency or they WILL dissolve in your soup. Set aside.

In a pot, heat oil over medium-high heat. Add the onion and garlic mixture and cook for 2-3 minutes.

Add tomatoes and green onions. Cook till wilted. Add salt. (i also added turmeric, but idk whats the rule on it)

Add water and let it simmer for 3-4 minutes.

Wet your hands in water and carefully form small balls from the mashed potatoes. Drop the potato balls into the soup.

Transfer to a serving bowl immediately and garnish with green onions, chilies, and butter, preferably yak butter. Enjoy!

18059766949895587.ingredients:

serve with some dahi and enjoyy

18264052567266867.method:
Add your olive oil and butter and melt
on medium heat, add in the onion and saute for 5 minutes. Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds. Add in the mushrooms
Stir it all to saute for 2-3 minutes.

Add In salt pepper and  herbs  and bring to a boil.Lower the heat to simmer covered for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add cream and mix
