18468914857052562.ingredients:
Capsicum/ Green bell peppers: 3, cubed
For tempering:
Oil: 1 Tbsp
Mustard seeds: 1 tsp
Channa dal: 2 tsp
Urad dal: 1 tsp
Cumin seeds/jeera: 1/2 tsp
Dried red chillies: 1 or 2
Curry leaves: 1 sprig
Hing: one pinch
Spices:
Turmeric powder: 1 tsp
Kashmiri red chilly powder: 2 tsp
Coriander powder: 1 tsp
Dry mango/aamchur powder: 1 tsp
Salt: to taste
Chickpea flour/ Besan: 2 Tbsp
Chopped Coriander leaves: for garnish
18468914857052562.method:
To a cast iron skillet, add oil and mustard seeds. Once they start to splutter, add channa dal, urad dal, cumin seeds, dry red chillies and curry leaves with a pinch of asofoetida. Wait until the dals turn light brown and then add the cubed capsicum.
Saute it for about two minutes and start to add the spices one by one. Now we just keep stirring occasionally and allow the peppers to cook down. It takes around 6 minutes. You can cover and cook if you want it to get done quicker.
Add a Tbsp or two of water to deglaze the pan and mix in the spices that may be stuck to the bottom.
After the peppers cook down and the oil separates, add two Tbsp of besan/chickpea flour. Keep stirring until the besan gets cooked and coats the peppers (for about 3 minutes).
Turn off the stove and garnish with coriander leaves 😊

18049169135048791.ingredients:
3 cups water
1 tablespoon fresh ginger (grated or crushed)
1 tablespoon coriander seeds (slightly powdered)
10 black peppercorns (crushed)
1 small cinnamon stick
½ teaspoon fennel seeds (crushed)
4 cardamom pods (cracked open)
1 tablespoon Assam black tea leaves (organic preferred)
1 cup milk (dairy or plant-based)
A pinch of saffron
Sweetener to taste (jaggery or sugar)
18049169135048791.method:
1. Bring 3 cups of water to a rolling boil in a saucepan.
2. Add:
Ginger for its warming, zesty kick.
Coriander seeds for earthy depth.
Crushed black pepper for a spicy spark.
Cinnamon stick for a sweet aroma.
Crushed fennel seeds for a subtle sweetness.
Cardamom pods for that unmistakable chai magic.
3. Let the spices simmer for 3 minutes, releasing their rich flavors.
4. Add Assam black tea leaves, and let the blend steep for 8–10 minutes.
5. Pour in 1 cup of milk and bring to a gentle boil.
6. Add a pinch of saffron for a luxurious touch.
7. Sweeten with jaggery or sugar to your liking, and stir well.
8. Strain the chai into your favorite cup and savor every silky-smooth sip.

18074022598626266.ingredients:
100g low fat paneer
2 cups of methi
1/2 cup Matar (peas) - (Boiled)
1 tsp jeera
Spices - Salt, 1/2 tsp coriander powder, 1/2 tsp haldi, 1/2 tsp red chilli powder, 1/2 tsp garam masala
For the creamy base:
2 big chopped onions
4-5 garlic cloves
2-3 cashews
1 cinnamon stick
1 bayleaf
2-3 peppercorns
1 clove
2-3 elaichi
18074022598626266.method:
In a pan, add 1.5 tsp ghee and saute some jeera.
Then add Matar and cook for 2-3 mins. Then add methi and let it cook for 6-7 mins on low flame.
Add the above spices in the cooked methi, matar and saute for 3-4 mins. Turn off the flame.
Boil the above ingredients for 12-15 mins (water should be just enough to soak all the above well) until everything is soft and the water has turned slightly pink (onion will leave its color)
Let it cool down and remove the bayleaf and cinnamon stick before blending
Blend this all along with its water (this is the magical ingredient as it contains all the flavor of the spices post boiling) with 100g low fat paneer.
Add this creamy mixture to the methi matar mixture and cook for another 7-8 mins on low flame (Add more water while cooking to adjust consistency if needed)
Add 1 tsp sugar and mix well.
Let it thicken a little and its ready!

18019559036345022.ingredients:
2 cups peas

2 tbsp olive oil
salt
pepper
thinly sliced tomatoes
juice from one lemon
chilli flakes, oregano, mixed herbs, crunchy garlic for garnish
18019559036345022.method: Take some thinly sliced tomatoes. Sprinkle salt and mixed herbs and keep in oven on convection mode for 15mins @180C. Til then cook peas in water for 10mins and then rinse and drain the water. Take a pan, add 1 tbsp oil, add onions and garlic, salt, let onions caramelise- get brown and then keep aside. Take a mixer jar, add peas, add paneer, fried garlic, salt, pepper, lemon and blend- your spread is ready. Airfry sourdough slices @180C for 7-10mins so you get the crunchiest bread. Apply the spread. Top it with the tomatoes and caramelised onions. Garnish with herbs mentioned above and enjoyy!

18072810706631440.method:
Heat some oil (I use olive oil) in a pan and put garlic.

put the filing, and wrap it in the shape you desire.
pan fry it using very little oil

18339198844197758.ingredients:
2 Tsp Ragi Flour ( Finger millet)
2-3 Drumsticks
Choice of veggies(Carrot, beans, green peas etc)

1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C).
2. Cut your honey nuts in half, remove seeds, add a little olive oil and roast it in the oven until soft (about 40 minutes but varies depending on size)

4. Melt butter and allow to cool

8. Chop up chocolate and fold in dark chocolate chunks

12. Top with flakey sea salt and enjoy!!!!

Whisk cream cheese, egg, vanilla, and sugar until smooth.

Brown butter in a saucepan over medium-low heat, stirring every 10 seconds. Once milk solids from butter sink and turn golden brown, transfer to heatproof bowl.Add cocoa powder, oil, vanilla, and chopped chocolate; mix until dissolved. Let the mixture cool at room temperature for 15-20 mins

Transfer half of brownie mixture to prepared pan. Reserve 30g / 2-3 tbsp cream cheese mixture; add remaining on brownie mixture.

1 teaspoon coriander powder
1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
A few splashes of hing (asafoetida)
2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream
Olive oil for frying
Fresh cilantro, chopped (for garnish)
Salt to taste
18052518691798792.method:
1. Prepare the Okra: Cut the okra into 1-inch pieces. Fry them in a generous amount of olive oil on high heat until they are slightly crispy. Add the cubed red onions towards the end and sauté until the onions soften. Set aside.
2. Make the Masala Base: In the same pan, with the leftover oil, add 1 teaspoon of cumin seeds and 5 cloves of chopped garlic. Cook until the garlic is almost golden brown. Add the minced red onion and sauté on high heat for 5-10 minutes until the onions are caramelized.
3. Add the Spices: Add 1 teaspoon each of red chili powder and coriander powder, 1/2 teaspoon of turmeric powder, and a few splashes of hing. Pour in a little water to cover the spices and sauté until the oil starts to separate from the masala.
4. Finish the Masala: Stir in 2 tablespoons of heavy whipping cream and mix well.
5. Combine and Serve: Add the fried okra and onion mixture to the masala, gently combining everything. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with crispy roti.

1 tsp ginger-green chili paste
1 tsp sugar
Salt to taste
For Tempering:
1 tbsp oil

1 tsp sesame seeds
1-2 green chilies, slit

A pinch of asafoetida (hing)

1 tsp sugar
17859504213145155.method:
1. Prepare the Batter: In a mixing bowl, combine besan, semolina, yogurt, water, lemon juice, ginger-green chili paste, sugar, and salt. Mix well to form a smooth batter. Adjust the consistency with more water if needed. The batter should be thick but pourable. Let the batter rest for 15-20 minutes.
2. Steam the Idlis :Grease idli moulds with a little oil. Just before steaming, add Eno fruit salt or baking soda to the batter. Mix gently and immediately pour the batter into the idli moulds. Steam the idlis in an idli steamer or pressure cooker (without the whistle) for about 10-12 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
3. Prepare the Tempering: In a small pan, heat oil. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter. Add sesame seeds, slit green chilies, curry leaves, and asafoetida. Sauté for a few seconds. Add 1/4 cup of water and 1 tsp of sugar. Bring it to a boil and then turn off the heat.
4. Once the idlis are done, remove them from the moulds and place them on a serving plate. Pour the prepared tempering over the idlis, ensuring they are well-coated.
5. Garnish and Enjoy: Garnish with freshly chopped coriander leaves and freshly grated coconut, serve hot with green chutney or tamarind chutney.

17911129367955155.method:
Blitz all the ingredients together in a blender
Roll into balls
Drizzle some chocolate on the top of each ball, and top with some crushed peanuts
Refrigerate until set (about an hour)

18311108212155415.method: Grind all ingredients and make laddoos.

100 gms gram flour

18033560821810590.ingredients:
150g cashew nuts
150g medjool Dates
30g shredded coconut
40g Dark chocolate, melted (I used 70%)
Pinch of Salt
18033560821810590.method:
In a food processor add cashews, dates and shredded coconut and salt.
Blitz for a few minutes until the ingredients are well incorporated. It’s ready when the dough is not crumbling anymore and it compact itself when you squish it with your finger.
Divide into 18 cookie shapes and make a hole in the middle with your thumb (to make space for the chocolate).
Place the cookie balls on a tray with baking paper on top.
Leave in the freezer for 20-30 minutes until the dough is firm.
Take out of the freezer and add the melted chocolate on top.
Put back in the freezer for 5-10 minutes so the chocolate hardens up.

18049348531679721.ingredients:
1 block of soft tofu (150g)
30g chickpea flour or sattu
Water (as needed for blending)
Salt (to taste)
Turmeric (a pinch)
Chopped onions (to taste)
Chopped tomato (to taste)
Chopped capsicum (to taste)
Chopped green chilies (to taste)
Oil spray
18049348531679721.method:
Blend the Base:
In a blender, add the block of soft tofu, 30g of chickpea flour or sattu, a little water, salt, and a pinch of turmeric.
Blend the mixture until it is completely smooth.
Prepare the Mixture:
Pour the blended tofu and chickpea flour mixture into a bowl.
Add the chopped onions, tomato, capsicum, and green chilies to the bowl.
Stir well to combine all the ingredients.
Cook the Omelette:
Heat a pan over medium heat and spray it with a little oil.
Pour the tofu and chickpea flour mixture into the pan and spread it evenly.
Cook the omelette until it is fully set and golden brown on both sides, flipping carefully as needed.

18013836137161311.ingredients:
1 cup Rice
½ cup Chana Dal
¼ cup Tuar Dal
2 tbsp Urad Dal
½ cup Dahi
1 tbsp Ginger Green Chilli paste
Pinch of Hing
¼ tsp Haldi
¼ tsp Red Chilli Powder
½ tsp Lemon Juice
½ cup Corn Kernels steamed

½ cup Carrot grated
¼ cup Coriander leaves chopped

White Sesame

18013836137161311.method:
Transfer rice and dals into a bowl and rinse well using water
Soak in water for 4 hours
Drain out the water and transfer into a blender with dahi and grind it into a thick batter (make sure it is thick)
Whisk the batter for 7-10 mins to make it light and fluffy to avoid using eno
Add in all the other ingredients and lastly add eno, if you’re not whisking the batter
Prepare your paniyaram pan by heating it
Add some oil, mustard seeds, sesame & curry leaves in each cavity
Followed by a spoonful of the batter and cook it on low flame till golden brown from both sides
Serve hot with green chutney and enjoy!

17857168134176229.ingredients:
1/3 cup raw unsalted pistachios
1/3 cup roasted vermicelli (sevaiyyan or kataifi pastry or filo pastry strips)

4-5 small dates soaked in boiling water for 10 - 15 mins
1/2 cup dark chocolate chips
1 tbsp coconut milk/cream
1 tsp vanilla essence
Optional- chopped pistachio for garnish
17857168134176229.method:
1. Dry roast pistachios until lightly brown and fragrant. Let it cool down.
2. Fry roasted vermicelli in ghee until it browns a bit.
3. Blitz pistachio on a high speed in intervals in the mixie - keep scraping it down - until a smooth pistachio butter forms.
4. Add the soaked dates, vanilla and coconut milk and blend until smooth.
5. Mix this with the roasted vermicelli.
6. Take spoonfuls of this and set on a baking paper.
7. Flatten them a bit and freeze for 10-15 mins.
8. Melt dark chocolate over a double boiler.
9. Coat the kunafa bites with chocolate, sprinkle some chopped pistachio on top, freeze for another 5 mins and done.

17922242984905595.ingredients:
1 cup desiccated coconut

17922242984905595.method:

Add the desiccated coconut and cook on low flame until the mixture comes together
Shape the laddoos, garnish & enjoy!

18088328131431288.ingredients:
1 cup Ragi flour (finger millet flour) - 120g

18088328131431288.method:

In a bowl, add ragi flour, whole wheat flour, baking powder and baking soda. Mix well.
Add the prepared paste along with milk and fold the batter.
Transfer it to a loaf pan, top it up with any nuts of choice and bake at 180 degrees C for 45-50 mins or until a skewer inserted in comes out clean!

18141035026315880.ingredients:
For the Crostini + Topping:
2 Tbsp Butter
3 Cloves Garlic
1/2 a Medium Sweet Yellow Onion, diced small
5 Mushrooms, chopped
1/2 tsp Red Pepper Flakes
1 tsp Kosher Salt
1/2 tsp Black Pepper
16 oz. Fresh Baby Spinach
1/3 Cup Italian Breadcrumbs
1/3 Cup Shredded Mozzarella
1/3 Cup Grated Parmesan
6 Tbsp Olive Oil
1 Baguette, sliced in rounds
Sprinkle On Top:
2/3 Cup Finely Shredded Mozzarella
1/4 Cup Grated Parmesan
Vegan Modification: Sub in olive oil for butter, plant based cheese for mozzarella, and nutritional yeast for parmesan
18141035026315880.method:
Preheat oven to 425F
In a medium pot or large pan, sauté the onions and garlic in butter for 2-3 mins until onions start to become translucent, then add the mushrooms, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper and sauté 2-3 more mins until mushrooms are tender
Add the spinach (in batches if you can’t fit it all at once) and sauté until it cooks down (2-3 mins) then mix in the breadcrumbs
Transfer into a bowl and let cool while you slice your baguette and cover the bottom of two quarter baking sheets (~9x13”) with 3 Tbsp olive oil each
Once the veggies have cooled slightly, mix in the mozzarella and parmesan (1/3 cup of each); spread a slightly heaping mound of the veggie topping on each slice of bread and place on the baking sheet
Top with finely shredded mozzarella and parmesan and bake 15 mins until bread is golden brown and crispy - enjoy!

18005746478430998.ingredients:
Avocado or Olive Oil
1 Rice Paper Sheet
2 Eggs
Salt & Pepper
1 Scallion, sliced
Chili Oil (optional)
Cilantro Leaves
Carrot, shaved with a vegetable peeler
18005746478430998.method:
Beat eggs with a sprinkle of salt and pepper and set aside
Preheat a medium pan over medium heat and coat (or spray) lightly with oil
Add a dry rice paper sheet (textured side down) and then add the scallions on top of the rice paper sheet, arranging them so they’re distributed evenly
Pour the eggs in the middle of the rice paper sheet and then push them toward the perimeter with chopsticks or a spoon so they fill the sheet in one layer
Cook 1-2 mins until the eggs are almost set, then add chili oil to taste and cook for another 1-2 mins until eggs are set (you do not need to flip)
Transfer onto a plate and add the cilantro leaves and shaved carrot
Eat open face with fork and knife or roll up like a jelly roll and enjoy egg wrap style :)

18012187688346141.ingredients:
15-20 lychee
100 gms paneer

1 scoop vanilla icecream/ 1/4 cup sugar / 1 tbsp sugar free

18012187688346141.method: Make a slit in the lychee & deseed it. Mash the paneer well with your palms till smooth. Add in the chopped mango, vanilla icecream/sugar & half the kesar soaked in milk. Give it a good mix & then stuff the sandesh mixture in the lychee & remove the excess. Chill it for 30-40 minutes. Arrange in a dish & add in the remaining kesar milk & garnish with chopped pistachios. Serve immediately & dig in.!

18020922373993413.ingredients:
4 slices of whole-grain bread
1 large egg
1/2 cup/ 120 ml milk (dairy or plant-based)

1/2 tsp ground cinnamon
a pinch of salt
Cooking spray or oil for the air fryer basket
1 cup / 240 g Cottage cheese
2 tbsp maple syrup
2 tsp vanilla extract
1/4 cup / 30 g chopped pecans
4 tbsp maple syrup
18020922373993413.method:
Preheat your air fryer to 350°F / 180°C.
In a shallow bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, vanilla extract, ground cinnamon, and salt until well combined.
Dip each bread slice into the egg mixture, ensuring it’s evenly coated.
Lightly grease the air fryer basket or tray with cooking spray or oil. Place the bread slices in the air fryer basket, leaving some space between them.
Air fry the French toasts for 6-8 minutes, flipping them halfway through the cooking time until they are golden brown and crispy.
Meanwhile in a blender or with a hand mixer, combine cottage cheese, 2 tbsp maple syrup, vanilla extract, and a pinch of salt until creamy.
Remove the air-fried French toast from the air fryer. Serve with vanilla cottage cheese cream, chopped pecans, and remaining maple syrup.

18257129293242678.method:

- 200 ml coconut milk
- 1 ripe mango, diced

1/2 lemon juiced

18009595199141142.method:
In a large bowl soak the sabudana with 2 cups of water or enough so they are just fully submerged and let this sit covered over night or 4 hours. (If you’re short on time, soak the sabudana in super hot water from a kettle for 30 minutes then replace the hot water as it cools down. Do this until your Sabudana are soft.)
Make sure the water is fully covering the sabudana. Drain any excess water the next day & set aside.
In a wide non-stick skillet heat oil over medium high heat. Once the oil is hot, add the cumin seeds & green chilis & cook for a few seconds. Add curry leaves then reduce the heat slightly And add the potatoes with 1 tsp salt.
Let the potatoes cook, covered for about 8-10 minutes until completely fork tender, lowering heat and stirring as necessary to prevent burning.
Once potatoes are cooked are tender add the drained sabudana, chili powder, sugar, lemon juice & remaining salt. Stir well & continue to cook for an additional 4-5 minutes while stirring occasionally.
Add the cilantro for garnish, mix well & remove from heat. Taste & adjust seasoning as necessary. Favors should be a balance of sweet, spicy & salty. Serve hot!

4 cloves of garlic
1 lemon
1/4 of a stock cube
1 tbsp nutritional yeast or Parmesan
100ml double cream
17861587500096025.method: Fry the diced shallot in olive oil for 3-5 minutes and then add the garlic for another minute. Boil the gnocchi for 2 minutes. Pour cream into the pan with the onions, along with the stock cube and peas, stir in the drained gnocchi and some of their cooking water. Stir through nutritional yeast, season to taste and finish with lemon juice

17984101193359741.ingredients:
1 cup curd/yogurt, little sour is preferred
2-1/2 cups water or more, adjustable
Salt, to taste
1/2 tsp black salt
1/2 tsp red chilli powder
1/2 tsp cumin powder
3-4 tbsp boondi
1 tbsp coriander, finely chopped
For tadka -
1 tsp mustard oil
1/2 tsp cumin seeds
1 dry red chillies, broken
1 green chilli, chopped
1/4 tap hing
17984101193359741.method:
Add yogurt, water in a bowl and whisk it well. You can use buttermilk too if you need watery raita. Add salt, black salt, red chilli powder, cumin powder and mix it well.
Heat a diya. Add oil and heat it up. Add hing, cumin seeds, dry red chillies and cook for a few seconds. Add green chillies and add the diya in the yogurt mix, mix well and let it rest for 2-3 mins.
Take out the diya, add boondi, coriander and mix it well. Serve with aloo ki sabzi and hot hot pooris.

18175569442295154.method:
For the Green Base: Add some garlic butter to a pan. Then add 5-6 cloves of garlic, pepper, oregano, mixed herbs. Sauté well until the garlic is golden brown and add fresh peas to this. Cook for 3-4 mins and add a handful of freshly chopped spinach. Cook for 1 min and add freshly chopped basil. Now add this to a blender, add 150g low fat paneer, a tiny dash of water, salt and 1/2 tsp red chilli powder.
For the topping: Add garlic butter to a pan. Then add some chopped onion. Sauté for 2 mins and add mushrooms. Let it cook for 5 mins until they are caramelised and beautifully brown. Now add salt, red chilli powder, mixed herbs and cherry tomatoes chopped in half and just mix for 30 seconds and turn off the flame. Also add some fresh basil along with the cherry tomatoes.
Assemble: Take 2 slices of whole wheat/multigrain/ sourdough bread and apply this greek paste on the toasted bread. Add the toppings we prepared. Sprinkle oregano and drizzle siracha/hot sauce.

18115382404351213.ingredients:
1 cup Makhana (Fox nuts or Lotus seeds)
1 cup Curd (Yogurt)
1/2 cup Pomegranate seeds
1/4 teaspoon Hing (Asafoetida) (optional)
1/2 teaspoon Cumin Powder
1/2 teaspoon Chaat Masala
1/2 teaspoon Black Salt
Salt, to taste
1/4 teaspoon Black Pepper
Coriander Leaves, for garnishing
1 teaspoon Jaggery (optional, for sweetness)
18115382404351213.method:
1. Dry roast the Makhana in a pan until they become crispy.
2. Whisk the curd until smooth in a mixing bowl. Add cumin powder, chaat masala, black salt, regular salt, hing and black pepper according to taste. Mix everything well.
3. Optionally, add a teaspoon of jaggery for a hint of sweetness.
4. Add pomegranate seeds to the mixture for a burst of flavor and color.
5. Add the roasted Makhana to the curd.
6. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves & pomegranate seeds .
7. Chill the Makhana Raita in the refrigerator for some time before serving.
8. Serve cold as a refreshing and healthy accompaniment to your meal!

18014910934986460.ingredients:
For the stuffing:
boiled potatoes, grated carrots, mixed in with some salt, ginger paste, finely cut chili and a powder of ajwain&cumin seeds in appropriate quantities-
For the batter:
1/2 cup besan flour, 1 tbsp plus a little rice flour, salt, karam to taste, a little bit of that ajwain+cumin powder, water
18014910934986460.method: Cut the peppers in half, roast if necessary, cut a vertical slit, coat the inside with a sprinkling of besan, stuff the curry, close it up, (optional: coat the outside with some curry too), dip in besan batter and fry on low heat till golden brown!

17952980531749760.ingredients:
4 store-bought croissants
3/4 cup mascarpone cheese
3/4 cup heavy cream
4-5 Tbsp icing sugar
2 tsp espresso powder (dissolved in 1 Tbsp warmed cream)
1 tsp vanilla
Pinch salt
Cocoa powder, for dusting
17952980531749760.method: Bake croissants at 300F for 14 minutes so they crisp up then let cool completely before filling with the cream.

18417360085053052.ingredients:
Dry Ingredients
1 +1/2 cup oats flour (made with rolled oats)
1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder (reduce if you don’t like the intense  taste of chocolate)
1 tsp baking powder
3/4 tsp baking soda
1/4 tsp Himalayan salt
1/4 tsp vanilla powder
Optional
1tbs cinnamon powder
1tsp coffee powder
Wet Ingredients
1 ripe avocado (for the best results)
1/2 cup date paste/more (as per taste)
3/4 cup coconut/ almond milk
2-3 tbs coconut butter
3-4 tbs of water to mix the dough well
Dressing
Roasted sliced walnuts/ berries of choice
18417360085053052.method:
Method
Preheat the oven to 180 degrees C
Dry mixing
Dry roast the oats for 4-5 mins.
Once cool down, add them to a blender, blitz for about 15 sec. to make a powder
In a mixing bowl, add oats flour and the rest of the dry ingredients, mix well
Set aside
Wet mixing
Blend the almonds with water to make the creamy milk
Blend the avocado (peeled & pitted) to make a smooth paste
Prepare the date paste
In a food processor or wide-mouth blender, add all the wet ingredients, blend to mix them well
Add the dry  ingredients to the wet ingredients mix well
Prepare a baking pan with a parchment paper
Pour the batter into the cake tin
(smooth textured, smooth pourable consistency not tight)
Bake for 30-45 mins. or until a toothpick comes out clean
Frosting
Chocolate paste
Cashew cream+ date paste+ cocoa powder+vanilla powder+a pinch of salt (optional)
Mix, adjust the sweetness
Dressing
After spreading a thick alayer of chocolate  frosting, add the dressing immediately
Spread roasted walnuts
OR
Arrange  fresh berries over the layer of frosting
Once you switch off the oven, please wait for 1-2 hours or more/overnight

18061210948508019.method:
Cut drumsticks and pressure cook them with 1/2 cup water for 2 whistles
Now mash and strain them through a strainer, because we want the pulp
In that pulp add
1/2 tbsp turmeric powder
1/2 tbsp red chilli powder
1 tbsp coriander powder
Salt as per taste
Ajwain
Cumin seeds
Finely chopped ginger,garlic and geeen chilli(you can also add paste)
Mix it well and add wheat flour
Don’t add any extra water while kneading the dough
Now make parathas out of it
To enhance the taste I’ve also put some chopped coriander leaves and sesame seeds while making parathas
And enjoy them with curd

17991119195355723.ingredients: 1/3 cup/ 75 gms of moong dal, roasted
17991119195355723.method:
Once cool, wash and pressure cook with just enough water.
Once cooked, mash- keep it as chunky/ smooth as you like.
While the dal is cooking, prepare the orange- peel, remove membranes and seeds of 1 orange- keeping the segments as intact as possible. Also reserve some peel (about 1/8th of an orange- too much will make it bitter) and cut it into thin strips
Now
In a pot, heat
1 Tbsp ghee and temper it with
1/2 tsp sugar- let this begin to caramelise and then quickly add
Ginger, julienned/ cut into strips
1 bay leaf
Garam masala made by grinding 1/2 inch stick of cinnamon and seeds from 1-2 cardamom
1/4 tsp turmeric powder + 1/4 tsp red chili powder, diluted with 2 tsp water
Stir everything well, now tip in the cooked and mashed dal
Add water, along with
Salt, to taste
2 green chilies, slit
Sugar, to taste/ optional (we already have sugar in the tempering)
Once the dal comes to a simmer, carefully add orange segments + the peel cut into strips and turn off heat.
Cover and let it sit for 10 mins.
Serve with hot rice- and take in the surprising joy of fishing out juicy orange segments from your dal.

17910002861796460.ingredients:
1 Tsp coconut oil
1 Tbsp maple syrup
a pinch of salt and cinnamon
1/4 cup (25g) oats
17910002861796460.method:
Melt in a pan.
Add and toss around on medium heat for 3-4mins.
Transfer to parchment paper to let it cool down briefly.
Serve over yogurt and fruit. (I mixed coconut yogurt with protein powder and made cinnamon apples).

17842752552174307.ingredients:
1 brinjal (large)
3 red serrano peppers or 8 pandu mirchis
4-5 green chillies
6-7 garlic
2 tbsp peanut oil
1 medium tomato
1 tbsp chilli powder
1 tbsp salt
For tadka:
1 tsp oil
1 tsp jeera and mustard seeds
1 tsp chana and urad dal
4-5 curry leaves
17842752552174307.method:
Heat oil in a pan, add the garlic and chopped brinjal, let it roast well in oil, add red and green chillies mix well. Immediately add the tomato and mix well. Cover and cook for 2 minutes. Mix and cook again until the tomato is well cooked. Add chilli powder and salt. Mix well and turn the flame off in 1 minute.
You can then grind this to a chutney in a mortat pestle, grinder (on pulse mode) or use an immersion blender like I did. Don’t blend it too much, coarse texture is what brings taste to this pachadi.

18025722307947632.ingredients:
Chicken marination-
250 gms boneless chicken
1/2 tbsp ginger-garlic-green chilli paste
1/2 tbsp lemon juice
1 tsp salt
1 tsp haldi
1/2 tbsp coriander powder
1/2 tbsp mutton masala(optional)
1 tsp red chilli powder
2 tbsp thick yogurt
For the Khichdi -
1/3rd cup Rice + 1/4th cup Masoor Dal
1 tbsp Ghee
1/2 tbsp Jeera
1 tbsp ginger-garlic-green chilli paste
1 finely chopped onion
1/4th cup Green peas
5-6 mushrooms
1/4th cup carrot
1/4th cup beetroot
1/4th cup capsicum
2 tbsp spring onion
1/4th cup Tofu/Paneer
2 finely chopped tomatoes
Salt to taste
Haldi, coriander powder, red chilli powder
Garam masala & Meat masala (optional)

17913340001876171.ingredients:
3 beaten eggs
Neutral Oil for frying
5 tbsp of salted butter
6 cloves of chopped garlic
4 chopped spring onions whites separate to the green
1 tsp or more of sesame seeds
1 tsp of sesame oil
2 cups of any rice. I used the Trader Joe’s brown rice it’s my favorite. But basmati also works great. Ideally should be short grain
Seasonings: 1/2 tsp of salt, 1/2 tsp of white sugar, 1 tsp of chicken powder I use the @shaheenroastery brand
2 tbsp of soy sauce
17913340001876171.method: In a frying pan over medium heat scramble the eggs. Remove from pan. Return the pan back to the heat and place the heat on high. Add 2 tablespoons of butter and a little bit of oil. When the butter gets warmed up add the garlic and the whites of the green onions. Once the garlic gets fragrant and Golden add in the sesame seeds and the rice and 2 more tbsp of butter. Once the butter melts add in the seasonings as well as the soy sauce. Mix well, adjust seasoning. Pour the sesame oil and Add another tbsp of butter right before serving. Top with green spring onions and serve immediately.

18014098625175436.ingredients:
500g baby potatoes
1 heaped tbsp harissa paste
3-4 tbsp olive oil
Salt
Yoghurt:
1 small clove garlic
1/2 a lemon
3 heaped tbsp greek yoghurt
Salt
Parsley and Pickled onions(recipe in highlights) to serves
18014098625175436.method:
Preheat the oven to 200C. Par boil the potatoes until just soft, drain and then smush with a glass. Mix the harissa and oil together and then pour this on top and mix. Roast in the oven for another 35-40 minutes until crisp around the edges.
Meanwhile, mix minced garlic with lemon juice and salt in a bowl, leave for 5 minutes and then stir through the yoghurt. Spread it on a plate and top with the crispy pots, pickled onions and parsley

18400741177064351.ingredients:
1 bunch spring onion (5-6 individual stalks)
1 tbsp peanut oil
1tsp jeera
4-5 green chillies (or more if you want it to be extra spicy)
1 small marble sized ball of tamarind
1 tsp turmeric powder
5 cloves of garlic
1/2 cup cilantro
1 tsp corriander powder
1 tsp salt
18400741177064351.method:
Heat oil in a pan, add jeera, garlic, green chillies and roast well. Then add tamarind and turmeric powder and mix.
Add chopped spring onions and mix well
Immediately add cilantro and mix well
Add salt and corriander powder and let this cook for 3-4 minutes
Now add 1tbsp water (only if it got too dry), close lid and let it cook for a minute.
Turn the stove off and transfer the mixture into a mortar pestle after it cools down
Alternatively you can use a grinder to pulse grind
Mash into a chutney and enjoy with hot rice and ghee/peanut oil

17996000036299334.method:
1. Cook 1 cup sticky rice to 1.1 cup water in rice cooker
2. Slice mangos
3. Make coconut sauce, which is 1 cup coconut milk and 1/2 cup sugar +1 tsp salt and adjust to desired sweetness
4. Once rice is done, add about 1/4 of the coconut mixture and gently mix into the rice.
5. Add about 3 tbsp corn starch slurry (2 tbsp corn starch + 1 tbsp water, mixed in a bowl) into the coconut milk and stir until thickkkkyyy
6. Plate and garnish with toasted sesame seeds!

17972650736660303.ingredients:
Cinnamon stick (1)
Star anise (1-2)
Cardamom pods (handful)
Loose green tea leaves (half cup)
Milk (2 cups)
Sugar (per your liking)
Salt (dash)
Baking soda (1.5 teaspoons)
17972650736660303.method:
Place cinnamon stick, star anise, cardamom and green tea leaves in 3 cups of water.
Bring to boil approximately 2-3 times. Aerate/whisk the liquid so much that it evaporates and reduces to one cup, then add ice 🧊 cold water to replace the evaporated water.
Add baking soda, and a pinch of salt. Allow that to boil for approximately 15-25 mins on medium heat, if water reduces, keep adding more cold water to replenish.
After a while, the liquid should start changing color toward a dark red/burgundy! Strain the tea leaves.
Separately warm up milk, mix the tea with milk. Add sugar to your liking and top with pistachios or almonds!

17934892592805598.ingredients:
For the broth:
1 tbsp tahini
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 tbsp miso
1 tbsp tamari/soy sauce
1 large garlic clove/1 tsp minced garlic
1 tsp minced ginger
500ml vegetable stock
250ml soya milk
2 portions of pre-cooked noodles or instant ramen noodles
2 portions frozen gyoza
Toppings of choice (I had edamame, pak Choi, sesame seeds and chilli oil)
17934892592805598.method:
Add the tahini, miso, sesame oil, tamari/soy sauce, garlic and ginger to a pot. Add a splash of broth and whisk together to make a smooth, creamy paste.
Add the broth and soy milk and whisk well. Bring to a simmer and leave to bubble for a few minutes to cook out the ginger and garlic.
Add the ramen noodles and gyoza and cover with a lid. Leave to simmer for a further couple of minutes until cooked through.
Serve in bowls, add your toppings and enjoy! 💛

18019278965066704.ingredients:
Lady's Finger: 250 g
Red Chilies 6-8 (remove few seeds or else would get too spicy)
Fenugreek Seeds: 1/2 Tsp
Cumin Seeds: 1 +1/2 Teaspoon
Coriander Seeds: 2 Tablespoons
Mustard Seeds: 1 Teaspoon
Garlic: 7 to 8 Cloves
Small Lemin size tamarind
Salt: to taste
18019278965066704.method:
Take 1/4 Kg of Lady's Finger/Okra and cut them into small pieces,
heat a pan and roast Red Chilies in Oil. Roast until change in color, transfer them to a separate bowl.
To the same pan add 1/2 a Tsp of Fenugreek Seeds, 1 Tsp of Cumin Seeds, 2 Tbsp of Coriander Seeds roast them, cook Bhindi now till it’s well cooked
Now add oil in the same pan cook garlic, 1/4 tsp mustard seeds, curry leaves 1 sprig, add a large Tomato to the same pan along with 2 Reeds of washed Tamarind, salt n pepper and fry until soft with a lid on it. Add salt & pepper
the dry red chilli, okra and tomato paste to chutney.
Optional can add an extra tempering of oil & red chilli

17985803738434578.ingredients:
Chicken marinade
1. 600 grams chicken thighs (about 5 chicken thighs)
2. 2 tablespoons course ground coriander
3. 1 tablespoon course ground black pepper
4. 5 garlic minced
5. 2 teaspoons ginger minced
6. 2 tablespoons oyster sauce
7. 1/2 teaspoon salt
Sauce :
1. 5 small red onion or 2 large sliced
2. 2-3 tablespoons chili flakes- or however much you like 1-2 teaspoons??
3. 3 tablespoons brown sugar
4. 2 tablespoons corn starch or rice powder (browned and grinded )
5. 3 tablespoons tamarind water
6. 2 tablespoons lime juice
7. 2 tablespoons fish sauce
8. 2 tablespoons cilantro chopped ( more for garnish)
To Saute:
2 tablespoons butter
1 tablespoon oil
17985803738434578.method:
1. Cut chicken thighs into long strips .
2. Add all chicken ingredients to chicken and marinate for 30 minutes or more
3. Mix all sauce ingredients and set aside.
4. In a skillet add butter and oil and sauté garlic for 30 seconds (do not burn)
5. Add in chicken and cook for 8-10 minutes on medium high heat stir after the first minute to get a nice sear.
6. Add the onion mixture and cook another 2-3 minutes mixing well to incorporate all the flavors.
7. Garnish with more cilantro.
8. Serves 3-4 people.
9. Serve as a main dish , over rice or noodles with a cold beer !

17959192397610733.ingredients:
1 cup plain flour
2tbs rice flour
1/2 tsp cumin seeds
2tbs sugar
1/4 tsp turmeric and a pinch of salt
Water as needed
2-3 ripe plantains
17959192397610733.method:
All you have to do is mix the flour, rice powder, salt, sugar, turmeric and cumin seeds with some water till you get a smooth, cake batter kinda consistency.
Slice your plantains, dip it into the batter and fry in some hot oil till lightly golden and a bit crispy!

17994124613588045.ingredients:
Noodle Dough
400g plain flour
1/2 tsp salt
200ml water
Fried Garlic Butter (optional)
1 tbsp neutral oil
3 tbsp butter
1 tsp chilli flakes
2 tsp minced garlic
1 red chilli, sliced
1 tsp white sesame seeds
3 tbsp light soy sauce
2 tbsp chopped chives
17994124613588045.method:
Mix flour and salt together in a bowl then pour in water while stirring with chopsticks. Use your hands to combine then turn onto a bench and knead until smooth, about 10 minutes. Cover with cling wrap and rest for 30 minutes. Bring a pot of water to the boil then hold the dough over and carefully cut strips of noodles into the pot. Cook for 2 minutes then strain and use as desired.
To make the fried garlic butter, place oil and butter in a small saucepan over medium to high heat. Add chilli flakes, garlic, fresh chilli and sesame seeds. Stir cooking until the garlic is fragrant then add in soy sauce. Add the cooked noodles and chopped chives and toss. Serve immediately.

17996234477448120.ingredients:
Noodle Dough
500g plain flour
1/2 tsp salt
6 eggs
Cornstarch, for dusting
Hot Oil Sauce (optional)
2 tsp minced garlic
2 tsp minced spring onion
1 tsp chilli flakes
1 tsp white sesame seeds
2 tbsp neutral oil
1 1/2 tbsp light soy sauce
1 tbsp black vinegar
1/2 tbsp dark soy sauce
17996234477448120.method:
Mix flour and salt together on a clean work surface. Make a well in the centre then add in the eggs. Using chopsticks gently break up the eggs, then using your hands working the dough until a shaggy ball. Don’t worry if it gets messy, it will all come together. Knead for 8 - 10 minutes until smooth then wrap in cling wrap and rest for 30 minutes. Cut into 4 portions and working with 1 portion, roll to your desired thickness. Make sure to use cornstarch to dust. Fold the dough onto itself then cut to your desired thickness. To cook the noodles, bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook for 60-90 seconds. Drain, and use as desired.
To make the hot oil sauce, place into a mound the minced garlic and spring onion, chilli flakes and white sesame seeds. Heat oil until hot then pour over to sizzle. Add light soy sauce, black vinegar and dark soy sauce. Toss until well combined and enjoy.

18018533635890906.ingredients:
For boiling chicken
Chicken - 1 kg
Water - 1 & half litre
Salt - 1 tablespoon
For chicken fry:
Cardamom - 4
Cloves - 4
Cinnamon - 1 inch
Star Anise - 1
Stone flower - 2 tbsp
Bay leaf - 1
Oil - 1 cup (50ml)
Green chillies - 4
Chopped onions - 150gms (2 medium size)
Curry leaves
Ginger & Garlic paste - 2 tablespoons
Turmeric powder - 1 tsp
Salt
Red chilli powder - 2 tbsp (Fry for another 2 mins)
Coriander powder - 1 tbsp
Cumin powder - 1 tsp (Fry two more mins)
Black pepper powder - 1 tsp
Blended garam masala
Kasuri methi - half cup
Curry leaves - 1 cup
Ingredients for rice :
Basmati Rice - 3 Glasses
(Wash & Soak Basmati Rice for 30 Mins)
Bay leaves - 3
Kapok buds - 3
Cardamom - 4
Star Anise - 1
Cinnamon - 1 inch
Cardamom - 4
Star Anise - 1
Cinnamon - 1 inch
Cloves - 4
Kasuri methi - half cup
For Rice Preparation:
Oil - 4 Tablespoons (50ml) (half cup)
Half divided green chillies - 5
Chopped onions - 250gms (3 medium size)
Ginger & Garlic paste - 2 tbsp
Coriander leaves
Mint leaves
Curd - 150gms
Salt
Chicken stock -5 3/4 Glasses for 3 Glasses Rice
Lemon juice - 1 (medium size)
Coriander leaves - half cup
Mint leaves - half cup
30 Mins Soaked Basmati Rice
Sprinkle Coriander leaves
Sprinkle Mint leaves
18018533635890906.method:
Grind the above ingredients to a fine powder
In a pan add
Add the boiled chicken (Fry for medium flame for 2 mins)
Now add the following :
Must add 2 tbsp oil when chicken gets dry
And finally add few coriander leaves
Add the spices mentioned above
Assemble the fry and rice as shown in the video and it’s done ❤️

17966536445681265.ingredients:
2 eggplants
4 Tbsp miso paste
3 Tbsp maple syrup or agave syrup
4 Tbsp (sesame) oil
salt to taste
1 Tbsp white wine or rice vinegar
optional: sesame seeds.
Peanut sauce:
2 Tbsp peanut butter
1 Tbsp soy sauce
1 Tbsp vinegar
1 Tbsp agave or maple syrup
optional add ins: ginger, garlic, sriracha
17966536445681265.method:
Cut in wedges.
Mix, add to the wedges and fully coat them with it.
Dip one side of the wedges in sesame and place on a baking tray.
Bake at 200C/400F for 25-30mins but flip halfway through.
Mix until creamy.
Serve with the eggplant.

18016921139062667.ingredients:
2 10 oz. cans Old El Paso Enchilada Sauce
1 cup quinoa, uncooked
1 small onion, diced
1 small red bell pepper, diced
1 jalapeno, diced small
1/2 tsp cumin seeds
1 Tbsp Taco Seasoning
1/4 cup chopped scallions
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp oil
2 Tbsp Sour Cream
1/4 cup shredded mexican blend cheese
Optional Add In’s: Few Dashes Hot Sauce, Cilantro, Black Beans, Corn
18016921139062667.method:
Heat a large skillet or pot over medium high heat and add oil. Add cumin to the pan and let splutter. Add jalapeños and cook for about 1 minute.
Add onions, peppers, garlic and taco seasoning to the pan and saute until onions and peppers are slightly softened.
Add quinoa, enchilada sauce and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover lid and let cook for about 15 minutes. Check in between and stir if necessary (add splash of water if needed).
Once the quinoa has cooked, add in the scallions, cheese, sour cream and serve immediately while hot!

17945578409727600.ingredients:
For the Achari Masala:
2-3 tbsp oil
1 tbsp Zeera (Cumin Seeds)
1 tsp Fenugreek/Methi Seeds
1 tsp Mustard Seeds
1 tsp Nigella/Kalonji Seeds
1 tsp Fennel Seeds/Saunf Seeds
For the Gravy:
2 chopped onions
1-inch ginger
3-4 cloves of garlic
2-3 green chillies
3-4 tomatoes
1 cup yogurt
For the Chicken:
2-3 tbsp oil
500g Boneless chicken thigh cubes (or chicken breast) thigh pieces are better
1 tsp salt
1 tsp Red chilli powder
1 tsp Degi mirch
1 tsp Coriander powder
1 tsp Zeera powder
For Garnish:
Handful of chopped coriander
For Stuffed Chillies:
Large green chillies
1 tbsp vinegar (for soaking)
3-4 tbsp chat masala
2-3 tbsp lemon juice
Batter (made with chat masala and lemon juice)
17945578409727600.method:
Step 1:
In a hot pan, add oil and the Achari Masala ingredients (Zeera, Fenugreek, Mustard Seeds, Nigella Seeds, Fennel Seeds). Stir for a couple of minutes on medium low heat. Make sure not to burn the spices we need the achari fragrance at the stage.
Step 2:
Add chopped onions, ginger, garlic, and green chillies. Fry until the onions are translucent.
Step 3:
Add tomatoes and yogurt. Mix for approximately five minutes. Grind this mixture and set aside.
Step 4:
In the same pan, add more oil and the boneless chicken cubes. Stir until the chicken changes color.
Add salt, red chilli powder, Degi mirch, coriander powder, and Zeera powder. Mix for 2-3 minutes.
Add the ground mixture from step 3. Cook for a few minutes and leave it on steam for 10-15 minutes until the chicken is cooked.
Once the chicken is cooked, add chopped coriander.
For the stuffed chillies, clean and slit large green chillies. Soak them in vinegar for 30 minutes.
Mix chat masala with lemon juice to make a thick batter. Stuff the chillies with this mixture and place them on top of the chicken.
Cook on low heat for 5-6 minutes until the chillies are cooked in steam and become soft.
Serve the Achari Chicken Handi with fresh chapatis.

18040323466591300.ingredients:
Tofu & Broccoli
1 tbsp chili oil
1 tbsp light soy sauce
Broccolini or a head of broccoli
200g extra firm tofu
Spicy Rice
1.5 - 2 cups cooked rice
2 tsp chili oil
1 tsp ginger paste
1 tsp garam masala
1/4 tsp turmeric
pinch of hing (or 1 tsp minced garlic)
1 tbsp dark soy sauce
18040323466591300.method:
Preheat over to 200C.
Cut broccoli into florets or if using broccolini, cut off the stems. Slice tofu into rectangles.
Mix soy sauce and chili oil together.
Brush the marinade over the tofu and broccoli until evenly coated.
Bake for 15 minutes and grill for 3 minutes, flipping halfway.
Meanwhile, add chili oil to a pan.
Add ginger paste, garam masala, turmeric, hing and saute until fragrant.
Add cooked rice, 1 tbsp dark soy sauce and mix well.
Fry on the pan until fragrant and well coated (I used a claypot)
Serve rice with tofu, broccoli and garnish with scallions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

18009745064190081.ingredients:
Spice paste:
4 medium sized shallot
6 garlic cloves
6 candlenuts
3 inch piece fresh ginger
3 inch piece fresh turmeric
1/4 water
Chicken:
6 whole chicken legs
2 tablespoons oil
1 tsp salt
2 tsp chicken bouillon
1 tsp ground coriander
1 tsp white pepper
1/2 tsp MSG, optional
2 lemongrass stalks, bruised
2 lime leaves, torn
2 bay leaves
2 cups water
Sambal:
About 15 Thai chili peppers
4 shallots
4 garlic cloves
1 tomato, quartered
18009745064190081.method:
1. To make the spice paste: place all the ingredients into a food processor and blend until smooth.
2. Into a skillet add 2 Tbsp. of the oil and cook the spice paste until the liquid has mostly evaporated and the mixture is dry. Add the remaining ingredients and let it come to a boil. Taste the broth. It should be slightly salty, adjust as needed. Add the chicken and once it has come to a boil, lower the heat and put the lid on slightly ajar, cook for 30-40 minutes until most of the liquid has been evaporated.
3. Remove the chicken and place inside the air fryer basket skin side up, may need to do this in 2 batches. Spray the chicken and air fry for 15 minutes at 400F.
4. To deep fry the chicken, add enough oil to cover the bottom of a skillet and fry the chicken skin side down for about 4 minutes or until golden brown. Flip and cook for a few more minutes. Serve with rice and keemes (fried flakes)
use a mortar and pestle of use a food processor to make blend the ingredients. I like mine a little chunky.
Into a skillet add 2 tablespoons oil and fry the paste for about 5-7 minutes. Add a pinch of salt and a squeeze of lime juice. Add a pinch of sugar, optional. Serve with chicken and enjoy!

18303630187126165.method:
3 oranges- peeled. Separate the slices- remove the inner white membrane, thin threads, seeds. The slices will naturally separate into 3-4 pieces in this process, collect everything in a bowl.
Save the peel of 1/4-1/2 an orange and slice it into thin strips- the peel has fragrant oils, but is also bitter- start with less the first time you make it, add more as needed next time.
Combine the peeled segment pieces and sliced peel in the bowl.
Now in a Kadhai, temper
1 Tbsp oil with
1/8 tsp mustard seeds
A fat pinch of heeng
7-8 curry leaves, torn
1-2 green chilies, sliced
1/8 tsp turmeric powder
2 tsp ginger, finely chopped
Quickly tip in the orange and stir everything together
Now add salt, to taste.
Also add
1.5 tsp sugar/ more- this will depend on how sweet your oranges are. Start with 1.5 tsp, taste and add more as needed.
Let everything reduce and turn jammy- about 4-5 mins.
Taste- see if you need salt, sugar.
Turn off the heat, add a generous squeeze of lime, mix well and transfer to a serving bowl.

18009656873489508.ingredients:
Green Chillies
Sesame seeds-1/2 cup
Groundnuts-1/2 cup
Besan-1 cup
Turmeric powder
Heeng /Asafoetida
Salt
Oil
18009656873489508.method:
Slit the green chilli and spread some salt in it
Roast the peanut & grind
Then roast a sesame seeds and grind
Then roast the besan with some turmeric and heeng
Then mix all togather and add salt and little bit of oil and mix it well
Then stuff the green chilli with this mixture
Then add a oil in pan & Roast
( Cover & cook it. & don’t forget to sprinkle some water in between )

18032436079770067.method:
start by peeling cucumber (2) & grating it as shown
squeeze out the water & set aside
in a pan heat 1-2 tsp oil, add 1 tsp Rai & 1/4 tsp hing & mix. Now add 1 finely chopped green chilli. Let that cook & now add in 1/4 tsp haldi & 1/2 tsp red chilli powder or more!
now add in your grated cucumber. Give this a good mix. Add some salt to taste. Allow it to cook for a minute or two.
then add in a mixture of besan (1 tbsp & water 1/2 tbsp) to@this. Mix this very well. Add some coriander & cover & let it cook for 2 mins.
serve with rice / roti & enjoy!

18047454862584992.ingredients:
1/2+1/4th cup any neutral oil
1 inch cinnamon stick
4-5 peppercorns
3-4 cloves
1 star anise
1 bay leaf
1 finely chopped onion
1 inch ginger sliced
10-12 finely chopped garlic cloves
4-5 tbsp chilli flakes (or more as per your spice tolerance)
1 tsp dark soy sauce
1 tsp salt
A pinch of sugar
18047454862584992.method:
Heat the oil in a pan & add the whole spices along with onions. Cook till the onions turn crispy brown, will take around 7-10 min. Keep it on low heat only!
Once done, strain the oil and in the same pan heat the oil again and add garlic & chilli flakes. Let the garlic turn crisp, then turn off the heat. Add salt, a pinch of sugar & soy sauce. Mix & let it cool down completely.
Store in an airtight jar and enjoyyyy!🤤

18296778826145264.method:
start by soaking 1 cup moong dal for 4-5 hours in water. Then Drain completely
In a bowl add 2 cups atta, the soaked moong dal.
1 tsp nigella seeds (kalonji), 1 tsp fennel seeds (saunf), 2 tsp kashmiri red chilli powder, 1 tsp hing, 1 tsp salt, pinch of haldi & mix this well
Now add 1/3 cup chopped coriander & wtee gradually (1/3 cup approx) & knead this well into a soft dough
Cover with a wet towel & set aside for at least 30 mins
Now brush 1-2 tbsp oil on it & knead for 5 mins.
Divide into smaller balls, roll into parathas with some atta to dust
Heat a tawa, & place your paratha. Let it cook as is without anything for 2 mins meanwhile brush the ghee / oil / butter on the other side
Then flip & cook well on both sides
Serve hot with dahi / acchar / raita & enjoy!!

18010364849006254.ingredients:
2 (over)ripe bananas
60 ml oil / ¼ cup
1 tsp vanilla flavouring
300 grams of oatmeal / 3 cups
75 grams unsalted nuts / ½ cup
cinnamon / cardamom / gingerbread spices
18010364849006254.method:
1. Mash the bananas. Add the oil and aroma and mix together.
2. Mix in the oatmeal, nuts and spices until all ingredients are evenly mixed.
3. Spread the mixture evenly on a baking tray lined with baking paper.
4. Bake the granola in the oven at 160 degrees Celsius for 25 minutes or 15 minutes in the air fryer until golden brown. Stir halfway through the baking time.
5. Store in an airtight container to enjoy over time🥰

18012527966500667.ingredients:
1 pack Buldak Spicy Chicken Ramen
1 tablespoon soy sauce
1 tablespoon rice vinegar
1 teaspoon sesame oil
2 teaspoons brown sugar
1 boneless skinless chicken breast, cubed
1/2 onion, sliced thinly
2 garlic cloves, minced
1 tablespoon oil
1.5 cup chicken broth
Handful bok choy
Shredded mozzarella cheese
18012527966500667.method:
1. Remove the seasoning packet and place in a bowl  along with the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil and brown sugar. Taste and adjust as needed.
2. Combine the chicken breast, onion, garlic and 1/2 of the seasoning mixture. Toss and set aside for at least 15 minutes.
3. Into a skillet add the oil and cook the chicken until completely done. Add the broth and let it come to a boil, add the ramen noodles and bok choy, cook for 3 minutes or  to your desired texture. Add the other half of the mixture and stir  combine. Top with cheese, cover and cook until it has melted. Garnish with green onion and kimchi. Enjoy!

18094534687384196.ingredients:
1 tbsp red Thai curry paste
1 packet of Noodles
150ml of your choice of plant based Cream
1 punnet of Mushrooms
1 bunch of Pak Choy
5 Gyoza (I used @itsuofficial )
3 cloves Garlic
Extras - 1 stock cube, salt pepper, chilli oil if you like spice, sesame seeds for an optional crunch.
18094534687384196.method:
1. Fry off the garlic, Pak choy and mushrooms in some oil for 5 mins.
2. Add in the red Thai curry paste, stir to combine. Then go in with 300ml stock and the cream. Bring to a boil, season to your taste then lower the heat to a simmer and cover with a lid.
3. Whilst that’s blipping away add some oil to a pan, fry the gyoza for 3-4 mins over a medium heat until the bottoms are crispy. Pour in a small amount of stock and cover with a lid, cook for 5 mins or until most of the liquid has dissolved.
4. Add your noodles to the soup and cook to packet instructions.
5. Serve up your soup with the noodles, top with the gyoza and sesame seeds and chilli oil which is optional and enjoy!

17981175968629163.ingredients:
3 lbs chicken pieces, preferably dark meat
About 8 cups water
2 inch piece garlic
6 garlic cloves
2 green onion stalks
1 cup short grain rice like Arborio or sushi
1 teaspoon salt or to taste
1 teaspoon chicken bouillon or to taste
1/2 teaspoon white pepper or to taste
4 tablespoons butter
Toppings:
Chicken
Youtiao (Chinese fried dough)
Boiled egg
Green onion
Fried shallots
Soy sauce
Kecap manis
Sesame oil
Sambal
Kerupuk (shrimp crackers)
17981175968629163.method:
1. Into a large pot add the chicken, water, ginger, garlic and green onion. Make sure the chicken is submerged. Let it come to a boil, lower the heat and simmer for 45 minutes.
2. Remove the chicken pieces, ginger, garlic and green onion from the pot. Rinse rive thoroughly and add into the pot. Let it come to a boil, lower the heat and simmer for 90 minutes. Stirring occasionally to prevent sticking to the bottom of the pot.
3. Once porridge has reached desired texture add the salt, chicken bouillon, white pepper and butter. Stir to combine.
4. To serve, place porridge into a bowl and add your toppings. Mix well and enjoy!

18153448297307187.ingredients:
For the broth:
30g coriander
3 garlic cloves
1-inch piece of ginger
1 green chilli
1 1/2 tbsp miso
1 x 400 ml tin of coconut milk
250 ml water
2 portions of cooked noodles
Veg of choice (Tenderstem broccoli, sugar snap peas, shredded pak choi all work well)
Toppings:
Sesame seeds
Sliced spring onions
Chilli oil
Lime wedges
Soy sauce/tamari
Crispy tofu:
200g firm tofu, crumbled
1 tbsp soy sauce or tamari
18153448297307187.method:
Mix soy sauce and tofu. Pop into oven proof dish or silicone liner and air fry at 180°C or spread over a tray and oven bake at 200°C for 15-20 minutes or until golden and crispy.
Add all of the ingredients for the broth to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour the broth into a large pot with a lid. Bring to a gentle simmer and then add the noodles and veg. Pop the lid on and leave to cook for a few minutes.
Once the veg is tender, finish with a squeeze of lime and soy sauce/tamari, to taste.
Serve up, drizzle with chilli oil and a sprinkle of sliced spring onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy! 💛

17946043700649862.ingredients:
1 cup water in a glass
Tea- 3 Tbsp
Sugar- 3 Tbsp (Depends on your taste)
Ginger- 6-7 pieces
Cloves- 6-7 pieces
Elaichi- 5-6 pcs
Cinnamon - 2 sticks
17946043700649862.method:
Cover it with a malmal cloth
Now, pour 2 cups water in any deep pan. We have used a cooker here. Let it boil for 5-6 mins.
Now, add this prepared Tea mixture in milk. Bring a boil and it’s ready!

17994013847267753.ingredients:
1/2 cup oats
2 cup water (i don’t consider it as an extra ingredient lol)
vanilla (optional)
1 tbsp jaggery (this mildly sweetens the pudding, main sweetness from toppings)
1 tbsp cornstarch (or tapioca or gelatin/agar agar)
3 tbsp water
17994013847267753.method:
blend everything into oat milk
double strain and transfer to a pot
cook for 2 min till it thickens a bit like slime
add in the cornstarch slurry and keep mixing till it thickens into a jelly like consistency
add to greased bowls and this sets in just a few minutes but i like refrigerate for atleast an hour before serving

17890515245900175.ingredients:
1 onion
a thumbsize piece of ginger
3 cloves garlic
2 cups (500ml) water
2 Tbsp miso paste
2 Tbsp soy sauce
2 Tbsp sugar
optionally: 1 Tsp Gochujang
1 Tbsp lime juice or vinegar
3 servings of noodles
pak choi and tofu (or other toppings you like)
17890515245900175.method:
Sauté in oil for a couple minutes.
Let it simmer while preparing toppings.
I fried the tofu until crispy and sautéed the pak Choi.
Serve in a bowl and top with chili oil if you like.

18051909991527378.ingredients:
12-14 cloves of garlic
1 tbspn red chili powder
2 tbspn oil
pinch of salt
18051909991527378.method:
To make the chili garlic paste - crush the below ingredients in a mortar and pestle
chop up some onion and veggies of choice. Boil the veggies and set aside. In a an add 4tbspn oil add chopped onion and chili garlic paste sauté for 2-3 mins and add boiled veggies and cooked rice. Adjust salt and mix it well and serve it hot

17869568885998046.ingredients:
3 large bananas, mashed
60g coconut oil, melted
60g maple syrup
2 flax eggs*
200g plain flour
1 tsp baking soda
1/4 tsp salt
1 tsp cinnamon
30g cocoa powder
50ml milk to mix the cocoa powder in
5g instant coffee
Vegan dark chocolate chunks, to top
17869568885998046.method:
*Make the flax eggs by combining 2 tbsp milled flaxseed with 5 tbsp water. Set aside for at least 5 mins to thicken before using.
Mix together the wet ingredients, then follow with the dry and mix well.
Separate into two bowls, adding cocoa powder to one and coffee to another.
Layer spoonful by spoonful into a lined loaf tin, then top with chocolate chips.
Bake for 40-45 mins (for a less gooey loaf, bake for 45-50 mins) at fan 175 C. ENJOY!

18271887934161358.ingredients:
Ragi flour - 3/4th Cup/ 107g
Whole Wheat Flour - 3/4th Cup/ 100g
Jaggery powder - 3/4th Cup/ 164g
Cocoa powder - 6 Tbsps/ 32g
Baking Soda - 1 Tsp
Baking Powder - 2.5 Tsps
Salt - 1/4th Tsp
Oil - 6 Tbsps/ 77g
Curd - 1/3rd Cup/ 102g
Vanilla - 1/2 Tsp
Coffee Pwd - 1 Tsp
Vinegar - 1/2 Tbsp/ 14g
Hot Water - 3/4th Cup/ 176g
California Walnuts- 1 cup
Choco chips - 1/4th cup
18271887934161358.method:
Pre-heat the oven to 170C
In a bowl, add in the powdered jaggery, coffee powder with hot water - whisk & allow the jaggery to melt completely
Next, add in the oil & curd - whisk the wet ingredients
Combine the ragi flour & whole wheat flour along with some cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda & salt - combine the dry ingredients using a whisk
Add the dry ingredients into the wet mix in 2-3 parts & combine to form a smooth & lump-free batter
Finish with vinegar and fold it in
Before folding the walnuts- toss them in 1 tablespoon of the dry mix
Transfer the batter to a lined loaf tin
Top up the cake with whole walnuts & chocolate chips. Cover with foil and Bake the cake in a pre-heated 170C oven for 25-30 mins/ until a skewer inserted comes out clean
Allow the cake to cool down slightly & de-mould it carefully - cool it down fully
Serve, Slice & Enjoy 🍫♥️

17992943756309919.ingredients:
1. half Orange
2. 1 cup Water
3. 1 tsp Tea Leaves (Chaipatti)
4. Honey (as per choice)

18274906804164277.ingredients:
1.5 cups soaked raw cashews (soaked at least 4 hours or up to overnight)
7 cups water
1/4 cup coconut cream
1 heaping tbsp vanilla extract
3 tbsp honey (or maple syrup or 3 pitted dates)
1 tsp sea salt
18274906804164277.method:
Add your raw cashews to an airtight container and cover with water
Soak overnight or for at least 4 hours
Strain your cashews and rinse until the water runs clear
Add all of your ingredients to a high speed blender (like a @vitamix) and blend for 2 minutes until frothy
Store in the fridge in an airtight container for up to a week
Enjoy!

18066335290468393.ingredients:
1/2 cup quick-cooking tapioca pearls
1 cup dark brown sugar
1 1/2 tbsp loose-leaf black tea
1 cup milk
Ice cubes
18066335290468393.method: Cook the tapioca pearls as per the instructions on the packet. Drain, rinse and set aside. Heat brown sugar and 1 cup water in a saucepan until dissolved, then add the pearls back in. Turn the heat off and let soak for 30 minutes. Bring 2 cups of water to the boil, turn the heat down and stir in the tea leaves. Strain and set aside. To assemble add boba pearls to your glass followed by ice, tea and milk. Enjoy with a thick boba straw!

18066106003468658.ingredients:
Honey butter toast:
4 thick slices of brioche bread
6 tbs/80g softened unsalted butter
¼ cup light brown sugar
2 tbs honey
Pinch of salt
Vanilla cream (optional):
½ cup cold heavy cream
1 tbs vanilla bean paste (try to get this over vanilla extract. It’ll make a huge difference)
1 tbs powdered sugar
18066106003468658.method:
1. Preheat your oven to 180°C/356°F.
2. Trim the crusts of your brioche slices and set them aside.
3. In a small bowl combine the butter and brown sugar with a spatula.
4. Add salt and honey and mix.
5. Spread the butter mixture evenly over all the faces of the slices of bread- the top, bottom and sides.
6. Place on a baking tray and bake for 10 minutes, then remove from the oven and gently flip each piece of bread.
7. Return to the oven for 8 more minutes.
8. Take the toast out and let them sit for about 2 minutes without touching them before moving them to a cooling rack. They will be very hot and soft, but they’ll harden as they cool.
9. Let them sit on the cooling rack for about 8-10 minutes, then enjoy.
10. If making the whipped cream, mix the cold heavy cream, vanilla bean paste and powdered sugar in a bowl. You can add more sugar if you want, but I don’t recommend making it very sweet as it may overpower the toast.
11. Whip until stiff peaks form then top your toast with it.

18279884983084232.ingredients:
1.5 garlic bulbs peeled and minced
1.5 shallots finely chopped
1.5 cups chilli flakes
1/2 cup chilli powder (can use any )
1 tbsp ground pepper
1 tbsp salt and sugar
1.5 tbsp sesame seeds
2 tbsp soy sauce
450-500ml Vegetable oil (can use any besides olive oil) depending on how much you want to make
18279884983084232.method:
In a large bowl add all the dry ingredients.
Heat oil, and carefully pour over mixture and mix well.
Once cooled, add sesame seeds, soy sauce and mix well. Add to clean glass storage jars and enjoy.
This made 3 generous jar portions.

17901381107925765.ingredients:
Besan
Jeera/Cumin Seeds
Salt, Red Chilli Powder, Haldi, Garam Masala
Onion
Green Chilli
Coriander
Water
Bread

18017132573055968.ingredients:
Green Chilli (slit, de-seeded) - 6 nos (30 g)
Garlic (finely chopped) - 1 tbsp (20 g)
Onion (sliced) - 1 no. (80 g)
Capsicum (sliced) - 1 no. (70 g)
Butter - 1 tbsp (15 g)
Salt - ¼ tsp (1 g)
Black Pepper Powder - ¼ tsp (1 g)
Water - 1 Cup (250 ml)
Processed Cheese Cube (grated) - 1 no (30 g)
Cheese slice - 2 nos (10 g)
Macaroni Pasta (to be boiled)- 1 Cup (110 g)
18017132573055968.method:
1. In a pan, add the green chilies, capicum, onion, garlic, salt, pepper, butter and water.
2. Bring it to a boil, cover and simmer for 10 mins until the veggies are soft.
3. Add the cheese slices and grated cheese to the pan and cover again for a minute.
4. Mix well until the cheese has completely melted and makes a sauce.
5. Add the cooked pasta and toss until well coated and serve hot.
Boil the dry pasta in salted water until cooked. Drain, apply and use in this recipe.

18303996127191809.method:
1. Grab 1 small tub (16oz or 4 servings) of cottage cheese and put it into a small food processor with 2/3 cup cacao powder and 1/2 cup to 3/4 cup of monkfruit or your favorite sweetener. ***IMPORTANT: use POWDERED sweetener or it will be gritty****.Pulse for about 15-20 seconds to get it creamy and remove the clumps.  You can always taste and see what more you’d like to add.
2.This is best chilled - so i highly recommend chilling for 1-2 hours unless youre anxious to get going right away!
3.You can serve this as is, but if you want to upgrade it, you can add some crushed roasted hazelnuts, or a tablespoon or two of melted chocolate! Layer it up however way you want.
4.If you do add melted chocolate on top, you can just mix 2 tablespoons of stevia-sweetened chocolate chips with 1 tsp or so of coconut oil, microwave for 15 seconds, stir, microwave again for 15 seconds. Pour it over the top, then let it chill so you can break the top chocolate layer with a spoon.

17937945686681569.ingredients:
4 tablespoons of salted butter
1 ½ cups white onions, chopped
1 lb. mushrooms, sliced (use crimini, button, etc.)
2 teaspoons dried dill weed
1 teaspoon EACH: dried thyme
1 tablespoon EACH: sweet paprika and lemon juice
2 cloves garlic, grated
2 ½ cups broth
2 tablespoons soy sauce
3 tablespoons all purpose flour
One cup half and half or milk
1/3 cup sour cream or crème fraiche
3 tablespoons chopped parsley
17937945686681569.method:
1. Melt butter in a soup pot. Sauté onions for a few minutes and then add mushrooms. Cook for 8-10 minutes on medium heat stirring occasionally.
2. Add dill, thyme, paprika, garlic and lemon juice. Cook for 2 minutes.
3. Add broth and soy sauce. Simmer on low to medium heat for a few minutes.  In a bowl mix half and half with all purpose flour removing lumps. Add to the soup while stirring to avoid curdling. Simmer soup to desired thickness. Do NOT boil the soup only simmer it.
4. add sour cream and stir.
5. Garnish with parsley.
6. Serve with warm crusty bread and a glass of wine .

18002040020349811.ingredients:
Thai Basil Stir Fry
½ cup red onion or shallot (diced or shallots roughly chopped)
16 oz ground chicken
5 garlic cloves minced
½ cup Thai basil or regular basil
1 medium red chili (chopped roughly)
1 jalapeno pepper or 1/2 green bell diced
Neutral oil 2-3 tablespoons (chicken shoukd not be dry )
Sauce
2 tablespoon light soy sauce
2 tablespoon dark soy sauce
1 tablespoon honey or maple syrup
2 tablespoons garlic chili sauce or sriracha
2 tablespoon oyster sauce
2 tablespoon fish sauce
For serving
1 cup uncooked rice for serving
2-3 stalks of green onion for garnish
More basil leaves
Sesame seeds
2 fried eggs
18002040020349811.method:
1. Mix all sauce ingredients and set aside.
2. In a wok or skillet add 2-3 tablespoons oil and sauté shallot or onion , garlic and jalapeno. Cook 1 minute without burning.
3. Add in ground chicken and cook just until no longer pink. Do NOT overcook and dry out chicken.  Add oil if it looks dry.  Should be a bit juicy/saucey from chicken and oil.
4. Stir the sauce and add the sauce to the chicken.
5. Cook until everything is incorporated. Turn off the heat.
6. Add the fresh basil and stir then add red chile and a squeeze of lime.
7. Serve over rice.
8. Garnish with more fresh basil, lime and sesame seeds and sliced green onion and a fried egg .

17969759222627838.ingredients:
2 honeycrisp apples
creamy natural peanut butter
crushed peanuts
melted dark chocolate
17969759222627838.method:
I used a sharp vegetable peeler to core the apples, then slices horizonally.
Add creamy pb to each slice, top with peanuts, and drizzle with melted dark chocolate.
You can refrigerate them until the chocolate hardens, or just enjoy right away!

17988354335588541.ingredients:
14.2 oz package of udon noodles
2 tbsp minced garlic
2 medium shallots, thinly sliced
1 tsp grated ginger
8 oz shiitake mushrooms sliced
1 baby bok choy, chopped
2 tbsp oil
To make the sauce, combine the following ingredients in a bowl and set aside:
2 tbsp dark soy sauce
1 tbsp hoisin sauce
1 tbsp sweet thai chili sauce
1 tbsp gochujang
1 tsp gochugaru or crushed red chili flakes
1 tsp rice wine vinegar
1/2 tsp sesame oil
17988354335588541.method:
Cook or prepare the noodles according to package directions. I had udon noodles that did not require boiling but I did rinse them with hot water to simply help loosen them up. Follow the directions for whichever type of noodles you decide to use.
Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large wok or pot over medium high heat. Once the oil is hot, add the shallots and stir until they become soft.
Next, add the mushrooms and cook until the mushrooms are for just about tender but not too soft. Reduce the heat to medium/low, add the garlic, ginger, bok choy, and stir until garlic is fragrant and bok choy starts to slightly wilt.
Add the noodles, sauce, sesame seeds and stir until well combined and noodles are heated through.
Serve hot and fresh!!

18028470406829874.ingredients:
2-3 cloves of minced garlic
Knob of ginger, grated
1-2 tsp sesame seeds
2-3 tsp gochugaru/ chilli flakes
1/2 tbsp Gochujang paste
1 tbsp peanut butter/ tahini
1 tbsp soy sauce
1/2 tbsp rice vinegar
18028470406829874.method:
Start by cooking your noodles of choice. I’m using ramen. You can blanche some leafy greens like bok choy as well whilst the noodles are cooking.
Drain the noodles , but reserve the hot and starchy noodle water.
To a heatproof bowl, add:
Add 1.5 tbsp of hot sesame oil, followed by:
Give it a brisk whisk to combine well.
Then ladle in the noodle water until you have a soupy consistency.
Drop in your cooked noodles along with all your favourite toppings. Here we have bok choy, kimchi , scallions and of course, my homemade chilli oil.
Give it a good mix and DIVE IN!

18274733851160406.ingredients:
8 chilli pepper
1/4 cup peanuts
1/5 cup toor dal
1 tsp cumin seed
1 tsp coriander seed
7-8 kapok buds( marati moggu in kannada)
1 tsp fennel seed
1 tsp sesame seed
1/4 tsp turmeric
6-7 small garlic
1/2 tsp hing
1 tsp homemade garam masala( recipe already posted)
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 tsp sugar
2 tbsp oil
Thread (to tie the chillies)
18274733851160406.method:
Clean the chilies, then slit and remove the seeds. In a pan, roast the ingredients, grind them to make powder, and stuff the masala into the chilies.
Tie them with clean thread. In a large pan, add oil and roast.
Sprinkle some water, cover the lid, and cook.
Then, add the leftover masala on top, sauté for 1-2 minutes.
While serving, cut the thread and serve.✨

18038867812623801.ingredients:
2 cups fresh organic ginger root (washed + any weird bits cut off, no need to fully peel)
Juice of 3-4 organic lemons
2-3 cups filtered water
1-2 Tablespoons of turmeric powder (or you can use the full turmeric root if you have access to it!)
1-2 Tablespoon of raw honey
Pinch of black pepper
18038867812623801.method:
Blend the ginger, lemons, and water in a high speed blender.
Pour into a straining bag and strain.
Pour the strained ginger lemon juice back in the blender and add turmeric powder, pepper, honey. Blend until combined.
Store in the fridge

17885950427915819.ingredients:
3 cups puffed amaranth (store bought or home made, tips below)
1 cup nuts of choice- I’ve used cashews – roughly chopped
1 cup seeds of choice- I’ve used pumpkin and sunflower seeds
1/4 cup nut butter - I’ve used almond
1/4 cup date syrup or liquid jaggery, make sure it’s runny and not too thick
pinch salt
1/2 tsp vanilla extract options
1/3 cup raisins
17885950427915819.method:
1. To pop amaranth seeds- use a high heavy bottomed pan preferably with a lid. I haven’t used one, just to show you how they pop but otherwise the amaranth seeds will fly all over.
2. Heat the pan on medium to high, add a sprinkle of water to the pan to check if it’s hot enough. If the water forms a ball, you know the pan is hot enough.
3. Add in 1/2 tbsp of amaranth seeds at a time. They should start to pop immediately- if you have to wait too long then theban isn’t hot enough. Cover with a lid and shake the pan so the seeds don’t get stuck. This takes some practice but don’t get discouraged if you you burn the seeds a few times.
4. You can also buy puffed amaranth if you don’t want to go through the trouble :)
5. Preheat oven to 140 degrees Celsius.
6. Add all granola ingredients to a large bowl and mix until the granola is evenly coated. It’s easier to mix your hands.
7. Add granola to a flat layer to a sheet pan lined with parchment paper.
8. Bake for 8 mins. Take out and mix well. Bake again for about 6-8 mins until done. Amaranth seeds cook much faster than an oat granola so make sure it doesn’t burn.
9. Once done add in the raisins and let it cool for 15 mins. (I forgot to add raisins in mine 😅) Store in a sealed container for a few weeks. Don’t refrigerate.

18219248884249541.method:
1 cup Button Mushrooms, chopped
A few Spring onion greens, julienned
1.5 tsp Sesame oil
Add the mushrooms
& sauté well for 2 minutes
2 tbsp Peanut butter or sesame paste

Mix everything well
1.5 cup Water
Add the seasoning sauce (to taste)
Add seasoning mix
2 cup Soy milk
Mix & bring to a light simmer
Add the noodles
& cook for about 8 minutes
Serve it hot
with boiled eggs, spring onion greens & Chili oil

17992960985277496.ingredients:
1 avocado
1 tbsp lime juice
1/2 tsp turmeric
1 tsp coriander powder
1 tsp ginger garlic paste
1/2 tsp crushed carom seeds
salt to taste
Fistful chopped spinach
2 tbsp chopped cilantro leaves
1 cup whole wheat flour
2 tbsp yoghurt
1 tsp oil
Sesame seeds
17992960985277496.method:
Start by slicing an avocado in half, remove the pit and scoop into a bowl. Then use a fork and gently mash the avocado. Add lime juice and the spices: turmeric, coriander powder, crushed carom seeds. Add ginger garlic paste. salt and finely chopped spinach and cilantro.
Add whole wheat flour and mix together, add yoghurt and knead into dough, towards the end drizzle oil and knead to form soft dough.
Cover and it let it rest for 10-15 mins.
Make toddler sized portion balls from the dough.
Roll into paratha, sprinkle sesame seeds and gently roll so sesame seeds stick to the dough.
Heat a tawa/skillet on medium heat and place the paratha on it. Using ghee/ oil cook both sides.
Serve with dahi.

18257317714207133.ingredients:
500g chicken, diced
150g Halloumi, diced - I used light halloumi
2tbs cornflour
1tbs of salt and pepper seasoning
1 onion, sliced
2 peppers, sliced
4 cloves garlic, finely diced
1 red chilli, sliced (optional)
500g cooked rice- I used microwave rice
1tbs light soy
I garnished mine with sweet chilli sauce, chilli mayo, chilli flakes and sesame seeds (optional)
18257317714207133.method: Start by mixing together the cornflour and seasoning and then coat the chicken and halloumi. Fry this off until crispy and cooked through then remove from the pan. Add in the onions and peppers and cook until they’re starting so soften then add in the garlic and the chilli. Cook that for a minute or so and then add in the cooked rice and soy sauce. Give it a good mix and add the chicken and halloumi back in. Garnish, serve and enjoy!

17978612003630190.ingredients:
5-6 Garlic Cloves
2 Green Chillies
2 tbsp Ghee
1 Bay Leaf
4-5 Cloves
1-inch Cinnamon Stick

Salt
1 cup Fenugreek Leaves (chopped)

2 cups Water (lukewarm)
Salt

18313644991139276.ingredients:
1/2 cup oats
2/3 cup water
1 serving @promix vanilla whey protein powder
2 tbsp cocoa powder
1/2 tbsp maple syrup (or sweetener of choice)
pinch of salt
1 tbsp peanut or almond butter
18313644991139276.method:
Add the oats, water, protein powder, cocoa powder, maple syrup and pinch of salt to a blender.
Blend for 30 seconds or until smooth.
Pour into a small oven safe bowl and microwave for 1-1.5 minutes. The edges should be cooked but the center should still be a little soft.
Drizzle peanut butter on top and enjoy!

18306532672192548.ingredients:
For Aloo Ki Sabzi -
7-8 potatoes, boiled, peeled and chopped
4-5 tbsp oil
1-1/2 tsp cumin seeds
2 tbsp coriander powder
1 tbsp red chilli powder
1/2 tbsp Kashmiri red chilli powder
1/2 tbsp garam masala powder
1-1/2 tbsp amchur powder
2-3 tbsp ginger, finely chopped
3-4 green chillies, finely chopped
Salt, to taste
For Bathua Ki Poori -
2 cups whole wheat flour
2 tbsp sooji
Salt, to taste
1 tbsp ghee
1-1/2 cup bathua puree
1/2 tsp ajwain
18306532672192548.method:
Boil, peel and chop the potatoes. Keep aside.
Heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds and let it splutter. Add coriander powder, red chilli powder, garam masala powder and amchur powder. Mix well and add the potatoes, ginger and green chillies. Mix everything well and cook for about a minute.
Add in salt and mix again. Cook until the potatoes are lightly crispy. Serve with Bathua Ki Poori.

18032154070701134.ingredients:
4 tbsp bread flour (30g)
1/2 cup soy milk (120ml)
4 tbsp water (60ml)
720g bread flour (6 cups)
1/2 cup brown sugar (100g)
4 tsp dried active yeast
1 tsp salt
1 + 1/2 cups warm soy milk (360ml)
2/3 cup vegan butter (140g)
125g vegan butter
2 roasted garlic heads
bunch of parsley
18032154070701134.method:
mix the flour, water and milk starter then heat on medium for 2-3 minutes until the mixture thickens to a wet paste. Set aside and allow to cool.
now mix the flour, sugar, yeast and salt then gradually add the soy milk, vegan butter and flour paste and combine.
once combined knead into for 15 minutes, then cover and rest for 1.5hrs
mix the roasted garlic, butter and parsley then set aside.
roll the dough out to a few CM/1 inch thick then spread over the garlic butter, vegan cheese, herbs and salt.
cut the dough into equal sized squares then layer them on top of each other and transfer to a greased loaf tin.
bake in the oven for 30 minutes then cover with foil and bake for another 15-30 minutes.
serve with a delicious ragu/pasta sauce, best enjoyed whilst still warm from the oven

17955423782607131.ingredients:
2 chicken breasts
Salt & pepper
25g Cajun seasoning
1 egg or egg white
50g cornflakes
3 tbsps sweet chilli sauce
1 tsp honey
Lettuce, sliced
Cherry tomatoes, diced
4 mini tortilla wraps
Optional: a drizzle of garlic & herb dressing 🤤
17955423782607131.method:
Mix together the sweet chilli sauce and honey and set aside. Cut the chicken breasts into tenders (3-4 each breast) then season with 1 tbsp Cajun seasoning, salt and pepper. Crush the cornflakes then season with the remaining 2 tsp Cajun seasoning.
Dip the chicken tenders into whisked egg then the cornflakes, place in the air fryer, spray with low calorie spray and cook on 180C for 6 mins. Flip then spray again and cook for a further 6 mins or until cooked, for the last 2 mins brush over the sticky glaze. Assemble the tacos with the salad and add an optional drizzle of garlic and herb sauce and enjoy!

17894054567951733.method:
Roast vermicelli in ghee
Boil milk
Add sugar or condensed milk as per taste
Add roasted vermicelli and cook
Once done, add custard slurry
Cook on medium flame
When it thickens, remove from flame
Let it cool down complete
Add sabja seeds, chopped fruits and nuts

17896792967840926.ingredients:

17896792967840926.method:
