17872041204022054.ingredients:
1 lb. Peeled and Deveined Shrimp, cut into small pieces then rough chopped
1 Clove Garlic, minced
3/4 Cup Chinese Chives (also known as garlic chives), chopped small
1 Tbsp Fresh Ginger, minced
1 Tbsp Cornstarch
1/4 tsp Kosher Salt
1/4 tsp Pepper
1 Tbsp Sesame Oil
1 Tbsp Soy Sauce
12-14 Sheets Rice Paper
2 Tbsp Avocado Oil
For the Sauce (or sub sweet chili sauce):
1 Clove Garlic, minced
1 Tbsp Carrot, minced
2 Limes, juice
2 Tbsp Fish Sauce
Vegan Modification: Sub in 1 lb. mixed mushrooms (or small diced tofu) for shrimp (sauté the veggie filling before folding the dumplings); sub in soy sauce for fish sauce in the sauce
17872041204022054.method:
Preheat oven to 400F convection (if you have it, no worries if not); mix together the ingredients for the sauce and set aside
Add the shrimp, garlic, Chinese chives, ginger, cornstarch, salt, pepper, sesame oil, and soy sauce to a bowl and mix
Fill up a large bowl (or pie dish) with water and place two damp paper towels on a cutting board; soak the rice paper wrapper in water for ~15 seconds (don't leave it in too long bc it will continue to soften as you work) and place on the paper towel
Cut the rice paper in half down the middle, break it in two pieces, and put 1 Tbsp of the shrimp mixture in the middle of each piece
Fold the sides of the rice paper over to filling (it will create a triangle shape) then flip the dumpling over and fold the excess rice paper onto the other side
Drizzle a baking sheet with 2 Tbsp avocado oil and add the dumplings; roll each dumpling in oil on both sides as you place them on the baking sheet
Convection bake for 13-15 mins until shrimp is pink and bottoms of the dumplings are golden brown (if you don’t have convection you may need to cook 3-5 mins longer), then broil 2-3 mins until tops of the dumplings are golden brown (watch closely while you broil because the dumplings can burn easily)
Serve with sauce and enjoy!

18016634792056706.ingredients:
50 gms paneer
1 capsicum
1 inch ginger
Handful of coriander leaves
1 green chilli
Salt and pepper
1/2 lemon
Water to grind
18016634792056706.method: Maethod: Roast the capsicum and put all the ingredients in a blender. Blend till smooth, then enjoy with bread or chapatis.

18027909799668223.ingredients:
4-5 ripe bananas
1 cup salted butter (softened)
1 cup white sugar
1 cup brown sugar
5 eggs
1 cup Almond flour
1 cup AP flour
1 tsp sesame oil
2 tsp baking soda
3 tsp vanilla extract
1 tbsp cinnamon
handful of chocolate chips (optional)
18027909799668223.method:
1. Mash up 4-5 banana then add in your white sugar, brown sugar, butter and eggs and mix.
2. Add in the almond flour, AP flour, baking soda, vanilla extract, cinnamon and chocolate chips and mix again.
3. Grease a bread pan with oil spray or butter and pour in your mix. Depending on the size of your pan, you may need to do it twice or use 2 pans.
4. Bake at 350 F for 1 hour. (test by poking it with a knife and if it comes out clean, it is ready)
5. Let it rest for 10 minutes before cutting.

17985179915404769.ingredients:
3 broccoli
garlic oil
salt
white pepper
Savory Umami Broth
50g sake
50g mirin
18g light soy sauce
36g yondu
1g sesame oil
100g shojin dashi (15g kombu soaked in 1qt water overnight)
5g sliced ginger
5g rice vinegar
17985179915404769.method:
Preheat your oven to the highest setting or Broil if your burner is on the top of the oven. Trim the florets and peel off the tough fibres from the stems. Cut the stems in half legthwise and slice thin at an angle. Season the florets and stems with enough garlic oil to coat well, rubbing into the florets. Season with salt and white pepper. Spread the broccoli in a single layer on a sheet tray and cook until the florets are lightly charred, 8-10 minutes.
Bring the sake, mirin and ginger to a boil and cook off the alcohol. Add the soy sauce and bring to a boil once more. Take off the heat and add the rest of the ingredients. Cool to room temperature and store in the fridge until needed.
Cover the broccoli with the broth, garnish with sesame seeds and serve. It’s even better if the florets are in direct contact with the broth and left in the fridge overnight.

18010495055073712.method:
boil one glass water
then add 1 inch Pound Ginger (in a motar pestle)
1 tsp black peppercorns
1 tsp long / clove
1 tsp coriander seeds
2 strands of Tulsi Leaves & bring it to a boil for 5-10 mins until you can see your water change colour
now strain this over a cup, add a drop or two of honey mix that in & consume hot!

17980521638439682.ingredients:
2 boiled potatoes
half of a broccoli blanched & cooled.
2tbsp full cornflour
1tsp pizza seasoning
1/2tsp pepper powder
Salt to taste
17980521638439682.method:
chop the broccoli super fine in a chopper.
Mix everything well to make dough like consistency.
Tip: if you feel your mix it too sticky & not holding shape add some more cornflour.
Take a regular piping bag. Put the mix into it. Now press & push the mixture down till the tip.
Cut the tip off to the thickness you need.
Now lay a parchment paper. Pipe out to make fries like shape(don’t worry it not difficult you will get a hang after you make 2-3)
Tip: you can directly pipe out in the oil but the shape may get distorted but the taste still remains same😊
Now grease your hand a little, pick the fries & drop in hot oil.
Deep fry in high flame till crispy.
Tip: you can air fry these as well.
Tip : if you think making fries out of this is an hassle just make tikkis out of it & fry. They taste equally delicious.
Enjoy with any dip of your choice!!

17931059363704008.ingredients: For this one serving shown in the video, I have used 1/2 cup mung dal & 150 g spinach 😇
17931059363704008.method:
1. Soak 1/2 cup mung for atleast 2 hours
2. Heat some oil in a pan & add jeera, mustard seeds & little hing (asafoetida)
3. Once it crackles, add garlic paste & let it cook for 30 secs
4. Time to add soaked mung & chopped spinach
5. Close the lid & let it cook for 5 minutes without stirring until the spinach reduces. You need not add water at this stage. Spinach will leave moisture & the dal will get cooked in that water.
6. Now add the spices - salt, turmeric, chili powder & coriander seeds powder.
7. Stir everything well, add little water & cover.
8. Let it cook for another 10 minutes or until the dal is cooked.
9. Enjoy it hot with any millet roti. I used bajra roti 😊

17995762529184870.ingredients:
1 cup yogurt + 1/2 cup water
salt

red chilli powder (as much as you can handle)

coriander leaves for garnish

17982643682398501.method:
Fill your liners half full.
Use small piping tips to shape before baking.
Bake and cool.
Use tip 1A to pipe white buttercream in the shape of a snowman ⛄️
Press into shredded coconut.
Use sprinkles for the eyes and nose and pipe dots for the mouth.
Use piping tip 48 for the scarf 🧣

18000078083344886.ingredients:
1 cup raw honey

2-3 lemons, sliced

2 cinnamon sticks or 2 tsp

17880470390930453.ingredients:
Curd - 1 Cup
Salt & Pepper - to Taste
Turmeric Pwd - 1/4th Tsp
Red Chilly Pwd - 1/2 Tsp
Ghee - 1 Tbsp
Mustard Seeds - 1 Tsp
Green Chilly - 1 no
Curry Leaves - 1 Sprig
Coriander Leaves - 1 Tbsp
Bread - 5 Slices
Onion & Coriander - Garnish
17880470390930453.method:
Start by whisking curd along with red chilly pwd, turmeric pwd, salt & pepper to taste
Prepare a tadka by heating some ghee in a saucepan - add in some mustard seeds, green chilly & curry leaves
Add prepared tadka to the dahi along with some chopped coriander & give it a mix
Dip the bread in the curd mix & pan fry until golden brown & crisp on both sides
Serve hot, garnish with sliced onions & coriander leaves & Enjoy 🍞♥️

18400260919008773.ingredients:
400g oyster mushrooms (it’s a lot but they reduce in size, and if you have too many, I’m sure you’ll find a use for them - they’re delicious)
1 tbsp sweet white miso paste (I used @clearspringuk )
1 tbsp tamari
1 tbsp olive oil
For the sauce:
100g soaked cashews nuts (leave in boiling water for 10 mins)
1 tbsp sweet white miso paste
Juice of one lemon
1 clove garlic
3 tbsp nooch
Pinch salt
A splash of water (about 40ml) for blending to a paste like consistency. More if you need it!
To serve:
Ciabatta bread
Rocket or spinach
18400260919008773.method:
Pre heat your oven to 220 degrees Celsius
Tear mushrooms into strips with your hands, massage them in the oil, tamari and miso, then roast for 10-15 mins before taking out, mixing them around and sticking them back in the oven for another 10-15 mins. Them should be crispy and greatly reduced in size, but not burned so keep an eye on them during the second roast.
Whizz you the sauce ingredients and layer your sandwich with the cashew miso cream on both sides. Makes sure you pile the mushies high. Go BIG! 💚

18002091404263294.ingredients:
1 lb mini yukon gold potatoes, halved
2 tb olive oil
1 tb dried parsley
1 tb garlic powder
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 tsp ground black pepper
1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted
1 1/2 cups freshly grated parmigiano reggiano
18002091404263294.method: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F. Wash potatoes and cut them in half. Then, take a sharp knife and score them into a diamond shape. Transfer the potatoes to a large bowl and toss with olive oil, parsley, garlic powder and salt. Set aside. Next, grate the parmigiano reggiano cheese. Pour melted butter on top and mix until you get a thick paste. Transfer the mixture to a large baking dish and spread into an even layer. Take each potato half and press it into the cheese, cut side down. Repeat until all potatoes are in the dish. Bake for 25-26 minutes. Remove from the oven. Let the potatoes rest for 10 minutes so the cheese hardens and then take a spatula and remove from the pan. Break into pieces and enjoy!

18014490140046510.ingredients:
4 Pieces of Chicken
1 Medium Onion
4 Cups Orange Juice
4 Tablespoons Brewed Saffron
Salt, Black Pepper Powder, Turmeric Powder, and Cinnamon Powder as needed

18057207964453523.ingredients:
2 apples, sliced very thin
1 sheet Puff pastry, cut into 8 rectangle pieces
Honey
Cinnamon
1 egg yolk
Powder sugar (to dust)
18057207964453523.method:
On a baking tray add a sheet of baking paper.
Spoon or drizzle 6 tsp of honey on the baking paper, these needs to be very far apart.
Sprinkle cinnamon on top and as 4-5 slices of apple on top of each bit of honey. Add another teaspoon of honey.
Add the puff pastry rectangle piece on top and press down the edges with a fork, to seal each rectangle.
Brush the top of the puff pastry with egg yolk.
Bake for 12 mins at 180C
Let it cool down and sprinkle some icing sugar.

17953022813582978.ingredients:
Chicken Thighs – 2lbs
Honey – 2 tbsps.
Brown Sugar – ¼ cup
Sesame Oil – 2/3 tsp.
Soy Sauce – 2 tbsps.
Chicken Stock – ½ cup
Corn Starch – 1.5 tbsps.

Garlic – 3 cloves, minced
Rice Vinegar – 1 tsp.
Scallion – garnish
Sesame Seeds – garnish
Chicken Seasoning
Kosher Salt

18012350417009166.ingredients:
Dashi (premade dashi packet or see below for homemade)
Onsen egg (See my two other onsen egg recipes)
Greens - I chose mizuna, a mustard green and cruciferous veggie, but you can use kale, bok choy, any sprouts
Green onions, sliced thinly
Miso paste (preferably organic)
Wakame seaweed
Soft tofu, cubed
Dashi recipe:
Kombu seaweed and Katsuoboshi (dried bonito flakes)
18012350417009166.method:
1. Place a small amount of miso paste (about 1/2 tsp) into a bowl and mix with a bit of the hot dashi broth. Stir until it’s uniform throughout.
2. Crack open an onsen egg into the miso-broth mixture.
3. Sprinkle dried wakame seaweed and pour broth on top.
4. Layer the rest of the soup ingredients: greens, tofu, green onions
Place 1-2 kombu strips of seaweed into a pot of  4 cups of cold water and let it sit about 20 minutes. Heat the water on medium low and turn off once the water is almost boiling. Remove the kombu and add 1 cup of katsuoboshi and bring it back to a boil, then let it simmer and turn off the heat. Wait until the bonito flakes sink to the bottom then strain the dashi broth.

18036005602607330.ingredients:
5 Chicken thighs (diced)
Spices:
1 tsp salt
1 tsp garlic powder
1/2 tsp black pepper
1 tsp paprika
1 tsp onion powder
Olive oil
Sauce:
1 tbsp butter
2 garlic cloves minced
1/2 tsp red chilli flakes
Chopped parsley
Freshly grated parmesan (as much as you want)
18036005602607330.method:
Marinate the chicken & thread it onto wooden skewers that are pre soaked in water.
Prepare the sauce by adding all the ingredients in a pot or pan and cook for 3-4 mins until the butter is completely melted.
Air fry for 7 mins on one side. Then brush the garlic butter sauce on it & flip and air fry for 7 more mins.
Once done, take the skewers out and brush more sauce on top as well as sprinkle parmesan. Enjoy!

17893202663877256.ingredients:
4 russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 inch rounds
10 garlic cloves, smashed
salt and pepper
avocado oil
4 tbsp butter
2 sprigs rosemary
4 sprigs thyme
1/2 cup chicken stock
17893202663877256.method:
STEP 1.
Peel potatoes, trim ends, and cut in half crosswise. You should now have 8 flat potato rounds. Place in a large bowl and cover with cold water. Soak for 20 minutes.
STEP 2.
Arrange oven rack in the middle of the oven at 400*F.
STEP 3.
Drain the potatoes, rinse with cold water and pat dry on paper towels. Season with salt and pepper.
STEP 4.
Heat oil in a pan over medium high heat. Add potatoes, cut side down and brown for 7 minutes. Flip and add garlic, butter, thyme, and rosemary. Cook until butter is foaming and starts to brown, 2-3 minutes. Add chicken stock so potatoes are half submerged. Bring to a simmer.
STEP 5.
Transfer to the oven and bake until the potatoes are fork tender and lightly browned on all sides, 15-20 minutes

18017280616840333.ingredients:
For the Pickled Onions:
1 Thin Sliced Red Onion
1 Cup White Vinegar
1 Cup Water
2 Tbsp Sugar
2 tsp Kosher Salt
For the Sauce + Slaw:
3/4 Cup Greek Yogurt
1/4 Cup Light Sour Cream
3 Tbsp Cilantro, minced
1 Clove Garlic, grated or minced
2 Limes, juice
2 Tbsp Water
1/4 tsp Salt
3 Cups Red Cabbage
For the Tacos:
1 lb. Tilapia (or other white fish)
1+1/2 tsp Chili Powder
1+1/2 tsp Cumin
1/2 tsp Garlic Powder
1 tsp Salt
1 tsp Olive Oil
6-8 Cassava Flour Tortillas (I love @sietefoods, but any tortilla will work)
1 Avocado, sliced
1/2 Jalapeño, seeds removed and diced small
18017280616840333.method:
First make the pickled onions: Place onions in a heat safe bowl (or jar) and set aside; add the vinegar, water, sugar, and salt to a small pot and bring to a simmer; stir so the  sugar and salt dissolves; pour the liquid over the onions and let sit at room temp while you prep the other ingredients (or if you can wait an hour that's best!)
Mix together the ingredients for the sauce and set 1/4 cup aside (to serve on top of the tacos); mix the rest of the sauce with the slaw ingredients
Place the  chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and salt in a large shallow bowl and then coat both sides of each piece of fish in the spice blend (press the spices on with your fingers if needed)
Heat up a pan over medium heat and add 1 tsp olive oil; add the tilapia and cook 3-4 mins per side until internal temp reaches 145F; turn off the heat and break the fish into pieces (I like to serve the fish in the hot pan so it stays sizzling hot)
Heat up your tortillas in a hot pan for ~30 sec per side; top each tortilla with some slaw, fish, pickled onions, jalapeño, a slice of avocado and some additional yogurt sauce - enjoy!

17990632928521663.ingredients:
garlic butter:
4 tablespoons salted butter, softened
1 tablespoon grated Parmesan
1/2 tablespoon minced parsley
1/2 tablespoon thinly sliced chives, plus more for garnish
1 minced garlic clove
1/8 teaspoon black pepper
8 ounce wheel brie, top rind scored into a crosshatch
17990632928521663.method:
1. Preheat oven to 350˚F.
2. Spread an even layer of garlic butter over the scored brie and transfer brie to a baking dish.
3. Bake brie for 12 to 14 minutes or until butter has melted and brie is soft.
4. Top brie with more sliced chives and serve with crackers and/or crostini.

18002040386483099.ingredients:
16 pitted medjool dates
1 c walnuts
1/2 c (112g) unsalted butter, melted
1 c oat/ wholewheat flour
1 tsp cinnamon
1/2 tsp cardamom
pinch of salt
1 c pistachio slivers/ desiccated coconut/ nut of choice ground up
18002040386483099.method:
in a frying pan, toast the walnuts on medium-high heat, stirring every so often until fragrant (5-8 minutes) and set aside.
in the same pan, switch heat to low and melt the butter
while the butter melts, pit and flatten the dates. arrange walnuts on top and press (slightly crush) i used a rolling pin to help flatten the walnuts.
go back to the butter, turn the heat to medium-high and combine the flour with a rubber spatula. keep stirring, making sure to scrape the base so it doesn’t burn until it thickens up slightly. take off heat when it smells toasty and fragrant - kinda like popcorn. mix in the cinnamon, cardamom and salt.
pour the mixture on top of the dates. let it cool for about 5 mins.
sprinkle the ground pistachio on top and press down gently but firmly.
allow it to cool and set in the fridge for a couple hours before slicing.

18007856408163506.ingredients:
1/2 cup of cream

1 full dark chocolate bar
your choice of toppings!

17905283513860062.ingredients:

1/4 cup date/ maple syrup
17905283513860062.method: Combine everything, form small balls and bake at 350F for 20-25 minutes or until crispy

18016896196981947.ingredients:

18016896196981947.method: Now to make a cup for yourself, combine 2 tbsp of the mix per cup of hot water or milk along with some chopped dark chocolate and enjoy this dreamy treat perfect for these cold days!

18401164183001297.ingredients:
3 cups water
3 tsp black peppercorns

5-6 garlic cloves

1/4 cup coriander
2-3 tsp jaggery
Lemon sized tamarind soaked in 1/4 cup water
Salt as per taste
Fresh coriander for garnish
For tempering:
3 tsp coconut oil
1 tsp mustard seeds
1 sprig curry leaves
2-3 dried red chillies
1/4 tsp hing
1/4 tsp turmeric powder ( add just before pouring the tempering)

18207686257283143.ingredients:
GF Fudgey Brownie mix of choice(@simplemills works best)
Sliced almonds(If you can't do almonds, use cereal flakes instead)
9 oz chocolate chips(@hukitchen Hu Gems works best)
1-2 tsp coconut oil(use more if your chocolate is very thick)
Powdered sugar or powdered monk fruit
18207686257283143.method:
1) Make your brownie mix accordingly to the instructions(make sure to not over bake them so they will be somewhat gooey in the middle and easy to work with) Bake your brownie mix and then let it cool down for a few minutes.
2) Take the baked brownie mixture and remove any really crispy parts then form into about 12 cone shapes.(kinda like you would a cake pop)
3) Place the almond slices in and around the brownie cones(carefully because they are fragile), making the pine cone look full with "scales."
4) Place the pine cones on a parchment paper lined sheet pan, and stick in the freezer for 30 minutes.
5) Melt the chocolate chips with the coconut oil by heating in a bowl in the microwave in 30-second increments.(Or use a double boiler).
6) Take the pine cones out of the freezer and carefully coat each one with the melted chocolate. Place the pine cone brownies back on the parchment paper to set.
7) Sprinkle some powdered sugar on top for a frosted look and enjoy!

17999793017201091.ingredients:
3 tbsp olive oil
3 tbsp butter
1 large onion, chopped
8-10 cloves garlic, minced
1 packet mushrooms, cleaned + sliced 1/2 inch thick
1/4 cup chopped California walnuts
salt and pepper to taste
1 tsp red chili flakes optional
2 tbsp  all purpose flour
2.5 cups water
1 Maggi stock cube
1 tbs fresh thyme optional
1 tsp oregano
1/4- 1/3 cup fresh cream as preference
17999793017201091.method:
Add your olive oil and butter and melt
on medium heat, add in the onion and saute for 5 minutes. Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds. Add in the mushrooms
Stir it all to saute for 2-3 minutes.
Next add in chopped walnuts and cook for about 10 minutes until it all caramelises
Next, sprinkle on the flour and stir to coat all. Cook for 2 minutes Pour in veg stock or water + veg stock cube. Mix well and let it boil
Add In salt pepper and  herbs  and bring to a boil.Lower the heat to simmer COVERED, for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add cream and mix
Transfer about half of the soup to a mini food processor or blender to puree. Add it back into the pot and mix

18254603275200729.ingredients:
Chicken:
6 boneless skinless chicken thighs
2 tbsp tandoori masala (I’ve used shaan)
1 tbsp coriander powder
1 tbsp cumin powder
1 tbsp paprika powder
1 tsp chilli powder
2 tsp salt
2 tsp black pepper powder
1 lemon worth of lemon juice
2 tbsp ginger and garlic paste
3 tbsp Greek yoghurt
Rice:
2 cups basmati rice (washed and soaked for 30 mins)
4 tbsp olive oil
1 large diced
1 green pepper diced
2 tbsp tomato purée
1 tsp coriander powder
1 tsp cumin powder
2 tsp red chilli flakes (or more for more spicy)
1/2 tsp turmeric powder
1 tsp salt or according to taste
3 cups boiling water dissolved with 1 chicken stock cube
18254603275200729.method:
1. Marinate chicken in all the spices listed
2. Heat a large pan with olive oil and fry the chicken for 4 mins on each side. Doesn’t need to be fully cooked at this point
3. Set aside and in the same pan, fry onions and add a splash of water to prevent the pot from burning
4. Add green peppers and garlic. Cook till onions have soften
5. Add the rice spices and tomato paste. Cook for 2 mins
6. Add the soaked and drained basmati rice. Toast the rice with the masala for 5 mins continuously mixing the rice to prevent burning (be gentle don’t break the grains)
7. Add 3 cups of chicken stock and bring to a boil. Let the liquid evaporate.
8. When the water has dried, re add the chicken thighs and cover the pot. Put flame on lowest setting and let the rice cook for 30 mins in the steam
9. Garnish with fresh coriander and chillies. Enjoy with a side of yoghurt or hummus!

18009575915310626.ingredients:
chicken, ginger, goji berries
ginger 🫚 - as much as you want
scallions/spring onions - slightly more than ginger
soy sauce - measure with your heart
sesame oil - a few drops will do bc sesame oil is heavy in flavour :)
salt - just a lil to taste
18009575915310626.method:
place a bowl in the middle
you can steam this on the stovetop! (i'm just using a steam oven)
when you stir fry scallion and ginger in oil = aromatics +++

18205078165279573.ingredients:
Fresh coriander (around 2 cups)
3-4 green chillies
Fresh Mint leaves (1/2 cup)
1 inch Ginger
6-7 Garlic cloves
1.5 tsp Black pepper
Salt to taste
1 tsp Haldi
1 tsp Red chilli powder
1.5 tsp Jeera
1/4th cup Curd
1 Bay Leaf
Cinnamon stick
1-2 dried red chillies
Lemon juice (1/2 lemon)
5 tbsp Mustard oil
Spring onions (Only the white part)
Garam Masala

18099168724368983.ingredients:
1/2 cauliflower(washed & blanched head) cut into small pieces
1 carrot cut into 1 inch pieces with medium thickness
1/2 radish cut into 1 inch pieces with medium thickness
10-12 green chillies slit
10-12 garlic cloves
1 inch ginger
1 tsp turmeric
1/4 tsp fenugreek ( methi)
1 tsp black peppercorns
1 tbsp fennel seeds
1 tbsp black mustard
1 tbsp yellow mustard
1 tsp cumin
1/4 tsp heeng (asafoetida)
1/4 tsp ajwain(caron seeds)
1 tsp kalonji
1/2 cup kacchi ghani oil
2 tbsp salt ( I’m using pink salt so it’s lighter, be careful & add less if using white)
1 tsp amchur
1 tbsp Kashmiri red chilli
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar (increases shelf life)
18099168724368983.method:
Crush ginger and garlic cloves using mortar & pestle. Add to the veggies. Add some turmeric and let it dry in the sun for 4 hours on a clean cotton cloth. If you don’t get sun light then you can dry them under fan. I’m making it the traditional way so sun drying is imp
Roast all these spices on low flame until a bit fragrant. You want slight roasting and not overdo this step
Grind them and add to the sun dried veggies
Heat 1/2 cup kacchi ghani oil until a light smoke emerges, switch the flame off and let it cool down for 2 mins and then add the hot oil to the veggies
Store in a sterilised glass container. Cover using a cotton/muslin cloth and let it sit in the sun for 2-4 days depending on the amount of sunlight. Shake it a bit everyday. Make sure to not let any moisture get in so use dry spoon while serving this.

18099697249335589.ingredients:
3 cups strawberries
3/4 cup sago (tapioca pearls)
1 jar of Nata de Coco (coconut jellies)
2 cups of half and half (this is half milk, half cream mixture)
1/2 cup condensed milk
18099697249335589.method:
Cut the strawberries into cubes. In a bowl, add strawberries and the syrup from the Nata de Coco jellies. This will help to sweeten the strawberries. Set it aside.
Boil the sago/tapioca pearls on medium low heat for about 10 minutes then remove from heat and cover with lid for 10-15 minutes until it is translucent in color. Don’t worry if there if there are tiny specks of white, it’s fine. Drain and rinse the in cold water.
To your bowl of strawberries, add sago, condensed milk, Nata de Coco jellies, and half and half. Taste and adjust for your sweetness level. Refrigerate for at least hours before serving. Serve chilled or with crushed ice.

17889737273941774.ingredients:
1 cup hazelnut
1 cup toasted hazelnuts : 1/4 cup hazelnuts (to be used for stuffing and coating) + 3/4 cup hazelnuts (to be blended)
7 dates
2 tbsp cocoa powder (add less if you want it less rich)
pinch of salt
vanilla essence
1 cup grated coconut toasted on a pan for 3 min till dry
melted dark chocolate (dark chocolate microwaved with 1 tsp coconut oil)
top: chopped toasted hazelnuts + pinch of salt
17889737273941774.method:
toast on a pan on medium low heat for 15-20 min till golden brown: the hazelnuts will release oils so they’ll look shiny
blend into a smooth hazelnut butter
blend everything
form ladoos with a toasted hazelnut in the centre
coat ladoos with chocolate
chill in the fridge till the chocolate hardens before serving

17979900899541613.method:
Start by removing the veins of fresh paan leaves.
Add 9-10 chopped paan leaves, 1/4 cup gulkand and 1 tbsp variyali in a mixer jar to make paste.
In a shake maker/ bigger jar, add 3 cups of milk, 1/2 cup of condensed milk and all the prepared paan paste into it and blend to make paan flavoured milk.
In shot glasses, add 1 tsp of soaked chia seeds, 1 tsp of sevaiyan, and fill the glass with paan milk leaving enough space for a small scoop of vanilla ice-cream.
Garnish with dried and crushed rose and paan leaves.

18025984903633158.ingredients:
900g frozen peas
1 potato
1 onion
4 garlic cloves
1 litre vegetable stock
1tbsp miso paste (optional)
Large bunch of mint
1 lemon
2tbsp olive oil
2tbsp (vegan) butter
Salt
Pepper
Sugar
TO SERVE
Crispy onions / shallots
(Vegan) cream
Smoked paprika
Toasted sourdough
18025984903633158.method:
1. Add the oil + butter to a large saucepan over a medium heat.
2. Finely dice the onion, then add to the saucepan once the butter has melted with a large pinch of salt.
3. Peel the potato, chop into small cubes, then add to onions + cook until soft (10-15 minutes)
4. Mince the garlic, add to the pot + fry until fragrant (1 minute).
5. Add 750g peas, the vegetable stock + miso paste.
6. Simmer for 5/10 minutes, or until potatoes are cooked through. Add a large handful of mint leaves & cover with a lid.
7. Reserve the rest of the peas for garnish - place in a bowl of boiling water for 3 minutes, then into cold water + set aside.
8. Blend the soup until smooth, then place back in the pot + bring to a simmer. Season to taste with a squeeze of lemon juice, then salt, pepper + sugar if needed.
9. To serve, ladle into bowls, top with a swirl of cream, olive oil, a spoonful of peas, crispy shallots + a sprinkle of smoked paprika.
10. Toast + butter your sourdough, then dive on in.

18041737891516767.ingredients:
1 Tbsp olive oil
4 garlic cloves
1 red onion
0.5 tsp paprika
1 tsp dried rosemary
1 tsp dried thyme
0.5 tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp chili flakes
1.2 L (5 cups) cooked butter beans
1 L (4 cups) vegetable broth
salt & black pepper, to taste
Juice from 1 lemon + zest
18041737891516767.method:
1. Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat, add the onion sauté for about 1 minute, add the garlic and sauté for another minute.
2. Add the spices, butter beans and broth.
3. Use an immersion blender and blend until smooth.
4.  Let it simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
5. Add lemon juice and zest.
6. Add more salt and pepper to taste. Enjoy!

18049902043479608.ingredients:
2 cups mangos (2 large mangos)
3/4 cup sago
1 tsp ube extract (optional)
1 jar Nata de Coco (coconut jellies)
1 14 oz can coconut milk
1 cup half and half (half milk/half cream mixture)
1/3 cup condensed milk
18049902043479608.method:
Boil 3 cups water in a pot then add sago and ube extract. Cook only medium heat for 10 minutes, then remove from heat and cover with a lid for 15 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water.
Cut the mangos into cubes and place in large bowl. Add the sago to the bowl along with the coconut jellies (drain out half of the syrup), coconut milk, half and half and condensed milk. Mix to combine then refrigerate for 2-4 hours before serving.

18039528019603982.ingredients:
1 medium broccoli cut into florets.
4 Tbsp curd
1 Tsp Mustard oil
1 Tsp Ginger Garlic Paste
A few fenugreek leaves/kasuri methi
Salt & Pepper to taste
Mozzarella Cheese, 1 Tsp on each floret.
18039528019603982.method:
1. In a pot, bring water to a boil.
2. Add in the broccoli florets along with 1/2 Tsp of sugar.
3. On the second boil/after 2-3 Minutes, strain the broccoli.
4. In a bowl, add curd, mustard oil, ginger garlic paste, salt, pepper and fenugreek leaves.
5. Whisk to a smooth and creamy texture.
6. On a baking tray, lined with parchment paper, smash the broccoli florets using a flat surface.
7. Pour in 1 Tbsp of the creamy dip on each broccoli.
8. Top it up with 1 Tsp of Mozzarella on each broccoli.
9. Bake it for 10-15 Minutes at 180 degrees until that cheese is perfectly broiled!
10. Enjoy, serve with dips of choice.

18012357616957491.ingredients:
Paan syrup:
6 paan leaves (blanched- boil in hot water for a few seconds and add it to ice cold water)
2 Tbsps gulkand
2 teaspoons saunf
45 ml sugar syrup (cook 1/4th cup sugar with 1/4th water and boil for a few seconds)
For the drink:
Lots of ice
60 ml paan syrup
45ml gin
120ml tonic water
Lime juice - few drops
Nutmeg - sprinkle
Paan leaf to garnish
18012357616957491.method:
For the Paan syrup: Blend the blanched leaves along with gulkand, saunf & sugar syrup until nice & smooth
Strain the mixture
To assemble start with lots of ice, paan syrup that we prepared, gin, tonic water & lime juice
Garnish with nutmeg & a paan leaf & enjoy

18031720456649534.ingredients:
1 cup sweet potato
1 cup almond butter
1/2 cup maple syrup (going to try with 1/3 cup next time!)
1/3 cup cacao powder
+ chocolate chips (optional)

18009063053029752.ingredients:
1 cauliflower
about 1/4 cup (60ml) olive oil
a good pinch of salt
Sauce:

1 Tbsp maple syrup
juice of 1 lime
optionally 1 Tsp sriracha
salt to taste
water to thin
18009063053029752.method:
Boil in salted water 5-6mins.
Rub the cauliflower with the oil and add the salt.
Bake at 225C/450F for 45mins.
Mix and serve with the cauliflower.

18021702184718411.ingredients:
1/4 cup mirin.
1/4 cup sake.
1/3 cup miso paste.
1/3 cup cane sugar.
2 lb black cod (deboned, cut into filets).
18021702184718411.method:
1.- Boil the mirin and sake for 3 min.
2.- Add in sugar and miso. Cook a couple min without boiling. Let it cool.
3.- Pour it all over your fish, cover it VERY tightly and marinate for 24-48 hrs in fridge.
4.- Broil it (I did 7 min) but every oven is different so keep an eye out.

17980113083339168.ingredients:
4-5 eggs.
1/4 cup heavy cream.
1 tbsp salsa macha + more for topping.
chives to taste.
salsa macha.
17980113083339168.method:
1. Preheat a pan for 2 min on high. Add in heavy cream and chili crisp. Lower heat to medium and simmer for 1 min.
2. Add in eggs and cover. Cook like this for 2-3 min until the whites set.
3. Top with chives, seasoned eggs and chili crisp.

18081638614393018.method: Use folded up pieces of baking paper or foil to shape your cupcakes. Add a swirl of chocolate buttercream. Use chocolate cereal (I used MILO) to make your pine cones. Dust them with powdered sugar.

17992271159148698.ingredients:
300g Boneless Chicken (cut into strips)
1 or 2 tbsp Olive oil
1 tsp Salt
1/2 tbsp Grated garlic (2 cloves)
1 tsp Chilli powder
1 tsp Cumin powder
1 tsp Chilli flakes
1 tsp Paprika
1/2 tsp Black pepper
For the spicy sauce
1/2 cup Low fat Greek yogurt
2 tbsp Sriracha hot sauce
1 tsp Grated garlic
1/2 tsp Salt
1/2 tsp Chilli flakes
Juice of half a Lemon
2 tbsp Chopped coriander
To assemble I’ve used
I’ve used wheat & white wraps which has only 183 calories per wrap)
Lettuce
Cucumber
Tomatoes
Onions

18307937071115373.method:
You can bake, airfare, grill, or pan fry the chicken.
1. Add 2lbs chicken thighs to a bowl. Drizzle with 1-2 tbsp olive oil, the juice of a lemon, a couple generous pinches of salt, pepper, 1 tbsp onion powder & 1/2 to 1 tbsp garlic powder. Mix well, then ideally let this marinate for 2 hours to overnight, but if you want to make it right away you can.
2.Bring a pan to medium heat, add 1 tbsp avocado oil, add chicken, and cook it on medium heat. This takes 12-15mins depending on thickness of chicken. I usually cook first side down for 5 mins, flip for 5, flip for 2, then flip for another 1 min.
3. Make the green goddess sauce by processing or blending: 1 large handful EACH cilantro, parsley, basil, and chives; a small handful of mint and dill, 1 small shallot, 2 garlic cloves, 1/2 cup creme fraiche, sour cream, or thick yogurt, the zest & juice of 1 lemon, 2 tbsp olive oil, and a generous pinch of salt + pepper. Process well, taste and adjust.
4.Make the sumac pickled red onions by thinly slicing a red onion. Add to a bowl, sprinkle with 2-3 pinches salt, 1 to 2 tbsp of sumac, and juice of 1 large lemon. Mix well, then let it sit for about 10-15 mins, stirring a couple of times.
5.Finally, the base. I used my Kaizen lowcarb rice, but you can use rice, cauli rice, quinoa, or whatever you like. I boiled my rice for 5 mins in a mixture of salted water & chicken broth.
6.When rice is done, add a serving to the bowl, with a heaping handful of greens, some chicken, & pile high with pickled red onions, red radish, fresh herbs, green goddess sauce, & white sesame seeds.

17998902818242187.ingredients:
500g paneer
3 onions, sliced
50g cashews
7 cloves garlic
3tbsp ghee
250ml water
1tsp cumin seeds
3 green cardamom
1 bay leaf
1 cinnamon stick
2 green chillies, sliced
75g fresh methi, roughly chopped
1tsp salt
2tsp garam masala
2tsp black pepper
1tsp cumin powder
100ml double cream
1/2tbsp kasuri methi
Handful fresh coriander
Tempering:
1tbsp ghee
2 cloves garlic, sliced
2 green chillies, sliced
1/2tsp chilli powder
750g cooked Basmati rice (made from 300g raw rice)
1tbsp ghee
2tsp cumin seeds
1 bay leaf
1/2tsp turmeric
2tbsp water
1tsp salt
Juice of 1 lemon
17998902818242187.method:
Start by chopping the paneer into bite-sized pieces, then soak in boiling water for 30 mins
Heat tbsp of ghee in a pan and sauté the onions, 3 cloves of garlic, and cashews for 10 mins on low heat
Then transfer to a blender jug with 250ml of water and blend till smooth
Heat another 2tbsp of ghee and toast the cumin seeds, cardamom, cinnamon, and bay leaf for 1 minute
Mince the remaining 4 cloves of garlic and add to the pan along with the green chillies. Continue to cook until the garlic has turned golden
Next add the fresh methi and sauté until it has started to wilt
Pour in the onion sauce along with the salt, black pepper, cumin powder, garam masala, and paneer. Mix to combine, then cover the pan and let it simmer on a low heat for 5 minutes
Finish with cream, kasuri methi, and fresh coriander
For the tempering, heat ghee in a pan and sauté the garlic and green chillies until the garlic becomes crispy. Mix in chilli powder and spoon over the paneer before serving
Heat the ghee in a pan + toast the cumin seeds and bay leaf for 30s
Add in the turmeric and splash of water
Then add in the cooked rice and salt, and mix to combine
Finish with lemon juice

17997662636215728.ingredients:
3 eggs
1/3 cup cottage cheese
tomatoes
peppers
spinach or your favorite greens
Cheese
Salt and pepper
Burrito sized tortilla
17997662636215728.method: Bake at 350 degrees for 15-20 minutes or until eggs are set.

17895535244894177.ingredients:
3 Wild-Caught Icelandic Cod (@bluecirclefoods)
1 lemon
Marinade for the cod:
1/4 cup mirin
1/4 cup sake
3 tbsp miso paste
1 tbsp sugar
17895535244894177.method:
For caramelized lemon, cut 1 lemon into thin slices and sear it in a pan on medium low heat until it browns
In a pot, on medium heat, boil the marinade ingredients until well combined. Then let it cool.
Put the fish in a container then pour it all over the fish
Keep in fridge for 24-48 hours
Broil the fish in the oven for 7-10 mins (depending on your oven heat)

18087173374361659.method:
Heat 1 tbsp oil, Add 7-8 garlic cloves and 2 dried red chillies saute for 1 min. Add 1 cup Arhar/Toor Dal and roast this for about 4-5 minutes.
Now add 8-10 Curry leaves, Salt to taste, 1/4 tsp turmeric powder and 1/4 tsp Hing. Saute for a min and let this cools down at bit.
Transfer to a blender and add 1/4 cup Imli/ Tamarind pulp and grind it nicely. Add fresh corriander and serve with hot rice & Ghee.

17865722720982121.ingredients:
2kg Maris Piper or King Edward potatoes
5 Tbsp Goose fat
2 Rosemary sprigs
2 Garlic cloves, crushed
Lemon Rosemary Salt
1 Tbsp Rosemary, freshly chopped
1 Tbsp Maldon salt
Zest of ½ a Lemon
17865722720982121.method:
Preheat the oven to 180ºC/350ºF.
Peel and quarter the potatoes (or halve smaller ones). Wash them under running water to remove the starchy residue until the water is clear.
Salt the cold water, add rosemary sprigs and crushed garlic, and simmer for 15-20 minutes until soft.
Pour goose fat into a roasting tray. Drain and roughen the potatoes in a colander. Let them cool for 5 minutes, then coat them evenly in the hot fat using a large spoon.
Roast for 1hr 30 minutes, turning every 30 minutes.
Make rosemary-lemon salt by combining rosemary and salt in a mortar and pestle, adding lemon zest at the end.
Remove the potatoes from the oven, drain on kitchen towels, and generously sprinkle with rosemary-lemon salt.

17994890852078386.ingredients:
3/4 oz lime juice
1/2 oz blood orange cordial from @liberandco or blood orange syrup
1 oz cranberry juice
3/4 oz orange liqueur
1/2 oz Chile liqueur
1.5 oz Mezcal, or tequila
1-2 tsp gold edible glitter

18162691216288585.ingredients:
25 Dates (pitted) (197g)
(1 + 1/2 cups) Hot Milk (375g)
1/2 cup Vegetable Oil (95g)
1 cup Whole wheat Flour (120g)
1/2 tsp Baking Powder
1 tsp Baking Soda
1/2 cup Walnuts (chopped)  50gm
18162691216288585.method:
Soak the pitted dates in Hot milk for 1 hour so that they become super soft.
Then in a bowl, add flour, baking powder and baking soda. Whisk well.
Then once the dates become soft, blend them into a smooth paste and transfer to a bowl. Add in vegetable oil and mix well.
Add in your dry ingredients and whisk.
Transfer the batter to a 6’inch lined tin, top it up with walnuts and bake at 180 degrees for about 50 mins or until a skewer inserted in comes out clean!

18001227755159306.method: You can let them dry overnight or you can put them in a 300° oven for about 10 minutes before you fry them. They make a pretty big wow. You can also add a little bit of flavouring if you’d like them to taste of coconut or vanilla, or whatever you prefer

17965505696537971.ingredients:
1 ripe banana (approximately 200g)
2 cups Greek yogurt
1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
70g dark chocolate (70% cocoa or higher), chopped or in chips
17965505696537971.method:
1. Peel the banana and place it in a blender or food processor with the yogurt and vanilla.Blend until creamy.
2. Pour the mixture into molds or small cups and insert popsicle sticks into each mold or cup. Place in the freezer for at least 4 hours.
3. For the chocolate coating. In a microwave-safe bowl, melt the dark chocolate in short intervals, stirring in between, until smooth and fully melted. Alternatively, you can melt the chocolate using a double boiler.
4. Once the ice cream is frozen solid, remove the molds or cups from the freezer and dip each ice cream pop into the melted dark chocolate, ensuring it’s evenly coated on all sides.
5. Place the coated ice cream pops on a parchment-lined tray or plate and return them to the freezer for a few minutes to set the chocolate.

18311739073106332.ingredients:
12 Eggs
1/4 cup Diced Red Peppers
1/4 cup Diced Onion
1 cup Mexican blend shredded cheese
1/2 tbsp olive oil
18311739073106332.method:
I use a 12 count muffin pan to portion these out and bake them and off course top off with everything but the bagel seasoning 🤩
Bake in the oven at 375 for 12 minutes!!

17870834178000639.ingredients:
400g tofu
3 cloves garlic
2 spring onion
1 Tbsp chili flakes
1 Tbsp sesame oil
1/4 cup (60ml) soy sauce
1/4 cup (60ml) water
2 Tbsp syrup or sugar
17870834178000639.method:
Pat dry, cut in thick slices and fry in oil on both sides.
Finely chop.
Mix and add the sauce to the tofu.
Let it simmer for 5-10mins.

18199558786280723.ingredients:
1 cup split red lentils, dry
2 cups water
juice of 1 lemon
1/2 cup tahini
1 garlic clove
1 tsp salt
18199558786280723.method:
Add the lentils to a sieve and rinse well to get rid of any dirt. Bring 2 cups of water to a boil in a small pot, then add the lentils, reduce to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
Drain and rinse with cold water. The lentils should be soft and almost paste like. Add to a blender and blend a few seconds until smooth.
Add the lemon juice, tahini, garlic and salt and blend again. Add 2-3 Tbsp of water until you’ve reached the desired consistency (it will firm up more once it gets cold).
Serve with paprika, cumin and a drizzle of olive oil and enjoy!

18016778134736144.ingredients:
Roasted Cauliflower
1 small head of cauliflower, cut into  florets
1 tsp smoked paprika
1/2 tsp ground coriander
1/2 tsp onion powder
1/2 tsp garlic powder
1-2 tbsp avocado oil
Chickpeas
1, 15 oz can of chickpeas, drained and rinsed
1 tbsp avocado oil
1/4 cup walnuts, chopped (optional)
1/2 tsp onion powder
1/2 tsp ground coriander
Marinated Onions
1/4 medium red onion, thinly sliced into strips
1 clove garlic, grated
Zest and juice of 1 lime
1-2 tbsp maple syrup
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1/4 cup cilantro, stems removed and minced
1/4 cup dates, chopped
Kosher salt to taste
18016778134736144.method:
Preheat the oven to 425F then line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper.
To 1 tray add the cauliflower along with paprika, coriander, onion powder, garlic powder and a generous pinch of salt. Drizzle with a tbsp or more of oil then toss together to evenly coat the cauliflower. Spread the cauliflower pieces out, placing pieces cut side down on the tray. Bake in the oven on the bottom rack for 30 mins, flipping the cauliflower after 20 mins.
To the 2nd tray, add chickpeas and oil. Toss to coat and bake  for 20 mins on the middle rack. Remove and allow to cool for 5-10 mins. Top with the walnuts and spices along with a pinch of salt then toss to coat. Bake for another 10 mins.
While everything bakes, prepare the marinated onions. Add the onions, garlic, lime zest and juice , maple syrup, vinegar, olive oil, cilantro, dates, and a generous pinch of salt. Using clean hands, toss the onions together until fully coated then cover and place in the fridge until everything is done baking.
Transfer the onion mixture to the tray of cauliflower and toss together to coat.
To assemble, serve the roasted cauliflower over your grain or starch of choice then top with the crispy chickpeas and walnuts. Use any of the dressing left in the bowl of marinated onions to drizzle over top then enjoy.

17944178543596893.ingredients:
3 cups cooked Japanese sushi rice

2 tsp Coriander Seeds

17994057317328078.method:
1. Toss the peppers, onion, tomatoes, and chili with oil, salt, and black pepper. Then roast in the oven at 400F/200C for 25-30 mins till slightly blackened.
2. Caramelize the tomato paste in a bit of olive oil for 5 minutes.
3. Toast the cumin and coriander seeds for a couple minutes, then grind to a powder.
4. Remove any blackened veggies from the tray. (The tomatoes need extra time because they have more moisture.) Then add the garlic cloves and Put the tray back in the oven for another 15 mins
5. Peel and discard the pepper skins and then add everything EXCEPT the walnuts to a food processor. After it’s smooth, add the walnuts and pulse a few times till the spread is your desired consistency.
6. TRADITIONALLY, bread crumbs will be added to help with consistency and give the dip more body, but I prefer it to have a denser flavor, and find that by thoroughly roasting the veggies, the dip is not too wet. The pita is enough bread to fill me up.
7. Garnish with pomegranate seeds, some walnuts, parsley, and a final drizzle of pomegranate molasses. Do NOT skip the parsley. It isn’t just for color, but it’s an amazingly crisp undertone in every bite.

18005465791841839.ingredients:
3 cups basmati rice
2 tbsp Himalayan salt
1/6 tsp saffron (optional)
3 tbsp vegetable oil
18005465791841839.method:
1. First, wash and drain the rice 3 times or until the water is not cloudy.
2. Fill a large pot with water (about 10 cups) to boil with 2 tbsp of salt. Once it has come to a boil, add the washed rice and turn the heat the low-medium heat.
3. Boil the rice for 6-7 minutes only, so that it is half cooked. Check the rice by taking a single grain and pressing it between your fingers. It should be still a little hard in the centre.
4. Immediately drain the rice in a colander, and rinse with cold water to stop the cooking process.
5. In a non-stick pot, oil the bottom of the pot with 3-4 tbsp of oil. If using saffron (recommended), mix 1/6 teaspoon ground saffron with 2 tbsp of boiling water. Let it sit for 2-3 mins.
6. Add the saffron water into the oil on the bottom of the pot and brush together make a uniform liquid.
7. Add the half-cooked rice in, spoon by spoon. Once all the rice has been added, create a mound shape by pulling up the sides of the rice. Poke some holes into the rice mound to allow steam to escape.
8. Wrap the lid of the pot in a dishcloth or a damkoni and set the lid on the pot.
9. Add in 1/6 cup of boiling water to the rice.
10. For the first 5 minutes, set the heat to medium. At this point, check to see that steam is beginning to rise in the pot.
11. Turn the heat to low, and leave it on low heat for 45 minutes-1 hour.
12. When ready to serve, take the pot off the heat for a few minutes.
13. Remove the lid. Place a large platter on top of the pot and in a swift motion, turn the platter and pot upside down.
14. If the tahdig is stuck, run the bottom of the pot under cold water.
15. Enjoy with rice and any persian stew (khoresht)!

3. To make the dressing, I added 2 garlic cloves, 1 small shallot (don’t go overboard), fresh chives, fresh basil, spinach (not pictured but optional), 1/4 cup walnuts, small handful cashews, 1/4 cup olive oil, juice from 2 large lemons, 2-3 tablespoons nutritional yeast, 2 tablespoons rice vinegar, and sea salt. Process or blend away till creamy. Taste, then modify as needed! Make it taste how you want, if you need more vinegar, salt, or lemon, just add it to your liking.
4. Then I used @hilolifesnacks tortilla style chips as the vessel and ate straight out of the bowl.

17903779859137946.ingredients:
3-4 cups of cherry tomatoes
1 serrano pepper
1 garlic clove
1 cup of diced green onions
1/2 cup of diced sweet onions
1/3 cup of finely chopped cilantro (for blended)
1/3 cup of finely chopped cilantro (to be mixed in at the end)
1 teaspoon of cumin and pink Himalayan salt
1/4 teaspoon of white sugar and red chilli powder (laal murchoo)
1/2 - 1 tablespoon of fresh lemon or lime juice
17903779859137946.method:
1. In a food processor, pulse the cherry tomatoes until it is a bit chunky and not too smooth, where it is a watery consistency.
2. Ten pour into a separate bowl. In the same food processor add in cilantro, garlic, a serrano pepper and 1/3 cup of the blended tomatoes and blend until smooth.
3. Add this back into the blended tomatoes. Add in the chopped green onions, sweet white onions and cilantro. Last add in the salt, cumin, sugar, red chilli powder and lemon juice and mix up everything until smooth. Then enjoy !

17848400345641261.ingredients:
1/2 tbsp coconut oil
1/2 tsp cumin seeds
1/2 tsp fennel seeds
4 cloves
10 kadi patta (also called curry leaves or sweet neem leaves)
5 garlic cloves, minced
3/4 inch ginger, grated
3 birds eye green chilies, finely chopped (+/-)
1 small onion, finely chopped
3 tbsp tomato paste
1 large tomato, finely diced
1/2 tsp turmeric
2 tsp coriander powder
1 to 2 tsp kashmiri red chili (+/-)
1/2 tsp black pepper
Salt to taste
2 cups full fat coconut milk
1/2 tsp garam masala
Handful of kasuri methi (dried fenugreek leaves), crushed between palms
4 pasture raised eggs
17848400345641261.method:
Heat up coconut oil, then add cumin, fennel, & cloves. Once they start wiggling around, quickly & carefully add kadi patta (there will be spluttering so don't stand too close!) Toast around for 30 sec.
Add garlic, ginger, chilies, and onion. Sauté until onions are a bit translucent.
Add tomato paste & cook for 3-4min to caramelize - the color will go from bright red to deep dull red.
Add tomatoes, turmeric, coriander, red chili powder, black pep, & salt. Cook until tomatoes are mushy.
Add coconut milk, mix well, & raise the heat if needed to maintain a slight simmer. Simmer for 3-4min.
Add garam masala, kasuri methi, & mix well for a minute. Taste for salt then turn off heat.
Add the eight halves of your eggs. Garnish with a sprinkle of crushed kasuri methi.
Jammy Eggs:
Bring a saucepan with enough water to cover the eggs to a vigorous boil.
Using a slotted spoon, lower in your eggs.
Immediately start a timer for 6min 30 sec (I personally prefer 6.5min than exactly 6min eggs, but you can try both!). Maintain a boil.
Remove the eggs and dunk them in the ice bath. Let them sit for 5min then peel & enjoy!

17909567113861467.ingredients:
1 cup dried white beans, soaked overnight
1 oz dried shiitake mushrooms
6 cups water
2 cloves garlic
1/2 small white onion
1 1/2 tsp salt
2 tbsp olive oil
2 tsp gochugaru or other chili pepper flakes
1 tbsp Chinese black vinegar
1 tbsp rice wine vinegar
1 tsp sesame oil
Cripsy shiitakes//
1/4 cup of sliced fresh shiitake mushrooms
2 tsp cornstarch
High heat oil for frying
Salt to taste
Finely chopped chives to garnish
Sesame oil to garnish
Sesame seeds to garnish
17909567113861467.method:
1. Add the dried mushrooms, soaked beans, onion, garlic, salt, and olive oil to a large pot. Cover with 6 cups water and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook until beans are extremely tender, about 45 minutes - 1 hour. Use a slotted spoon or fine mesh skimmer to transfer the beans, mushrooms, onion, and garlic into a heat proof bowl. Return the pot to the stove with the liquid and reduce on medium-high heat until roughly 1/4 cup remains. Transfer to a heat proof bowl and set aside.
2. Add the black vinegar, rice wine vinegar, gochugaru, sesame oil, and 2 tbsp of the reduced mushroom/bean liquid to the bowl of mushrooms and beans and stir to combine. Transfer to a food processor and process until smooth.
3. For the fresh shiitakes, place a sieve or colander over a bowl and add the fresh mushrooms and cornstarch. Tap the sieve or colander to shake off any excess cornstarch from the mushrooms. Transfer to a generously oiled medium sized pan on medium heat and fry mushrooms on both sides until lightly browned and crisp, about 3-5 minutes. Place on a paper towel and season with salt immediately.
4. Garnish dip with crispy mushrooms, chives, sesame oil, and sesame seeds.

For the tadka

17912400673721320.method:
Soak the dried peas overnight
Pressure cook the peas and potatoes for about 5-6 whistles
Take some of the boiled peas and keep them aside
Peel the potatoes and add it to the peas
Mash everything and keep the mixture aside
Heat oil in a pan, add onions, ginger, garlic and green chilies
Saute them till the onions are transparent
Let the sauteed ingredients come to room temperature
Add them to a mixer jar, add tomatoes
Grind everything to a smooth paste by adding some water
Heat a pan with oil, add the ground masala, add some water, turmeric powder, red chili powder, garam masala, chaat masala, salt. Mix everything well
Add about 1/2 cup of water. Cook the masala for 10 mins
Add the mashed peas and potatoes

17981231014367454.ingredients:
4 chicken breasts pounded to about 1/4 inch and even
1/2 cup almond flour
1 tablespoon arrowroot
1 lemon zested and divided in half
2 tablespoons olive oil more as needed
1 tablespoon butter
Salt & pepper to taste
Sauce
2 tablespoon butter
1 cup chicken broth
1/2 lemon zest
1 garlic clove minced
1 lemon juiced (about 2-3 tablespoons)
2 tablespoons fresh parsley chopped
17981231014367454.method:
1. Combine the flour, arrow root, 1/2 lemon zest, salt and pepper. Dredge the chicken in mixture
2. Heat olive oil and 1 tbsp butter over medium high heat and cook chicken about 4-5 minutes per side or until just until cooked through. Cook in batches if you cannot fit into pan.  Remove from pan, leave juice and bits behind and place on a plate.
3. In the same pan, reduce heat to medium and add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 min.
4. Add chicken broth and scrap any brown bits from the pan. Those have huge flavor! Add lemon juice. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Reduce by half, about 2 minutes
5. Add 2 tbsp butter and lemon zest. Stir to melt butter
6. Return chicken to skillet, spoon sauce over chicken. Allow chicken to absorb the flavor. Garnish with parsley and a lemon wedge.

17853218546521036.method: Toss, some corn, herbs, spices and rice flour together. Add water and cook on a skillet. I like to add fresh basil, jalapeno and loads of black pepper to these!

17860975439475123.ingredients:

17860975439475123.method:
1. Wash and Soak the Basmati Rice for 30 mins.
2. Cook the Basmati rice in an open pot with 1 litre of water and ¼ tsp of salt. Once the rice is 80% done, drain the water and let the rice cool completely.
3. In a pan, add oil, butter, finely chopped garlic cloves, red torn into half, finely chopped onions, carrots, beans and capsicum. Saute this for 3 mins.
4. Add the Schezwan sauce and continue to saute for another 1 minute.
5. Add the cooked rice to the pan.

17947523014391322.method:
1. In a kadhai add 1 cup suji(semolina) and dry roast it for 2-3 mins without changing its color.
2. Now add 1 cup of milk in small quantities with continuous stirring.Mix well to form a dough.
3. Transfer the dough to a plate and let it come to room temperature.
4. Grease your hand and knead the dough well.
5. Now add 2 tbsp milk powder, 2 tbsp sugar and 2 tbsp dessicated coconut. Mix and knead it again for 3-4 mins.
6. Take a portion of dough and roll to form a cylindrical shape. Ensure that there shouldn't be any crack.
7. In a kadhai, add 3/4 cup of sugar , 1 elaichi and 1 cup of water.
8. Mix well and let it cook to form sugar syrup of sticky consistency.
9. Place all the rolls in the sugar syrup. Cover and let it cook on low flame.
10. Turn off the flame and let it remain untouched for 10-15 mins.
11. Take each roll and coat it with dessicated coconut.
12. Place all the coated rolls in a plate.
13. Garnish with Pistachios or your favourite dryfruits.
14. Chum Chum is ready.

17847097853401818.ingredients:
4 medium sized potatoes, boiled and peeled
3–4 tablespoon ghee for shallow frying
1 1/2 teaspoons roasted cumin powder

17847097853401818.method:

Heat ghee in a skillet or tawa. Place the potatoes on the skillet (make sure they are not overlapping/ fry them in batches if required) and let them fry on low heat, turning once or twice, till golden brown and crisp on both sides.
Transfer the fried potatoes to a bowl and sprinkle all the masalas and salts on top and toss to mix. Add the lemon juice and toss again. Taste to check seasoning and add more chili powder or salt as required.
Arrange them on a serving platter or large plate and drizzle with tamarind chutney, sliced onions, coriander and nylon sev.

17874086739566402.ingredients:
1 large white onion (or 2-3 medium onions), diced
2 garlic cloves minced
4 tablespoon olive oil
3 tablespoon butter
salt & black pepper to taste
3 sprigs fresh thyme
1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar
80 ml white wine
1.5 tablespoon plain flour
1 liter vegetable stock
225 g dried pasta
60 ml double cream
60 g mature cheddar cheese (plus extra for grilling the top)
17874086739566402.method:
1. Peel your onion and slice thinly.
2. Heat the oil in a pan and add the thinly sliced onion. Cook on low, stirring occasionally, for 15 - 20 minutes until softened.
3. Add the salt, pepper, and butter and continue cooking for another 20 minutes. The onions should be beginning to turn a deep golden brown at this point. Stir often.
4. Add the balsamic vinegar, thyme, and minced garlic. Saute for 2 minutes.
5. Add the flour and stir it into the onions. Then, add the white wine and deglaze the pan, cooking for another 5-8 minutes until the wine has cooked down/evaporated.
6. Add the pasta and vegetable stock, stir, and cover the pan to simmer for another 10 minutes or until the pasta has cooked. Stir the pan intermittently to ensure nothing is sticking to the bottom of the pan - add more stock as required.
7. Stir in the cream and grated cheese until the cheese has melted and then serve with more cheese and black pepper to finish.

17885303154613540.ingredients:
For the Tofu Chilli Cheese Mixture
7 ounces extra firm tofu, pressed for 15 minutes
1 cup vegan cheese shreds, such as mozzarella or a mix of mozzarella and cheddar
1 tablespoon nutritional yeast, or more, to taste
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon black pepper
3 green chillies, finely chopped, such as serrano or Indian green chillies
1/4 cup finely chopped red bell pepper
1/4 cup finely chopped red onion, or more, to taste
1/2 cup loosely packed chopped cilantro
1/4 to 1/2 cup chopped greens, such as spinach or baby kale, or 1/4 cup frozen spinach
2 tablespoons hemp seeds, or more, to taste
1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes, optional, or more, to taste
1/2 teaspoon chaat masala blend, or use lime zest or 1/8 teaspoon kala namak
1/2 cup non-dairy yogurt, cashew cream, or blended silken tofu
1 teaspoon dried oregano, optional
lime juice, as needed
For Topping the Cheese Toast
1/2 cup vegan cheese shreds
1 green chilli, thinly sliced
2 teaspoons oil
7 to 8 slices sourdough, or other sturdy bread, such as multigrain bakery bread
For the Crispy Chilli Lime Tempeh
4 ounces tempeh, grated, crumbled, or finely chopped
2 teaspoons oil
3 cloves garlic, thinly sliced
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon Kashmiri chili powder
zest of 1/2 lime
17885303154613540.method:
Make the chilli cheese mixture.
Crumble the tofu into a bowl, then use a fork to break it down further, so there are no large chunks remaining. If you are using miso, mix 1 to 2 teaspoons miso into the yogurt before adding it to the mixture. Add all of the remaining chilli cheese mixture ingredients, and mix very well. Press and mix so the cheese is evenly distributed throughout the tofu mixture.
If the mixture seems dry, add a little more non-dairy yogurt or a squeeze of lime juice. Taste and adjust the seasoning. If you want a cheesier flavor, add more nutritional yeast. Set the mixture aside and slice another green chilli for topping. This mix can be refrigerated for up to three days.
Assemble the toasts (see notes for a grilled cheese version!).
Lightly toast the bread slices. You don't want them deeply browned, but you do want a little crispness. This helps prevent the bread from becoming soggy once topped. Spread the chilli cheese mixture generously onto each slice. For a heartier meal, use a thick layer. For snack-sized toasts, use a thinner layer. Top with a little more vegan cheese, then add sliced green chillies and a few drops of oil over the chillies.
Preheat the oven to 450° F (232° C). Once preheated, switch to low broil. Depending on your oven, this may be around 500° to 525° F (260° to 275° C). Place the prepared toasts directly on a clean baking sheet. Do not use parchment paper, as it may burn under the broiler.
Broil for about 2 minutes, then check. If the cheese has not fully melted and started browning, continue broiling for another 1 to 2 minutes. Once the cheese is melted, golden, and the edges of the toast are lightly browned, remove from the oven.
Airfry: air fry at 370deg F(190 c) for 6-8 minutes
Meanwhile, make the crispy chilli lime tempeh.
Heat a small skillet over medium heat and add the oil. Once the oil is hot, reduce the heat to medium-low and add the garlic. Cook, stirring frequently, until the garlic is crispy and golden, about 2 minutes. Remove the garlic and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the tempeh and increase the heat to medium. Cook until golden brown, stirring every minute or so. This can take 4 to 6 minutes, depending on your skillet and stove.
Add the garlic back to the skillet, and mix well. Turn off the heat, and immediately add the salt, lime zest, and Kashmiri chilli powder. Toss to coat. Transfer the tempeh mixture to a bowl so it doesn't continue cooking and lose the fresh lime zest flavor, and try not to snack on all of it before serving.
Top the chilli cheese toasts with the crispy tempeh and garlic mixture, and serve immediately.

17900423592378945.ingredients:
1 cup long grain white rice*, rinsed well
2 cups chicken broth, low sodium preferred, extra to moisten at the end
2-3 garlic cloves, minced
3 – 4 Tbsp melted butter
1½ lb chicken breast, cut in bite-sized pieces
1 ½ – 2 tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp onion powder
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp paprika
½ tsp sea salt
½ tsp pepper
½ cup freshly grated parmesan
¼ cup heavy cream, technically optional, but adds richness and creaminess
2 cups chopped baby spinach, measured before chopping
17900423592378945.method:
Preheat oven to 375°F.
Add rice, broth, butter and minced garlic to a 9×13 inch baking pan and stir to combine. I use the 2 cups, and then later after baking, if it feels a bit too dry, add in the extra ¼ cup or a bit more if desired.
Add the cubed chicken over top and sprinkle seasonings Gently stir to combine. (*You can also add the spinach at this time if preferred. After original testing, I did it before baking and found liked it a bit better this way because the spinach bakes with all the flavors and seasoning.)
Cover the pan with foil and seal very tight. Bake for 50-60 minutes or until the chicken has reached 165°F and the rice is tender. Check in at the 45 minute mark and adjust as needed.
Once cooked, stir in the parmesan and cream if using and allow to melt. Add the spinach and stir it in, let it sit for several minutes to wilt.
Allow the dish to rest for several minutes before serving. Serve with fresh chopped herbs (thyme, sage, or parsley are faves) and more parmesan.

17967055626129552.ingredients:
1 large egg, at room temperature
1 cup full-fat cottage cheese, small curd
2 tablespoons cream cheese, softened
1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar
1 cup all-purpose flour
2 teaspoons baking powder
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese, plus more for topping
1 jalapeño, finely chopped, plus slices for topping
17967055626129552.method:
1. Preheat the oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a medium bowl, whisk the egg lightly. Add the cottage cheese, cream cheese, and apple cider vinegar and whisk until mostly smooth. Some small curds are fine.
3. Stir the shredded cheddar and chopped jalapeño into the wet mixture.
4. In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt.
5. Add the flour mixture to the cottage cheese mixture and fold gently with a spatula just until combined. Do not overmix.
6. Using a large cookie scoop or two spoons, portion the dough into 8 equal mounds and drop onto the prepared baking sheet, spacing them evenly. Lightly press the tops to flatten slightly.
7. Top each biscuit with a pinch of shredded cheddar and a slice of jalapeño.
8. Bake for 18 to 24 minutes, until the biscuits are puffed, golden, and set through the centre.
9. Let cool completely before storing. Keep in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months. Reheat in a 350°F oven until warmed through.

17973751889934411.ingredients:
12 tbsp unsalted butter (170g)
3/4 cup + 1 tbsp light brown sugar, packed (163g)
125g extra ripe banana (about one and a quarter medium-sized banana, and around 1/2 cup once mashed)
1 tsp vanilla bean paste
1/2 tsp instant coffee dissolved in 1/2 teaspoon water – optional
3/4 tsp salt
1/2 tsp baking soda
1 1/2 cup + 2 tbsp all purpose flour (210g)
4 oz dark chocolate, chopped (113g)
4 oz milk chocolate, chopped (113g)
17973751889934411.method:
1. Line 2 light colored 18″x13″ baking sheets with parchment paper (you can also use one sheet and bake the cookies in batches if you don't have two)
2. Add the butter to a light-colored saucepan. Place on the stove on medium-low heat, and cook until the butter has melted. Continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until the butter has turned brown. First it will melt and become very frothy, but then it will stop sizzling and you will see brown specks and a nice, toasty smell. Be careful not to overcook, as brown butter can burn very quickly
3. Add the brown butter to a mixing bowl (scrape in all the brown specks on the bottom of the pan, too!). Add the brown sugar, mashed banana, vanilla bean paste and instant coffee dissolved in water. Whisk until the ingredients are combined and smooth (almost like a caramel)
4. Mix in the salt and baking soda until just combined
5. Sift in the flour and add the chopped chocolate. Use a rubber spatula to gently fold the ingredients together until you see no more streaks of flour, and the chocolate is evenly dispersed. Avoid over-mixing the dough
6. Use a 2 tbsp cookie scoop to scoop the cookie dough onto the prepared baking sheets, keeping at least 2-3″ between the scoops. Level off the cookie scoops so the cookie balls aren't too big, and you should have 16 cookies divided between the two sheets
7. Optionally, you can press in some more chocolate chunks on top of the cookies, and sprinkle some flaky sea salt. I also like adding a thin slice of banana on top of each cookie
8. Rest the scooped cookies for 20-30 minutes at room temperature (or the fridge if you want thicker cookies)
9. Pre-heat your oven to 370F (conventional / no fan) while the cookies are resting
10. Bake the cookies in the pre-heated oven for ~8-10 minutes, until the edges are set but the centers are still slightly soft to touch
11. Remove the cookies from the oven, and use a 4″ cake ring to "scoot" the cookies into perfect circles while they're still hot. Let the cookies rest on the baking sheets until they're set
12. Serve and enjoy!

17982691347065116.ingredients:
1 tbsp (15 g) brown butter (or melted salted butter)
1 tbsp (13 g) brown sugar
1/2 tbsp (7 g) white sugar
3/4 tbsp (10 g) milk
1/2 tsp vanilla essence
3 tbsp (24 g) all purpose flour
1/2 tsp (1.5 g) cornstarch, optional
1/16 tsp (0.25 g) baking soda
Mix Ins + Toppings
1 tbsp (15 g) dark chocolate chips
1 tbsp (15 g) dark chocolate callets
sprinkle of flaky sea salt (to top)
17982691347065116.method:
For the cookie dough, whisk together brown sugar, white sugar, milk, vanilla essence and brown or melted salted butter in a bowl until well combined.
Sift in all purpose flour, cornstarch and baking soda and mix gently until just combined and then fold in the chocolate chips and callets.
Scoop the dough onto parchment paper and top with more chocolate chips.
Bake: Oven: 180C for 8-10 mins ; OTG: 180C for 10-13 mins ; Airfryer: 170C for 7-9 mins until the cookie is golden and mostly set.
Sprinkle with flaky salt while warm and let cool slightly to set before enjoying!

18017470097731290.ingredients:
TOFU
1 block silken or soft tofu drained (around 400g block)
SAUCE
1 1/2 tbsp neutral oil
1 scallion thinly sliced, some green parts saved for garnish
1 tbsp grated ginger
1/8 tsp Chinese 5 spice powder
2 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp Chinese black vinegar
1 tbsp brown sugar
1/2 tbsp chili oil adjust to desired heat
1 tbsp vegetarian oyster sauce
TO FINISH
Scallions or cilantro for garnish
Sesame seeds
Chili oil
TO SERVE
Steamed rice
18017470097731290.method:
PREPARE THE TOFU
Carefully drain the tofu and place it on a heat-safe plate or shallow bowl that fits inside your steamer. Slice the top of the tofu into a checkered grid pattern, but do not cut all the way through the base so the tofu stays together.
STEAM THE TOFU
Steam the tofu over medium high heat for 5-6 minutes or until warmed through. Carefully drain any excess liquid released by the tofu after steaming.
MAKE THE SAUCE
Heat the neutral oil in a small pan over medium heat. Add the scallion and grated ginger, then cook for 1-2 minutes or until aromatic. Pour the hot scallion ginger oil into a bowl.
In the bowl, mix the soy sauce, Chinese black vinegar, brown sugar, chili oil, vegetarian oyster sauce, and Chinese 5 spice powder. Taste and adjust to your liking.
FINISH AND SERVE
Pour the sauce over the steamed tofu. Garnish with scallions or cilantro, sesame seeds, and extra chili oil, if desired.
Serve with steamed rice to soak up all the sauce and flavor. Enjoy while hot!

18060549404788026.ingredients:
Mushroom filling
1 pack (200 g) mushrooms
1/4 cup walnuts
5 garlic cloves
2 red onion, sliced
salt and pepper, to taste
1-2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tsp balsamic vinegar
Garlic butter
3 tbsp salted butter, melted
3 cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp chopped coriander
1 tsp chilli flakes
1/2 tsp dried or fresh thyme
Green sauce
1/4 cup curd or yogurt
2 tbsp cream cheese
handful of fresh coriander
handful of fresh mint
juice of 1/2 lemon
5 cloves garlic
salt, to taste
1/4 cup ice
More
3 tortilla
18060549404788026.method:
For the mushroom filling: In a baking tray or baking tin, add mushrooms, walnuts, sliced onions and garlic. Season with salt and pepper and drizzle with olive oil and give everything a good mix to make sure everything is well coated.
Airfry at 180°C for 20–25 minutes, or bake at 190°C for 25–30 minutes, mixing halfway through till the mushrooms and onions are deeply browned and caramelised. Let the mixture cool completely.
Add the roasted mixture to a blender and pulse a few times to get a coarse mixture. Mix in the soy sauce and balsamic vinegar and your rich, umami packed filling is ready.
For the garlic butter: Simply mix melted butter with minced garlic, chopped coriander, chilli flakes and thyme.
Take a tortilla and spread the mushroom filling generously all over it. Roll it tightly from bottom to top to form a log. Using a sharp knife, divide the log into smaller pieces. Thread each piece onto a skewer to make the roll ups, I arranged five roll ups on each skewer but you can add as many as you like.
Brush the garlic butter generously all over the roll ups and airfry at 180°C for 10–15 minutes till the tortilla is crispy and the tops are golden brown. Brush with some more garlic butter immediately after taking them out of the air fryer.
For the green sauce: To serve, I wanted a fresh, tangy and savoury sauce to cut through the rich mushroom filling so I made this simple herby cream cheese sauce. Add fresh coriander, fresh mint, yogurt, cream cheese, lemon juice, garlic, salt and ice to a blender and blend till completely smooth.
Drizzle the green sauce all over the tortilla roll ups and enjoyy!

18091468616194107.ingredients:
2 15-oz cans black beans, drained and rinsed, 425 g cans
1 green bell pepper, seeds and stem removed
½ medium white onion, cut into chunks
2 cloves garlic
1 tsp each smoked paprika, cumin, chili powder
¼ tsp each salt and pepper
1 cup panko breadcrumbs, 60 g
1 large egg
18091468616194107.method:
Dry Beans: Drain and rinse 2 15-oz cans black beans well, then spread them onto a few layers of paper towels to let them dry.
Flavor Base: Add 1 green bell pepper, ½ medium white onion, and 2 cloves garlic to a food processor. Pulse until finely chopped. Transfer mixture to a mesh sieve and use a spatula or spoon to press out as much moisture as possible.
Make Dough: Transfer dried beans, pepper mixture, 1 tsp each smoked paprika, cumin, chili powder, and ¼ tsp each salt and pepper back to the food processor. Pulse just until combined – there should still be some bigger pieces of beans.
Stir: Transfer to a large bowl and stir in 1 cup panko breadcrumbs and 1 large egg. At this point, you can move forward or refrigerate the dough for up to 24 hours. The burgers are easier to shape if the dough has been refrigerated for at least 30 minutes.
Shape: Scoop ½ cup sized portions of the burger dough, then use your hands to form them into patties.
To cook on the stove: Place patties on a greased saute pan over medium-high heat. Cook each side for 5 to 7 minutes, or until golden brown and firm.
To cook on the grill: Set patties on a greased piece of aluminum foil over medium/high heat. Cook each side for about 7 minutes, or until golden brown and firm.
To cook in the oven: Arrange patties on a greased baking sheet and bake at 400°F (204°C) for 15 to 20 minutes, flipping once during cooking.
Serve on a burger bun with your favorite burger toppings, like cheese, lettuce, tomato, and red onion!

18121652656667372.ingredients:
3.2 oz Nasoya Organic Super Firm Tofu 2 servings, 182 grams
1 cup Kodiak Cakes Power Cakes Flapjack and Waffle Mix
28 gram Truvani Unflavored Plant based protein powder can be sub with Kodiak mix
30 gram Anthony's Vital Wheat Gluten (1/4 cup) can be sub with Kodiak Mix or Sooji
1½ cup Minced Cabbage easy to mince in food processor
1 inch Ginger
3 Thai Green Chili
2 large Galic Cloves
1¼ tsp Salt
¼ tsp Turmeric Powder
2 tsp Cumin Coriander Powder
¼ tsp Garam Masala
½ tsp Red Chili Powder
⅓ cup Fat Free Plain Greek Yogurt, 85 grams
⅓ cup Freshly Chopped Cilantro
For Tempering
2 tbsp Avocado Oil choice of oil with high smoking point
1 tsp Mustard Seeds
1 tbsp White Sesame Seeds
⅛ tsp Asafetida, Hing
4 Curry Leaves
18121652656667372.method:
Press tofu and pat dry using paper towel to remove as much moisture as possible. Shred 2 servings from the whole block. Place it in a big mixing bowl.
Process cabbage in a food processor, Place it in a big mixing bowl along with shredded tofu.
Process ginger, garlic, thai green chili using food processor, Place it in a big mixing bowl along with cabbage.
In the same mixing bowl, place Kodiak mix, vital wheat gluten, Truvani unflavored protein powder along with salt, turmeric powder, red chili powder, garam masala, cumin coriander powder and greek yogurt.
Mix everything together to form a dough. Divide dough into 4-6 big chunks. The dough should be soft enough to make a cylinder like shapes using your hands. Make 4-5 dough cylinders.
You should not need water to form the dough, but if you have hard time forming the shape and keeping it together feel free to add little water at a time until you get the good consistency of the dough. Take some oil between your palms if it is super sticky.
If using steamer for steaming, start boiling water at the bottom of the steamer. Grease the steamer plate and place dough cylinders in it.
If using Instant Pot, Add 2-4 cups of water in the pot of the Instant Pot. Place Steamer Rack Stand at the bottom of the pot and put IP on saute mode. Let the water come to boil. Place cylinder shaped dough in a greased stainless steel plates/thali, thali with a little less diameter than IP pot diameter.
Place the thali/plate inside the steamer (if using steamer) OR on top of the steamer rack stand inside the Instant Pot.
If using steamer, close the steamer lid tight, and steam on high heat for 20 minutes. If using IP, close the lid, seal the valve, secure/seal the valve and put IP on steam mode for 20 minutes. Once timer goes off, let the pressure release for 15-20 minutes. Release rest of the pressure manually
Once muthiya is steamed, take the thhali/plate out of the steamer/IP, let it cool down for 10-15 minutes.
Once cooled down to handle, cut them in decent size pieces.
Tempering of Muthiya
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a flat wide pan. (non stick would work the best)
Once hot, add mustard seeds and sesame seeds. Once done splattering, add a pinch of asafetida and curry leaves. Then Immediately add cut muthiya and give it a gentle toss.
Keep cooking on medium heat until you reach desired crispiness. Keep tossing them at every few minutes to make sure it gets evenly crispy.
Garnish it with fresh cilantro. Serve it hot with sprinkle of thin sev and side of masala chai!!

18140200696513587.ingredients:
8 cups (1.9L) water
3/4 cup (155g) small tapioca pearls
1 cup (235ml) whole or 2% milk
3/4 cup (175ml) full-fat canned coconut milk
3 1/2 tablespoons honey, divided (can sub with sugar or maple syrup)
3 medium-sized mangoes (about 775 to 800 grams), see note 1
1 cup sliced strawberries, see headnote
18140200696513587.method:
Cook Pearls
Add the water to a pot or large saucepan and bring it to boil over high heat. DO NOT add the tapioca pearls when the water is still cold (see note 2). Reduce the heat slightly to medium-high and add the tapioca pearls. Give the pearls a quick stir. Cook the pearls for 15 minutes and turn off the heat. The pearls will be translucent around the exterior with solid white specks in the center. Cover the pot with a lid and let the pearls sit for another 10 to 15 minutes, until the pearls look completely translucent. It's okay if a few pearls here and there still have tiny white specks in the center.
Drain the pearls and rinse them under cold water. Transfer them to a large bowl with cold tap water. Submerging the pearls completely in cold water helps them to cool faster and makes them less sticky. Let that sit while you prepare the other components of the tapioca pudding.
Prepare Mango Puree
Add the milk and coconut milk to a saucepan and bring to a boil. Do not cover the saucepan with a lid because it's very easy for the milk to boil over. Turn off the heat and add 2 tablespoons of honey. (See note 3 for the reasoning behind boiling the milk.) Let the milk cool for 5 to 10 minutes.
Slice a mango along the oblong pit in the center. Using the tip of your knife, make crosswise cuts inside the 2 mango slices to make cubes. Use your fingers to bend the mango slices so that the mango cubes protrude. Then, run the knife below the cubes to slice them off.
Take the piece of mango containing the central pit and use a paring knife to peel off the skin. Then, use the knife to cut off as much flesh from the pit as possible. I generally use the flesh around the pit for the mango puree.
Measure 1 1/4 cups (225 grams) of mango flesh and transfer it to the bowl of a high-speed blender. Add the warmed milk to the blender. Blend everything until smooth. Pour the mango puree into a large bowl.
Finish Tapioca Pudding
Drain the tapioca pearls and drizzle 1 1/2 tablespoons of honey over the pearls. Toss to coat the pearls with the honey. Add the tapioca pearls to the bowl with the mango puree and stir.
