Next, add the remaining mango cubes/chunks and sliced strawberries to the bowl. Stir to combine. Taste the mango tapioca pudding and add more honey, if necessary.
Chill the mango tapioca pudding for at least 2 hours before serving.

18156175558494262.ingredients:
Garlic, Ginger, Jalapeno mixture
6–8 cloves of garlic
2 inch ginger
½ jalapeno with seeds
Corn and Shishito Pepper Kofta
2 teaspoons vegetable oil
6–7 large shishito peppers
400 grams potatoes
1 corn shucked, and corn kernels removed from the cob
1 teaspoon cumin seeds
½ cup corn flour (makai ka atta)
1 teaspoon table salt
1 tablespoon garlic-ginger-jalapeno mixture
1 teaspoon garam masala
Vegetable Oil or avocado oil to fry
Corn Curry
3 tablespoons vegetable oil
1 bay leaf
1 ½ teaspoon cumin seeds
¼ stick cinnamon
2–3 cardamom pods
1 tablespoon garlic-ginger-jalapeno mixture
1 cup red onion, finely chopped
½ cup cashew nuts
2 corn, shucked and boiled
1 cup heavy cream or coconut cream
1 cup water, divided
1 ½ teaspoons table salt
1 teaspoon garam masala
1 teaspoon ground cumin
1 teaspoon ground coriander
2 teaspoons granulated sugar
¾ teaspoon turmeric
Garnish
Heavy cream
Blistered shishito peppers
18156175558494262.method:
Garlic, Ginger, Jalapeno mixture
1. In a mini food processor, add the garlic, ginger and jalapeno, and grind the mixture until it is finely chopped. Remove into a bowl and set aside.
Corn and Shishito Pepper Kofta
1. In a medium saucepan, on medium heat, add the oil. After a minute, add the shishito peppers. You will start to hear the sizzling of the peppers. Bring the peppers to a char for 2 minutes, and turn them onto the other side, and char for another 2 minutes. Repeat the process until you see brown blisters around the shishito peppers, roughly about 2 more minutes.
2. Set the peppers aside.
3. Peel the potatoes, cut them into halves and boil the potatoes in water for about 15 minutes until they are fork tender. Drain immediately and set aside to cool completely.
4. Grate the corn on a grater in a large mixing plate/bowl to remove all the corn kernels and the juice as well.
5. Grate the boiled potatoes as well.
6. Add the cumin seeds, corn flour, salt, ginger-garlic-jalapeno-mixture, and garam masala.
7. Finely chop 3 blistered shishito peppers and add it to the mixture. Using gloves, mix all the ingredients well to form a cohesive dough.
8. Using a 2 tablespoon scooper, divide the dough into 17~18 balls.
9. Take each ball between the palms of your hands and move your one hand in a clockwise direction and the other hand in an anti-clockwise direction to form a round ball. Set it aside.
10. Repeat for the remaining balls.
11. In a medium saucepan, on medium high heat, add vegetable oil about 3 inches in height from the bottom of the saucepan. Place a plate lined with a paper towel to drain off the excess oil.
12. After 5-7 minutes, test by adding a tiny piece of the dough. If the dough rises up immediately with tiny balls around it, the oil is ready for frying.
13. Fry about 2 to 3 balls at a time for a minute until the bottom size is light brown. Turn the ball around to brown the other side, for another minute. The ball should look medium brown in color. Remove using a spider strainer onto the plate.
14. Repeat the process for all the koftas. Set aside.
Corn Curry
1. In a large skillet, on medium heat, add the vegetable oil.
2. After a minute, add the bay leaf, cumin seeds, cinnamon, cardamom pods, and saute for a minute.
3. Next add the ginger-garlic-jalapeno mixture, along with the red onions and saute for 3 to 5 minutes until the onions turn translucent and light brown in color.
4. Next remove the corn off the cob, and add it to the onion mixture.
5. Add the cashew nuts and saute the mixture for a minute.
6. Add the heavy cream and ½ cup of water and stir to combine.
7. Add all the spices such as salt, garam masala, ground cumin, ground coriander, sugar, and turmeric. Stir to combine and cook the mixture for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
8. Remove the bay leaf, add the mixture into a high speed blender to get a smooth sauce.
9. Add the sauce back into the pan along with additional ½ cup water, cover with a lid and cook the mixture on medium-low heat for 3 to 5 minutes. Uncover the lid.
10. Plate the curry onto a serving plate. Add the koftas into the curry in a circular pattern. Drizzle with the heavy cream.
11. Decorate with 4 blistered shishito peppers on top of the koftas.
12. Serve with naan immediately.

18120626122718031.ingredients:
Tofu Marinade
16 oz Organic Super Firm Tofu I user Nasoya
½ cup Plain Greek Yogurt I use Fage Fat Free Plain Greek Yogurt
1 tbsp Grated Ginger
2 tbsp Minced Garlic
1 tbsp Tandoori Masala I use Shan foods tandoori masala
1 tsp Garam Masala
1½ tsp Chaat Masala
1 tsp Kashmiri Red Chili Powder ½ tsp of using regular spicy red chili powder
1½ tsp Roasted Cumin Powder
½ tsp Turmeric Powder
¼ tsp Black Pepper Powder
½ tsp Salt
½ tsp Kasuri Methi
1 tbsp Lemon Juice
2 tbsp Mustard Oil any oil of your choice will work
2 tsp Honey
1 medium Red Onion, sliced if using extra large onion, user ¾ of it
Cilantro Mint Yogurt Sauce
½ cup Fresh Cilantro washed/drained/roots removed
¼ cup Fresh Mint Leaves
½ tsp Roasted Cumin Powder
¼ tsp Black Pepper Powder
½ tsp Salt
½ Jalapeno 1 whole for more heat
1 small Garlic
1 tbsp Lemon Juice
½ cup Fage Fat Free Greek Yogurt ⅔ cup of only using greek yogurt, not sour cream
¼ cup Sour Cream skip if using ⅔ cup greek yogurt
If making kathi rolls
5 Whole Wheat Lavash Bread, or choice of paratha
1 English Cucumber, sliced
½ Red Onion, very thinly sliced
½ Green Pepper, very thinly sliced
1 cup Shredded Lettuce
1 tsp Chaat Masala
18120626122718031.method:
Marinade the Tofu
Mix everything BUT tofu and onion listed under "Tofu Marinade" in a big wide bowl. Keep it aside.
Break tofu into small uneven pieces so that the edges are rough. Bring a pot of water to boil with 1 tsp of salt. Add in tofu pieces and boil them for 5-7 minutes. Then drain it.
Once tofu is boiled and drained, add it into marinade bowl. Add in sliced red onions too. Toss all pieces around or gently mix with rubber spatula so that each pieces are well coated with marinade, without breaking them or making them mushy. Once ready, cover it and let it marinate for anywhere from 30 minutes to over night.
Once ready to bake, pre heat oven on 375℉. Lay out marinated tofu and onions on a greased baking tray, all in single layer. Bake it for 20 minutes, tossing them half way through. Serve it with cilantro mint sauce.
Cilantro Mint Yogurt Sauce
First place everything but yogurt and sour cream in a food processor. Pulse it all until you have grainy texture.
Then add in greek yogurt and do just few pulses so that the grainy texture is mixed into yogurt. Blending too much with yogurt will make the sauce very liquidy. You want to leave the sauce thick, grainy, pasty.
Make Kathi Roll
Warm up lavash bread or choice of paratha.
Spread some cilantro mint sauce on one side of the lavash/paratha.
Top it with sliced cucumber, onion, pepper, lettuce and sprinkle of chaat masala.
Top it with baked tandoori tofu with drizzle of cilantro mint sauce. Roll it and enjoy with or without making it crispy on the skillet.

18336373453229972.method:
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl mix the tahini, honey, baking soda and salt until combined.
Add in the all purpose flour and ground walnuts. Stir using a spoon or a spatula until the dough comes together.
Divide the dough into 12 pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Roll the cookie balls in sesame seeds until they are well coated on all sides. Transfer the cookie balls to the baking sheet and leave about 2 inches between them.
Using a glass with a round bottom, gently press on the cookies to flatten them so they are about 1/4 inch thick. Keep in mind that the cookies won't spread much while baking.
Bake the cookies for 12 minutes, they will be brown around the edges ever so slightly.
Let the tahini cookies cool for 10 minutes before serving.

17915096409296317.ingredients:
4 cup Whole Wheat Flour Sujata whole wheat 100% chakki atta
2 scoops Truvani Plant Based Unflavored Protein Powder 2 servings, can be sub with 1/4 cup chickpea flour
½ cup Vital Wheat Gluten can be sub with 1/2 cup whole wheat flour
½ cup Chickpea Flour, Besan
6 large Garlic Cloves
3 inch Ginger
5 Thai Green Chili less for less spicy
14-16 oz Extra Firm Tofu I prefer soy free big mountain tofu, but regular tofu works exactly same way
1 cup Fat Free Greek Yogurt
3 tbsp White Sesame Seeds, till
1 tbsp Carom Seeds, ajwain
5 tsp Salt
2 tsp Garam Masala
2 tsp Kashmiri Red Chili Powder
2 tsp Turmeric Powder
2 tbsp Cumin Coriander Powder, dhana jiru powder
2 tbsp Jaggery, gud
½ cup Avocado Oil more for cooking the thepla
4 cup Fresh Fenugreek Leaves OR baby spinach washed, dried, finely chopped
½ cup Water only if needed to bind the dough
¼ cup Avocado Oil this is to cook the thepla
½ cup Rice Flour/Whole Wheat Flour/All Purpose Flour this is to roll the thepla
17915096409296317.method:
Boiled cubed tofu in salted water for 5-7 minutes, once done drain the water out and let it sit until cool enough to handle. This step helps remove access water from tofu as well as slighly removes the tofu smell.
Blend boiled.drained tofu with fat free greek yogurt and jaggery. Once done keep it aside. This creamy mixture is needed to form the dough and to add protein.
Chopp/grind ginger, garlic, thai green chili together and keep it aside.
In a mixing bowl, add wheat flour, chickpea flout, unflavored protein powder, vital wheat gluten and all the dry spices listed above.
Mix in chopped fenugreek leaves. Be sure to remove big stems, wash thoroughly, dry completely before chopping it.
Mix in ½ cup of oil then start using tofu/yogurt/jaggery creamy mixture to start forming the dough. If the dough does not seem to come together, keep adding little more water at a time to make the dough. I ended up using ½ cup of water ot get the right consistency.
The dough consistency should be like playdoh (the one kids play with!). In other words, the dough consistency should be a little firmer than pizza dough. You should be able to roll the thepla easily with just a small amount of dry flour.
Cover the dough for 10 minutes. After 10 minutes, if the dough feels sticky, kneed the dough again with 2 tbsp of oil to smooth it out. Make 50 equal sized balls out of the dough. The bigger the dough ball, the thicker your thepla will be.
Start warming up your flat pan/tawa.
Massage one dough ball between your palms to smooth it out and press it a little to flatten it. Dust it with dry rice flour (any dry flour like rice flour, whole wheat flour, all purpose flour works just fine).
Start rolling thepla. Roll it as big/small or thin/thick you like with the help of dry flour. The less dry flour you use the better it is! Thicker thepla will stay softer for longer.
Place your rolled out thepla on the hot tawa/flat pan. Cook it on one side on low heat for 15-20 second or until you see some white and light brown spots on the side that is facing the hot tawa.
Flip the thepla so now the other side is facing the tawa. Cook it on low heat for 20-30 second and then turn the heat to medium. Cook more on medium heat for another 5-10 ish seconds or until you see the side that is facing the tawa is somewhat cooked with some brown spots on it.
Once the second side is somewhat cooked, add ¼ to ½ tsp of oil on the thepla (on the side that is facing up) and flip it.
Put some pressure on thepla and spin it with the help of Wooden Roti Chapati Presser or spatula.
Flip it after 10-15 seconds and cook the other side the same way by putting some presser on thepla and spinning with the use of tawa presser or spatula. It is cooked now, take it off the tawa!
Repeat the same process of rolling and cooking for rest of the dough balls.
Serve thepla with any pickles, tea, coffee, milk, yogurt, chutney or even peanut butter! I prefer topping each thepla with fried egg, sliced avocado and dry achar masala (sambhario masalo)
These theplas freeze well. Pack it up in a double ziplock bags and freeze them. It stays good for 3-4 months in the freezer. Take it out of freezer and warm it up in a toaster oven and eat!

17854181202568239.ingredients:
TOFU
extra firm tofu (I love using pre-pressed tofu like this one!)
BULGOGI SAUCE
grated asian pear or Fuji apple
soy sauce
gochujang
sesame oil
sesame seeds
dark soy sauce
sugar
finely grated ginger
garlic, minced
TO SERVE
Chopped green onions
Sesame seeds
Steamed rice, I used short grain or Japanese sushi rice
17854181202568239.method:
FOR THE SHREDDED TOFU
Remove the tofu from the water and drain from any excess water. Using a cheese grater, carefully grate the tofu into shreds.
Meanwhile, preheat your air-fryer or oven to 350F/180C.
On a lined baking tray or air fryer basket (I used parchment paper), place the shredded tofu and try to spread it out as thin as possible.
For air-frying, air-fry for 12-15 minutes or until lightly golden brown - do not overcook since it can easily harden and become too dry.
You can flip the tofu halfway through cooking. It’s also okay not to get even browning and even have the tofu still white, since this can add to the different textures of the overall tofu dish.
If baking, you may need to bake the tofu for 25-30 minutes.
SAUCE AND MARINATING
While the tofu is cooking, prepare the sauce by mixing everything together. Feel free to adjust to your taste.
Want it really saucy? You can double the sauce!
Once the tofu is lightly golden brown and crisp on the edges, transfer it to the sauce. Mix well to coat.
COOKING THE SHREDDED TOFU BULGOGI
In a medium wok or pan, add in the shredded tofu and sauce. Cook down over medium heat for 7-8 minutes or until the sauce has reduced and absorbed by the tofu. The sauce will also slightly thicken from the sugars in the sauce.
Taste the tofu and feel free to season more, if desired.
Turn off the heat.
SERVE AND ENJOY!
Serve this hot with rice and garnish with some chopped green onions & sesame seeds, if desired. Enjoy!

18013342040705646.ingredients:
1 cup (210 g) cottage cheese
1 cup + 2 tbs (125 g) flour
3 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
1 tbs olive oil
2 oz (56.7 g) baby spinach, micro chopped
1/2 cup (56 g) shredded mozzarella cheese
Egg Wash: 1 egg, lightly beaten
18013342040705646.method:
Preheat oven to 375℉. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a mini food processor, add in your cottage cheese and pulse until smooth.
To a large bowl, add the cottage cheese, flour, baking powder, salt, olive oil, spinach, mozzarella and mix together until combined. Use your hands to form the dough into a thick log (6 inches long). Divide the dough into 6 equal pieces. Shape the pieces into flatter circles and poke a hole in the middle with your finger. Place onto pan and brush them with egg wash. Bake for 22-25 minutes or until golden brown on top. Transfer to wire rack to let cool completely.

17953627586789711.ingredients:
8 chicken thighs, bone-in, skin-on
2 tablespoons olive oil
¼ cup plain yogurt, I used Balkan-Style but any works
½ tablespoon salt, to taste
¼ tablespoon pepper, to taste
1 ½ tablespoons dried oregano
2 lemons, juiced
6 cloves garlic, unpeeled
17953627586789711.method:
Add the chicken to a baking dish with the olive oil and yogurt. Season with salt, pepper, and oregano. Add the juice of 2 lemons and add the squeezed lemon pieces to the dish as well. Add the garlic. With clean hands, massage the mixture well to evenly distribute the spices. Let the chicken marinate in the fridge for at least 1 hour or up to overnight. (If you don't let it marinate for 1 hour it will still be delicious but not as tender.)
Preheat the oven to 400F (200C)
Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes to 1 hour depending on the size of the thighs. The chicken is done when a meat thermometer inserted in the thickest part of a piece of chicken registers 165F (74C).
If you want to crisp up the skin you can put it under the broiler for the last few minutes of cooking, but keep a close eye on it as it can burn quickly.
Enjoy the chicken on salad, mashed potatoes, in wraps, with rice, or with any side you like.

17867405436130105.ingredients:
3 tablespoon unsalted butter
8 oz kataifi
3 tbsp tahini
¼ teaspoon salt
16 oz milk chocolate bars roughly chopped
10½ oz pistachio cream
any color candy melts for decoration, melted optional
17867405436130105.method:
Remove kataifi from freezer to defrost for 1-2 hours. This will make chopping it easier, or shred in a food processor. Melt butter in large pan on medium heat and add kataifi, toasting it for 8-10 mins or until golden brown. Transfer to large mixing bowl and allow to cool completely.
Add pistachio cream, tahini, and salt to cooled kataifi. Mix until well combined and set saide.
Optional: melt any decorating candy melts in small bowls using the microwave. Drizzle desired decorations in chocolate mold, and chill in fridge for 10 mins.
Melt the milk chocolate in a large bowl also using the microwave, or alternatively over a double boiler. If you wish to temper your chocolate, reserve a small handful of chocolate and melt the rest until it reaches 113℉ (45℃). Remove bowl from the heat and stir in the reserved pieces until it melts in. Cool chocolate until it reaches 84-86℉ (28-30℉).
Pour milk chocolate into mold. Tilt mold sideways or upside-down to allow excess chocolate to drip off back into chocolate bowl. We're trying to layer a thin even coating. You can also use an offset spatula to scrape off all extra chocolate. We will be re-melting the chocolate bowl, so avoid wasting any! Once you finish the first layer, tap mold on the counter a few times to allow chocolate to settle and to get rid of any air bubbles. Transfer back to fridge for another 10 mins to set.
Spoon filling into chocolate mold and spread evenly. Be sure to leave room for the final chocolate layer - do not overfill. Chill mold in fridge for 10 more mins.
Re-melt (or temper) milk chocolate. Then, pour over filling and spread evenly to seal in the filling. Tap mold again gently a few times on counter to create a smooth finish. Chill mold in fridge for 1-2 hours minimum before enjoying. Carefully detach finished bars from mold. Keep refrigerated.

18054502999550479.ingredients:
2 tablespoons olive oil
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
2 celery ribs
2 garlic cloves, quartered
salt, to taste
pepper, to taste
5 cups cauliflower, small head
3 potatoes, peeled and quartered
4 cups chicken broth
2 cups water
chives + bacon bits for presentation are optional
18054502999550479.method:
In a big pot on the stove on medium high heat add olive oil and add the onions.
You do not need to dice anything finely because everything will be puréed at the end.
Add the carrots, celery, garlic and sauté for a few minutes.
Season with salt, pepper, and stir again. Add the cauliflower florets and potatoes.
Cover with enough stock and water and put just enough to cover the veggies. Let it come to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low and partially cover it with a lid, let it cook for 25 to 30 minutes or until the veggies are soft.
Once the soup is done, you can use a stick blender to blend until smooth. You can also blend the veggies with the stock in batches in a blender if you don’t own an immersion blender.
If blending with a blender, pour the creamy soup back in to the pot and taste for salt. Serve with bacon bits and chives.

17988875827983225.ingredients:
The base
2 eggs
25 g vegetable oil
25 g milk
30 g cake flour
30 g granulated sugar
5 g lemon juice
5 g vanilla extract
Cheesecake
185 g cream cheese (softened)
20 g unsalted butter (softened)
2 egg yolks
15 g granulated sugar
10 g cornstarch
130 g milk
36 g egg white
20 g granulated sugar
5 g lemon juice
5 g vanilla extract
17988875827983225.method:
Cake Base
1. In a clean bowl, separate the eggs. Keep the egg white bowl cool in the fridge.
2. In another bowl, mix well vegetable oil and milk, add in cake flour, and mix well.
3. Preheat the oven to 302℉(150℃).
4. Take the egg white bowl out of the fridge. Add in lemon juice, granulated sugar and vanilla extract and use a hand mixer to beat until it forms soft peaks. Take a scoop of whipped egg white to fold into the batter until just combined. Pour all the batter back into the whipped egg white and gently fold it in until just combined.
5. Line the baking tray (28*28*2.6cm) with baking mat or parchment paper (don’t grease the pan), pour all the batter into the baking tray, smooth it out and give it a tap or two to break the air pockets. Send into the oven to bake for 18-20 minutes.
6. Take the cake out of the oven right away, and let it cool down on the cooling rack until cool to touch. Release the cake from edges using an icing spatula, turn it upside down and peel off the baking mat. Use a mini cheesecake mold to cut out many small cake bases. Set aside.
Cheesecake
1. In a clean bowl, mix well 2 egg yolks, cornstarch and 15g granulated sugar until well combined. Set aside. Heat the milk until simmer; pour into the egg yolks mixture while whisking quickly to mix them well so you won’t cook the egg yolks. Pour all the mixture back into the saucepan, whisk over medium heat until thickened. Set aside.
2. In another bowl, bring together softened cream cheese and butter, mix until well combined and smooth. Pour in the egg yolks mixture and whisk until well combined. Set aside.
3. In a clean bowl, bring together 36g egg white, 20g granulated sugar, lemon juice, and vanilla extract, use a hand mixer to beat until thickened, can form very very soft peaks. Sift in the batter, and gently fold it in until combined. Pour all the batter into a piping bag.
4. Preheat the oven to 185℃(365℉). Line the baking tray with parchment paper or baking mat. Line each mini cheesecake mold with cake base on the bottom and parchment paper around. Fill each mini cheesecake mold with batter.
5. Grab another baking tray, pour in enough water (enough to last in the oven for 20 minutes), place the first baking tray in it, and send into the oven to bake for 20 minutes, or until the cake surface turns golden brown.
6. Take off the cake molds when they are cool to touch.

17985381385971781.ingredients:
MARINADE
1/4 cup olive oil
1/4 cup plain whole milk yogurt
2 teaspoons paprika
2 teaspoons cumin
2 teaspoons salt
1/2 teaspoon onion powder
1 teaspoon ginger
1/2 teaspoon black pepper
1/2 teaspoon turmeric
2 to 3 teaspoons minced garlic, to taste
2 tablespoons parsley, finely chopped
2 tablespoons cilantro, finely chopped
sumac and parsley or cilantro to garnish, optional
FOR ASSEMBLY
8 to 9 chicken drumsticks
12 ounces baby gold potatoes, cut in half
5 lemon slices
1/4 cup black or green olives
1 preserved lemon, peel only and diced
17985381385971781.method:
Preheat the oven to 400°F.
To make the marinade, combine olive oil, yogurt, paprika, cumin, salt, onion powder, ginger, black pepper, turmeric, minced garlic, parsley, and cilantro in a small bowl.
Add the chicken, potatoes, and lemon to a large baking dish.
Pour the marinade and toss the potatoes and chicken to evenly season it all. Also, make sure to get the marinade under the chicken skin for extra flavor.
Bake in the oven uncovered for 50 to 60 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked through to the center. To make the chicken extra golden and crispy, turn the oven to broil for 3 to 5 extra minutes.
Take out of the oven and add the olives and preserved lemons before serving!

18156959602280018.ingredients:
1–4 tsp red chili flakes (based on spice tolerance & heat of the flakes)
1–2 cloves of garlic, very finely minced or grated
2 tbsp oil
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp black vinegar*, or rice vinegar*
2 tbsp peanut butter
Pinch of salt, to taste
4 oz of Noodles (or Spaghetti)
18156959602280018.method:
Bring a pot of water to boil. Once it comes to a boil, add the noodles and cook according to package instructions. Move onto next steps while the water comes to a boil.
Add the chili flakes and garlic to a bowl. Then, heat up 2 tbsp oil in a saucepan until hot and pour over the bowl letting it sizzle. Let this sit for 2 minutes to infuse all the flavor from the chili and garlic into the oil.
Then, add the soy sauce, vinegar, peanut butter and salt to the bowl. Mix well with a. spoon and let it all chill out will the noodles cook.
Drain the cooked noodles, then pour the sauce over the noodles while they are still hot. If it’s too thick, add in 1-2 tbsp hot water to loosen it up. Toss to combine, garnish with some sesame seeds and/or green onions and enjoy!

17896875020148549.ingredients:
1/4 cup unsalted butter
1/2 teaspoon chili flakes
1 teaspoon Aleppo pepper
1/2 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil
2 5.3 ounce containers of yogurt or Skyr
zest and juice of 1/2 lemon
1 large garlic clove, grated
salt and pepper to taste
4 large eggs
top with chopped parsley
serve with toasted bread of your choice
17896875020148549.method:
Make your chili butter. In a saucepan or skillet melt butter on medium-low with your olive oil.
When it is shimmering and melted, add in chili flakes and Aleppo pepper. It will bubble a bit and that’s okay! It will simmer down when you turn off the heat. Let everything cook together, brown and infuse. Mix well on low and allow it to infuse for a few minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Begin by making your yogurt mixture. In a bowl, mix yogurt or skyr, lemon juice, lemon zest, salt, pepper and fresh garlic. You can also choose to go the extra step to double whip in a food processor or immersion blender. Mix well and set aside.
Next, make your jammy eggs. Bring a pot to a boil, and add in your eggs gently. Set a timer for 6 1/2 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water, or in an ice bath. Peel.
Time to assemble! On a bowl or platter, layer on your yogurt mixture. Then cut your eggs in half and add them on the plate. Finish off with your chili butter and chopped parsley. Serve with toasted bread!

17915190589962041.ingredients:
1 (15 oz) can of chickpeas, rinsed
1/4 cup peanut butter
2 tablespoon red miso paste
2 tablespoons rice vinegar
2 tablespoons maple syrup or mirin
1 teaspoon ginger powder
1 teaspoon garlic powder
1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
1/2 teaspoon cumin
1/2 teaspoon sannam chili (or chili powder)
water, to thin
1/4 cup red onion, diced
1/4 cup chopped cilantro
17915190589962041.method:
Begin by dicing and chopping your red onion and cilantro, respectively. Set aside.
In a bowl, add your rinsed chickpeas. Using a potato masher, or fork, mash the chickpeas to the consistency of your choice. I prefer to have an even blend of mashed to partially broken chickpeas.
In a separate bowl, add the peanut butter, miso, rice vinegar, maple syrup, and spices. Mix until emulsified/combined. Taste and adjust seasonings per your preference. You may need to add water to thin if the peanut butter thickened while mixing.
Add the peanut butter-miso mixture to the mashed chickpeas. Stir to combine.
Add the red onion and cilantro. Stir until combined.
Chill for 1 hour or eat at room temperature. Some favorite ways I like to eat this salad below:
In a sandwich with toasted sourdough, leafy lettuce, tomatoes, and sriracha
In a cabbage wrap (using a whole leaf of red/green cabbage, add the salad and some scallions and sesame seeds. Roll and devour
On top of a kale salad.
Dive in!

17916207805613380.ingredients:
Thandai Masala
10 – 12 Almonds, blanched and peeled
10 – 12 Cashews
10 – 12 Raisins
10 – 12 Cardamom Pods
25 – 30 Black Peppercorns
1 Teaspoon Poppy Seeds
1 ½ Teaspoons Fennel Seeds
2 Teaspoons Melon Seeds
Thandai Milk
3 Cups Whole Milk, use full fat for best results
2 Pinches Saffron
⅓ Cup Sugar
1 Tablespoon Rose Water
17916207805613380.method:
Thandai Masala
Grind all the masala ingredients to a coarse powder and set aside.
Thandai Milk
Heat the milk in a heavy bottomed pot and bring to a boil. Once the milk boils, reduce the heat to low and simmer.
Meanwhile, crush the saffron in a bowl. Add a ladle full of hot milk to it, and set aside to use later.
Add all the thandai masala to the pot of simmering milk and mix. Continue to heat on low and add the sugar. Keep stirring and cooking till the sugar dissolves, about 2-3 minutes. Turn off the flame and allow the milk mixture to rest for 30 minutes.
Add the saffron milk mix and the rosewater to the thandai milk pot and combine. Allow to rest for another 30 minutes.
Strain the milk into a bottle or jug using a fine sieve or strainer. Press down the masala in the strainer using the back of a spoon to ensure you extract as much of the masala flavour as possible.
Chill the thandai in the refrigerator for 8 hours or overnight. Always serve chilled!

17883099590111554.ingredients:
Broth Ingredients
½ pineapple cut into large chunks
1 large jicama cut into cubes
2 Granny Smith apples seeds removed
1 Daikon radish roughly chopped
3 carrots roughly chopped
2 large leeks reserve the white part
10 stalks lemongrass reserve the white part
40 g rock sugar
20 cups water
umami seasoning or mushrooms seasoning
salt to taste
Annatto Oil
2 tablespoons Annatto seeds
5 tablespoons oil
Filling Ingredients
14 oz firm tofu pressed, cut into cubes, and pan-fried
¼-½ cup white part of leek
¼-½ cup the white part of the lemongrass
1 cup King oyster mushrooms sliced
2 tablespoons chili flakes more for a spicier broth
umami seasoning
Pairing Ingredients (Herbs and Garnishes)
Thai basil
Mung bean sprouts
Shredded green cabbage
Shredded purple cabbage
Water spinach stems
Green onions
Cilantro
Vietnamese coriander
Banana flower
Jalapenô slices
17883099590111554.method:
Make the Broth
Prepare the lemongrass; remove the outer layer, and finely chop the white part and reserve the stalk for soup. Repeat the same step for leek.
Use the back of the knife or pestle to pound the lemongrass to release its flavor.
Then, place all the broth ingredients in a large pot except the umami seasoning.
Bring the mixture to a rolling boil, then lower the heat to medium and cook for an hour. Feel free to use an Instant pot to reduce the cooking time.
When ready, discard the ingredients and season to taste with mushrooms seasoning or Yondu.
Annatto Oil
Heat a small pot with oil. Add in the annatto seeds and stir until the oil turns red.
Sieve to discard the seeds and reserve the oil for cooking.
How to prepare the filling ingredients
Heat a small pan, add in the annatto oil, then sauté leek and lemongrass until fragrant.
Add in the mushrooms, tofu, chili flakes, and season to taste.
Transfer this mixture into the prepared broth and cook for another 10-15 minutes to release its flavor. You may reserve some filling as toppings as well.
How to serve
To put everything together, cook noodles as directed and place them into a bowl.
Ladle hot soup over the noodles and garnish with suggested pairings. Serve warm.

18128469355875831.ingredients:
olive oil
garlic
chili flakes
pasta
pasta cooking water
parsley
grated cheese
18128469355875831.method:
Pour cold olive oil into a pan, add minced garlic and chili flakes, and cook slowly to infuse the oil and avoid bitterness.
Boil the pasta until half-cooked.
Transfer the half-cooked pasta to the pan and toss it in the garlic-chili oil so it finishes cooking in the pan (about 70% of the cooking) and absorbs the flavors.
Add a splash of starchy pasta water and toss to create a smooth, creamy sauce.
Plate and top with chopped parsley and grated cheese.

18118557853767103.ingredients:
two eggs
white rice
butter
oil
black pepper
Parmesan cheese
chili crisp
green scallions
soy sauce
18118557853767103.method:
Crack two eggs into a bowl.
Put steaming white rice in a bowl, add a pat of butter, and stir it in.
Heat oil in a pan, pour in the eggs, and fry them sunny-side-up until the whites set while keeping the yolks runny; season with black pepper.
Slide the fried eggs onto the buttered rice.
Top with shaved Parmesan cheese, spooned-on chili crisp, chopped green scallions, and a drizzle of soy sauce.

18072985289756962.ingredients:
heavy cream
yogurt or kefir (a spoonful, as starter culture)
ice water
salt
18072985289756962.method:
Pour the heavy cream into a bowl, add a spoonful of yogurt or kefir, and mix gently.
Cover with a kitchen towel and let it ferment at room temperature for 24 to 48 hours until thick and scoopable.
Whip the cultured cream with an electric hand mixer until it separates into solid butter and liquid buttermilk; save the buttermilk.
Transfer the butter to a bowl of ice water and knead by hand to wash out the remaining buttermilk.
Add salt and mix it in.
Shape the butter into a log, wrap it in parchment paper, and store.

18086487293636537.ingredients:
asparagus
butter
salt
fresh lemon juice
cold butter (several tablespoons)
fresh herbs (dill or parsley)
18086487293636537.method:
Blanch the asparagus spears in boiling water.
Finish the asparagus in a pan with butter and salt over medium heat.
Add fresh lemon juice and bring it to a bubble, then remove the asparagus and set it aside.
With the heat off, whisk in the cold butter piece by piece until it emulsifies with the lemon juice into a thick, creamy sauce.
Season with salt and stir in fresh herbs such as dill or parsley.
Spoon the sauce generously over the plated asparagus.

18632498812054543.ingredients:
fresh blueberries
brown sugar
honey
shallots
fresh thyme
red pepper flakes
burrata cheese
pistachios
basil leaves
lemon zest
olive oil
focaccia bread
18632498812054543.method:
Combine the blueberries, brown sugar, honey, chopped shallots, fresh thyme, and red pepper flakes in a pan and cook down into a compote.
Plate the fresh burrata and spoon the cooked blueberry mixture over it.
Garnish with crushed pistachios, torn basil leaves, and grated lemon zest, and finish with a drizzle of olive oil.
Serve with toasted focaccia alongside.

18177119125447854.ingredients:
cucumber
red onion
garlic
pumpkin seeds
olive oil
soy sauce
18177119125447854.method:
Slice the cucumber.
Add chopped red onion, minced garlic, and pumpkin seeds.
Dress with olive oil and soy sauce, and mix.

17979760032098978.ingredients:
Okinawan purple sweet potato
white flour
agave or honey
sesame seeds
17979760032098978.method:
Slice and dice the purple sweet potato and steam the cubes in a bamboo steamer.
Mash the steamed sweet potato and mix with white flour and a liquid to form a dough.
Roll the mixture into small round balls and place them on a tray.
Cook in an air fryer until warm, puffy, and chewy.
Transfer to a bowl, drizzle with agave or honey, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

17966625549158235.ingredients:
salmon fillet
rice paper wrapper
feta cheese
crushed cereal or breadcrumbs
creamy sauce
17966625549158235.method:
Place a seasoned salmon fillet on a rice paper wrapper and sprinkle crumbled feta over it.
Fold the rice paper around the salmon to form a tight roll.
Press the roll into crushed cereal or breadcrumbs to coat it completely.
Cook in an air fryer until crisp.
Plate and drizzle with a creamy sauce.

18109654343040508.ingredients:
large tomatoes
cherry/candy tomatoes
red bell pepper
onion
Italian seasoning
black pepper
olive oil
garlic
chicken or vegetable stock (one cup)
water (one cup)
Thai coconut milk
18109654343040508.method:
Place halved large tomatoes and cherry tomatoes on a foil-lined sheet pan, and add chopped red bell pepper and onion.
Coat everything with Italian seasoning, black pepper, and olive oil, and roast at 350°F for about an hour until wrinkled and caramelized.
Let the roasted vegetables cool (she lets them cool overnight).
Transfer the roasted vegetables to a blender, squeeze in the softened roasted garlic from its head, add one cup of chicken or vegetable stock and one cup of water, and blend until smooth.
Heat the soup in a pot and stir in Thai coconut milk while heating until velvety.
Serve finished with a drizzle of olive oil.

18599142022056843.ingredients:
salmon fillets
salt
oil
garlic
lemon
yogurt
dill
parsley
rice
fresh herbs
18599142022056843.method:
Salt the raw salmon fillets.
Heat a pan, add oil, turn the heat down, and place the salmon skin-side down.
Cook until it turns from pink to opaque halfway up, then flip it and spoon oil over it for 30 seconds.
Remove the salmon from the pan and let carryover cooking finish it.
Mix yogurt with dill, parsley, and lemon to make the sauce.
Stir fresh herbs into warm rice.
Serve the salmon over the herby rice with the yogurt sauce and lemon wedges.

17910042885282136.ingredients:
garlic chives
silken tofu
potato starch
oil
sugar
soy sauce
vinegar
sesame seeds
chili oil
17910042885282136.method:
Chop the garlic chives.
Place a block of silken tofu in a bowl, add potato starch, and mash it into a batter.
Fold in the chives.
Pour the batter into a hot oiled pan and cook until golden brown, then flip and cook the other side.
For the dipping sauce, combine sugar, soy sauce, vinegar, sesame seeds, and chili oil.
Serve the pancake with the dipping sauce.

18113936989694377.ingredients:
rice flour
tapioca flour
boiling water
neutral oil
18113936989694377.method:
Mix rice flour, tapioca flour, boiling water, and neutral oil together so the starches bind into a dough (no kneading).
Press the dough through a ricer straight into boiling water to form fresh noodles.

17897177178606136.ingredients:
carrots
glutinous rice flour
garlic
ginger
chili powder
MSG
sugar
sesame seeds
hot sesame oil
soy sauce
black vinegar
coriander
17897177178606136.method:
Peel and slice the carrots, boil them, then mash them in a bowl.
Add glutinous rice flour and knead until the dough holds together.
Roll the dough into a log, cut pieces, and shape each into a small indented disc.
For the sauce, combine grated garlic and ginger, chili powder, MSG, sugar, sesame seeds, hot sesame oil, soy sauce, black vinegar, and chopped coriander.
Boil the shaped noodles until they float, then drain them.
Plate the noodles and pour the sauce over.

18335673694279611.ingredients:
silken tofu
soy sauce
rice vinegar
sugar
chili crisp
tofu (for crumbling)
udon noodles
cilantro
green onions
sesame seeds
18335673694279611.method:
Combine silken tofu with soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and chili crisp in a bowl and blend into a smooth sauce.
Fry crumbled tofu in a pan until golden, then mix it with a dark glaze.
Boil the udon noodles and drain.
Pour the sauce over the noodles in a bowl.
Top with the glazed tofu crumble, fresh cilantro, sliced green onions, and sesame seeds, and mix together.

18114353537517723.ingredients:
puff pastry
diced chicken
spices
red and green peppers
shredded cheese
sesame seeds
18114353537517723.method:
Add diced chicken to a hot pan, season with spices, and saute with chopped red and green peppers.
Place a square sheet of puff pastry on a board and score each corner.
Fill the center with the chicken mixture and shredded cheese.
Fold the corners inward to create a four-petaled flower shape.
Top with sesame seeds, place on a baking tray, and bake until golden-brown.

18095890412093685.ingredients:
rice
sliced onion
chicken thigh
soy sauce
seasonings
eggs
green onions
sesame seeds
18095890412093685.method:
Place uncooked rice in the rice cooker pot.
Combine sliced onion and raw chicken thigh in a bowl with soy sauce and seasonings, mix, and pour over the rice.
Cook the rice and chicken together in the rice cooker.
Open the lid, pour beaten eggs on top, and close briefly to set the egg.
Serve in a bowl, garnished with chopped green onions and sesame seeds.

18070101596773642.ingredients:
1 cup soaked moong dal
½ lauki, peeled and cut into cubes
50 g paneer
1 green chilli
½ tbsp jeera
½ tbsp haldi
Salt to taste
12 tbsp besan
Chopped onion
Chopped capsicum
Grated carrot
Fresh coriander
Oil/ghee for cooking
18070101596773642.method:
1. Blend: Add soaked moong dal + cubed ½ lauki + paneer + green chilli to a blender. Blend until smooth.
2. Transfer to a bowl and add jeera, haldi and salt.
3. Add 12 tbsp besan and mix well. Adjust consistency with a little water if required.
4. Heat a tawa and lightly grease it.
5. Pour and spread the batter into a chilla.
6. Top with chopped onion, capsicum, grated carrot and coriander.
7. Cook until golden, flip and cook the other side.
8. Serve hot with dahi/green chutney.

18095437343381922.ingredients:
rice paper sheets
white cubes (likely konjac)
brown sugar
water
milk
two eggs
banana
chocolate chips
cucumber
egg
salmon
canned beverage
lemon juice
sesame seeds
cherry tomatoes
cheese
strawberries
18095437343381922.method:
Hydrate the rice paper sheets.
For the drink, cook the diced white cubes (likely konjac) with brown sugar and water, pour the mixture into a jar, and add milk.
Crack two eggs into a tray, whisk them, and pour onto a waffle iron; top with sliced banana and chocolate chips, close, and cook into a waffle; cut it and place it in the box.
Peel a cucumber and wrap thin strips of cucumber, egg, and salmon in hydrated rice paper to make rolls.
Mix a dressing from a canned beverage, lemon juice, and sesame seeds and pour it over the rolls; garnish with cherry tomato halves and star-shaped cheese.
Add fresh strawberries and a round cheese slice to the last compartment.

18107814005268687.ingredients:
three eggs
warm water
soy sauce
dashi powder
soft tofu
raw shrimp
sesame oil
spring onions
microgreens
Lao Gan Ma chili crisp
18107814005268687.method:
Whisk three eggs with warm water and seasonings including soy sauce and dashi powder.
Gently place cubes of soft tofu into the bowl and top with raw shrimp.
Microwave for about three minutes until set.
Finish with soy sauce, sesame oil, snipped spring onions, fresh-cut microgreens, and a spoonful of Lao Gan Ma chili crisp.

18472473505116828.ingredients:
white rice (Nishiki)
quinoa
black rice
Japanese barley
adzuki beans
water
bone broth powder (one packet)
18472473505116828.method:
Add white rice to the rice cooker pot, followed by the quinoa.
In a separate bowl, measure the black rice, Japanese barley, and adzuki beans, and soak them.
Add the soaked mixture to the pot along with water and a packet of bone broth powder.
Cook in the rice cooker.
Open the lid, fluff the rice, and serve it into a bowl.

18219889309328235.ingredients:
rice
chicken broth (Swanson)
garlic
ginger
scallions
chicken bouillon powder
turmeric
two chicken thighs
salt
sesame oil
oil
18219889309328235.method:
Rinse the rice in the rice cooker pot.
Add chicken broth, minced garlic, minced ginger, chopped scallions, chicken bouillon powder, a sprinkle of turmeric, two raw chicken thighs, a pinch of salt, and sesame oil.
Close the lid and start the rice cooker.
While it cooks, heat oil in a pan and pour it over a bowl of chopped scallions and ginger with salt to make a scallion oil sauce.
When done, remove the chicken, slice it, and plate the rice topped with the sliced chicken and generous spoonfuls of the scallion oil.

18133009759735546.ingredients:
ground chicken
coriander
cumin
salt
parsley
rice paper
cayenne
tortillas
diced tomatoes
cucumber
jerk seasoning
grated garlic
chopped green onion
pepper
honey
beaten egg
18133009759735546.method:
Mediterranean Chicken Poppers: season ground chicken with coriander, cumin, and salt, and add parsley; wrap the mixture in rice paper, roll it, cut it into six pieces, and air fry at 400 degrees for 14 minutes.
Chicken Smash Taco: season ground chicken with cayenne, coriander, cumin, and salt, spread it on tortillas, and air fry at 400 for 8 minutes; top with diced tomatoes, cucumber, and salt.
Jerk Chicken Poppers: mix ground chicken with jerk seasoning, grated garlic, chopped green onion, pepper, and honey; dip rice paper in beaten egg, add the filling, fold, cut into six pieces, and air fry at 400 for 10 minutes.

18108566045579641.ingredients:
green beans
ground pork
garlic
Thai red chili (optional)
soy sauce
oyster sauce
honey
fresh Thai basil
two eggs
white rice
18108566045579641.method:
Chop the green beans into bite-sized pieces.
Cook the ground pork in a hot pan for 5-6 minutes.
Add the chopped green beans, minced garlic, and optional sliced Thai red chili, and saute for 3-4 minutes.
Season with soy sauce, oyster sauce, and honey, tossing until glossy.
Add fresh Thai basil at the end.
Fry two crispy eggs.
Plate the stir-fry over hot white rice and top with a fried egg.

18114328931005780.ingredients:
onion
spinach
basil
zucchini
lime juice
black rice
fried tofu cubes
red chilies
18114328931005780.method:
Chop an onion.
Blend large amounts of fresh spinach and basil with liquid into a vivid green puree.
Pour the blended mixture into a pan and add sauteed diced zucchini.
Squeeze in lime juice and stir.
Plate black rice and pour the curry over it, topped with fried tofu cubes, fresh basil leaves, and sliced red chilies.

18016579118916696.ingredients:
gluten-free bread
low-fat cottage cheese (1/2 cup)
vanilla extract
maple syrup
fresh blueberries
lemon juice
chia seeds
walnuts
mint leaves
lemon zest
18016579118916696.method:
Toast the gluten-free bread.
Blend 1/2 cup low-fat cottage cheese with vanilla extract and maple syrup in a food processor until smooth.
Cook fresh blueberries into a compote with lemon juice and chia seeds.
Spread the whipped cottage cheese mixture on the toast.
Add a dollop of blueberry compote, grate lemon zest over it, and finish with diced walnuts and thinly chopped mint leaves.

18107371589216581.ingredients:
overripe bananas
pitted dates
lemon zest
egg whites
almond flour
buckwheat flour
cacao mass
coconut milk
sea salt
18107371589216581.method:
Mash the overripe bananas with pitted dates and lemon zest.
Whip the egg whites separately.
Combine the wet and dry ingredients, including almond flour and buckwheat flour.
Fold in the whipped egg whites.
Chop the cacao mass and fold it into the batter.
Bake the loaf.
For the ganache, melt cacao mass with coconut milk, blend additional dates into a paste, and mix the paste into the chocolate.
Serve slices plated with ganache and sea salt.

18146546881502362.ingredients:
ginger
garlic
oil
scallions
chicken leg quarters
soy sauce
sugar
water
rice
chili-garlic sauce
18146546881502362.method:
Crush fresh ginger and garlic cloves in a stone mortar.
Heat oil in a pan and saute the crushed aromatics, sliced ginger, and chopped scallions.
Place raw chicken leg quarters on top, drizzle with soy sauce, and sprinkle with sugar; stir briefly, then add water, cover, and simmer.
Separately, fry minced garlic in oil, add uncooked rice, and toast it.
Place the cooked chicken pieces back on top of the rice, cover again, and steam.
Shred the chicken and serve with the rice and chili-garlic sauce.

18120558541871682.ingredients:
two eggs
salt
deli roll
butter
cheese (one and a half slices)
mayonnaise
lasanyu marchu (garlicky chili paste)
18120558541871682.method:
Crack two eggs into a bowl with salt.
Scoop out some of the interior of the deli roll so it isn't too bready.
Heat a 10-to-12-inch skillet on low with butter and pour in the eggs.
Mix mayonnaise with lasanyu marchu (a garlicky chili paste) to make a spicy mayo.
Once the egg is set, place one and a half slices of cheese on top and fold the egg over.
Spread the spicy mayo inside the hollowed roll and insert the folded egg and cheese.

18486889045105442.ingredients:
two eggs
udon noodles
miso paste
sesame oil
salt
honey
mushrooms
paprika
cumin
chili oil
spring onions
18486889045105442.method:
Boil the two eggs together with the block of udon in one pan.
While they cook, blend miso paste, sesame oil, salt, and honey in a blender into a creamy sauce.
Transfer the cooked noodles and eggs to a bowl and pour the sauce over them.
Peel and halve the soft-boiled eggs.
Top with pan-fried mushrooms seasoned with paprika and cumin, chili oil, and snipped fresh spring onions.

17916757308442608.ingredients:
chicken
soy sauce
rice wine
grated ginger
minced garlic
five-spice powder
salt
brown sugar
white pepper
egg white
coarse tapioca starch
oil spray
Thai basil leaves
five-spice salt mix
17916757308442608.method:
Cut the raw chicken into bite-size pieces.
Marinate for 30 minutes with soy sauce, rice wine, grated ginger, minced garlic, five-spice powder, salt, brown sugar, and white pepper.
Coat the chicken in egg white, then dredge each piece in coarse tapioca starch.
Spray the air fryer basket with oil, place the coated chicken in a single layer, and spray again.
Air fry at 375°F for 9 minutes.
Flip the pieces, spray again, and cook for 6 more minutes at 400°F until golden and crispy.
Add fresh Thai basil leaves and cook for 2 more minutes.
Sprinkle with a five-spice salt mix and serve.

18152001961458650.ingredients:
chicken breast
white pepper
salt
Shaoxing wine
light soy sauce
corn flour
oil
corn kernels
garlic
chicken stock
water
creamed corn
egg
cornstarch slurry
white rice
green onions
18152001961458650.method:
Cut the raw chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and marinate with white pepper, salt, Shaoxing wine, and light soy sauce.
Add cold oil and corn flour to a cold pan, mix, then heat; coat the marinated chicken and fry until golden and crispy, then remove to a plate.
In the same pan, combine corn kernels, minced garlic, chicken stock, water, salt, and creamed corn to form the sauce.
Stir in a beaten egg and a cornstarch slurry to thicken the sauce.
Ladle the sauce over rice in a bowl, arrange the fried chicken on top, and garnish with green onions.

18099390287127107.ingredients:
tofu
quinoa
red cabbage
red bell pepper
carrots
cilantro
edamame
peanut-coconut-lime dressing
strawberries
plant milk
oats
chia seeds
yogurt
maple syrup
sliced almonds
18099390287127107.method:
Quinoa salad: press and cube the tofu, toss it in a marinade, and bake it.
Cook the quinoa in an Instant Pot.
Chop red cabbage, red bell pepper, carrots, cilantro, and edamame.
Blend a creamy peanut-coconut-lime dressing and mix everything into the quinoa salad.
Strawberry overnight oats: blend strawberries with plant milk and pour the mixture over oats, chia seeds, yogurt, and maple syrup.
Fold in chopped fresh strawberries, portion into jars, and top with sliced almonds.
Assemble lunch containers with the baked tofu and quinoa salad.

18123800732501564.ingredients:
cottage cheese
avocado
herbs
olive oil
grated parmesan
lemon juice
spices
spinach
artichoke hearts
Frank's RedHot sauce
shredded chicken
green onion
18123800732501564.method:
Green vegetable dip: blend the cottage cheese smooth with an immersion blender, then mix with chopped avocado, herbs, and olive oil; serve spread on toast.
Spinach artichoke dip: blend grated parmesan, lemon juice, olive oil, and spices with cottage cheese until smooth, then fold in chopped spinach and artichoke hearts; serve with toast.
Buffalo chicken dip: blend the cottage cheese smooth, stir in Frank's RedHot sauce, then add shredded chicken and chopped green onion; serve with a chip.

17903124030507969.ingredients:
frozen miso black cod fillets (pre-marinated)
rice
water
olive oil
sliced mushrooms
broccolini
17903124030507969.method:
Add rice, water, olive oil, and sliced mushrooms to a pan, cover, and simmer.
Place the marinated cod fillets in a baking dish and slide it into the oven to bake.
Steam the broccolini in a pot, drain it, and season it.
Serve the fish with the mushroom rice and broccolini.

18086523755423282.ingredients:
Medjool dates
vanilla marshmallow creme
seed-and-nut crackers (Simple Mills Sweet Thins Honey Cinnamon)
dark chocolate (melted)
flaky sea salt
18086523755423282.method:
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Split the Medjool dates open and remove the pits.
Fill each date with vanilla marshmallow creme using a knife.
Top the cream with a seed-and-nut cracker.
Spoon melted dark chocolate over each assembled bite.
Finish with a sprinkle of flaky sea salt.

18101486054256293.ingredients:
amaranth
water
sweetener (monkfruit and allulose)
nuts
saffron
cardamom
18101486054256293.method:
Soak the amaranth for 2-3 hours, then boil it (the audio explains the soaking and boiling; the visuals show it sifted into a pan with water added).
Cook the amaranth mixture, stirring, until it thickens into a paste.
Spoon in the sweetener, along with nuts, saffron, and cardamom, and stir again.
Roll the warm mixture by hand into smooth balls.

17882567805682095.ingredients:
Greek yogurt (FAGE Total 5%)
purple paste (ube)
honey or syrup (amber liquid)
dark chocolate (melted)
sea salt flakes
blackberries
pomegranate seeds
purple ice cream (two scoops)
17882567805682095.method:
Spoon Greek yogurt into a small ramekin, add the vibrant purple paste, and mix it in.
Add a drizzle of an amber-colored liquid (likely honey or syrup).
Transfer the mixture onto a cheesecloth, gather it, and squeeze to drain excess liquid, forming a dense purple mass.
Place the mass in a shallow dish, shape it into a dome, and cover it with melted dark chocolate using a spoon.
Sprinkle sea salt flakes on top.
Arrange on a plate alongside blackberries and pomegranate seeds, and add two scoops of purple ice cream.

18068574875709982.ingredients:
tofu
sauce (mixed in a mason jar)
onion
garlic
red chilies
fresh Thai basil
white rice
18068574875709982.method:
Mix a dark sauce in a mason jar.
Pan-fry shredded tofu until crisp.
Add diced onion and garlic, then stir in chopped red chilies.
Pour in the sauce.
Finish with a large handful of fresh basil and stir until it wilts into the mixture.
Serve spooned over white rice.

18141616621571611.ingredients:
green bell pepper
red onion
green chili
cilantro
cottage cheese
sourdough bread
grated mozzarella
chili flakes
18141616621571611.method:
Finely dice green bell pepper, red onion, green chili, and cilantro on a board.
Combine them with cottage cheese in a glass bowl.
Spread the mixture onto a slice of sourdough bread.
Top with grated mozzarella.
Air-fry at 400 degrees for 7-8 minutes until golden.
Finish with chili flakes.

17910426897421855.ingredients:
cauliflower
flour
chickpea flour
spices
water
cornflakes
nutritional yeast
oil spray
creamy herb dip
17910426897421855.method:
Remove the leaves from a whole head of cauliflower, cut out the stem, break it into florets, and wash them.
Boil the florets until fork-tender.
Mix flour with chickpea flour, spices, and water to create a thick batter.
Crush cornflakes with nutritional yeast for the crunchy outer coating.
Dip each boiled floret in the batter, then in the crumbs.
Place them in an air fryer basket, spray with oil, and cook until crispy.
Serve with a creamy herb dip.

18118904713851449.ingredients:
onions
honey
soy sauce
white miso paste
udon noodles
starchy noodle water
butter
garlic
chives
black sesame seeds
fried onions
miso rayu chili crisp
18118904713851449.method:
Add sliced onions to a pan and caramelize them low and slow.
Meanwhile, whisk together honey, soy sauce, and white miso paste in a small cup, then loosen the sauce with starchy noodle water.
Cook the udon noodles separately.
Once the onions are deeply golden, melt butter and pressed garlic into them.
Toss the cooked noodles and miso sauce together until glossy.
Plate and garnish with chopped chives, black sesame seeds, extra fried onions, and a spoonful of miso rayu chili crisp.

18088289264440426.ingredients:
moong dal (one cup)
chana dal (one cup)
toor dal (one cup)
water
ginger
dill leaves
coriander
freshly grated coconut
green chili (optional)
curry leaves
salt
hing (asafoetida)
ghee
18088289264440426.method:
Soak the three dals (moong dal, chana dal, and toor dal, one cup each) in water.
Blend the soaked lentils coarsely with ginger in a food processor.
Add chopped dill leaves, coriander, freshly grated coconut, optional chopped green chili, curry leaves, salt, and hing (asafoetida), and mix well by hand.
Shape the mixture into oval balls and place them in a perforated steamer tray.
Set the tray over boiling water and steam for 15 minutes under a glass lid.
Transfer to a bowl and serve with ghee.

17864343483661430.ingredients:
whole spices (coriander seeds, cumin, fennel, dried red chilies, bay leaf, cardamom, cinnamon, star anise)
chicken
yogurt
oil
garlic
ginger
green chili
onions
tomatoes
flour tortilla
shredded cheese
red onion (for relish)
creamy white sauce
17864343483661430.method:
Toast the whole spices and grind them.
Marinate diced raw chicken with yogurt and the ground spice mix.
Heat oil in a pan with minced garlic, ginger, and green chili, then add sliced onions and diced tomatoes.
Add the ground spices and the marinated chicken and cook until saucy.
Place a flour tortilla in a hot pan, top with shredded cheese and the bhuna chicken, fold it, and press until crisp and golden on both sides.
Top with a chopped red onion relish and drizzle with the creamy sauce.

18106342006805138.ingredients:
oil
herbs
spices
garlic
chicken drumsticks
red onions
salt
pepper
thyme
butter
broccoli
carrots
potatoes
18106342006805138.method:
Mix a marinade of oil, herbs, spices, and garlic in a glass bowl, coat the raw chicken drumsticks, and let them sit.
Prepare a baking dish with sliced red onions, oil, salt, pepper, and thyme, and place the marinated chicken on top.
Cover and bake for 15 minutes until the onions soften.
Add cubes of butter and return the dish to high heat to brown the skin.
Meanwhile, saute a vegetable mix of broccoli, carrots, and potatoes.
Remove the chicken and emulsify the pan juices with cold butter to create a sauce.
Plate the vegetables topped with the chicken and drizzle the sauce over.

17896208994542239.ingredients:
whole spices (coriander seeds, dried red chilies, cinnamon, cardamom)
chicken pieces
turmeric powder
salt
oil
sliced onions
green chilies
white rice
17896208994542239.method:
Dry-roast the whole spices (coriander seeds, dried red chilies, cinnamon, and cardamom) in a pan.
Marinate the raw chicken pieces with turmeric powder, salt, and other seasonings by hand.
Heat oil with whole spices, then saute sliced onions and green chilies until golden brown.
Add the marinated chicken and cook it down until deeply browned and saucy.
Serve with white rice and sliced onions garnished with herbs.

18005090795771369.ingredients:
neutral oil
ground pork
salt
spring onions
garlic
peanut butter
soy sauce
rice vinegar
lime juice
water
chili crisp
udon noodles (pre-cooked)
18005090795771369.method:
Heat neutral oil in a pan and add the ground pork, seasoning it with salt.
Finely chop the spring onions, separating the white and green parts, and smash and mince the garlic.
Break up the meat and add the white parts of the spring onion and the garlic.
Add a large spoonful of peanut butter, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and lime juice, and stir until the peanut butter forms a glossy sauce.
Add a splash of water to thin the sauce, letting it reduce further.
Stir in chili crisp to taste.
Add the blanched noodles to the pan along with the reserved green spring onion tops and toss everything together.
Plate into a bowl and serve.

18089164943536235.ingredients:
eggs
roasted sliced zucchini
sweet corn kernels
crumbled cooked meat
sauteed spinach
blistered cherry tomatoes
pickled red onions
cheddar slices
crumbled feta
shredded cheese
dried herbs
18089164943536235.method:
Line a muffin tin with paper cups.
Add fillings to the different cups: roasted sliced zucchini, sweet corn kernels, crumbled cooked meat, sauteed spinach, blistered cherry tomatoes, and pickled red onions.
Top with various cheeses (cheddar slices, crumbled feta, and shredded cheese) and sprinkle with dried herbs.
Pour a blended egg mixture from a blender over each cup.
Bake until the muffins are golden-brown and puffed.

18108982483950162.ingredients:
flat noodles
shallots
garlic
ginger
peanut butter
sesame seeds
chili crisp
green onions
hot water
18108982483950162.method:
Boil the noodles.
In a pan, add chopped shallots, minced garlic and ginger, peanut butter, sesame seeds, chili crisp, and chopped green onions.
Pour hot water from a pot into the pan and mix everything into a sauce.
Add the cooked flat noodles and toss them to coat.

17955032313235561.ingredients:
carrots
snap peas
green beans
red bell pepper
onion
tofu
canned coconut milk
rice
Panang curry paste
seasonings
garlic
ginger
fresh basil
17955032313235561.method:
Chop the vegetables and tofu on a board.
Rinse the rice in a ramekin.
Mix coconut milk with Panang curry paste and seasonings in a bowl.
In an Instant Pot, saute garlic and ginger, add curry paste, then the vegetables.
Pour in the curry mixture and add the tofu cubes.
Place a trivet over the curry and set the rice ramekin on top, seal the lid, and pressure cook.
Remove the cooked rice and stir fresh basil into the curry below.
Plate the rice with the curry and serve.

18102899621522717.ingredients:
butter
pitted dates
pre-cooked and cooled white rice
coconut milk
water
cinnamon
vanilla
maple syrup
egg yolks
collagen powder
18102899621522717.method:
Brown the butter in a cast-iron skillet.
Fry the pitted dates until caramelized.
Add pre-cooked and cooled white rice, coconut milk, water, cinnamon, vanilla, and maple syrup.
Temper whisked egg yolks with the hot mixture, then combine everything back in the pan to thicken into a creamy pudding.
Serve in a bowl topped with the sticky dates, a drizzle of brown butter, and cinnamon.

18439256071123632.ingredients:
uncooked rice
water
diced onion
minced garlic
chopped ginger
sesame oil
soy sauce
cubed tofu
18439256071123632.method:
Add the uncooked rice, water, diced onion, minced garlic, chopped ginger, sesame oil, soy sauce, and cubed tofu to a rice cooker.
Stir the mixture and cook in the rice cooker.
Open the lid, fluff the rice and tofu, and serve.

18113021671979475.ingredients:
cooked rice (leftover)
carrot sticks
zucchini
whole mushrooms
raw chicken
Korean seafood stock packet (optional)
water
sesame oil
salt
pepper
18113021671979475.method:
Add the cooked rice to a rice cooker.
Add the carrot sticks, zucchini pieces, whole mushrooms, and chunks of raw chicken.
Add the stock packet if using, and water.
Close the lid and cook on the porridge setting (36 minutes).
Cut the softened vegetables and chicken into smaller pieces inside the pot.
Season with sesame oil, salt, and pepper, and serve.

18075240422379292.ingredients:
cottage cheese
flour
baking powder
salt
milk
everything bagel seasoning
shredded cheddar
jalapeño slices
18075240422379292.method:
Blend the cottage cheese in a blender until smooth.
Mix the blended cottage cheese in a bowl with flour, baking powder, and salt to form a dough.
Divide the dough into eight equal portions and roll them into balls.
Dip each ball in milk, then roll in everything bagel seasoning.
Place the balls on a parchment-lined tray, leaving some plain and topping others with shredded cheddar and a jalapeño slice.
Air-fry or bake until golden brown.

17982291123050369.ingredients:
ground chicken
breadcrumbs
chopped red onion
fresh herbs
lemon juice
potatoes
Brussels sprouts
feta
honey
lemon
garlic
dill
yogurt
17982291123050369.method:
For the lemon herb chicken meatballs, mix ground chicken with breadcrumbs, chopped red onion, fresh herbs, and lemon juice, then roll into balls.
Cook the meatballs in a pan.
Wash, halve, and season the potatoes and Brussels sprouts, then roast them.
Blend a whipped honey lemon feta dip.
Mix a honey, garlic, and dill yogurt sauce.
Plate the meatballs and roasted vegetables into bowls with the dips.

18116194300900269.ingredients:
extra-firm tofu
oil
diced onion
grated garlic
tomato paste
dried herbs and spices
yogurt
butter
Turkish red pepper flakes (pul biber)
farfalle pasta
fresh herbs
chopped tomatoes
sliced radish
18116194300900269.method:
Crush the extra-firm tofu by hand into a mince-like texture.
Fry the tofu in oil until golden brown, then remove it from the pan.
In the same pan, sauté the diced onion and grated garlic.
Add the tomato paste and dried herbs and spices and cook them down.
Return the tofu to the pan and coat it in the mixture.
Prepare a garlicky yogurt base.
Melt butter until browned and bubbling and flavor it with Turkish red pepper flakes.
To assemble, spread the yogurt on a plate, top with cooked farfalle pasta and the seasoned tofu mince, and finish with fresh herbs, chopped tomatoes, and sliced radish.

18094356245365767.method: Boil the cubed tofu in salted water instead of pressing or freezing it.

18614362720059456.ingredients:
oil
finely diced shallots
minced garlic
chopped red chilies
crumbled tofu
sauce
sliced green onions
fresh basil leaves
white rice
18614362720059456.method:
Heat oil in a pan and add the finely diced shallots.
Add the minced garlic and chopped red chilies.
Pour in the crumbled tofu and stir-fry until browned.
Drizzle the sauce over the tofu and mix thoroughly.
Add the sliced green onions and fresh basil leaves and toss in.
Spoon the mixture over a bowl of white rice and serve.

18156068092438471.ingredients:
soy sauce
mirin
finely diced onion
chopped green onion
grated ginger
grated garlic
brown sugar
chili pepper
sesame oil
sesame seeds
tofu
white rice
18156068092438471.method:
Add the soy sauce, mirin, finely diced onion, chopped green onion, grated ginger, grated garlic, brown sugar, chili pepper, sesame oil, and sesame seeds to a glass container and mix to make a marinade.
Heat the marinade for one minute.
Place the block of tofu into the sauce and cut it into cubes while submerged.
Marinate for a couple of hours.
Serve the tofu over a bowl of white rice.

18109707215474744.ingredients:
12 eggs
1 cup soy sauce
1 cup water
1/2 cup agave sweetener
half onion, diced
green onion, chopped
jalapeño, sliced
2 tablespoons minced garlic
sesame oil
1/3 cup sesame seeds
18109707215474744.method:
Boil the eggs for 7 minutes.
Meanwhile, make the marinade in a glass dish by combining the soy sauce, water, agave sweetener, diced onion, chopped green onion, sliced jalapeño, minced garlic, a generous drizzle of sesame oil, and sesame seeds.
Cool the boiled eggs in an ice bath, then peel them.
Place the peeled eggs in the marinade and cover with a paper towel to keep them submerged.
Seal the container and refrigerate for 24 hours or more.

18329190931278027.ingredients:
white rice
water
minced ginger
garlic
scallions
stock cubes
soft tofu
soy sauce
sesame oil
miso-glazed mushrooms
sliced green onions
sesame seeds
red chili oil
cilantro
lime
18329190931278027.method:
Rinse the white rice multiple times.
Add the rice to boiling water with minced ginger, garlic, scallions, and stock cubes.
Simmer on the stove, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Add the soft tofu.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Serve topped with miso-glazed mushrooms, sliced green onions, sesame seeds, red chili oil, cilantro, and a lime wedge.

18615332260024465.ingredients:
rice
water
frozen shelled edamame
sliced beech mushrooms
raw peeled shrimp
minced garlic
honey
butter
fresh bok choy
lime juice
chopped cilantro
green onion
sesame seeds
18615332260024465.method:
Place the rice, water, frozen shelled edamame, and sliced beech mushrooms in a rice cooker and cook.
Season the raw peeled shrimp with minced garlic and honey.
Sauté the shrimp in a pan with butter and more honey until glazed.
Open the rice cooker mid-cycle and steam the fresh bok choy inside for four minutes.
Mix the cooked rice with lime juice, chopped cilantro, and green onion.
Plate the rice topped with the honey garlic shrimp and bok choy, and finish with sesame seeds.

18109347932119939.ingredients:
2 tablespoons ghee
2 dried red chilies
1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds
a pinch of hing
turmeric
1 pound frozen petite green peas
salt
smoked paprika
coriander powder
mango powder
roasted cumin powder
water
18109347932119939.method:
Heat two tablespoons of ghee in a pan.
Temper with two dried red chilies, half a teaspoon of cumin seeds, a pinch of hing, and turmeric.
Add one pound of frozen petite green peas and stir.
Season with salt, smoked paprika, and coriander powder and cook.
Add mango powder, roasted cumin powder, and water.
Simmer covered until finished.

17976412557074040.ingredients:
chicken thighs
paprika
garlic powder
turmeric
curry powder
salt
black pepper
olive oil
diced onion
garlic
coconut milk
Japanese curry cube
white rice
chopped green onions
black sesame seeds
17976412557074040.method:
Season the chicken thighs with paprika, garlic powder, turmeric, curry powder, salt, black pepper, and olive oil, and massage the spices in.
Pan-fry the chicken for 7 minutes per side until browned, then remove and set aside.
In the same pan, sauté the diced onion and garlic for 2-3 minutes.
Add the coconut milk and Japanese curry cube, mix, and simmer for 2 minutes to create a thick sauce.
Place a dome of hot white rice into the center of the sauce.
Slice the cooked chicken and arrange it around the rice.
Garnish with chopped green onions and black sesame seeds.

18138115342607569.ingredients:
steel-cut oats
water
sunflower seeds
pumpkin seeds
flax seeds
quinoa or oat flakes
psyllium husk
apple cider vinegar
18138115342607569.method:
Soak the steel-cut oats in water for about six hours, then drain them.
Transfer the soaked oats to a bowl and mix with sunflower seeds, pumpkin seeds, flax seeds, quinoa or oat flakes, and psyllium husk.
Add apple cider vinegar to water, whisk, and pour it into the dry mixture.
Stir the mixture and leave it to sit.
Press the thick mixture firmly into a loaf pan and bake.
Remove the loaf from the pan and slice.

17938965303303624.ingredients:
chicken leg quarters
salt
pepper
ginger
oil
water
cooked white rice
green onions
fried shallots
17938965303303624.method:
Season the chicken leg quarters with salt and pepper.
Pan-fry sliced ginger in oil, then sear the chicken until golden brown.
Transfer the chicken to a pot, add water, and boil.
Remove the cooked chicken, shred it by hand, and return it to the broth.
Add cooked white rice and a large amount of finely chopped green onions.
Stir into a soupy congee and serve garnished with fried shallots.

18101938040188902.ingredients:
ragi (finger millet) flour
rajgira (amaranth) flour
aamchur powder
chaat masala
chili powder
turmeric
salt
chopped carrots
beans
coriander
ginger
chili
1/4 cup dahi (curd)
ghee
green chutney
18101938040188902.method:
Mix the ragi and rajgira flours with aamchur powder, chaat masala, chili powder, turmeric, and salt.
Add the chopped vegetables and 1/4 cup dahi to form a thick mixture.
Shape the mixture into a patty.
Grease the waffle maker with ghee, place the patty in, and cook until done.
For the dip, mix green chutney into dahi until smooth and pale green.
Serve the waffles with the dip.

18083827760676288.ingredients:
tong hao (chrysanthemum greens)
sesame oil
roasted sesame seeds
shiitake mushrooms
soy sauce
black pepper
hot cooked rice
furikake seasoning
18083827760676288.method:
Blanch the greens for 1-2 minutes, squeeze out the excess water, and chop them finely.
Season the chopped greens with sesame oil and roasted sesame seeds.
Chop the shiitake mushrooms and sauté for 2-3 minutes with soy sauce and black pepper until softened.
Combine the hot cooked rice with a generous amount of furikake seasoning.
Add the seasoned greens and sautéed mushrooms and mix everything thoroughly.

18121650910801179.ingredients:
baked sweet potato
ground meat
salt
pepper
dried herbs
white rice
steamed broccoli
chopped green onions
sesame seeds
18121650910801179.method:
Split open a baked sweet potato and mash it with forks.
Add the mashed sweet potato to a bowl of raw ground meat with salt, pepper, and dried herbs.
Combine the mixture thoroughly with a fork.
Portion the mixture into uniform balls using a scoop and place them on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake until browned.
Toss the meatballs in a glossy dark sauce.
Serve over white rice with steamed broccoli, garnished with chopped green onions and sesame seeds.

17911188891444125.ingredients:
banana
avocado
ragi powder
whole wheat flour
salt
cinnamon powder
water
ghee
17911188891444125.method:
Place a peeled banana in a mixing bowl and add scooped avocado chunks.
Mash the banana and avocado together with a fork until combined.
Add spoonfuls of ragi powder and whole wheat flour, a pinch of salt, and a sprinkle of cinnamon powder.
Pour in water and whisk into a smooth, pourable batter.
Heat a non-stick pan with ghee.
Drop small ladles of batter into the pan to form mini pancakes.
Flip the pancakes, cover the pan with a lid, and cook both sides until browned.

17950522716216498.ingredients:
dates
tahini
orange zest
pumpkin seeds
dark chocolate
17950522716216498.method:
Blend the dates, tahini, orange zest, and pumpkin seeds into a dark paste.
Press the paste into a silicone ice-cube tray.
Melt the dark chocolate and pour it over the mixture, spreading it evenly.
Sprinkle more orange zest on top.

17894673390578752.ingredients:
soaked red lentils
mashed bananas
ground flaxseed
water
unsweetened dark cocoa powder
baking soda
baking powder
an acid
17894673390578752.method:
Pour the soaked red lentils into a blender and add the mashed bananas.
Blend until smooth and transfer the batter to a bowl.
Make a flax egg with ground flaxseed and water and add it to the batter along with the unsweetened dark cocoa powder.
Mix until well combined into a smooth chocolate batter.
Add the baking soda, baking powder, and an acid and mix.
Pour the batter into a fluted bundt pan and bake.
Invert the finished cake onto a board and slice.

18030852371650212.ingredients:
peaches
overnight oats
chickpeas
white beans
olives
radishes
herbs
ginger
lime
salmon
spinach
cucumber
avocado
edamame
raspberries
yogurt
dates
chocolate
18030852371650212.method:
Make peaches & cream overnight oats and top with caramelized peaches.
Make the olive dense bean salad with chickpeas, white beans, olives, radishes, and herbs.
Assemble anti-inflammatory ginger lime salmon bowls with spinach and a cucumber-avocado-edamame salad.
Make chocolate-covered raspberry yogurt stuffed dates.

18020618837896331.ingredients:
quinoa
water
mashed boiled potato
grated paneer
chopped fresh coriander
red spice powder
chopped onions
rice flour
18020618837896331.method:
Pour the dry quinoa into a pot, wash it with water by hand, then boil until cooked.
Transfer the cooked quinoa to a bowl.
Add the mashed boiled potato, grated paneer, chopped fresh coriander, red spice powder, chopped onions, and rice flour, and mix everything with a fork.
Form the mixture into a patty with your hands.
Grease a waffle maker, place the patty inside, close the lid, and cook until crispy.
Remove the waffle and serve with green chutney or ketchup.

18092735312071669.ingredients:
cooked spinach
cottage cheese
low-fat mozzarella
salt
pepper
onion powder
garlic powder
egg
puff pastry
egg wash
sesame seeds
18092735312071669.method:
Place the cooked spinach in a bowl and add the cottage cheese, low-fat mozzarella, salt, pepper, and onion and garlic powder, then mix.
Crack an egg into the mixture and stir it in.
Lay out a sheet of puff pastry and spoon the spinach-cheese filling along one edge.
Roll up the pastry and cut it into individual portions.
Brush the pieces with egg wash and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake in the oven until puffed and golden.

17870721339630465.ingredients:
soya chunks
chopped onion
coriander leaves
paneer cubes
garlic
salt
black pepper
cumin powder
gram flour
lemon juice
desi ghee
yogurt (for serving)
17870721339630465.method:
Pour the soya chunks into a blender jar, followed by the chopped onion, coriander leaves, paneer cubes, and garlic.
Blend the mixture smooth and transfer it to a bowl.
Season with salt, black pepper, cumin powder, gram flour, and lemon juice, and mix into a dough.
Shape small patties.
Heat desi ghee in a small pan and shallow-fry the patties for 2-3 minutes until golden.
Serve the patties on yogurt.

18115598980935567.ingredients:
two chicken leg quarters
green onions
shallots
salt
ginger slices
hot water
cooked white rice
crispy fried shallots
18115598980935567.method:
Place the chicken leg quarters on a tray and finely chop a large amount of green onions and shallots.
Season the chicken with salt.
Sear the chicken skin-side down in a pan with ginger slices until golden brown.
Transfer the chicken to a pot, pour in hot water, and simmer covered for 15 minutes.
Remove the chicken and shred the meat by hand.
Return the shredded chicken to the broth.
Add cooked white rice and lots of spring onions and stir everything together.
Serve topped with crispy fried shallots.

17888832885604076.ingredients:
eggs
soy sauce
tamarind
rice vinegar
sliced chili
ginger
garlic
rice (for serving)
17888832885604076.method:
Boil the eggs for seven minutes.
Transfer the eggs to an ice bath for three minutes.
Prepare a marinade in a container with soy sauce, tamarind, rice vinegar, sliced chili, ginger, and garlic.
Peel the eggs and submerge them in the marinade overnight.
Serve the eggs over rice, sliced in half.

18099626390272588.ingredients:
fresh cilantro
curry leaves
ginger-garlic paste
chili powder
turmeric
spices
raw prawns
coconut milk
rice paper sheets
chopped scallions
roasted peanuts
chili oil
18099626390272588.method:
Blend the fresh cilantro, curry leaves, ginger-garlic paste, chili powder, turmeric, and spices into a green paste.
Marinate the raw prawns in the paste.
Fry the marinated prawns in a pan.
Add coconut milk to create a creamy sauce and simmer.
Soften round rice paper sheets and cut them into strips.
Add the rice paper strips to the sauce to soak up the flavor.
Plate and garnish with chopped scallions, roasted peanuts, and chili oil.

18109488643777207.ingredients:
butter
sugar
flour
egg
chopped chocolate
hot cream
18109488643777207.method:
Mix butter, sugar, flour, and egg into a butter cookie dough.
Pipe oblong shapes onto parchment.
Bake until golden.
Make a whipped chocolate ganache by pouring hot cream over chopped chocolate and whisking.
Sandwich the cooled cookies together with the ganache.

18104173586025519.ingredients:
chopped broccoli
sweetcorn
shredded cheese
beaten eggs
herbs
18104173586025519.method:
Add the chopped broccoli to a greased square pan.
Layer in the sweetcorn, shredded cheese, and beaten eggs with herbs.
Mix everything together and sprinkle more cheese on top.
Bake until golden brown.
Cut the baked slab into finger-sized strips.

17998112468948532.ingredients:
eggs
avocado toast
spinach
salt
pepper
chili oil
honey
orange slices
masala tea spices
coconut kefir
pre-marinated chipotle chicken thighs
white rice
pineapple
avocado
cucumber
red onion
cilantro
lime juice
broccoli
red bell peppers
red bell pepper seasoning
salmon fillet
chili
garlic powder
grated garlic
soy sauce
white vinegar
chili flakes
sesame seeds
17998112468948532.method:
For breakfast, make fluffy folded scrambled eggs and serve with avocado toast topped with spinach, salt, pepper, chili oil, and honey, plus orange slices and masala tea made with toasted spices and coconut kefir.
For lunch, cook the chipotle chicken thighs, then assemble a bowl with white rice, sliced chicken, and a pineapple salsa made from diced pineapple, avocado, cucumber, red onion, cilantro, lime juice, salt, and pepper.
For dinner, sauté broccoli and red bell peppers with salt and red bell pepper seasoning.
Pan-sear a salmon fillet seasoned with salt, pepper, chili, and garlic powder.
In the same pan, make a hot honey sauce with grated garlic, honey, soy sauce, white vinegar, and chili flakes, and coat the salmon with it.
Finish the plate with sesame seeds.

18327559480254543.ingredients:
soaked quinoa
steamed pumpkin
black pepper
water
garlic
homemade paneer
desi ghee
18327559480254543.method:
Place the soaked quinoa in a bowl, followed by the steamed pumpkin, black pepper, water for consistency, and garlic.
Blend into a smooth paste.
Stir in the homemade paneer.
Spoon the mixture onto a hot iron tawa with desi ghee.
