Pan-sear into small golden coins.

18056364977742644.ingredients:
soaked moong dal
salt
cumin
coriander
red chili powder
turmeric
Eno fruit salt
oil
salted boiled water
buttermilk
fresh coriander
mint
soaked whole red chili
cumin powder
18056364977742644.method:
Prepare a soaked moong dal paste seasoned with salt, cumin, coriander, red chili powder, turmeric, and Eno fruit salt.
Spoon small dollops of the paste onto an oiled metal plate and steam them.
Soak the steamed phulkis for 10 minutes in salted boiled water, then gently squeeze them dry.
Prepare buttermilk with fresh coriander, mint, and soaked whole red chili paste, topped with cumin powder.
Add the squeezed phulkis to the cold spiced buttermilk and mix.
Serve cold.

18058764974709538.ingredients:
eggs
cheese slices
green chilies
garlic
butter
water
chili oil
grilled toast
18058764974709538.method:
Melt butter in a pan and sauté the garlic and chilies.
Add water, then melt the cheese into a sauce and season it.
In a separate pan, fry several sunny-side-up eggs.
Pour the hot cheese-chili mixture over the frying eggs and let it cook together.
Plate the combination onto grilled toast and drizzle chili oil on top.

18255760258291009.ingredients:
leftover roasted bones
carrots
celery
water
apple cider vinegar
18255760258291009.method:
Chop the carrots and celery on a wooden board.
Place the leftover roasted bones into a slow cooker.
Add the chopped vegetables and cover everything with water.
Add apple cider vinegar to help break down the collagen.
Cook low and slow for 36 hours.
Strain the finished broth and pour it into small glass jars for the freezer.

17918612796161273.ingredients:
coconut milk
garlic
fresh cilantro
scallions
onion
lime juice
sea bass fillets
oil
black pepper
rice
red chili oil
17918612796161273.method:
Pour the coconut milk into a food processor and add garlic, fresh cilantro, scallions, onion, and lime juice.
Blend into a creamy green sauce.
Place the raw sea bass fillets in an oiled baking dish and season with oil and black pepper.
Smother the fillets with the sauce and bake.
Serve alongside rice and drizzle red chili oil on top.

17916746547366876.ingredients:
potatoes
oil
salt
water
turmeric
chili powder
jeera (cumin) powder
17916746547366876.method:
Peel and dice the potatoes.
Add oil to a hot pan, then add the diced potatoes, salt, and a little water.
Cook for 5 minutes, then turn off the heat and let the potatoes rest for 5 minutes.
Add turmeric, followed by chili powder and jeera (cumin) powder.
Fry on low flame until crisp.

17869958064533797.ingredients:
chia seeds
kefir
frozen raspberries
chickpeas
carrots
celery
dill
avocado oil mayo
mustard
pita
avocado
cherry tomatoes
cucumbers
green beans
sweet potato
red onion
oil
chicken
17869958064533797.method:
Make breakfast chia-kefir jars and top them with frozen raspberries.
For the chickpea 'tuna' pita, mash the chickpeas and add diced carrots, celery, dill, avocado oil mayo, and mustard.
Stuff the chickpea mixture into pita with avocado and serve with cherry tomatoes and cucumbers.
Roast the green beans, sweet potato, and red onion with oil.
Portion sliced chicken over the roasted vegetables.

18079012169540155.method:
Add blocks of tofu to a food processor containing fresh spinach and blend into a coarse green paste.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl.
Take a portion, roll it into a ball, flatten it by hand, and roll it out with a rolling pin into a thin round flatbread.
Cook the roti on a hot cast-iron skillet and flip it.
Place the roti directly over an open gas flame until it puffs up and develops brown spots.
Drizzle with ghee and serve.

18050707805760521.ingredients:
croissants
eggs
milk
vanilla
spices
brown sugar
18050707805760521.method:
Tear the croissants into a baking dish.
Mix eggs, milk, vanilla, and spices in a measuring cup.
Pour the custard mixture over the croissants and cover with foil.
Sprinkle brown sugar over the top.
Bake until golden brown.
Serve with syrup.

18114882940773256.ingredients:
roasted Bengal gram (sattu)
curd
mint
coriander
ginger
water
spices
salt
ice
18114882940773256.method:
Grind roasted Bengal gram into sattu powder.
Add the curd, mint, coriander, ginger, water, spices, salt, ice, and the freshly made sattu powder to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Pour the drink into a glass with crushed ice and garnish with a mint leaf.

18348968449245444.ingredients:
white onion
green bell pepper
red bell pepper
yellow bell pepper
oil
seasoning
dry fusilli pasta
tomato sauce
rinsed black beans
water
shredded cheese
18348968449245444.method:
Chop the white onion and the green, red, and yellow bell peppers.
Sauté the veggies in an Instant Pot with oil and add the seasoning.
Pour in water, dry fusilli pasta, tomato sauce, and rinsed black beans.
Close the lid and pressure cook.
Open the lid, stir the pasta, and top with shredded cheese.

18080077100124868.ingredients:
light brown broth
uncooked white rice
melted butter or oil
chopped broccoli florets
seasoning powder
shredded cheddar cheese
18080077100124868.method:
Pour the broth into a pot and add the uncooked white rice.
Stir and cook the rice until fluffy.
Add a stream of melted butter or oil.
Add the chopped broccoli florets and a sprinkle of seasoning powder.
Add a large amount of shredded cheddar cheese.
Mix everything together into a creamy cheesy broccoli rice.

18003277082868809.ingredients:
half a block of firm tofu
Greek yogurt
2 cups multigrain atta
1 cup soya bean atta
18003277082868809.method:
Blend half a block of firm tofu with Greek yogurt.
Mix it with 2 cups multigrain atta and 1 cup soya bean atta and knead into a dough.
Rest the dough for 1-2 hours.
Roll out the rotis.
Cook on a tawa and directly over a gas flame until puffed.

18092630582285555.ingredients:
edamame
baby corn
potatoes
green beans
cucumber
mint
yogurt
mango
dal (lentils)
steamed white rice
18092630582285555.method: Assemble the thali by adding each component to its compartment: edamame & baby corn sauté, aloo beans poriyal (potatoes and green beans), cucumber mint raita, mango dal, and steamed white rice.

17954065040964254.ingredients:
cookie dough
vanilla cheesecake filling
blueberry sauce
17954065040964254.method:
Press an indentation into each dough ball with the back of a small spoon.
Bake the cookie bases.
Stir the vanilla cheesecake filling until smooth.
Spoon the filling into the wells of the baked cookie bases.
Spoon blueberry sauce on top.

18091542842590124.ingredients:
cubed chicken thighs
ginger garlic paste
salt
pepper
Kashmiri chili powder
turmeric powder
lemon or lime juice
spray oil
thinly sliced red onions
green chilies
coriander
Greek yogurt
garlic pickle
mustard oil
kasuri methi
18091542842590124.method:
Marinate the cubed chicken thighs with ginger garlic paste, salt, pepper, Kashmiri chili powder, turmeric powder, and lemon/lime juice.
Cook the chicken in a pan with spray oil until golden brown.
Mix the cooked chicken with thinly sliced red onions, green chilies, and coriander.
In a separate bowl, prepare a sauce with Greek yogurt and garlic pickle.
Make a tadka with mustard oil, turmeric, and kasuri methi and add it to the yogurt.
Combine the yogurt mixture with the chicken.
Top with more coriander and serve with roti, paratha, or rice.

18102403474777628.method:
Crack multiple eggs into a large bowl and add milk and salt.
Blend with an immersion blender until frothy.
Strain the mixture for smoothness.
Pour it into a square baking pan.
Place the pan in a larger dish filled with hot water and cover with foil.
Bake until set.
Cool, remove the egg slab, and cut it into nine neat squares.
Layer the patties with parchment paper in a glass storage container and refrigerate or freeze.

18094927592166218.ingredients:
roasted chana dal
green chilies
chopped ginger
cumin seeds
salt
puffed rice
corn
chopped onion
cilantro
raw mango
crackers
18094927592166218.method:
Gather the roasted chana dal, green chilies, chopped ginger, and cumin seeds on a plate and add extra salt.
Grind them in a small mixer on pulse mode to make a dry green chutney.
Sprinkle the chutney over a bowl of bhel made with puffed rice, corn, chopped onion, cilantro, raw mango, and crackers.
Mix everything together and serve.

17861817099683327.ingredients:
cumin seeds
chopped red onion
dried red chilies
turmeric
powdered spices
peanuts
garlic
green chilies
cilantro
yogurt
cubed paneer
17861817099683327.method:
Toast cumin seeds in a wok.
Add the chopped red onion and dried red chilies, then turmeric and other powdered spices.
Blend peanuts, garlic, green chilies, and cilantro into a coarse green paste and stir it into the wok.
Pour in the yogurt and mix until the sauce simmers.
Add the cubed paneer and gently coat it in the sauce.
Finish with fresh cilantro.

17945361357168967.ingredients:
Oats
Chicken broth
Salt
Pepper
Spring onion greens
Egg
Mushrooms
Chili oil
17945361357168967.method: Cook the oats in chicken broth instead of water. Stir in salt, pepper, and spring onion greens. Spoon into a bowl and top with a boiled egg, mushrooms, and chili oil.

17855919627526805.ingredients:
Jowar flour
Salt
Ghee
Hot water
17855919627526805.method: Mix the jowar flour, salt, ghee, and hot water into a dough. Rest the dough, then knead it. Roll out the rotis and cook them on a griddle and then over a gas flame until soft and fluffy.

18586910275046087.method: Heat the liquid in a pot on a gas burner. Pour the hot liquid into a bowl of flour and mix with a whisk to form a dough.

18100691515792529.ingredients:
Dried chickpeas
Chickpea cooking liquid
Tahini
Lemon juice
Salt
Olive oil
Paprika
18100691515792529.method: Soak the dried chickpeas overnight in salted water. Pressure-cook them for 30 minutes (or cook them on the stove for two hours). Drain, reserving the cooking liquid, and blend the chickpeas with some of their cooking liquid until very smooth; cover and refrigerate overnight. Freeze the leftover chickpea water separately. The next day, blend the chilled chickpea puree together with the frozen chickpea water. Finish with tahini, lemon juice, salt, and olive oil, blending to a glossy, ultra-smooth texture. Plate with a swirl and top with whole chickpeas, olive oil, and paprika.

17995904885925061.ingredients:
Split yellow moong dal
Ghee
Milk cream
Peanuts
Melon seeds
Powdered sugar
17995904885925061.method: Roast the split yellow moong dal in a wok, let it cool, and grind it into a fine powder. Cook the powder with ghee until fragrant. Stir in the milk cream. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and add crushed peanuts, whole roasted melon seeds, and powdered sugar. Pour melted ghee over the mix and form it by hand into small round ladoos.

18137492395518782.ingredients:
Plain yogurt
Fresh mango
Pistachios
Maple syrup
Dark chocolate
18137492395518782.method: Whisk the plain yogurt in a bowl. Add diced fresh mango, chopped pistachios, and a drizzle of maple syrup, and mix everything together. Spoon small mounds of the mixture onto a plate and place them in the freezer to firm up. Melt the dark chocolate, dip each frozen cluster into the chocolate to coat it, and return them to the freezer until set.

17986930913975912.ingredients:
Puris
Potatoes
Sev
Boondi
Fresh cilantro
Mint
Green chilies
Ginger
Garlic
Lemon juice
Dried red chilies
Tamarind water
Tomatoes
Red onions
Red chili powder
Spices
17986930913975912.method: For the green chutney, blend fresh cilantro, mint, green chilies, ginger, garlic, spices, and lemon juice into a smooth paste. For the red chutney, soak the dried red chilies with garlic, then blend them with sev, tamarind water, and spices into a thick sauce. Place the fried puris on a plate and top each with mashed potato. Sprinkle with red chili powder, add diced tomatoes and chopped red onions, and spoon both chutneys over each puri. Finish with a generous shower of sev, boondi, and fresh cilantro leaves.

17968689780013370.ingredients:
Almond flour
Almonds
Baking powder
Maple syrup
Milk
17968689780013370.method: Chop the almonds. Mix the almond flour, baking powder, maple syrup, milk, and chopped almonds into a dough. Shape the cookies and bake them in the oven.

17950539204121134.ingredients:
1/2 cup moong dal
Lauki (bottle gourd)
Green chili
Garlic
Onion
Capsicum (shimla mirch)
Carrot
Beans
Turmeric powder
Red chili flakes
Chaat masala
Cumin
Salt
1/2 cup suji (semolina)
1/4 cup curd
Fresh coriander
Baking soda
Oil
White sesame seeds
Mustard seeds
17950539204121134.method: Soak the moong dal, then grind it with green chili and garlic. Peel and grate the lauki and mix it with chopped onion, capsicum, grated carrot, and chopped beans. Add turmeric powder, red chili flakes, chaat masala, cumin, salt, the suji, curd, and fresh coriander. Mix in the baking soda last. Spoon the batter into hot oil in a pan with white sesame seeds and mustard seeds, and fry until crisp on both sides.

18116616382659664.ingredients:
Tofu
Water
Atta (whole wheat flour)
Olive oil
18116616382659664.method: Blend the tofu with water. Mix it with atta flour to form a dough. Roll out the rotis and cook them on a pan. Drizzle the finished roti with olive oil.

17990461754755464.ingredients:
Pumpkin seeds
Melon seeds
Sunflower seeds
Poppy seeds
Sesame seeds
Flax seeds
Chia seeds
Peanuts
Makhana (fox nuts)
Ghee
Dates
17990461754755464.method: Dry-roast the seven seeds - pumpkin, melon, sunflower, poppy, sesame, flax, and chia - together in a pan, grind them into a coarse powder, and set aside. Separately roast the peanuts and makhana and grind them. Cook chopped dates in a pan with ghee until they form a paste. Combine all the powders in a large bowl with melted ghee and the date paste, mix by hand until bindable, and roll into balls.

17851746975645117.ingredients:
Peanuts
Coriander seeds
Chana dal
Urad dal
Cumin
Dried red chilies
Green chilies
Sesame seeds
Oil
Garlic
Cucumber
Red onion
Turmeric
Salt
Cilantro
Curry leaves
17851746975645117.method: Roast the peanuts, coriander seeds, chana dal, urad dal, cumin, dried red chilies, green chilies, and sesame seeds in oil. Separately fry the garlic, sliced cucumber, and red onion with turmeric and salt. Grind the roasted spice mixture in a mortar, add the cooked cucumber and onion, and pound everything together. Finish with chopped raw onion, cilantro, and a tempering of curry leaves in hot oil.

18067562612649890.ingredients:
Cumin
Fennel
Red chilies
Curry leaves
Onions
Cashews
Oil
Red chili powder
Water
Paneer
Green chilies
Red onion
18067562612649890.method: Dry-roast the whole spices - cumin, fennel, and red chilies. Add fresh curry leaves to the pan. Saute the onions and cashews in oil, then add red chili powder. Add water to form a sauce and add the cubed paneer. Finish with fresh green chilies and a generous amount of crushed curry leaf powder. Garnish with fresh red onion rings.

18102659773927675.ingredients:
Cumin seeds
Coriander seeds
Fennel seeds
Cinnamon
Cloves
Black pepper
Dry red chilies
Pink salt
Amchur powder
Black salt
Chaat masala
Hing (asafoetida)
Lime juice
Pomegranate seeds
Water
18102659773927675.method: Dry-roast the cumin seeds, coriander seeds, fennel seeds, cinnamon, cloves, black pepper, and dry red chilies in a pan. Transfer them to a grinder jar and add the pink salt, amchur powder, black salt, chaat masala, and hing. Grind everything into a fine powder and store it in a jar. To serve, stir the powder into water with lime juice and pomegranate seeds.

17870183331577842.ingredients:
Chicken
Spices
Yogurt
Cashews
Almonds
Green chilies
Milk
Onions
Cilantro
17870183331577842.method: Marinate the chicken with spices and yogurt. Blend the cashews, almonds, green chilies, and milk into a creamy paste. Cook the chicken in a pan with onions and the cashew paste until it forms a gravy. Garnish with cilantro.

17852449851633018.ingredients:
1 whole cucumber
Ground yellow mustard seeds
Turmeric powder
Ginger
Green chilies
Mint leaves
Water
17852449851633018.method: Chop the cucumber and add it to a jar with the ground yellow mustard seeds, turmeric powder, sliced ginger, green chilies, and mint leaves. Pour in water and mix well. Cover the jar with cloth and keep it at a warm place for 2 days to ferment. Stir the mixture and strain it into a glass.

17878530231521417.ingredients:
Fennel seeds (saunf)
Peppercorns
Gond katira (soaked)
Chia seeds (soaked)
Fennel powder
Black salt
Lemon juice
Water
17878530231521417.method: Grind the fennel seeds and peppercorns. Add the soaked gond katira and soaked chia seeds to a pitcher. Add the ground fennel and peppercorns, fennel powder, black salt, lemon juice, and water, and mix the drink well.

17981116157986154.method: Pour the milk into a bowl and whisk it. Place the bowl inside the Instant Pot, seal it, and cook for six minutes on the 'Pressure Cook' setting. Remove the bowl, cover it with a paper towel, and press down to drain the excess liquid (whey). Place the bowl in the refrigerator to chill and set.

18330461680168513.ingredients:
Almonds
Saffron
Poppy seeds
Oat milk
Chia seeds
Jaggery
Pistachios
Rose petals
18330461680168513.method: Soak the almonds, saffron, and poppy seeds. Blend the soaked ingredients into a smooth paste and combine it with the oat milk. Stir in the soaked saffron, chia seeds, and a touch of melted jaggery. Let the mixture rest until set. Garnish with chopped pistachios and rose petals.

17952125298028238.ingredients:
Oats
Cashews
Almonds
Peanuts
Walnuts
Pistachios
Flaxseeds
Chickpea flour
Butter
Sesame seeds
17952125298028238.method: Measure and combine the oats, cashews, almonds, peanuts, walnuts, pistachios, and flaxseeds in a glass bowl. Incorporate the chickpea flour and softened butter using a whisk and spatula to form a dough. Shape the dough into uniform balls and coat them in sesame seeds. Bake until golden brown.

17873106441542570.ingredients:
Potatoes
Spinach leaves
Cumin seeds
Salt
Turmeric
Chili powder
Garam masala
Flour
Oil
17873106441542570.method: Boil the diced potatoes. Wilt the fresh spinach leaves in a separate pan. Season the cooked potatoes with cumin seeds, salt, turmeric, chili powder, and garam masala. Make a green dough by mixing flour, salt, and pureed spinach; knead and rest the dough, then roll it out. Stuff a ball of the dough with the spiced potato mixture and roll out the paratha. Cook in a pan with oil until golden brown.

18163100239404344.method: Soak the rajma overnight. Blend the ingredients into a batter. Pour the batter into a pan and bake the cake. Glaze the finished cake.

18087051872115658.ingredients:
Cookie dough
Almond filling
Sliced almonds
Powdered sugar
18087051872115658.method: Use a cookie scoop to press an indentation into each dough ball, creating a well. Pipe the almond filling into the well and top generously with sliced almonds. Bake until golden. Dust lightly with powdered sugar.

18026974997593644.method: Blend the cubed paneer, yogurt, and spices into a batter. Cut the broccoli into florets and blanch them in boiling water. Coat the blanched broccoli in the batter and arrange the skewers on a baking sheet. Cook until golden brown.

18301011616272311.ingredients:
Green bell peppers
Red onions
Coriander powder
Jeera (cumin)
Salt
Oil
Green chillies
Curd
18301011616272311.method: Add the sliced green bell peppers and red onions to a bowl with coriander powder, jeera, and salt. Temper jeera in oil in a pan, then add green chillies. Add the prepared vegetables and cook them. Mix in the curd.

18086986099995452.ingredients:
Moong dal
Nuts
Flax seeds
Dates
Water
18086986099995452.method: Toast the moong dal with nuts and flax seeds in an air fryer. Blend the dates with water to create a paste. Mix all the ingredients together and shape them into round balls.

18083614292107655.method: Measure out the gram flour and sugar. Fry the dough pieces until golden brown and mix the ingredients thoroughly. Shape the mixture into laddu balls and top each with almonds.

17872523865538280.ingredients:
Jowar (sorghum)
Yogurt
Chia seeds
Cucumber
Carrot
Ginger
Green chilies
Salt
Pepper
Fresh coriander
Roasted peanuts
Oil
Mustard seeds
Cumin seeds
Dried red chili
Curry leaves
17872523865538280.method: Pressure-cook the soaked jowar grains. Whisk the yogurt in a bowl and add the cooked jowar, soaked chia seeds, grated cucumber, shredded carrot, chopped ginger, green chilies, salt, pepper, fresh coriander, and crushed roasted peanuts; mix well. Heat oil and add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, dried red chili, and curry leaves for a tadka, and pour it over the pudding.

17862754131594277.ingredients:
Boiled chickpeas (kala chana)
Boiled potatoes
Tomatoes
Spring onions
Spices
Tortillas
Butter
Cheese
17862754131594277.method: Mix the boiled chickpeas, boiled potatoes, tomatoes, spring onions, and spices in a bowl. Spread the mixture onto a tortilla, fold it, and cook it in a pan with butter until the cheese melts. Serve with your favorite sauce and pickled onions on the side.

18107862775683749.ingredients:
Soya chunks
Yogurt
Pepper
Salt
Lemon juice
Ginger-garlic
Onion
Green chilies
Cashews
Oil
Butter
Bay leaf
Cinnamon
Cloves
Cardamom powder
Kasuri methi
Fresh coriander
18107862775683749.method: Soak the soya chunks in hot water, then drain them. Marinate the soya with yogurt, pepper, salt, and lemon juice for 15 minutes. Saute the ginger-garlic, onion, green chilies, and cashews in oil, add water, and grind into a paste. Melt butter in a separate pan, add the whole spices (bay leaf, cinnamon, and cloves), and cook the ground paste for 2-3 minutes. Add the marinated soya chunks and more green chilies and cook for 4-5 minutes. Finish with pepper, cardamom powder, kasuri methi, salt, and fresh coriander.

18389872327146560.ingredients:
1/4 cup ragi
1/4 cup chana dal
1/4 cup moong dal
1/4 cup masoor dal
1/4 cup urad dal
1/4 cup idli rice
1/4 cup dosa rice
1 teaspoon methi dana (fenugreek seeds)
Water
Ghee
18389872327146560.method: Measure 1/4 cup each of ragi, chana dal, moong dal, masoor dal, urad dal, idli rice, and dosa rice, plus a teaspoon of methi dana. Wash the mixture and soak it in water covering it by 1.5 inches. Drain the soaked grains, transfer them to a blender with about 2/3 cup plus another 2/3 cup water, and grind into a smooth batter. Pour the batter into a bowl, mix it thoroughly by hand, and leave it overnight to ferment. Heat a cast-iron tawa, pour the batter in a spiral, add ghee, and cook until crisp and golden.

17911862025313918.ingredients:
Cumin
Red chilies
Oil
Coriander powder
Boiled potatoes
17911862025313918.method: Temper the cumin and red chilies in oil. Add a masala mix made with coriander powder. Add the boiled potatoes and stir the mixture together.

17900406537369225.ingredients:
Buttermilk
Beetroot
Salt
Coriander
Green chilies
Rava (semolina)
Ghee
Hing (asafoetida)
Mustard seeds
Urad dal
Chana dal
Cashews
Dry red chilies
Ginger
Onion
Curry leaves
17900406537369225.method: Blend the buttermilk with chopped beetroot and salt, then add coriander and green chilies. Separately roast the rava until fragrant. Temper ghee with hing, mustard seeds, urad dal, chana dal, cashews, dry red chilies, ginger, onion, and curry leaves. Pour in the beetroot-buttermilk mixture. Add the roasted rava and cook until thick. Finish with more ghee.

18081568145520088.ingredients:
Potatoes
Peas (matar)
Tomatoes
Chilies
Spices
Water
Coriander leaves
18081568145520088.method: Add spices to a pan on the stove. Cook the tomatoes and chilies in the pan, then add dry spices and water. Add the potatoes and peas and boil until cooked. Finish with coriander leaves.

18556880203050837.ingredients:
Chickpeas
Tomatoes
Onions
Cucumbers
Green chillies
Fresh coriander
Chaat masala
Cumin powder
Black salt
Tamarind water
Jaggery
Dry mint
18556880203050837.method: Pressure-cook the chickpeas. Mix in chopped tomatoes, onions, cucumbers, and green chillies. Add fresh coriander, chaat masala, cumin powder, and black salt, and mix thoroughly. For the spicy water (paani), combine tamarind water, water, jaggery, dry mint, and more spices.

17978828009808928.ingredients:
Yogurt
Gram flour (besan)
Turmeric
Red chili powder
Salt
Water
Oil
Dried red chilies
Mustard seeds
Cumin
Garlic
Red onion
Curry leaves
Green herbs
Cooked black chickpeas
17978828009808928.method: Pour the yogurt into a blender cup and add the gram flour, turmeric, red chili powder, salt, and water; blend into a smooth mixture. Heat oil in a pot and temper it with dried red chilies, mustard seeds, cumin, minced garlic, chopped red onion, curry leaves, and a large amount of chopped green herbs. Add the cooked black chickpeas and stir. Pour in the blended kadhi mixture and additional water, and simmer.

18097592251912460.ingredients:
Sabudana (tapioca pearls)
Yellow lentils
Water
Milk
Curry leaves
Peanuts
Black peppercorns
18097592251912460.method: Wash the sabudana in a bowl. Fry the yellow lentils in a pressure cooker until golden brown. Combine the fried lentils with the cooked sabudana and water in the pressure cooker and cook. Add milk to enrich the dish. Garnish with fresh curry leaves, peanuts, and black peppercorns.

18121785541521970.ingredients:
Wheat flour
Gram flour
Grated bottle gourd (dudhi)
Methi (fenugreek leaves)
Spices
Lemon juice
Grated coconut
18121785541521970.method: Add the wheat flour, gram flour, grated bottle gourd, methi, spices, and lemon juice to a mixing bowl and knead into a dough. Shape the dough into a log and steam it. Cut the steamed log into pieces and fry until golden. Garnish with grated coconut.

18158401405365695.ingredients:
Flour
Baking soda
Cinnamon
Bananas
Eggs
Vanilla extract
Buttermilk
Walnuts
Chocolate chips
Maple syrup
18158401405365695.method: Mix the dry ingredients - flour, baking soda, and cinnamon - in a large bowl. Add the wet ingredients - mashed bananas, eggs, vanilla extract, and buttermilk. Combine the wet and dry ingredients and gently fold them together. Cook the pancakes in a non-stick pan on the stove, adding chopped walnuts and chocolate chips to the batter. Flip the pancakes and cook on both sides until golden brown. Stack the pancakes and pour maple syrup over them.

17996398499887527.ingredients:
Boiled eggs
Kashmiri red chilli powder
Salt
Potatoes
Yogurt
Cumin powder
Mustard oil
Kasuri methi
17996398499887527.method: Coat the boiled eggs with Kashmiri red chilli powder and salt. Cook the potatoes and roughly cut them into cubes. Prepare a yogurt base by adding cumin powder to the yogurt. Mix all the ingredients together. Prepare a hot tadka of mustard oil and kasuri methi and mix it into the dish.

18176497195372718.ingredients:
Ragi
Idli rice
Urad dal
Fenugreek seeds
Water
18176497195372718.method: Wash and soak the ragi, idli rice, urad dal, and fenugreek seeds. Grind the soaked ingredients into a smooth batter. Mix the batter and leave it to ferment. Steam the batter into soft, spongy idlis.

17952503900935473.ingredients:
Mustard oil
Garlic
Ginger
Spices
Boiled potatoes
Water
Fresh coriander
Kasuri methi
17952503900935473.method: Add mustard oil, garlic, ginger, and spices to a pot on the stove. Add the boiled potatoes and water and stir the mixture. Finish with fresh coriander and kasuri methi.

18139265011412505.ingredients:
Gond (edible gum)
Urad dal
Nuts
Silver leaf
18139265011412505.method: Cook the ingredients in a wok. Cool the mixture, then shape it by hand into small, round balls. Decorate the ladoos with nuts and silver leaf.

17929382493169923.ingredients:
Oil
Peanuts
Chana dal
Green chilies
Grated fresh coconut
Tamarind
Mint leaves
Salt
Small onions
Water
Fresh coriander leaves
Mustard seeds
Urad dal
Cumin seeds
Dried red chilies
Curry leaves
Asafoetida
17929382493169923.method: Heat oil and roast the peanuts until golden. Add the chana dal, green chilies, grated fresh coconut, tamarind, and mint leaves and saute briefly. Let the mixture cool, then grind it with salt, small onions, water, and fresh coriander leaves. Transfer the ground paste to a bowl. Prepare a tempering with oil, mustard seeds, urad dal, cumin seeds, dried red chilies, curry leaves, and asafoetida, pour it over the chutney, and mix in.

18065899043217505.ingredients:
Soaked yellow moong dal
Ginger
Green chilies
Water
Spinach
Carrot
Onion
Garlic
Jeera (cumin)
Ajwain
Saunf (fennel)
Dhania (coriander seeds)
Salt
Red chili powder
Asafoetida (hing)
2 tablespoons curd
18065899043217505.method: Blend the soaked yellow moong dal with ginger, green chilies, and water. Mix in chopped spinach, grated carrot, onion, and garlic, along with a coarsely ground spice blend of jeera, ajwain, saunf, and dhania. Add salt, red chili powder, a pinch of asafoetida, and two tablespoons of curd to make a thick batter. Cook the batter on a hot tawa until crispy on both sides. Serve with a pink beetroot-yogurt dip.

18056875361662999.method: Soak the sweet potatoes in salted water. Wrap them in aluminum foil and bake them in an air fryer at 320 degrees F for one hour. Remove the foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes at 400 degrees F.

17961813189008679.ingredients:
Bajri (pearl millet)
Moong
Palak (spinach)
Onions
Herbs
Spices
Curd
Cumin seeds
17961813189008679.method: Soak the bajri grains. Prepare the filling with moong, palak, finely chopped onions, herbs, and spices. Blend the mixture into a thick batter. Cook on a pan until golden brown. Serve with curd topped with cumin seeds.

18089427166778186.method: Blend the jowar dosa batter. Blend a chutney, keeping it coarse in texture. Heat the pan, pour in the batter, and add ghee. Cook until crispy.

17945469663089726.ingredients:
Moong dal
Vegetables
Tofu
Mint leaves
Mayonnaise
17945469663089726.method: Finely chop the vegetables in a food chopper. Add the tofu to the mixture along with the moong dal and combine. Shape the mixture into fritters and cook them on a pan until golden brown. Serve with mint mayo sauce.

17936067392990431.method: Dry-roast the whole spices. Saute the onions. Blend a creamy mix. Combine everything with the peas and cook it all together.

18086624498512755.ingredients:
Black salt
Chaat masala
Water
Ginger
Mint leaves (pudina)
Lemon juice
18086624498512755.method: Mix the black salt and chaat masala on a plate. Add water to a glass pot on the stove, then add the ginger and mint leaves, cover the pot, and let it boil. Strain the tea into a glass cup, add lemon juice, and stir. Garnish with a mint leaf.

18054210485350576.method: Stuff the dates with peanut butter. Dip the stuffed dates in chocolate.

18543299404016539.ingredients:
Semolina
Hot water
Chickpeas
Ginger
Garlic
Green chilies
Cumin
Red chili powder
Salt
Mustard seeds
Fresh coriander
18543299404016539.method: Mix the semolina with hot water to make the dough. Soak the chickpeas, then blend them with ginger, garlic, green chilies, cumin, red chili powder, and salt to make the stuffing. Knead the dough, roll it out, and use a round cutter to cut small circles. Place the stuffing in the circles and fold them into half-moon shapes. Steam for 8-10 minutes. Garnish with a tadka of mustard seeds, cumin, green chilies, and red chili powder, and finish with fresh coriander.

18096498337748625.method: Prepare the paneer, tomatoes, and sourdough bread. Assemble the toastie with the pesto and paneer. Cook the toastie.

18136248262482753.ingredients:
Garlic
Fresh coriander
Lemon juice
Salt
18136248262482753.method: Mince the garlic in a wok. Chop the fresh coriander and add it along with the squeezed lemon juice. Add salt, stir, and let the soup simmer.

18085909717841778.ingredients:
onions
garlic
cumin seeds
dried red chilies
curry leaves
fresh coriander leaves
yogurt
water
salt
18085909717841778.method: Sauté the onions, garlic, and cumin seeds in a pan until fragrant. Add the dried red chilies and curry leaves and cook briefly. Blend the spices with the fresh coriander leaves into a spice paste. Mix the yogurt with water and salt to thin it slightly. Stir the spice paste into the yogurt mixture until well combined.

17877072705444598.ingredients:
lauki
coriander
black sesame seeds
green chilli and ginger paste
salt
sooji
rice flour
curd
17877072705444598.method: Add the shredded lauki, chopped coriander, black sesame seeds, green chilli and ginger paste, salt, sooji, rice flour, and curd to a bowl. Mix into a thick batter. Cook the batter in a small pan until golden-brown and crispy.

17892167262380036.ingredients:
red onions
garlic
Thai red chili peppers
tofu
corn starch
soy sauce
sugar
Thai basil
17892167262380036.method: Press and crumble the tofu, coat it with corn starch, and bake it. Prepare a sauce using soy sauce and sugar. Stir-fry the baked tofu with the sauce and fresh Thai basil.

18088364317821497.ingredients:
carrots
dates
ghee
cardamom powder
milk
milk powder
dry fruits
18088364317821497.method: Blend the carrots and dates into a puree. Sauté the puree with ghee and cardamom powder. Let the mixture cool, then shape it into round balls. Prepare a creamy milk base in a pot with milk, milk powder, and cardamom. Add the carrot balls and simmer. Garnish with dry fruits and serve warm.

18425924188119101.ingredients:
oil
mustard seeds
green chillies
garlic
dried red chillies
curry leaves
turmeric
pepper powder
cumin powder
onions
tomatoes
water
tamarind paste
salt
coconut milk
fresh coriander
18425924188119101.method: Heat oil and temper the mustard seeds until they pop. Add the green chillies, garlic, dried red chillies, curry leaves, turmeric, pepper powder, cumin powder, and onions. Add the chopped tomatoes, water, tamarind paste, and salt. Bring to a boil, then simmer. Stir in the coconut milk and fresh coriander.

18098721775741197.method: Mix the poha, eggs, onions, and herbs together. Cook the mixture into an omelette.

17985718967867840.method: Dry roast the urad dal. Make a green spice paste. Combine all the ingredients and cook together.

18547889116044864.ingredients:
yogurt
besan flour
water
fenugreek leaves (methi)
turmeric
spices
ghee or oil
cumin
coriander seeds
mustard seeds
red chili powder
onions
garlic
green chilies
dried red chilies
18547889116044864.method: Whisk the yogurt with the besan flour and water. Sauté the chopped fenugreek leaves with turmeric and spices. Combine the yogurt mixture with the fenugreek and simmer slowly until thickened. Prepare a tadka with ghee or oil, cumin, coriander seeds, mustard seeds, red chili powder, sliced onions, garlic, green chilies, and dried red chilies. Pour the tadka over the kadhi and stir it in.

18086467610093735.ingredients:
tofu
salt
water
coconut milk
spices
noodles
butter
18086467610093735.method: Boil the tofu in salt water. Blend the boiled tofu with coconut milk and spices into a creamy sauce. Serve the sauce over noodles with a pat of butter.

18317887093173061.method: Sauté the ingredients. Add water and boil the soup.

17900909667335458.method: Boil the soya chunks. Prepare the sauce. Combine the soya chunks with the sauce.

18048835646388164.method: Toast the nuts and spices. Prepare the gond. Grind the mixture. Roll the mixture into balls.

17858410110468878.ingredients:
bread
garlic
onions
green chilies
mushrooms
wheat flour
milk
oregano
chili flakes
salt
processed cheese
cilantro
17858410110468878.method: Toast the bread. Sauté the garlic, onions, and green chilies. Add the mushrooms and cook until crispy. Stir in the wheat flour and milk to make a creamy sauce, and season with oregano, chili flakes, and salt. Add the processed cheese and cilantro. Spoon the mushroom sauce onto the toasted bread.

18078394184143288.method: Roast the vermicelli with the nuts and spices. Prepare a milk-based custard. Assemble the dessert in layers in a glass dish.

17863881693487441.method: Temper the vegetables and spices in a pan. Blend them into a smooth curry. Serve over rice.

17978629430924095.method: Blend the chutney. Form the pinwheels. Bake the pinwheels.

17981214683919738.method: Mix the ingredients and knead into a dough. Roll out the dough and cut it into pieces. Fry until golden and crispy.

17962609916809378.ingredients:
sweet potato
ghee
water
powdered jaggery
cardamom powder
walnuts
17962609916809378.method: Peel and grate the sweet potato. Heat a pan, add ghee, and roast the grated sweet potato. Add water, cover the pan, and cook. Add the powdered jaggery, cardamom powder, and roasted chopped walnuts.

17970153521953304.ingredients:
coriander
red chili
garam masala
yogurt
potato
boiled chickpeas
oil
17970153521953304.method: Crush and mix the coriander, red chili, and garam masala into a spice paste. Make a yogurt and potato paste. Cook the masala in a kadhai. Add the boiled chickpeas. Finish with a tempering of oil.

17962905011969213.method: Sauté the vegetables and nuts. Blend them into a puree. Combine the puree with the paneer mixture and cook into a creamy curry.

17863692948466890.ingredients:
onions
chilies
spinach
eggs
cooked rice
fresh coriander
lemon juice
17863692948466890.method: Sauté the onions and chilies. Add the spinach. Crack in the eggs and scramble them. Add the cooked rice and mix thoroughly. Garnish with fresh coriander and lemon juice.

18062452454364035.ingredients:
water
ginger-chili paste
cumin seeds
ajwain
sesame seeds
salt
coriander leaves
rice flour
18062452454364035.method: Boil water and add the ginger-chili paste, cumin seeds, ajwain, sesame seeds, and salt. Bring the mixture to a boil and add the coriander leaves. Add the rice flour, stirring continuously to avoid lumps. Cover the pan and cook on low heat.

17992151570837442.ingredients:
white rice
barley
soybean sprouts
soy sauce
gochugaru
17992151570837442.method: Soak the rice. Layer the rice with the soybean sprouts in a rice cooker and cook. Make a marinade with soy sauce and gochugaru. Pour the marinade over the cooked rice.

18174825265346934.ingredients:
roasted chana (brown chickpeas)
ghee
almonds
pumpkin seeds
pistachios
dates
raisins
cardamom powder
saffron
pistachio powder
18174825265346934.method: Remove the husks from the roasted chana by rubbing them in a cloth. Fry the chana in ghee until golden and aromatic. Add the almonds, pumpkin seeds, and pistachios and toast them together. Transfer the mixture to a food processor with the dates, raisins, cardamom powder, and saffron, and blend into a coarse, sticky mixture. Shape the mixture by hand into balls and roll them in pistachio powder.

17921105451014654.ingredients:
black chickpeas
spinach
curd
cumin seeds
onions
green chilies
ginger-garlic paste
dry spices
fresh coriander
17921105451014654.method: Soak the black chickpeas overnight, then pressure-cook them. Blanch the spinach, combine it with a small amount of curd, and blend into a smooth puree. Sauté the cumin seeds, finely chopped onions, green chilies, and ginger-garlic paste in a pan. Add the dry spices, then a small amount of the water from the cooked chickpeas, and then the spinach puree. Bring to a boil, add the cooked chickpeas, and simmer for a few minutes. Garnish with fresh coriander.

18058366892434207.method: Crack an egg onto the papad. Add cheese and vegetables. Fold it into an omelette and cook.

18052153451623023.ingredients:
mushrooms
ginger garlic chili paste
fried onion paste
coriander powder
garam masala
chicken masala
jeera powder
turmeric powder
curd
salt
mustard oil
whole spices
fresh coriander leaves
18052153451623023.method: Clean the mushrooms in water and slice them into thin pieces. Mix the mushrooms with the ginger garlic chili paste, fried onion paste, coriander powder, garam masala, chicken masala, jeera powder, turmeric powder, curd, and salt, and stir thoroughly to coat. Add the marinated mushrooms to a hot pan with mustard oil and whole spices. Stir, cover with a lid, and cook for approximately 12 minutes. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves.

18099165883618699.ingredients:
cucumber
salt
spring onion
garlic
chilli flakes
red chilli powder
soy sauce
rice vinegar
sesame oil
sugar
sesame seeds
18099165883618699.method: Slice the cucumber. Salt the cucumber to remove excess water. Add the spring onion, garlic, chilli flakes, red chilli powder, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, sugar, and sesame seeds. Mix everything by hand.

18066975547844166.ingredients:
poha (flattened rice)
turmeric
salt
sugar
lemon juice
oil
hing
cumin
fennel
mustard seeds
green chillies
chopped onions
sev
pomegranate seeds
jirvan masala
jalebi
18066975547844166.method: Rinse the poha. Toss the poha with turmeric, salt, sugar, and lemon juice. Heat oil in a pan and sizzle the hing, cumin, fennel, mustard seeds, and green chillies to make a tadka. Pour the hot tadka over the poha. Steam the poha. Garnish with chopped onions, sev, pomegranate seeds, lemon juice, and a dusting of jirvan masala. Serve with hot jalebis on the side.

17909560908192687.ingredients:
fresh cilantro
green chilies
red chili flakes
green onions
17909560908192687.method: Chop the cilantro and green chilies in a food processor. Add them to a pot of water with the other spices and bring to a boil. Add a white powder, such as flour or cornstarch, to thicken the mixture. Steam the mixture in a steamer basket. Roll the cooked mixture into balls. Garnish with red chili flakes and green onions.

18305923591300485.method: Chop the garlic and chilies. Cook the dish in a wok. Serve with rice and a fried egg.

18048062423280133.ingredients:
dahi (yogurt)
ghee
honey
milk
sugar
sooji
elaichi powder
chopped nuts
baking powder
baking soda
18048062423280133.method: Mix the dahi, ghee, honey, milk, sugar, sooji, elaichi powder, chopped nuts, baking powder, and baking soda in a bowl. Fill muffin cups with the batter. Bake the cupcakes.

18020291987537690.method: Pour oil into a pan. Add the diced vegetables and rice. Spread the egg liquid over the mixture. Roll the mixture into a cylindrical shape.

18062118230351302.ingredients:
jaggery
coconut
nuts
ragi
water
ghee
salt
18062118230351302.method: Cook the jaggery, coconut, and nuts in a pan to make the filling. Mix the ragi with water, ghee, and salt to make a dough, and allow it to cool. Shape the modaks using a mold, or by hand into a bowl-like cavity, fill them with the prepared mixture, and seal them into a ball.

17878601388265430.ingredients:
potatoes
yogurt (dahi)
salt
red spice
onions
cilantro
mustard oil
tempering seeds
17878601388265430.method: Boil the potatoes and dice them. Add the yogurt to a bowl and season with salt and red spice. Add the sliced onions and chopped cilantro and mix. Heat the mustard oil, add the tempering seeds, and pour the sizzling tadka over the mixture.

17917070406158073.method: Stir-fry the eggs with pesto. Layer with tomatoes.

18099011821591808.method: Toast the pumpkin seeds. Roast the tomatoes and garlic. Grind all the ingredients together in a molcajete.

18130900987444615.ingredients:
mini potatoes
shredded Parmesan cheese
seasonings
mozzarella
18130900987444615.method: Boil the mini potatoes. Score them in a criss-cross pattern to create a flat smash. Layer them, on parchment paper, with shredded Parmesan cheese, seasonings, and mozzarella. Bake.

18096011698617532.method: Pour the millets into a bowl and mix with water. Cook on an induction cooktop with the jaggery and butter until the mixture thickens. Add the spices and stir the mixture thoroughly. Shape the cooked mixture into balls.

18057830732471481.ingredients:
raw green bananas
water
oil
Kashmiri red chili powder
amchur powder
chaat masala
black salt
18057830732471481.method: Boil the raw green bananas in water for about five minutes. Remove them from the water and allow them to cool. Peel the bananas and cut them into thick, rectangular pieces. Fry the pieces in hot oil until golden brown. Press the fried pieces with a wooden pestle to make them crispy, then double-fry them. Toss the crispy pieces with Kashmiri red chili powder, amchur powder, chaat masala, and black salt.

17906867544173489.ingredients:
garlic
ginger
onions
edamame
mushrooms
oil
sesame oil
soy sauce
vinegar
chili sauce
salt
basil
rice paper wrappers
water
17906867544173489.method: Sauté the garlic, ginger, onions, edamame, and mushrooms in a pan with oil and sesame oil. Mix the soy sauce, vinegar, chili sauce, and salt into a sauce. Combine the cooked filling with the sauce and chopped basil, then let it cool. Soak the rice paper wrappers in water and roll the filling in them. Pan-fry the rolls until golden and crispy.

17935634103052018.ingredients:
sabudana pearls
water
sugar
milk
almonds
pistachios
17935634103052018.method: Soak the sabudana pearls in water, then drain them. Grind them coarsely in a mixer jar with a spoon of sugar. Roll the mixture by hand into small, smooth balls. Pour milk into a pan, add sugar, drop in the sabudana balls, and cook until they swell and the milk thickens. Sprinkle chopped almonds and pistachios on top.

18518307076019273.method: Wash and peel the cucumber. Blend the ingredients together.

18043245647539838.ingredients:
water
ginger
cardamom
cloves
cinnamon
black pepper
loose Assam tea leaves
sugar
milk
18043245647539838.method: Add water to a saucepan on the stove. Crush the ginger, cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, and black pepper in a mortar and pestle. Add the crushed spices to the boiling water, followed by the loose Assam tea leaves and sugar. Stir in the milk until it reaches the desired consistency. Strain the chai and pour it into a mug.

17870040381343098.ingredients:
yellow lentils
coriander
cumin
spices
flour
oil
water
17870040381343098.method: Grind the yellow lentils. Coarsely grind the coriander and cumin. Mix the lentils, the coriander and cumin mixture, and the spices with the flour, oil, and water. Knead the dough. Roll out the dough and cook the flatbreads on a hot tawa until golden-brown.

18255806191274122.ingredients:
sweet corn kernels
garlic cloves
green chilies
coriander leaves
shredded cheese
chaat masala
dry mango powder (amchur)
chili flakes
salt
dough
oil or ghee
butter
18255806191274122.method: Pulse the sweet corn kernels, garlic cloves, green chilies, and coriander leaves in a grinder into a coarse mixture. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and combine with the shredded cheese, chaat masala, dry mango powder, chili flakes, and salt. Place the filling onto rolled dough, seal it, and roll it flat again. Cook on a hot pan with oil or ghee, brushing with more fat and flipping, until golden-brown with charred spots. Finish with a pat of butter.

17970169205748861.ingredients:
spinach leaves
vegetables
gram flour
cumin seeds
oil
17970169205748861.method: Place the spiced vegetable filling onto the center of a spinach leaf. Dip the filled leaf into a thick gram flour batter to coat it. Deep-fry the coated leaves in hot oil until golden-brown and crispy.

17932536152919216.ingredients:
fish steaks
dried red chilies
curry leaves
onions
lemon
17932536152919216.method: Marinate the fish steaks with a yellow marinade. Combine the dried red chilies and curry leaves into a masala paste and mix it into the fish. Fry the fish in a pan, turning it with a spatula, until it forms a rich, dark masala crust. Serve garnished with sliced onions and lemon wedges.

18101199433519211.ingredients:
garlic cloves
lemon rinds
olive oil
butter
Calabrian chili crisp
gnocchi
pasta water
fresh basil leaves
Parmesan cheese
18101199433519211.method: Cook the garlic cloves with the lemon rinds and olive oil in a small pot until golden brown and tender. Transfer the confit to a food processor with the butter and Calabrian chili crisp, and blend into a smooth, spicy butter sauce. Combine the sauce with cooked gnocchi in a pan. Toss everything together with pasta water to create a glossy coating. Garnish with fresh basil leaves and grated Parmesan cheese.

18054729095211194.ingredients:
yogurt
cucumbers
red onions
broad beans
snap peas
asparagus
olive oil
sunflower seeds
feta cheese
18054729095211194.method: Spread the creamy yogurt base on a plate. Chop the cucumbers, red onions, broad beans, snap peas, and asparagus. Whisk the olive oil and other dressing ingredients in a bowl. Transfer the chopped vegetables to a large mixing bowl, add the sunflower seeds, and crumble the feta cheese over them. Toss all the ingredients together. Plate the salad and add a final drizzle of dressing.

18020890622503023.ingredients:
palak leaves
onions
garlic
oil
cooked rice
cilantro
18020890622503023.method: Chop the palak leaves, onions, and garlic. Blend the onions and garlic into a paste, and blend the palak into a paste. Heat oil in a steel pan. Fry the onion-garlic paste until aromatic, then add the palak paste. Cook the masala for several minutes. Combine with cooked rice and garnish with chopped cilantro.

18080433562672870.method: Grind and mix the grated potatoes, semia, and spices into a batter. Shape the mixture into balls. Fry the balls in hot oil.

18043149086527721.ingredients:
TVP (Textured Vegetable Protein)
hot water
veggie bouillon
spices
soy sauce
vital wheat gluten
flatbread
shredded purple cabbage
white sauce
18043149086527721.method: Rehydrate the TVP with hot water. Add the veggie bouillon, spices, and soy sauce. Add the vital wheat gluten and mix it in. Serve the meat substitute in a flatbread with shredded purple cabbage and a white sauce.

18061528382059403.ingredients:
coriander
cumin seeds (jeera)
garlic
ginger
green chillies
rai (mustard seeds)
hing
spices
water
boiled potatoes
garam masala
fresh coriander
bread (pav)
butter
18061528382059403.method: Add the coriander, cumin seeds, garlic, ginger, and green chillies to a mortar and mash them into a paste for the green chutney. Add the chutney to a pan with a base of rai, jeera, hing, and other spices, along with water, to create a thick, green curry. Add the boiled potatoes, garam masala, and fresh coriander. Fry a slice of bread in a pan with butter and spices to prepare the pav.

18080417677651259.ingredients:
zucchini
spices
chickpeas
green chilies
coriander leaves
18080417677651259.method: Chop the zucchini into small cubes. Cook the zucchini in a pan on the stove with the spices, chickpeas, green chilies, and coriander leaves.

17848566384410968.ingredients:
cooked ragi sprouts
grated carrot
yogurt
flour
spices
sesame seeds
fresh cilantro
17848566384410968.method: Mix the ragi sprouts, grated carrot, yogurt, flour, and spices into a thick batter. Spread the batter evenly on a hot non-stick pan. Add toppings of sesame seeds and fresh cilantro. Flip the chilla and cook the other side.

18049166057007253.ingredients:
curd
moringa powder
mint leaves
chilli
ginger
salt
saunf (fennel seeds)
cumin powder
ice cubes
18049166057007253.method: Add the curd, moringa powder, mint leaves, chilli, ginger, salt, saunf, and cumin powder to a blender jar. Blend the ingredients together. Pour the drink into a glass filled with ice cubes.

17945764811946966.method: Blend the dry lentils. Cook the mixture. Bake it. Cut it into chips.

17868353628318542.ingredients:
whole yellow lentils
white rice
water
potatoes
onions
zucchini
carrots
peas
sesame seeds
green leaves
17868353628318542.method: Mix the whole yellow lentils and white rice in a pot, add water, and blend the mixture. Add the chopped potatoes, onions, zucchini, carrots, and peas. Season the batter and pour it into a baking pan. Bake until golden-brown. Top with sesame seeds and green leaves.

17893678122174247.ingredients:
rice
lentils
garlic
ginger
chili
onion
tomato
spinach
17893678122174247.method: Cook the rice and lentils in a pressure cooker. Prepare a tempering in a pan with the garlic, ginger, chili, onion, and tomato. Blanch the spinach and puree it, then add it to the masala. Combine the spinach masala with the cooked rice and lentils. Finish with a final sizzling tempering of garlic and spices.

17884040655228520.ingredients:
cauliflower rice
chickpeas
green onions
chapati
curd dressing
17884040655228520.method: Mix the cauliflower rice and chickpeas with chopped green onions to make the filling. Place the filling onto a fresh chapati. Spread a generous layer of creamy curd dressing evenly over the top.

18154878469345083.ingredients:
ginger
water
cumin seeds
fresh coriander leaves
18154878469345083.method: Grate the ginger and mix it with water and cumin seeds in a bowl. Transfer the mixture to a pan and heat it. Add fresh coriander leaves to the pan. Pour into a cup and serve.

17884107174224906.method: Grind a spice paste and prepare a dry paste. Cook the whole eggplants and potato with the pastes in a pressure cooker.

18261195550287545.ingredients:
flour
cooked moong dal
Indian spices
18261195550287545.method: Mix the flour, cooked moong dal, and spices together in a bowl to form a dough. Rest the dough, then roll it out into a thin, round shape. Cook the paratha on a tawa until golden brown and crispy on both sides.

18088448935491233.ingredients:
sweet potatoes
ground beef
avocado
cottage cheese
hot sauce
18088448935491233.method: Roast the sweet potatoes and season the ground beef. Assemble the bowl with the roasted sweet potatoes and seasoned ground beef, then add the avocado, cottage cheese, and hot sauce.

18154251760353012.ingredients:
cooked sweet potatoes
green herbs
paratha
oil
18154251760353012.method: Add chopped green herbs and a light-brown spice to the cooked sweet potatoes and mix. Spread the sweet potato filling onto a paratha, roll it up into a log, and cut it into bite-sized rounds. Pan-fry the bites in oil in a non-stick pan until golden brown and cooked through.

17868378870221674.ingredients:
fish fillets
ginger
garlic
green chilies
shallots
curry leaves
coriander leaves
peppercorns
corn flour
oil
green onions
lemon wedges
17868378870221674.method: Add the ginger, garlic, green chilies, shallots, curry leaves, coriander leaves, and peppercorns to a blender and blend into a green masala paste. Marinate the fish fillets with the paste and corn flour. Cook the marinated fish in a tawa with oil and curry leaves. Garnish with chopped green onions and lemon wedges.

17882856627125493.method: Blend the ingredients together. Mix the batter and bake the brownies.

18352562800177431.ingredients:
moringa powder (from dried moringa leaves)
nuts
seeds
raisins or dates
roasted ragi flour
ghee (if needed for binding)
18352562800177431.method: Dry-roast a mixture of nuts and seeds. Blend the roasted mixture with raisins or dates. Add the roasted ragi flour and moringa powder and mix everything together, adding a little ghee if the mixture does not bind well. Shape the mixture into laddus. Do not heat the mixture for long after adding the moringa powder.

18327348109088077.ingredients:
oil
mustard seeds
peanuts
garlic
green chilies
onions
fresh coriander leaves
salt
turmeric
red chili powder
beaten yogurt
18327348109088077.method: Temper the spices by frying mustard seeds, peanuts, garlic, and green chilies in oil. Chop the onions into large chunks and finely chop the fresh coriander leaves. Combine the chopped ingredients with the tempered spices and grind into a coarse paste in a blender. Sauté onions and add the ground paste along with salt, turmeric, and red chili powder. Stir in beaten yogurt and fresh coriander.

17988524240717617.ingredients:
dates
chia seeds
oats
olive oil
milk
apples
17988524240717617.method: Assemble the oats in a mason jar, layering the dates, chia seeds, oats, and olive oil. Top with milk, diced apples, and more olive oil.

18015455960670495.ingredients:
garlic
chilies
spices
boiled eggs
egg
pav
18015455960670495.method: Finely chop the garlic and chilies and sauté them with spices. Add the boiled eggs to create a thick green curry. Prepare a half-fried egg and place it on top of the dish. Serve with toasted pav.

18305815279207358.ingredients:
organic sprouted oats
chia seeds
hemp hearts
protein powder
maca root
vanilla extract
full-fat coconut milk

18068127406783600.ingredients:
dairy-free buttermilk
yogurt
oil
sugar
ground pistachios
flour
leavening agents
pistachio butter
18068127406783600.method: Mix the dairy-free buttermilk, yogurt, oil, sugar, ground pistachios, flour, and leavening agents in a food processor and bowl. Pour the batter into ramekins, hiding a spoonful of frozen pistachio butter in the center of each. Bake until golden. Flip the cakes out and serve.

18144996262324357.ingredients:
cooked idlies
spices
curry leaves
oil
green chutney
18144996262324357.method: Toast the spices and curry leaves in a large pot, then grind them into a fine powder to make a curry leaf podi. Mix the powder with oil and coat the cooked idlies with it. Coat a second batch of idlies with a regular spice mix. Skewer the coated idlies and grill them until the edges are crispy. Serve with green chutney for dipping.

17896720326037374.ingredients:
chicken
fresh coriander
vegetables
brown rice
17896720326037374.method: Marinate the chicken. Deep-fry the marinated chicken. Prepare the sauce. Combine the fried chicken with the sauce and add fresh coriander. Serve with a side of sautéed vegetables and brown rice.

17850606180369134.ingredients:
green beans
Diamond Crystal Kosher Salt
olive oil
garlic
lemon zest
juice of one lemon
17850606180369134.method: Fill a pot with water, add a generous amount of Diamond Crystal Kosher Salt, and bring to a boil. Blanch the green beans in the boiling water. Immediately transfer the beans to a bowl of ice water to stop the cooking and keep them bright green and crisp. Season the beans with a generous amount of olive oil, a pinch of salt, minced garlic, lemon zest, and the juice of one lemon.

18124819780392676.ingredients:
nuts
seeds
dates
honey
cocoa powder
dark chocolate chips
roasted walnuts
18124819780392676.method: Roast a mixture of nuts and seeds and add them to a blender. Add the dates, honey, and cocoa powder and blend until the mixture becomes clumpy. Pour the mixture into a baking dish. Top with dark chocolate chips and roasted walnuts.

18041532680022714.ingredients:
walnuts
about one teaspoon ghee
milk
dark chocolate
sugar (optional)
18041532680022714.method: Blend the walnuts into a coarse powder. Heat about one teaspoon of ghee in a pan, add the crushed walnuts, and stir until lightly toasted. Pour in the milk and let it bind. Melt in pieces of dark chocolate on low heat to avoid burning. Add extra chopped walnuts on top for texture.

17916597765033603.method: Grate the carrots. Cook the grated carrots in a pan with some ghee. Add the milk, stir, and cook until the mixture thickens.

18070935244656237.method: Cut a piece of butter and place it inside a date. Sprinkle salt on top.

18473397817026794.ingredients:
oil
mustard seeds
onions
curry leaves
green pigeon peas
sambar powder
18473397817026794.method: Add mustard seeds to hot oil. Add the onions and curry leaves, then the green pigeon peas, and finally the sambar powder.

18260095921270302.ingredients:
amla (Indian gooseberry)
dried red chilies
green leaves
spices

18108465169417737.ingredients:
water
coriander
chili flakes
salt
rice flour
18108465169417737.method: Add the water, coriander, chili flakes, salt, and rice flour to a pan. Knead the mixture into a dough. Place the roti on a hot pan and flip it as it cooks.

18042835810919649.ingredients:
yogurt
spices
besan
cooked black chickpeas (kala chana)
garam masala
kasuri methi
18042835810919649.method: Mix the yogurt, spices, and besan to prepare the kadhi base. Add the cooked black chickpeas to the kadhi and bring the mixture to a boil. Add garam masala and kasuri methi for flavor.

18047286433802917.ingredients:
dates
saffron
roasted nuts
cardamom powder
milk
18047286433802917.method: Soak the dates and saffron, then blend them. Add the blend to the milk along with roasted nuts and cardamom powder.

18056426311849505.ingredients:
boiled potatoes
onions
green chilies
fresh coriander
yogurt
red chili powder
turmeric
oil
steamed rice
18056426311849505.method: Combine the boiled potatoes, chopped onions, green chilies, and fresh coriander with the yogurt in a mixing bowl. Temper the red chili powder and turmeric in hot oil to make a tadka. Pour the hot tadka into the yogurt mixture and stir thoroughly to combine. Serve over steamed rice.

18120724759404037.ingredients:
avocado
cocoa powder
sweetener
egg
peanut butter
18120724759404037.method: Mix the avocado, cocoa powder, sweetener, and egg. Microwave the mixture. Drizzle with peanut butter.

18180452197307599.ingredients:
chicken
yogurt
ginger
garlic
spices
fresh coriander
mint
rice
18180452197307599.method: Marinate the raw chicken with yogurt, ginger, garlic, and a variety of spices for at least 20 minutes. Blend fresh coriander, mint, and other ingredients to make a mint raita. Cook the rice in a pot with spices and water, combining it with the marinated chicken. Garnish the chicken rice with fresh coriander and serve with the mint raita.

17933718893937178.method: Chop the beetroots and add them to a jar with spices and liquid. Leave the jar to ferment.

18079619476556503.method: Combine the spice mix ingredients in a jar and shake well. Roll out the dough for the paratha and sprinkle the spice mix generously over it. Cook the seasoned flatbread on a hot pan with ghee until golden brown and fluffy.

18134163871365881.ingredients:
ragi flour
water
jaggery
fresh coconut
oil
crushed cardamom
ghee
18134163871365881.method: Boil water in a pan, add the ragi flour, and stir it into a thick dough; cover and let it cook. Dissolve the jaggery in water to make a syrup. Grate the fresh coconut and squeeze it through a strainer to extract coconut milk. Knead the cooked ragi dough with a little oil and roll it by hand into many small marble-sized balls. Pour the coconut milk into a pot, strain it, mix in the jaggery syrup, and heat it, seasoning with crushed cardamom and ghee. Add the ragi balls to the simmering payasam and cook until soft.

18283932475229996.method: Mix mashed banana with rice flour and sugar to prepare a dough. Shape the dough into balls. Fry the balls in oil until golden brown.

18024282905429322.ingredients:
curd
spices
bread
green chutney
paneer
18024282905429322.method: Mix the curd with spices to create a masala. Dip slices of bread into the mixture. Fry the sandwich in a pan until crispy on both sides. Spread green chutney on one side, add slices of paneer, and finish with more chutney to complete the sandwich.

17882476728112604.ingredients:
pineapple
rava (semolina)
cashews
dry fruits
saffron
sugar
ghee
17882476728112604.method: Blend the pineapple. Roast the dry fruits in a wok with ghee. Combine all the ingredients and cook together to create the thick kesari.

17859584280201627.method: Prepare the batter and the chutney using a mini blender. Cook the dosa on a pan.

17921505152980005.ingredients:
boiled chickpeas
red and yellow spices
water
jeera (cumin seeds)
green chilies
ginger
amchur powder
17921505152980005.method: Strain the boiled chickpeas. Prepare a masala mix of red and yellow spices and mix the spices with water. Cook the chickpeas in a pan with the masala base, adding a simple tempering of jeera, green chilies, and ginger. Finish with amchur powder.

18040320727929387.ingredients:
sooji
milk
ghee
sugar
cashews
almonds
rose petals
18040320727929387.method: Soak the sooji in milk. Separately, roast sooji in ghee until crumbly. Caramelize sugar in ghee, then add milk to create a syrup. Combine the roasted sooji with the syrup and stir until thick. Add fried cashews and almonds, and garnish with sliced almonds and rose petals.

18459025690027789.ingredients:
pumpkin seeds
sunflower seeds
cocoa powder
chopped nuts
18459025690027789.method: Toast the pumpkin and sunflower seeds and grind them into a powder. Mix the powder with the other ingredients in a bowl, then add the cocoa powder and a liquid ingredient. Whisk until smooth and pour into a baking dish lined with parchment paper. Sprinkle chopped nuts on top before baking.

18033613153970723.ingredients:
purple sweet potato
red spice powder
green herbs
ragi flour
water
yogurt
18033613153970723.method: Steam the purple sweet potato, then peel and mash it, adding red spice powder and chopped green herbs. Mix the ragi flour with water and knead into a dough. Flatten a portion of the dough, fill it with the seasoned sweet potato mixture, seal it, dust with flour, and roll it out. Cook the stuffed paratha on a hot tawa, flipping and pressing until browned. Serve with a small bowl of yogurt.

18357846256115791.method: Soak the ragi pearls in water. Blend them in a blender. Strain the mixture through a cloth. Pour the strained ragi milk into a pitcher.

18096374647415108.ingredients:
red onions
green chilies
mustard oil
mustard seeds
chili powder
lemon juice or vinegar
18096374647415108.method: Chop the red onions and green chilies on a cutting board. Drain the excess moisture from the chopped ingredients using paper towels. Heat mustard oil in a small steel pot and add mustard seeds and chili powder to prepare the masala. Pour the hot masala oil over the onions and chilies in a glass bowl and mix everything thoroughly with lemon juice or vinegar. Enjoy immediately or store for later.

18036690206048471.ingredients:
red onion
garlic cloves
ginger
fresh cilantro
coriander seeds
besan (gram flour)
salt
turmeric
water
oil
sesame seeds
red chili powder
18036690206048471.method: Split a red onion and roast it directly over a gas flame until charred black. Grind the burnt onion with garlic cloves, ginger, fresh cilantro, and coriander seeds into a coarse green paste. Mix the besan with salt, turmeric, and water to form a smooth yellow dough and rest it with oil. Roll the dough flat, spread it with the green paste, sprinkle with sesame seeds and chopped cilantro, cut it into strips, and roll the strips into small cylinders (patodi). In a pan, sauté the remaining green paste with oil, season with red chili powder, turmeric, and salt, then add water to create a gravy. Gently drop the patodi into the simmering gravy and cook until tender. Garnish with fresh cilantro.

17861785029165747.ingredients:
rice flour
curd
gram flour
potato
garlic
dried red chillies
curry leaves
chutney
17861785029165747.method: Peel and cut the potato. Blend the rice flour, curd, gram flour, potato, garlic, dried red chillies, and curry leaves in a blender to create the dosa batter. Cook the batter on a griddle to make the dosa. Serve with chutney.

17996907431508664.ingredients:
amchur (dry mango) water
spices
onions
green chillies
17996907431508664.method: Heat a liquid with spices in a steel kadai on the stove. Pour in the amchur water mixture. Finely chop the onions and green chillies, add them to the kadai, and stir the mixture. Serve the chutney on a chapati.

18024741884338302.method: Roast the seeds, nuts, and dry fruits in a pan. Add them to a bowl and mix with the other ingredients to form a dough. Shape the dough into small balls.

18038619784921035.ingredients:
cooked leftover rice
red chili powder
salt
cumin seeds
sesame seeds
oil
18038619784921035.method: Place the cooked leftover rice on a large plate and add the red chili powder, salt, cumin seeds, and sesame seeds. Mix thoroughly with your fingers until the rice turns evenly orange-red. With wet hands, pinch off small portions and roll them into irregular balls, placing them on a tray. Keep the tray in sunlight for 2-3 days until the pieces dry and harden. Drop the dried balls into hot oil and fry on a medium flame until they puff up and turn crisp, then remove them with a slotted spoon.

18017553851418356.ingredients:
bitter gourds (karela)
yellow spice mixture
yellow filling
spices
onions
white rice
18017553851418356.method: Wash the bitter gourds, cut them into rings, and remove the seeds. Mix the rings with a yellow spice mixture and stuff them with a yellow filling. Place the stuffed gourds in a pan and stir-fry them with various spices, including onions, to create a flavorful masala. Serve on a plate of white rice.

18269577607174744.ingredients:
red onions
green olives
cooked white beans
homemade honey dijon vinaigrette
18269577607174744.method: Chop the red onions and green olives. Combine the chopped vegetables with the cooked white beans in a bowl and dress the salad with the homemade honey dijon vinaigrette. Let the salad rest for about 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld and the shallots to pickle.

18041445937771378.ingredients:
gwar phali (cluster beans)
salt
dry red chilies
green chilies
whole coriander
asafoetida
turmeric
garlic
lemon juice
mustard oil
cumin seeds
18041445937771378.method: Blanch the gwar phali beans in boiling water with salt. Crush the dry red chilies, green chilies, whole coriander, asafoetida, turmeric, and garlic in a stone mortar and pestle to make a spice paste. Combine the blanched beans with the spice paste and lemon juice. For the tadka, place a small clay pot filled with burning coal inside the mortar and pour hot mustard oil with cumin seeds over it, infusing the pickle with a smoky flavor. Mix the pickle.

18038312821856948.method: Prepare the lentil base for the dal. Temper the spices. Make the dough for the dhokli.

18137962867319144.ingredients:
chicken thighs
soy sauce
ginger
sugar
shaoxing wine
white pepper
MSG
egg white
fresh basil leaves
potato starch
18137962867319144.method: Marinate the raw chicken thighs with soy sauce, ginger, sugar, shaoxing wine, white pepper, MSG, and an egg white, and mix thoroughly. Coat the chicken pieces with potato starch. Place the coated chicken in an air fryer and cook. Toss the cooked chicken with the air-fried basil leaves.

18012856907272879.ingredients:
tomato
burrata cheese
olive oil
balsamic glaze
fresh basil
18012856907272879.method: Grate the tomato over the burrata cheese. Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze. Garnish with fresh basil.

18023225594468580.ingredients:
potato
grated cheese (likely)
sour cream (likely)
green chives
18023225594468580.method: Place a whole, unpeeled potato into a muffin pan and press down on it with a paper towel to create a concave shape. Bake until the potato shell is golden brown. In a glass bowl, stir a crumbly substance, likely grated cheese, into a creamy base, likely sour cream, then place the mixture into a piping bag. Pipe the mixture into the baked potato shell. Garnish with chopped green chives.

18002851700385390.method: Place a piece of baking paper into a muffin cup to prevent sticking. Place a boiled baby potato into the cup and press down firmly with a glass cup, shaping it into a cup-like form. Bake the potato until golden and crispy. Remove the baking paper to reveal the finished potato cup.

18056896999559890.ingredients:
oats
cocoa
liquid
cream cheese
chocolate-covered puffed rice
18056896999559890.method: Mix the oats, cocoa, and liquid in a bowl. Prepare a cream cheese layer and add it over the oats. Add a layer of chocolate-covered puffed rice to the top.

18034007351066749.ingredients:
egg
maple syrup
cocoa powder
whey protein powder
18034007351066749.method: Crack an egg into a glass container. Add maple syrup and cocoa powder, and incorporate a scoop of whey protein powder. Mix the ingredients thoroughly. Place the container in a microwave and set the timer for two minutes.

18037898158938040.ingredients:
red kidney beans
green moong
chickpeas
onions
tomatoes
cucumbers
yogurt
chaat masala
red chilli powder
18037898158938040.method: Combine the red kidney beans, green moong, and chickpeas in a bowl and cook them in a pressure cooker. Transfer the cooked beans and chickpeas to a serving bowl and mix with diced onions, tomatoes, and cucumbers. Add a generous amount of yogurt and sprinkle with chaat masala and red chilli powder for flavor.

18005162621563627.ingredients:
dates
cashews
almonds
mixed seeds
sesame seeds
18005162621563627.method: Toast the mixed seeds in a pan. Blend the dates, cashews, and almonds in a blender. Combine the blended mixture with the toasted seeds and mix in a pan. Shape the mixture into a log and roll it in sesame seeds.

17844397521240793.ingredients:
mango
white sugar
water or juice
ice cubes
17844397521240793.method: Blend the mango into a smooth puree. For the mango laddus, mix the puree with white sugar. For the mango sherbet, add a spoonful of the mango premix powder to a glass of water or juice and stir. Serve the sherbet with ice cubes.

17864647893152372.ingredients:
two bananas
two eggs
almond milk
oats
baking powder
vanilla extract
cinnamon
salt
avocado oil
fresh berries
dark chocolate chips
shredded coconut
maple syrup
17864647893152372.method: Add the bananas, eggs, almond milk, oats, baking powder, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and salt to a blender and blend until smooth. Cook the batter in a pan with avocado oil to make the pancakes. Serve topped with fresh berries, dark chocolate chips, shredded coconut, and maple syrup.

18024254137975884.ingredients:
dark sauce
green onions
white sesame seeds
black sesame seeds
one egg
rice
kimchi
cucumber
18024254137975884.method: Add the dark sauce to a frying pan, followed by chopped green onions and the white and black sesame seeds. Crack in the egg and cook until the white is set and the yolk is still runny. Transfer the egg to a bowl of rice. Add kimchi and cucumber, pour dark sauce over the dish, and garnish with green onions.

18047551852707599.ingredients:
corn
besan (gram flour)
red chili powder
turmeric
salt
water
oil
whole green chilies
red chutney
18047551852707599.method: Peel the husk and silk from the corn and cut the kernels off the cob. Mix the kernels by hand with the besan, red chili powder, turmeric, salt, and water to form a thick batter. Heat oil in a pan and deep-fry spoonfuls of the batter until golden and crispy. Remove with a slotted spoon, garnish with whole green chilies, and serve with red chutney.

18097317346386311.method: Cook the curd in a pot until the water separates. Strain the curd to remove the excess water. Put the strained curd solids in a pan, add the jaggery, and mix together over heat until combined.

17907333440891754.ingredients:
pistachios
mango chutney
goat cheese
herbs
cucumber
17907333440891754.method: Toast the pistachios in a dry pan. Warm the mango chutney using the residual heat of the pan and drizzle it over the toasted nuts. Layer the mixture onto a plate with goat cheese and garnish with chopped pistachios and herbs. Arrange cucumber slices beside the main dish and serve.

18027809689933757.ingredients:
raw mango
ginger
curry leaves
spices
mustard seeds
fresh coriander leaves
rice (for serving)
18027809689933757.method: Pressure cook the mango slices with ginger, curry leaves, and spices. Temper the mustard seeds and add them to the rasam along with fresh coriander leaves. Serve over rice.

18067846390525526.ingredients:
chicken thighs
lemon pepper seasoning
garlic powder
spices
butter
lemon zest
18067846390525526.method: Marinate the cubed chicken thighs with the lemon pepper, garlic powder, and other spices, mixing thoroughly. Thread the chicken tightly onto soaked wooden skewers. Air fry at 375°F for 20 minutes, flipping halfway through. Stir the butter, lemon zest, and spices together until smooth to make the sauce. Baste the cooked skewers with the warm sauce.

17994540410444394.method: Peel and grate the sweet potato. Mix the batter with the grated sweet potato and the seed blend. Bake the brownies and finish with a glaze.

18042474667871287.ingredients:
mushrooms
soy sauce
ketchup
sugar
black pepper
garlic
green onions
18042474667871287.method: Mix the soy sauce, ketchup, sugar, and black pepper to make the sauce. Sauté the mushrooms with garlic. Add the sauce, cover the pan, and cook until done. Garnish with green onions.

18326030668127028.method: Marinate the chicken breast in a mix of spices and the thick yellow marinade. Roll out the dough and cut it into flat strips, then coat the strips with flour. Coat the marinated chicken in the prepared dough strips and deep-fry until golden brown and crispy.

17903708498898166.ingredients:
two spoons of ragi flour
one ripe banana
water
17903708498898166.method: Dry-roast two spoons of ragi flour in a pan for ten seconds. Add water and cook into a porridge. Mash the ripe banana well on a plate. Once the porridge has cooled slightly, add the mashed banana and mix thoroughly.

17995823321444352.ingredients:
ivy gourd (dondakaya)
chili powder
whole jeera (cumin)
salt
asafoetida
oil
17995823321444352.method: Cut the ivy gourds on both sides. Mix the chili powder, whole jeera, salt, and asafoetida into a spice mixture. Stuff the cut ivy gourds with the spice mixture. Stir-fry the stuffed gourds in a wok with oil and the remaining spice mixture until cooked.

18035012650931458.ingredients:
cucumbers
red onions
green beans
fava beans
asparagus
salad dressing
18035012650931458.method: Slice the cucumbers, red onions, and green beans, and shell the fava beans. Blanch the asparagus and green beans in boiling water. Prepare a simple dressing. Combine all the components in a large bowl, add the dressing, and toss together.

18419278321031243.ingredients:
fresh spinach leaves
flour
spices
cheese
18419278321031243.method: Boil the fresh spinach leaves, then blend them into a smooth paste. Mix the spinach puree with the flour and spices to create a dough. Roll the dough out into a flat, round shape. Place a square piece of cheese on the flatbread and fold it over the cheese to create a square shape. Cook on a griddle until golden brown.

18425022526045455.ingredients:
wheat flour
salt
garlic paste
chili flakes
fresh coriander
ghee
water
18425022526045455.method: Add the wheat flour, salt, garlic paste, chili flakes, fresh coriander, ghee, and water to a bowl and mix thoroughly into a batter. Heat a pan and pour the batter onto it, spreading it thinly with the back of a ladle. Cook on a low flame with the lid on until done.

18024060272160928.ingredients:
green chilies
garlic
onions
tomatoes
oil
cumin seeds
red chilies
rice (for serving)
18024060272160928.method: Sauté the green chilies, garlic, and onions in a wok. Cook the tomatoes until they release their water, then let them cool down. Grind the sautéed ingredients and the tomatoes together. Heat oil and add cumin seeds, garlic, and red chilies for tempering, then add the ground mixture. Mix with rice and serve.

17954229710779838.ingredients:
green banana
cooked potatoes
oil
mustard seeds
curry leaves
red chilies
urad dal
17954229710779838.method: Peel and mash the green banana and the cooked potatoes. Heat oil in a pan and add mustard seeds, curry leaves, red chilies, and urad dal for tempering. Add the mashed banana and potatoes to the pan and mix everything together. Garnish with fresh curry leaves and red chilies and serve.

17919330134812512.ingredients:
bread flour
salt
yeast
water
tomato sauce (for pizza)
mozzarella cheese (for pizza)
fresh basil (for pizza)
sesame seeds (for sesame pancake)
17919330134812512.method: Mix the bread flour, salt, yeast, and water in a bowl and knead the dough. Ferment the dough overnight in the refrigerator. The next day, portion the dough into balls and proof for another one to two hours. For pizza, shape a portion into a round base, top with tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, and fresh basil, and bake. For pita, roll a portion slightly thicker and cook it in the oven. For a sesame pancake, flatten a portion, coat it with sesame seeds, and fry in a pan. For a roll, shape a portion into a long roll, score it, and bake until crispy.

18027583147898771.ingredients:
besan flour
100g grated paneer
chopped tomato
green coriander (dhania)
chopped onion
chopped carrot
salt
18027583147898771.method: Add the besan flour, 100g grated paneer, chopped tomato, green coriander, chopped onion, chopped carrot, and salt to a bowl and mix into a batter. Cook portions of the batter on a hot pan until golden brown.

18031969930938498.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups glutinous (sticky) rice
2 cups water
