one can Chaokoh coconut milk
1/2 cup sugar
a pinch of salt
cornstarch
mango
toasted sesame seeds
mint
18031969930938498.method: Cook 1 1/2 cups of glutinous rice with 2 cups of water in a rice cooker. Meanwhile, heat the coconut milk with 1/2 cup sugar and a pinch of salt until dissolved. Reserve about one cup of the coconut mixture for the rice and thicken the remainder with a cornstarch slurry to make a glaze. Transfer the cooked rice to a bowl while hot and mix in the reserved coconut milk until sticky. Plate a molded mound of rice, fan sliced mango on each side, pour the thick glaze over the top, and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and mint.

18045460030673357.ingredients:
soaked kidney beans (rajma)
bay leaves
yogurt
spices
desi ghee
onion paste
ginger garlic paste
white rice (for serving)
18045460030673357.method: Pressure cook the soaked kidney beans with bay leaves. Whisk a yogurt mixture with various spices. Sauté whole spices in desi ghee with onion paste and ginger garlic paste. Add the yogurt mixture to the pot and stir. Add the cooked kidney beans and cook the curry slowly for half an hour. Serve over white rice.

17858724969138923.method: Peel and mash the sweet potatoes. Mix them with the flour and eggs and knead into a dough. Roll the dough out and cut it into crackers.

17894194094918439.ingredients:
roasted chickpeas
sattu powder
fresh coriander leaves
salt
cumin powder
mango powder
mint leaves
water
lemon juice
ice cubes
lemon slice (for garnish)
17894194094918439.method: Sort the roasted chickpeas and blend them. Add the sattu powder, fresh coriander leaves, salt, cumin powder, mango powder, mint leaves, water, lemon juice, and ice cubes to a large mixing bowl and mix thoroughly. Pour into a glass and garnish with a lemon slice.

18023386274305479.method: Pour the condensed coconut milk into a saucepan and bring it to a boil. Add the dark chocolate and stir until the mixture becomes a thick, glossy fudge. Pour the hot fudge into silicone molds.

17846092587177095.ingredients:
raw mangoes
fresh mint leaves
coriander leaves
green chilies
jaggery
pepper powder
water
chilled water
salt
chopped onions
17846092587177095.method: Boil the raw mangoes in a pot. Peel the mangoes and separate the pulp from the seeds. Add the pulp to a blender with the fresh mint leaves, coriander leaves, green chilies, jaggery, pepper powder, and water, and blend until smooth. Add chilled water, more coriander, salt, and chopped onions to the puree and mix well.

17896221899975858.ingredients:
fresh mushrooms
oil
yellow spice paste (ginger and garlic)
fresh spinach leaves
spices
cream or coconut milk
17896221899975858.method: Slice the fresh mushrooms. Sauté the mushrooms in a pan with oil until browned. Add the yellow spice paste and sauté. Add the fresh spinach leaves and cook until they wilt. Add the spices and the creamy liquid (cream or coconut milk) to finish the dish.

17939926520799324.ingredients:
fresh mangoes
sweetener
lemon
milk
heavy cream
sticky rice
coconut (for the sauce)
17939926520799324.method: For the mango ice cream, dice the fresh mangoes and blend them with sweetener and lemon, then mix with milk and heavy cream and chill and churn the mixture. For the sticky rice, soak the rice overnight, then steam it in a bamboo steamer lined with cheesecloth. Cook a coconut sauce to soak the rice. Slice the mangoes and arrange the rice balls, mango slices, and coconut sauce on a plate, drizzling warm coconut sauce over the top. Finish with a scoop of the mango ice cream.

18257213005208832.ingredients:
jaggery
lemon juice
fresh mint leaves
ginger
cold water
18257213005208832.method: Add the jaggery, lemon juice, fresh mint leaves, ginger, and cold water to a blender. Blend until mixed, then pour into a glass and serve.

18024761075000669.ingredients:
white bread slices
oil
sugar syrup
rabri
chopped pistachios
18024761075000669.method: Flatten the slices of white bread with a rolling pin, cut them in half, and fold them into pocket shapes. Deep-fry the bread pockets in hot oil until light golden brown. Immediately dip the warm pockets into sugar syrup to soak up the sweetness. Fill the pockets with a generous spoonful of rabri and garnish with chopped pistachios.

18030726778649436.ingredients:
yam
turmeric powder
chilli powder
coriander powder
rice flour
ginger-garlic paste
oil
curry leaves (for garnish)
18030726778649436.method: Peel the yam and cut it into large, thick pieces. Add the turmeric powder, chilli powder, coriander powder, and rice flour to a bowl and mix, then add the ginger-garlic paste to create a thick coating. Coat the yam pieces in the mixture. Fry the coated yam pieces in hot oil in a tawa or pan until golden brown and crispy. Garnish with curry leaves.

18019130557907493.ingredients:
rice paper
pork
carrots
cabbage
dark sauce (for serving)
chopped spring onions (for garnish)
18019130557907493.method: Stir the filling of pork, carrots, and cabbage in a pan. Wrap the filling in rice paper, using a dumpling press to give the parcels a dumpling shape. Pan-fry the dumplings until golden brown and crispy. Serve with a dark sauce and garnish with chopped spring onions.

17999491502257132.ingredients:
milk powder
flour
cardamom
ghee
oil
water
sugar
pistachio powder (for garnish)
17999491502257132.method: Mix the milk powder, flour, cardamom, and ghee in a glass bowl. Knead the dough by hand until soft, then roll it out on a flat surface and cut it into uniform squares. Deep-fry the squares in hot oil until golden brown. Meanwhile, boil water and sugar to prepare a syrup. Soak the fried squares in the warm syrup for several hours. Garnish with pistachio powder.

18001171892418271.ingredients:
butter
paneer cubes
sweet corn kernels
chopped red onions
diced tomatoes
fresh coriander
chili flakes
salt
black pepper
dry mango powder
chaat masala
18001171892418271.method: Add butter to a hot pan, then add the paneer cubes and cook until they develop golden edges. Add the sweet corn kernels and toss everything together. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and combine with the chopped red onions, diced tomatoes, and fresh coriander. Add the chili flakes, salt, black pepper, dry mango powder, and chaat masala, and mix gently.

18322681093138449.method: Level 1: scramble beaten eggs in a hot wok, then mix in the rice. Level 2: mix egg yolks directly into leftover rice before cooking for a richer, more golden dish. Level 3: deep-fry a thin stream of beaten egg to create crispy egg floss, then incorporate it into the rice.

17993158874604098.ingredients:
diced green bell peppers
diced red onions
ginger garlic paste
turmeric powder
coriander powder
garam masala
cumin powder
roasted peanut powder
mustard oil
asafoetida
green chilies
buttermilk
salt
coriander leaves (for garnish)
17993158874604098.method: Add the diced green bell peppers, diced red onions, ginger garlic paste, turmeric powder, coriander powder, garam masala, cumin powder, and roasted peanut powder to a bowl. Heat mustard oil in a pan and add asafoetida and green chilies for tempering, then add the prepared mixture. Sauté, add buttermilk, then cover and cook on a medium flame for 10-12 minutes. Add salt to taste and garnish with coriander leaves.

18039976195641076.ingredients:
jowar millets
water
oil
peanuts
cumin seeds
mustard seeds
chopped ginger
green chilies
curry leaves
red chilies
red chili powder
salt
chopped coriander
lemon juice
18039976195641076.method: Add the jowar millets and water to a pressure cooker and cook. Heat oil in a pan and add the peanuts, cumin seeds, mustard seeds, chopped ginger, green chilies, curry leaves, and red chilies, stirring to release their aroma. Add the boiled jowar millets, red chili powder, salt, and the fried peanuts, and stir everything together. Finish with chopped coriander and lemon juice.

17889700373917799.ingredients:
fresh green chilies
dried chilies
salt
spices
rice flakes
papad
17889700373917799.method: Wash the chilies. Mix the chilies with salt and spices, then fry them. Mix the fried chilies with rice flakes and papad.

18008452097223667.ingredients:
1 cup sugar
half cup fruit juice (such as orange)
1 cup water
1/4 cup cornflour
butter (for greasing)
18008452097223667.method: Cook 1 cup sugar with half a cup of fruit juice until reduced to about 60% of its volume and thick, then set aside. Mix 1 cup water with 1/4 cup cornflour and heat on low, stirring continuously, until thick and transparent. Add the sugar syrup back in and stir on high heat for 4-5 minutes. Pour into a butter-greased mold and leave to set for 2-3 hours. Cut into cubes.

18017176423920740.method: Mix the sauce ingredients. Sauté the mushrooms. Add the sauce to the mushrooms and garnish with green onion.

17888244743912299.ingredients:
sugar
water
vanilla paste
juniper berries
rose buds
finely ground rose petals
espresso (double shot)
milk
a pinch of beetroot powder (optional)
17888244743912299.method: Combine the sugar, water, vanilla paste, juniper berries, and rose buds in a saucepan and simmer to make an infused syrup. Meanwhile, create a decorative stripe on the inside of the serving glass using a mixture of finely ground rose petals and sugar. After about 20 minutes, strain the syrup and pour it into the prepared glass, followed by a double shot of espresso. Add a pinch of beetroot powder to the milk before steaming to intensify the color, if desired. Pour the steamed milk into the glass and top with a decorative rose petal stripe.

18033626230682564.ingredients:
roasted split green gram
freshly grated coconut
jaggery
rice flour
cardamom powder
water
salt
cashews
raisins
coconut pieces
ghee
18033626230682564.method: Grind the roasted split green gram, freshly grated coconut, jaggery, rice flour, cardamom powder, water, and salt together in a grinder jar. Roast the cashews, raisins, and coconut pieces in a pan with ghee. Add the ground mixture to the pan and cook on a medium to low flame for about 8 to 10 minutes until it thickens and pulls away from the sides of the pan. Mix in the roasted cashews, raisins, and coconut pieces.

17960778170606159.ingredients:
tamarind-jaggery pulp
fresh coriander leaves
mint
1.5 liters water
green chilies
one red chili
lemon juice
roasted cumin powder
black salt
chaat masala
asafoetida (hing)
black pepper
red chili flakes
lime halves
17960778170606159.method: Strain the tamarind-jaggery pulp through a sieve to extract the juice. Blend the fresh coriander leaves and mint with water and strain. Add 1.5 liters of water to a large metal bowl. Add the tamarind-jaggery juice, the strained coriander-mint water, a paste of green chilies with one red chili, lemon juice, roasted cumin powder, black salt, chaat masala, asafoetida, black pepper, red chili flakes, and the squeezed lime halves. Stir thoroughly.

18015933521108856.ingredients:
spice powder (turmeric and chili powder)
fresh curry leaves
sliced garlic
sliced eggplant
cooked white rice
18015933521108856.method: Add the spice powder to a wok, then add the fresh curry leaves and sliced garlic. Add the sliced eggplant and mix everything by hand to coat evenly with the spices. Cook the eggplant mixture. Add the cooked white rice to the wok and mix thoroughly until well combined and evenly coated.

17948098835764699.ingredients:
pink cream
purple cream
brown crumb topping
fresh blueberries
white flower (for garnish)
17948098835764699.method: Pipe the pink cream layer into the glass, followed by the purple cream layer. Add a layer of brown crumb topping, then pipe another layer of pink cream on top. Garnish with fresh blueberries and a flower.

17999738498123307.ingredients:
oil
garlic
ginger
water
noodle tastemaker or stock cube
instant noodles
cheese
vegetables
frozen dumplings
chili oil (for garnish)
spring onions (for garnish)
coriander (for garnish)
17999738498123307.method: Heat oil in a pot and add the garlic and ginger. Pour in water and dissolve a noodle tastemaker or stock cube. Add the instant noodles, followed by the cheese, vegetables, and frozen dumplings. Cook for a few minutes. Garnish with chili oil, spring onions, and coriander, and serve.

17853046899117597.ingredients:
chicken thigh
fish sauce
rice vinegar
soy sauce
citrus
Kewpie mayo
sriracha
bacon
sourdough bread
17853046899117597.method: Make a marinade with the fish sauce, rice vinegar, soy sauce, and citrus and marinate the chicken thigh. Stir the Kewpie mayo and sriracha together into a creamy spread. Fry the leftover bacon and toast the sourdough bread in the bacon fat. Assemble the sandwich, layering the marinated chicken, bacon, and sauces.

18048664105596198.ingredients:
fresh Thai chilies
fish sauce
water
juice of a whole lime
sugar
18048664105596198.method: Chop the fresh Thai chilies and transfer them into a glass jar. Add the fish sauce, water, the juice of a whole lime, and the sugar. Mix all the ingredients together thoroughly with a spoon.

18006965405216930.method: Boil the noodles. Prepare the broth with soy sauce and ginger. Cook a sunny-side-up egg. Assemble the noodles and broth in a bowl and finish with the egg and toppings.

18332793148110931.ingredients:
bottle gourd
lentils
cumin seeds
spices
flour
18332793148110931.method: Grate the bottle gourd and transfer it to a bowl. Add the lentils, cumin seeds, and other spices, then add the flour and combine thoroughly. Press the mixture into a frying pan to form a circular pancake. Cook until golden brown on both sides.

18029801800667146.method: Add the rice flour, cumin, spinach, and onion to make a dough. Knead the dough and let it rest. Cook the akki rotti on a tawa.

18033854908698891.method: Add garlic cloves to a pot of water and cook to make the rasam. Finish with a tempering.

17995545137399258.ingredients:
bread, toasted
garlic confit
avocado
cottage cheese
chili oil
eggs, soft-boiled
green onions
17995545137399258.method: Top the toasted bread with garlic confit, avocado, cottage cheese, chili oil, soft-boiled eggs, and green onions.

18001281038124176.ingredients:
orecchiette pasta
sausage
kale
garlic
cream
cheese
Parmesan cheese
18001281038124176.method: Cook the sausage in a pan. Add garlic, cream, and cheese. Add the cooked orecchiette and kale and mix everything together. Serve in a bowl topped with grated Parmesan cheese.

18011473319318237.ingredients:
oats batter
fresh strawberries
chocolate chips
chocolate sauce
18011473319318237.method: Pour the batter into a bowl. Top with fresh strawberry slices and chocolate chips. Bake the oats. Drizzle chocolate sauce over the top before serving.

17910092564885416.ingredients:
black garlic, two pieces
Samyang Buldak hot sauce
Wok Mei oyster flavored sauce
sesame oil
Lao Gan Ma chili crisp
pre-cooked noodles
green onions
toasted sesame seeds
17910092564885416.method: Place the black garlic in a bowl and mash it with a spoon. Add equal parts hot sauce, oyster flavored sauce, sesame oil, and chili crisp, and mix the sauce thoroughly. Boil water in a saucepan, cook the noodles, and drain them. Pour the sauce over the hot noodles and toss with chopsticks until evenly coated. Plate the noodles and sprinkle with chopped green onions and toasted sesame seeds.

18050569438553608.ingredients:
eggs
green onions
water
seasoning
soy sauce
sesame oil
18050569438553608.method: Crack the eggs into a small pot and add chopped green onions, water, and seasoning. Whisk the mixture. Place the pot inside a larger steamer filled with boiling water and steam for approximately 20 minutes. Garnish with soy sauce and sesame oil.

17861868222072139.ingredients:
heavy cream
saffron
pistachios
vanilla ice cream
olive oil
17861868222072139.method: Whip the heavy cream. Mix in the saffron, pistachios, and vanilla ice cream. Freeze until set. Serve drizzled with olive oil.

17845786938135445.ingredients:
dates
coconut cream
vanilla extract
cinnamon
17845786938135445.method: Soak the dates. Add the soaked dates to a blender with the coconut cream, vanilla extract, and cinnamon. Blend into a smooth paste. Pour the date caramel into a jar.

18036469519679490.ingredients:
paneer
red chilli powder
oregano
black pepper
salt
vegetables
whole wheat flour
milk
cheese
spices
cooked rice
butter
chilli flakes
18036469519679490.method: Mix red chilli powder, oregano, black pepper, and salt to make a marinade, coat the paneer with it, and grill the paneer. Sauté the vegetables, then add whole wheat flour, milk, cheese, and spices and cook into a rich, creamy Peri-Peri sauce. Toss the cooked rice with butter, chilli flakes, and oregano to make herbed rice. Plate the herbed rice with the grilled paneer steak and coat the paneer generously with the sauce.

18016578926306827.ingredients:
baby potatoes
mustard oil
mustard seeds
dried red chilies
hing (asafoetida)
curry leaves
onions
turmeric powder
coriander powder
black salt
salt
chili flakes
fresh coriander
18016578926306827.method: Thinly slice the baby potatoes. Heat mustard oil in a pan and add mustard seeds, dried red chilies, hing, and curry leaves and let them sizzle. Add the sliced potatoes and cook until golden brown. Add sliced onions, turmeric powder, coriander powder, black salt, salt, and chili flakes and mix everything together. Garnish with freshly chopped coriander.

18041420224613061.ingredients:
dried tamarind (imli)
dates
jaggery
spices
water
18041420224613061.method: Soak the dried tamarind and dates. Grind the soaked ingredients in a mixer grinder. Combine the ground paste with jaggery, spices, and water in a pot. Cook on a medium flame for 30-45 minutes until the chutney thickens. Store in a glass jar in the fridge for up to a month.

18009599404968244.ingredients:
oil
green onions
garlic
coconut milk
red curry paste
water
ramen noodles
chicken
seasoning mix
egg, soft-boiled
cilantro
lime
18009599404968244.method: Add oil, green onions, and garlic to a saucepan. Add coconut milk, red curry paste, and water to create the broth. Add the ramen noodles to the boiling broth and simmer. Marinate the chicken with oil and a seasoning mix, then cook it in a frying pan. Assemble the bowl with the broth, noodles, and chicken, and garnish with a soft-boiled egg, cilantro, green onions, and a lime wedge.

18203052232263181.ingredients:
feta cheese
tortillas
eggs
chili oil
arugula
olive oil
lemon juice
balsamic reduction
18203052232263181.method: Melt crumbled feta cheese in a non-stick pan and crisp the tortillas in it. Fry the eggs, add chili oil on top, and cover them to cook. Massage the arugula with olive oil, lemon juice, and a balsamic reduction. Layer the crispy feta tortillas with the chili oil eggs and the dressed arugula, and finish with a drizzle of balsamic reduction.

18316527475114642.ingredients:
boneless chicken
broccoli
carrots
potatoes
lemon juice
minced garlic
black pepper
salt
piriri masala
olive oil
curd
water
fresh coriander
green chillies
chilli oil
18316527475114642.method: Season the chicken, broccoli, carrots, and potatoes with lemon juice, minced garlic, black pepper, salt, and piriri masala. Add olive oil and mix everything thoroughly. Transfer to an air fryer basket and cook at 200 degrees Celsius for 15 to 20 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through. For the sauce, mix curd with water and add minced garlic, fresh coriander, green chillies, salt, chilli oil, and lemon juice. Serve the roasted chicken and vegetables drizzled with the sauce.

18011419246909608.method: Chop the chocolate. Mix the chopped chocolate with cocoa powder and cornstarch. Heat the milk on the stove until it bubbles. Stir everything together until perfectly blended.

18123169972322082.ingredients:
whole wheat flour
besan (gram flour)
ajwain
spices
dal (lentils)
cinnamon
cloves
tamarind
18123169972322082.method: Prepare a dough from whole wheat flour, besan, ajwain, and spices. Roll out the dough and cut it into diamond shapes. Cook the dough pieces in piping hot dal seasoned with cinnamon, cloves, and tamarind.

18006926723140187.ingredients:
garlic, one whole head
oil
scallions
cold day-old rice
chicken bouillon powder
soy sauce
Shaoxing wine
white pepper
18006926723140187.method: Mince the whole head of garlic. Fry the minced garlic in oil in a wok over low heat until golden brown and crispy, then drain the fried garlic from the oil and set it aside. Add the garlic oil back to the pan with the white parts of the chopped scallions. Add the cold day-old rice and season with chicken bouillon powder, soy sauce, and Shaoxing wine, stirring to combine. Add the fried garlic and a dash of white pepper and give the dish a final stir.

18064383247460114.ingredients:
colocasia leaves (patra)
gram flour (besan)
green chutney
18064383247460114.method: Prepare the colocasia rolls. Mix a foamy gram flour batter and pour it into a pan. Steam until cooked. Garnish with green chutney and serve.

18047345686557065.ingredients:
chicken thigh
soy sauce
garlic, grated
ginger, grated
white pepper
Shaoxing wine
egg white
sweet potato starch
oil
fresh basil leaves
salt
five-spice powder
sugar
18047345686557065.method: Cut the chicken thigh into pieces. Marinate the chicken with soy sauce, grated garlic and ginger, white pepper, Shaoxing wine, and egg white for 30 minutes to overnight. Coat the pieces completely in sweet potato starch. Place them in a single layer in an oiled air fryer basket and cook at 350F for 10 minutes. Flip the pieces, spray again with oil, and cook at 400F for 6 to 8 minutes until golden and crispy. Fry the fresh basil leaves in the air fryer at 400F for 2 minutes. Sprinkle a seasoning mix of salt, white pepper, five-spice powder, and sugar over the hot chicken.

18005110801991548.method: Cut the green beans. Fry the green beans and add the garlic.

18243880474214037.ingredients:
Brussels sprouts
olive oil
kosher salt
black pepper
garlic powder
honey
18243880474214037.method: Pick off any wilted outer layers from the Brussels sprouts and halve them lengthwise. Toss them with olive oil, kosher salt, freshly cracked black pepper, garlic powder, and a drizzle of honey. Drizzle olive oil on a preheated baking tray and spread the sprouts cut-side down. Roast in the oven at 450°F for 30 minutes until super crispy. Season to taste.

18020472808870356.ingredients:
pistachios, shelled
water
cooked basmati rice
cardamom
salt
rosewater
18020472808870356.method: Soak the shelled pistachios. Blend the pistachios with water to create a smooth pistachio milk, then strain it. Combine the cooked basmati rice and pistachio milk in a saucepan with the cardamom, salt, and rosewater. Stir and cook on a low heat until the rice is soft and the mixture is thick.

17990182604351828.ingredients:
white button mushrooms
spices
spinach
coconut milk
17990182604351828.method: Slice the mushrooms. Sauté the mushrooms in a pan until browned. Add the spice mixture to the pan. Stir in the fresh spinach leaves until wilted. Pour in the coconut milk to create a sauce.

18023091484762667.ingredients:
extra-firm tofu
pink hummus
avocado
feta cheese
pumpkin seeds
honey
18023091484762667.method: Cut a block of extra-firm tofu and season it. Cook the tofu in a waffle iron. Top the tofu waffle with pink hummus, sliced avocado, crumbled feta cheese, and pumpkin seeds. Finish with a drizzle of honey.

17852052042049013.ingredients:
ground chicken
panko breadcrumbs
cabbage
sesame seeds
rice vinegar
mayonnaise
brown sugar
soy sauce
sesame oil
rice
tonkatsu sauce
17852052042049013.method: Toast the panko breadcrumbs. Mix the ground chicken, form it into cutlets, and coat the cutlets in the toasted panko. Bake the cutlets instead of frying them. Make a cabbage slaw with a dressing of sesame seeds, rice vinegar, mayonnaise, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame oil. Serve the baked chicken cutlets on a bed of rice, topped with the cabbage slaw and a drizzle of tonkatsu sauce. The entire meal takes about 30 minutes.

17930646050778350.method: Simmer the broth in a saucepan on the stove. Pour the broth into a mug and add lemon juice.

18005238395107747.ingredients:
tofu
sriracha
soy sauce
rice
seaweed
avocado
18005238395107747.method: Press and season the crumbled tofu. Prepare a sauce with sriracha, soy sauce, and other ingredients. Assemble the roll with rice, seaweed, avocado, and the prepared tofu filling. Cook the roll in a pan until crispy. Serve with the orange sauce.

18026431060680893.ingredients:
spinach puree
besan (chickpea flour)
ginger
dahi (yogurt)
jaggery
lemon juice
fruit salt
mustard seeds
red chilies
coconut water
oil
18026431060680893.method: Prepare the batter using spinach puree, besan, ginger, dahi, jaggery, lemon juice, and fruit salt. Steam the batter for 15 minutes. Temper mustard seeds and red chilies in coconut water and oil to make a tadka, and pour it over the finished dhokla.

18387894127013127.method: Prepare the jowari grains. Prepare a spice mix. Cook the grains with the spice mix in a copper pan to make the khichdi.

18044752744480023.method: Mix the sauce ingredients in a glass cup. Pan-fry the eggs. Drizzle the sauce over the eggs and serve over hot rice.

18383882425057824.ingredients:
white long-grain rice
bone broth
salt
18383882425057824.method: Measure the white long-grain rice and rinse it in a strainer under running water. Add the rice to a ceramic pot with bone broth and salt. Simmer the rice, covered, for 10 minutes. Cool the cooked rice, then reheat it to develop resistant starch.

18022247668737009.ingredients:
chicken breast
olive oil
garlic
chili powder
coriander
oregano
onion powder
cumin
salt
adobo paste
honey
red bell pepper
yellow bell pepper
green bell pepper
shredded cheese
sour cream
avocado
fresh cilantro
tortillas
limes
red onions
18022247668737009.method: Thinly slice the raw chicken breast. Mix the chicken with olive oil, garlic, chili powder, coriander, oregano, onion powder, cumin, salt, adobo paste, and honey to marinate it. Place the marinated chicken on a baking sheet and combine with sliced red, yellow, and green bell peppers. Bake in a preheated oven until the chicken and vegetables are cooked and golden brown. Garnish with shredded cheese, sour cream, sliced avocado, and fresh cilantro, and serve with tortillas, limes, and red onions.

18296633932137188.ingredients:
small potatoes
shallots
garlic
oil
butter
18296633932137188.method: Boil the small potatoes. Finely chop the shallots and garlic. Fry the aromatics in oil, then blend them with butter to make the crispy chilli garlic butter. Serve the potatoes with the chilli garlic butter.

17994020672490323.ingredients:
cucumber
garlic
yoghurt
mint
olive oil
paprika
17994020672490323.method: Grate the cucumber. Mix the cucumber with the yoghurt, garlic, mint, olive oil, and paprika. Serve the dip with crunchy chips or drizzle it on a wrap.

18097232197324656.ingredients:
ginger
onions
Sichuan peppercorns
cardamom
oil
18097232197324656.method: Chop the ginger and onions and gather the spices, including Sichuan peppercorns and cardamom. Pour oil into a pot with the spices and aromatics and heat it to make the chili oil.

17867429825947412.ingredients:
green onions
flour
spices
beer
truffle butter
17867429825947412.method: Cut the green onions. Measure the flour, spices, and beer into a bowl and mix to make a batter. Coat the green onions in the batter and fry them. Serve the fried green onions with truffle butter for dipping.

17989643366071533.ingredients:
Spam
soy sauce
brown sugar
mirin
egg
rice
mayonnaise
green onions
black sesame seeds
17989643366071533.method: Chop the Spam into cubes. Cook the Spam in a pan with soy sauce, brown sugar, and mirin until glossy and caramelized. Poach the egg by adding it to boiling water and covering it to cook. Place the cooked Spam on a bed of rice, top with the poached egg, and garnish with mayonnaise, green onions, and black sesame seeds.

17952963839557311.ingredients:
mint leaves
onions
spices
paneer
green chilies
water
cooked rice
17952963839557311.method: Add fresh mint leaves to a grinder and grind them. Sauté the onions and spices in a pan. Add the cubed paneer, followed by water and cooked rice, and mix everything together.

17904056774775005.method: Prepare the kadhi base with yogurt and besan. Temper the spices and add them to the kadhi. Fry the bhindi. Combine everything together.

17981396866436113.ingredients:
lentils
water
turmeric
onions
garlic
ginger
ground spices
tomato puree
17981396866436113.method: Cook the lentils with water and turmeric. Sauté chopped onions, garlic, and ginger to make a base. Add ground spices and tomato puree to create a rich, red masala. Add the prepared masala to the cooked lentils.

18165893923022989.ingredients:
cake flour
bread flour
baking powder
baking soda
salt
butter
granulated sugar
jaggery
dark brown sugar
eggs
vanilla extract
caramel
milk chocolate chips
18165893923022989.method: Measure the cake flour, bread flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt into a glass bowl. Mix the softened butter with the granulated sugar, jaggery, and dark brown sugar. Add the eggs and vanilla extract to create a smooth batter. Fold the caramel and milk chocolate chips into the dough. Cover the dough with plastic wrap and refrigerate it. Bake the cookies until golden. Cool the cookies for optimal texture.

18058571186311133.ingredients:
1/2 cup pumpkin, peeled and chopped
1 cup lauki/bottle gourd, peeled and chopped
1 onion, chopped
1 big tomato, chopped
1/2 cup carrot, peeled and chopped
2-3 cloves garlic
1 bay leaf
1/4 cup walnuts
2 cups water
Salt, to taste Pepper, to taste
Juice from 1 small lemon
2 tbsp coriander, finely chopped
18058571186311133.method:
Add pumpkin, carrot, tomato, onion, bottle gourd, garlic, bay leaf, walnuts and water in a pressure cooker. Pressure cook for 3-4 whistles. Grind it smooth and add to a pot.
Add water, salt, pepper and let it come to a boil. Add lemon juice, coriander and enjoy!

17989408508039850.ingredients:
Fish — 250 grams
Turmeric Powder — ½ tsp
Ginger Garlic Paste — 1 tsp
Red Chilli Powder — 1 tsp
Kashmiri Red Chilli Powder — 1½ tsp
Salt — 1 tsp
Tamarind — 1 tbsp
Small Onion (Shallots) — 20
Dry Red Chilli — 7
Water — 3 tbsp
Coconut Oil — ¼ cup
Coconut Oil — 2 tbsp
Small Onion (Shallots), Chopped — 5
Garlic, Chopped — 4
Ginger, Chopped — ½ inch
Curry leaves — 1 sprigs
Coriander Leaves — 1 tbsp
17989408508039850.method:
Marinate the fish with turmeric powder, ginger garlic paste, red chili powder, Kashmiri chili powder, and salt as required. Mix well and set it aside for 15-20 minutes.
Take a tablespoon of tamarind and soak it until it becomes soft. Roast 15-20 shallots until they turn slightly brown. Add 6 to 7 dried red chilies and roast them for 2 minutes on low flame. Grind the roasted shallots and chilies into a fine paste along with the tamarind water.
In a pan, add coconut oil and fry the marinated fish to a golden brown colour on all sides and keep it aside.
In another pan, heat 1 ½ tbsp of coconut oil. Add 5 chopped shallots, ½ tsp of finely chopped garlic, ½ inch of finely chopped ginger, and a sprig of curry leaves. Stir for about a minute. Add the ground paste and mix it over low flame. Add the fried fish to the mixture and mix till it is coated well with the masala. Give it one final toss, garnish it with coriander leaves and serve it hot with rice.

17900055036256707.ingredients:
Torai/Sponge gourd 500gm (chopped)
Potato 1 medium (chopped)
Onion 1 medium (finely chopped)
Garlic 3-4 (finely chopped)
French beans 1/4 cup (finely chopped)
Curd 100 gm
Roasted Besan/ Gram flour 2 tbsp
Salt to taste
Turmeric powder 3 tbsp
Red chilli powder 2 tsp
A pinch of heeng
Dried red chillis 2-3
Mustard seeds 1 tsp
Garam masala powder 1 tbsp
Kashmiri Lal mirch 1 tsp
Desi ghee 3 tbsp
Water 500-600 mL
17900055036256707.method:
Heat a tbsp of ghee in a cooker.
Now pressure cook chopped Torai and potato with salt, turmeric powder and water for 3-4 whistles or until well cooked.
Once the pressure is released and the cooked Torai is on room temperature add curd, roasted gram flour and chilli powder and blend it to a smooth purée with the help of a blender to resemble kadhi.
Now let the kadhi cook on the medium low flame until thick and well cooked. This will take around 12-15 mins.
In the meanwhile prepare the tadka by heating remaing desi ghee in a pan.
Next add heeng powder, dried red chillis and mustard seeds.
Once the seeds start to splutter add the garlic and onions and let it cook on medium flame until golden brown.
Once done add the chopped beans with salt to taste , garam masala powder and Kashmiri Lal mirch.
pour this tadka over the cooked kadhi and serve warm.

17875556658363037.ingredients:
Chickpeas 200 gm (overnight soaked)
Ginger 2 inch
Garlic cloves 3-4
Green chillis 2 (halved)
Onion 2 medium (sliced)
Tomato 2 medium (chopped)
Bay leaf 1
Badi elaichi 1
Green cardamom 3-4
Cloves 2-3
Cinnamon stick 1-2 inch
Tea bags 2
Water for boiling chickpeas
Turmeric powder 1 tsp
Red chilli powder 1 tsp
Coriander powder 1 tbsp
Garam masala 1 tsp
Chole masala 2 tbsp
Salt to taste
For tempering
Desi ghee 2 tbsp
A pinch of heeng
Kashmiri red chilli powder 1 tsp
Kasuri methi 1 tbsp
17875556658363037.method:
In a pressure cooked add soaked chickpeas followed by ginger, garlic, green chillis, onion and tomato.
Mix well and add water enough water to cook the chickpeas. (Approx 2-3 inch level above the chickpeas in the cooker)
Then add the whole spices in a mesh cloth or a mesh ball with two tea bags and salt to taste.
Now close the lid of the cooker and pressure cook for 8-9 whistles.
Once the pressure is released remove the tea bags and whole spices mesh and then mix the chickpeas and cooked veggies.
Now add the dry spices and cook for 7-8 mins on low flame until well cooked and oil is released.
Lastly prepare the tadka with a pinch of heeng, Kashmiri red chilli powder and kasuri methi in desi ghee and pour it over the cooked chickpeas.
Serve warm with kulchas.

18129300016400308.ingredients:
parmesan roasted chickpeas
1 15 oz can chickpeas
1 tbsp olive oil
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 tsp garlic powder
1/2 tsp onion powder
1/2 tsp herbs de province or Italian seasoning
2 tbsp parmesan cheese
roasted sweet potatoes
1 large sweet potato
1 tbsp olive oil
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 tsp cinnamon
1/4 tsp cumin
chicken meatballs
1 lb ground chicken
1 cup ricotta cheese
1 egg
1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs
1 shallot finely chopped
2 green onions finely chopped
1/2 cup cilantro finely chopped
1/4 cup dill finely chopped
zest of a lemon
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 tsp pepper
2 tbsp olive oil
yogurt jalapeño dressing
1 cup greek yogurt
1 cup fresh basil
1/2 cup fresh dill
juice of a lemon
1 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp honey
1 jalapeño seeds removed and washed
2 cloves of garlic
salt and pepper to taste
other
4 cups kale
18129300016400308.method:
Preheat the oven to 400F. Begin by making the parmesan roasted chickpeas. Drain the chickpeas and pat them dry with paper towels. Transfer the beans to a baking sheet.
Add the olive oil, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, herbs de province, and parmesan cheese. Toss until everything is well coated. Transfer to the oven and bake for 15 minutes.
While the chickpeas roast, start on the sweet potatoes. Cut the sweet potato into bite-sized pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet and add the olive oil, salt, cinnamon, and cumin. Toss until everything is well coated. Transfer to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, until sweet potatoes are cooked through and starting to brown.
While the sweet potatoes and chickpeas cook, make the chicken meatballs. Add all the ingredients (except the olive oil) to a bowl. Mix until well combined. Scoop out about 2 tbsp of the chicken mixture. Use your hands to form the chicken into a cylinder shape (you can also just roll them into balls, but I like having more surface area to brown).
Add the olive oil (2 tbsp) to a large pan over medium-high heat. Add half of the meatballs and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown and until the internal temperature reaches 165 F. Repeat with the remaining chicken.
While the chicken meatballs cook, make the dressing. Add all the ingredients (greek yogurt, fresh basil, fresh dill, juice of a lemon, olive oil, honey, jalapeño, garlic, salt, and pepper) to a food processor or blender. Blend until smooth.
To assemble, divide the kale, sweet potatoes, roasted chickpeas, and chicken meatballs between bowls. Top with plenty of yogurt jalapeño dressing and enjoy!

17914378847074728.ingredients:
1 kg Chicken, skinless, bone-in whole chicken cut into medium sized pieces (referred to as curry cut in India)
For the marinade:
2 tablespoons Ginger Garlic Paste
1 Juice of lime
1 tablespoon Salt
For the curry:
1/4 cup Mustard Oil, see note 2
4 medium Red Onions
10 cloves Garlic
1½ inches Ginger
3 – 4 Green Chilies, use Serrano Peppers as replacement, adjust the spice as required
1 tablespoon Cumin Seeds
2 Bay leaves
½ Cinnamon stick, Stick
4 – 5 Cardamoms
8 – 10 Peppercorns
4 – 5 Cloves
4 medium Tomatoes, finely chopped
½ teaspoon Turmeric Powder
1 teaspoon Red Chili Powder, optional; adjust the spice as required
2 tablespoons Coriander Powder
1 teaspoon garam masala Powder
1 teaspoon meat masala
1 teaspoon Salt
1 1/4 cups water
For tempering:
1 tablespoon Ghee or Oil
1 tablespoon Butter
2 Green Chilies, slit lengthwise
½ inch Ginger, julienned
2 tablespoon Coriander, for garnishing
17914378847074728.method:
Marinate the chicken pieces with ginger garlic paste, lime juice and salt. Cover and set aside while you prep everything else
Add onions, ginger, garlic and green chillies to a chopper and pulse to get a coarse mix.
Heat oil in a pressure cooker or a large heavy bottom pan. Add cumin seeds. Roughly pound all the whole spices (bay leaves, cinnamon, cardamom, peppercorns and cloves) and add to the oil.
once they start to splutter, add the onion mix. Cook the onion mix on a low flame, stirring occasionally till it is reduced to a golden brown mix and you see a thin layer of oil along the sides
Add tomatoes, salt, turmeric powder, red chili powder (if using) and coriander powder. Cook till the tomatoes start melting, and almost form a paste.
Add chicken and garam masala powder and roast for a minute or two till the chicken pieces turn pink and get coated with the masala. Add meat masala powder, 1 ¼ cups of water, mix well.
Pressure Cooker:
At this stage, if you are using a pressure cooker, place the lid and pressure cook on high till the first whistle goes off. Then reduce the flame to low and pressure cook for two more whistles and turn off the flame. If using a different kind of pressure cooker (without a whistle system), pressure cook on high for 15 minutes. Let the pressure release naturally.
Simmer for 5-10 mins on high flame, if required, to thicken the curry (chicken leaves a lot of water). I didn't need to do this.
Stovetop Method:
If you are using a heavy bottomed pan, bring the curry to a boil, reduce the heat, cover with a lid and let it cook on medium heat for 20-25 minutes. Uncover the pan, and cook for another 10-15 minutes till the curry starts to thicken. Once the curry is ready, switch off the flame.
Instant Pot Method:
If using an instant pot, place the lid and change the vent to sealing. Pressure cook on high for 8 minutes. Release pressure manually. Simmer the curry for a few minutes to achieve the desired thickness if there is too much water.
Tempering:
In another small pan, heat ghee and butter and add green chilies and ginger. Once they start to splutter, switch off the flame and mix the tadka (or tempering) into the curry. Top with coriander.
Let the curry sit for 10-15 minutes before serving. Tastes best with rotis or rice.

18016174645824883.ingredients:
Shrimp marinade:
1 pound jumbo shrimps peeled and deveined (we used 26/30 shrimps)
1 teaspoon Shaoxing rice wine (optional)
¾ teaspoon salt
1 TBSP cornstarch or potato starch
Shrimp batter:
1 large egg
½ cup potato starch packed
4 tablespoons oil any neutral oil
For the sauce:
4 tablespoons Kewpie mayo or regular mayo
3 tablespoon sweetened condensed milk
1 tablespoon honey
1 teaspoon lemon juice (optional)
For the candied walnuts:
½ cup walnut (halves or pieces)
3 tablespoons granulated sugar
1 tablespoon water
18016174645824883.method:
Marinade the shrimps:
In a bowl, season shrimps with Shaoxing rice wine and salt. Mix until well combined.
Add the cornstarch and mix until the shrimps are evenly coated. Set aside to marinade while you prepare the other ingredients.
Make the candied walnuts:
In a medium size pan over medium heat, combine the granulated sugar and water. Bring to a simmer and let the sugar cook until it becomes an amber color. Stir occasionally if necessary. Be very careful as the sugar will be super hot! Also, keep a close eye on the sugar once it becomes golden in color. It can go from amber to burnt in seconds.
Once the sugar caramelized to an amber color, add the walnut and mix until all the nuts are well coated.
Immediately transfer the candied walnuts to a parchment paper and separate the nuts as best as possible. Set the candied walnuts aside and let them cool until needed.
Prepare the sauce:
Into a large pan, combine the mayo, condensed milk, honey, and optionally, lemon juice. Mix until well combined. Set the sauce aside until needed.
Batter the shrimps:
In a mixing bowl, combine the potato starch, egg, and oil. Mix thoroughly until smooth and well combined.
Add the marinated shrimps and mix until all the shrimps are evenly coated with batter.
Make the honey walnut shrimps:
Heat 1 to 2 inches of oil in a wok or pan to 375°F. Also prepare a plate lined with paper towels.
Once the oil is hot, carefully place the shrimps into the oil, one at a time. Fry in batches if needed. Let the shrimps fry for about 3 to 5 minutes, until the shrimps are just cooked and looks golden. Remove the shrimps from the oil and let it drain on the prepared plate with paper towels.
When all of the shrimps are fried, heat the prepared sauce over medium heat until warm. Turn off the heat and add the shrimps along with the candied walnuts. Toss until everything is evenly coated.
Serve the honey walnut shrimps immediately and enjoy with some steamed broccoli and/or rice!

17896613779650386.ingredients:
1.5 cups atta (whole wheat flour), 195 grams
1/2 cup besan (gram flour), 52 grams
2 tablespoons kasuri methi (dried fenugreek leaves), slightly crushed
1/4 teaspoon red chili powder, or adjust to taste
1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder
3/4 teaspoon ajwain (carom seeds)
1 teaspoon sesame seeds
1 teaspoon salt, or to taste
1/4 teaspoon baking powder
1/3 cup olive oil or ghee, 80 ml, or use oil of choice
water, to knead the dough, little more than 1/2 cup
17896613779650386.method:
To a large bowl add atta (whole wheat flour) and besan (gram flour). Now add to it all the seasonings - kasuri methi, red chili powder, turmeric, ajwain (carom seeds), sesame seeds, salt and baking powder.
Mix to combine it all together. Add oil (or ghee) and mix it well with the flour using your hands (rub the flour between your palms to incorporate the oil).
The oil should be well incorporated into the flour. The mixture will turn crumbly.
Now, start adding water little by little to knead the dough.
Once the dough comes together, knead it for 5 minutes. I used my stand mixer to knead it. Cover and rest the dough for 15 to 20 minutes. Meanwhile pre-heat the oven to 375 F degrees.
After the dough has rested, divide it into 2 parts. Take one part of the dough and roll it, around 1/4 inch thick.
Now you can either use cookie cutter or pizza cutter to shape the mathri. I simply cut some into squares (1.75 inch x 1.75 inch) using my pizza cutter and also some circles (2 inches diameter) using my cookie cutter.
Using a fork poke the mathris so that they don’t rise much while baking. Repeat with the remaining dough.
Place the squares/rounds on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper or silicone mat. Leave a little space between each mathri.
Bake at 375 F degrees for 20-22 minutes, flipping them once half-way. I usually bake around 23-24 minutes since I like quite crispy mathris. If you don’t like super crispy, bake around 20 minutes.
Let cool and then store baked methi mathri in an airtight container.
If you roll the mathri thick, they will take more time to bake so keep that in mind.

17884171018814810.ingredients:
1.25 cups kesar pista shrikhand
6 cookies, I used biscoff cookies
1 tablespoon unsalted butter, melted & slightly cooled
4 gulab jamuns, cut in half
nuts, edible silver leaves, optional, to garnish & decorate
17884171018814810.method:
Make shrikhand beforehand. You can either use my homemade recipe or any that you like.
Add cookies to a food processor. I have used biscoff cookies here, you can use any cookie that you like.
Pulse to crush the cookies and then transfer them to a bowl.
Add melted butter to the bowl and mix it with the cookies until the mixture resembles crumbs. If using cookies which aren’t very sweet, you might need to add some sugar along with the butter into the cookie crumbs.
Now take the jars and add around 2 teaspoons cookie crumbs in each serving glass. Press lightly using your fingers.
Pipe shrikhand into the jars above the cookie crust. I have used a piping bag here, you can simply use a spoon.
Cut the gulab jamuns into half and top each jars with cut jamun.
Repeat with remaining jars. Place the jars in the refrigerator to chill for few hours. Shrikhand becomes thick as it chills so it’s important to chill.
Once chilled, serve immediately. You may garnish with nuts or decorate with edible silver leaves!

1/2 tsp baking soda
1 tsp vanilla extract
18030321800366386.method:
1. Sieve together the maida, baking soda, and baking powder. Set them aside.
 2. Use a mixer grinder to powder the sugar.
 3. In a mixing bowl, take the powdered sugar and add the melted butter along with the vanilla extract. Whisk well until the mixture turns creamy.
 4. Gradually add the flour and milk, a little at a time, and mix gently to make a smooth batter.
 5. Once the batter is ready, transfer it to a greased baking pan. Bake at 180°C for 40 minutes in a preheated oven, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

Ensure all ingredients are at room temperature before starting.
Baking time and temperature may vary slightly, as every oven is different.

17859775278261950.ingredients:
Rajgira/Amaranth seeds 3/4 cup
Water 2 cup
Milk 400 ml
Mixed dry fruit (chopped)
Cardamom/Elaichi Powder 1 tsp
Jaggery powder 3-4 tbsp
Grated/Dessicated Coconut
Mixed Fruits of your choice
Pumpkin/Musk melon seeds for toppings
Desi ghee 1 tbsp
17859775278261950.method:
1. Wash the amaranth seeds 2-3 times in enough water and drain the water.
2. Now a tbsp of desi ghee in a pressure cooker and saute the washed rajgira seeds for 1-2 mins.
3. Then add 2 cups of water and pressure cook for 2 whistles.
4. Once the seeds are cooked and pressure released add the milk, cardamom powder and chopped dry fruits. (I have added cashews, almomds and raisins).
5. Stir well and cook on medium low heat until the milk has thickened.
6. Then switch of the flame and add the  jaggery powder and mix well.
7. Refrigerate this pudding for 2-3 hours or you can also prepare it a night before and refrigerate it overnight.
8. Once the pudding is ready, plate in glasses or bowls with a layer of rajgira pudding, topped with a layer of dessicated coconut, banana slices and mixed fresh fruits of your choice.
9. Top it with more fresh seeds and serve. Trust me this recipe is fingerlicking good.

4-5 green chilies
1/4 cup water
For the Masala:
4-5 tbsp oil
Whole spices: 2 cloves, 2 green cardamom, 1 bay leaf, 1 small cinnamon stick, 3-4 black peppercorns, 1 small piece of javatri, 1 black cardamom

1 tsp black pepper powder

18045354343835489.method:
1.Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan over medium heat.
 -Add the boiled eggs, chili powder, and turmeric powder. Fry until golden and slightly crispy, about 5-7 minutes. Remove and set aside.
2. In a blender, combine onions, soaked cashews, ginger, garlic, green chilies, and 1/4 cup water. Blend until smooth.
3. Cook the Masala:
In a kadai, heat 4-5 tbsp oil over medium heat.
Add the whole spices (cloves, green cardamom, bay leaf, cinnamon stick, black peppercorns, javatri, and black cardamom). Sauté until fragrant, about 2-3 minutes.

Add the kitchen king masala, garam masala, and black pepper powder. Sauté for a few minutes.
Lower the heat and add the whisked dahi and 1/2 cup water. Cook slowly on low heat for about 7-8 minutes until the oil separates from the masala, stirring occasionally.
4. Finish the Dish:
Add kasuri methi, fresh cream, milk, pinch of garam masala, and chaat masala. Stir well.
Add the fried eggs and cook on low heat for about 5 minutes until the oil separates. Adjust the consistency with more water if needed.
Add chopped coriander leaves and mix well.

Serve hot with rice or naan.

Melt the butter in a frying pan, then add a couple leaves of sage for 1 min, followed by the onions.

Cook your pasta, saving at least 2 ladles of pasta water for the sauce (you can adjust depending on how thick you want the sauce).
Once the sqaush is roasted, remove the skin and add to a blender with the roasted garlic, sage, onions & cream.
Blend until smooth, season then add the pasta water 1 ladle at a time, blending until glossy.
Pour the sauce over your pasta and top with buratta, hot honey & crispy sage if you likeee xxx

18110110079233210.ingredients:
1 cup cottage cheese
1/2 cup greek yogurt
4 cups water
2 tbsp oil or ghee
1 tsp mustard seeds
1 tsp chana dal
1 tsp urad dal
curry leaves
2 chopped green chillies
1 tsp grated ginger
pinch of hing
1 chopped onion
salt
1 cup rava
18110110079233210.method:
Blend: 1 cup cottage cheese 1/2 cup greek yogurt with about 4 cups water, till completely smooth.
Tempering: heat 2 tbsp oil or ghee — 1 tsp mustard seeds (let them crackle), 1 tsp chana dal, 1 tsp urad dal, curry leaves, 2 chopped green chillies, 1 tsp grated ginger, a pinch of hing.
Add 1 chopped onion, sauté till soft.
Pour in the cottage cheese blend + salt, bring to a gentle boil.
Rain in 1 cup rava slowly, stirring non-stop so no lumps.
Cover, cook on low 2–3 minutes till soft and fluffy.
Serve hot, straight off the stove

18109546994462769.ingredients:
1 cup mashed sweet potatoes
3 eggs
1/2 cup maple syrup
1/4 cup honey
1 tsp vanilla
3 tbsp cacao powder
1/4 cup + 2 tbsp oat flour
1/4 tsp salt
1 tsp baking soda
1/2 cup dark chocolate chips (+ more for topping)
18109546994462769.method:
Preheat oven to 350.
Mash sweet potatoes in a large bowl, and whisk in eggs, maple syrup, honey, and vanilla.
Add dry ingredients and stir with a wooden spoon or spatula.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Pour batter into an 8x8 baking dish lined with parchment paper and sprinkle more chocolate chips on top.
Bake for 30-35 minutes (should look slightly underdone when taking them out, trust)
Slice & enjoy

17918665797458493.ingredients:
1 cup sabudana, soaked
1 cup sweet potato (boiled & mashed)
1 tsp cumin seeds
1 tsp green chillies (finely chopped)
¼ cup coriander leaves
1/3 cup peanuts (roasted & crushed)
1 tsp salt or kala namak
1 tsp tup/ghee
17918665797458493.method:
Soak sabudana in water for 5 hours (soak in water for 30 min, drain and put a plate on top), roast ⅓ cup peanuts and peel them, boil 2 sweet potatoes, peel and mash them.
Add soaked sabudana, mashed sweet potatoes, cumin seeds, finely chopped green chillies, coriander leaves, peanuts, salt and ghee to a bowl and mix it well.
Add some more ghee if needed to form the mix into balls.
Put some tup on the waffle maker and take one of the balls and place it on the waffle maker.
Cook the waffles for 7-8 minutes or until lightly golden.
Serve with dahi-saakar or any chutney.

18419817544156557.ingredients:
60g ground oats (oat flour)
7g chia seeds
80ml soy or almond milk
100g zucchini, grated
100g pre-cooked lentils
pinch of salt (optional)
Avocado oil spray
18419817544156557.method:
Grate the zucchini and combine it with the ground oats, chia seeds, cooked lentils, and plant-based milk.
Mix everything together and let it sit for 5 minutes.
Lightly spray your waffle maker with avocado oil.
Cook until golden and crispy.

18162469870485853.ingredients:
1 lb ground chicken
1 tbsp yellow mustard
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp onion powder
1 tsp chili powder
½ tsp paprika
½ tsp kosher salt
½ tsp black pepper
¼ cup buttermilk or milk (for brushing)
8 small flour tortillas (street style)
Neutral oil for frying (about ¼ inch in skillet)
1 cup all-purpose flour
1 tsp aluminum-free baking powder
1 tsp paprika
1 tsp kosher salt
¼–½ tsp cayenne
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp onion powder
½ tsp black pepper
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 tsp cayenne
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp onion powder
½ tsp chili powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
4 tablespoons neutral oil
18162469870485853.method:
In a bowl, combine ground chicken, mustard, garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Mix until just combined.
In a shallow bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, paprika, cayenne, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Drizzle 1–2 tablespoons of milk into the flour mixture. Use your fingers to rub and toss it through the flour to create craggly bits.
Press a thin, even layer of the chicken mixture onto one side of each tortilla.
Lightly brush the chicken side with milk and firmly press into the seasoned flour mixture.
Heat about ¼ inch of neutral oil in a skillet over medium heat. Place tacos chicken-side down. Press gently and cook 4-5 minutes, until deeply golden and crispy.
Flip and cook 1–2 minutes more, until chicken is fully cooked and tortilla is lightly toasted.
Transfer to a wire rack or paper towel-lined plate.
In another skillet warm up 4 tbsp oil on medium heat for 2-3 minutes. Add in the seasonings for the oil and mix until the sugar dissolves. Remove from heat and brush generously over the crispy chicken side of each taco.
Top each taco with a drizzle of sauce, pickles & kale slaw.

18149789749507793.ingredients:
140g butter
50g miso
150g brown sugar
100g white sugar
1 egg
10g vanilla
185g bread flour
3g baking soda
100g chocolate chunks

17874615081638451.ingredients:
100g mushrooms
salt
1 tbsp oil
2 sliced onions
¼ cup cashews
1 tsp coriander powder
1 tsp red chilli powder
1 tsp garam masala
1 tsp jeera powder
1 tsp salt
1-2 tbsp besan
atta or maida roti
sliced onion
green chutney
17874615081638451.method:
Wash 100g mushrooms & boil in salted water for 4-5 mins. Drain & set aside.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a kadhai, add 2 sliced onions & caramelise till 80% done. Add ¼ cup cashews & cook together. Blend into a smooth paste.
Add the paste back to the kadhai & cook with 1 tsp coriander powder, 1 tsp red chilli powder, 1 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp jeera powder & 1 tsp salt. Mix well & switch off the flame.
Add 1-2 tbsp besan to bind — add more if the mixture is too loose. Shape into tikkis & pan fry on both sides on a hot tawa till golden & crispy.
For the mini parathas, roll out an atta or maida roti & cut out small circles using a katori. Pan fry on both sides with a little oil till golden.
To serve, place the kebab on the mini paratha, top with sliced onion & green chutney

17985248724080126.ingredients:
3 cups rolled oats
1 cup quinoa
1 cup buckwheat groats
⅓ cup chia seeds
⅓ cup milled flaxseed
½ cup chopped walnuts
½ cup sesame seeds
10 Medjool dates, finely chopped
½ cup sunflower seeds
1 cup porridge mix
2 cups semi-skimmed milk
1 cup Greek yoghurt or Skyr
cinnamon, orange zest & juice (optional)
⅓ cup greek yoghurt or Skyr (to serve, per portion)
⅓ cup frozen blueberries (to serve, per portion)
17985248724080126.method:
Combine all of the porridge mix ingredients in a large airtight container and mix well.
Add 1 cup of the mix and 2 cups of milk to a saucepan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for around 20 minutes, stirring regularly, until the quinoa and buckwheat are tender. Add a splash more milk or water as needed.
Stir through 1 cup of Skyr, then divide between two portions — one for now and one for tomorrow.
Top each with ⅓ cup Skyr and ⅓ cup blueberries. Add a splash of milk when reheating the second portion if needed.

18057985322607818.ingredients:
1 egg, whisked
3 Tbsp ground flax
1/2 tsp baking powder
18057985322607818.method: Mix it all together and microwave for 1 minute.

18417874195085883.ingredients:
250g seed mix
2 tsp caraway seeds
2 tsp fennel seeds
3 tsp coriander seeds
3 tsp chia seeds
3 tsp milled flax
2 tsp psyllium husk
3 pinches of salt
200ml water
18417874195085883.method:
Mix everything together, then leave it for 10 minutes.
Spread it thinly over a lined baking tray and bake at 150C for 40 minutes.
Let it cool, then break it into shards.

17998641369047180.ingredients:
2 cups whipped ricotta (10% M.F)
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
pinch of salt
garlic confit
honey
lemon pesto or lemon zest
sourdough toast
17998641369047180.method:
Blend olive oil and ricotta until smooth
Spread the garlic confit on the toasted sourdough, then spread or pipe the whipped ricotta on top
Drizzle with lemon pesto and honey

18114730216747393.ingredients:
1 cup (240g) blended cottage cheese
1 cup (150g) all purpose flour
1 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
egg wash (1 egg, whisked)
everything but the bagel seasoning
18114730216747393.method:
Mix 1 cup (240g) blended cottage cheese, 1 cup (150g) all purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, and 1/2 tsp salt in a bowl until a thick dough forms.
Flour surface and cut dough into 4 equal parts.
Shape into bagels and lay on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Coat with egg wash (1 egg, whisked) and top with everything but the bagel seasoning.
Bake in the oven at 375F for 20-25 minutes, and enjoy!

18210246751349533.ingredients:
2.5 tbsp miso paste
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp mirin
1 tsp sesame oil
1 tbsp minced garlic
2/3 cups jasmine rice, uncooked/raw
1/3 cup beef bone broth
7 oz atlantic farm raised salmon, skinless, raw
10 large napa cabbage leaves
1/2 cup peeled edamame
1 cup white beech mushrooms
2 pan-fried eggs
salt and pepper to taste
1/3 second spray oil
2 green onions
18210246751349533.method:
Chop your napa cabbage leaves and green onions into small pieces.
In a bowl mix together miso paste, soy sauce, mirin, sesame oil, and minced garlic to make your marinade.
Wash your rice.
In your rice cooker add your washed rice, beef bone broth, salmon covered with the marinade, napa cabbage, edamame, and white beach mushrooms and cook for 20 minutes.
In a pan coated with spray oil, fry two sunny side up eggs season with salt and pepper to taste.
Once cooked mix together the rice with a spoon, take out half a portion of the mixed salmon rice, add one of the eggs, and top it off with half of the green onions and enjoy!

18130627825596903.ingredients:
180g Boneless Skinless Chicken Thigh
15g Soy Sauce
5g Sesame Oil
10g Gochujang
5g Honey
10g Minced Garlic
65g Rice Raw
65g Chicken Bone Broth
50g Frozen Vegetables (optional)
18130627825596903.method:
After washing your rice in the rice cooker bowl - add Bone Broth and Garlic
Marinate Chicken with Sesame oil, Soy sauce, Gochujang and Honey
Add optional Frozen Veggies, then stir well.
Place chicken thigh on top, make sure to add in excess marinate.
Start the rice cooker as normal, enjoy when ready.

18128266558766357.ingredients:
3 cups arugula
1 cup basil leaves
18 oz artichoke hearts
2 cloves garlic
Juice of 1/2 lemon
Lemon zest
Salt
1/2 cup olive oil
18128266558766357.method: To a food processor add: 3 cups arugula, 1 cup basil leaves, 18 oz artichoke hearts, 2 cloves garlic, Juice of 1/2 lemon, Lemon zest, Salt, 1/2 cup olive oil. Blend it up and enjoy!

18121792441941129.ingredients:
1 lb pasta (Cavatappi)
5 cups water or stock
salt
18121792441941129.method:
Add pasta to the Instant Pot.
Pour in 5 cups water or stock (adds flavor and protein)—the pasta should be mostly submerged. Add salt.
Do not stir too much; just gently press the pasta down so it’s covered.
Close the lid and set to High Pressure for 4 minutes.
When it finishes, do a quick release immediately.
Open and stir. If there’s a little excess liquid, let it sit for 1–2 minutes or drain it.

18113282057333285.ingredients:
1 sheet puff pastry, thawed
2 medium onions, thinly sliced
1 tbsp butter
1 tbsp olive oil
½ tsp salt, or to taste
¼ tsp black pepper
100–120 g brie cheese, cut into small pieces
3–4 tbsp fig jam
Fresh chives, finely chopped
Red chilli flakes, for garnish
18113282057333285.method:
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Cut puff pastry into squares/ circles using a cookie cutter and lay on a baking tray. Add parchment paper at the bottom.
Bake for 10–12 minutes until puffed and lightly golden. Gently press down the centres to create little cups.
Heat butter and olive oil in a pan. Add sliced onions and sea salt. Cook on medium-low heat for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft, golden and caramelised. Add black pepper.
Add a spoonful of caramelised onions to each pastry cup, followed by a small piece of brie and about ½ tsp fig jam.
Return to the oven for 5–8 minutes, until the brie melts and the pastry is golden and crisp.
Finish with freshly chopped chives and a pinch of red chilli flakes.
18113282057333285.comment_text:
CARAMELISED ONION & FIG JAM PUFF PASTRY BITES 🥐✨

Sweet, savoury, cheesy and perfectly flaky! An easy, elegant appetizer for your next gathering. 🤌🏻

INGREDIENTS(Makes 12–16 bites)

* 1 sheet puff pastry, thawed
* 2 medium onions, thinly sliced
* 1 tbsp butter
* 1 tbsp olive oil
* ½ tsp salt, or to taste
* ¼ tsp black pepper
* 100–120 g brie cheese, cut into small pieces
* 3–4 tbsp fig jam
* Fresh chives, finely chopped
* Red chilli flakes, for garnish (grinded)

Method:

1. Prepare the pastry: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Cut puff pastry into squares/ circles using a cookie cutter and lay on a baking tray. Add parchment paper at the bottom. 
2. Bake: Bake for 10–12 minutes until puffed and lightly golden. Gently press down the centres to create little cups.
3. Caramelise the onions: Heat butter and olive oil in a pan. Add sliced onions and sea salt. Cook on medium-low heat for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft, golden and caramelised. Add black pepper.
4. Fill: Add a spoonful of caramelised onions to each pastry cup, followed by a small piece of brie and about ½ tsp fig jam.
5. Bake again: Return to the oven for 5–8 minutes, until the brie melts and the pastry is golden and crisp.
6. Garnish: Finish with freshly chopped chives and a pinch of red chilli flakes.

✨ Hosting tip: Caramelise the onions and prebake the pastry cups ahead of time. Assemble and bake just before serving for the best texture!

17990938449085321.ingredients:
250 grams minced chicken
2 teaspoons light soy sauce
1 teaspoon toasted sesame oil
1 teaspoon grated garlic
1 tablespoon sesame or any neutral cooking oil, divided
1 teaspoon finely chopped ginger
1 teaspoon finely chopped garlic
1 tablespoon red thai curry paste
1 teaspoon light soy sauce
1 tablespoon peanut butter
½ teaspoon sugar
¼ teaspoon salt
1 cup thin coconut milk
½ cup water
1 cup cooked rice
⅓ cup cooked edamame beans
½ lemon juice
1 tablespoon finely chopped coriander
17990938449085321.method:
Add minced chicken to a bowl, add soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, mix well and set aside to marinate for 20-25 minutes.
Heat sesame oil in a flat bottomed pan, add marinated chicken and roast on medium heat till they turn golden from the bottom Flip and roast on the other side till they turn golden. Break them into bite sized pieces and transfer to a plate.
Heat the same pan, add the remaining 1 teaspoon of oil. Add ginger, garlic and saute for a few seconds till fragrant. Add thai curry paste, soy sauce, peanut butter, sugar, salt and saute for a few seconds till they mix well. Add coconut milk, water and boil for 2-3 minutes and take off the heat.
To serve, add rice to a large bowl, pour the hot broth on the rice, top with roasted chicken mince, edamame beans, lemon juice, garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.

18070061501585194.ingredients:
150 g uncooked short grain rice
2 chicken thighs, deboned
1/2 tsp black pepper powder
5 -6 dried shiitake mushrooms, rehydrated and sliced
150 ml mushroom soaking liquid
45 g fresh shiitake mushrooms
45 g shimeji mushrooms
5 ginger slices
1 green onion, chopped (garnish)
2 tbsp Shaoxing cooking wine
1 tbsp light soy sauce
2 tsp dark soy sauce
1/4 tsp white pepper powder
10 g rock sugar
2 tbsp sesame oil
18070061501585194.method:
Soak the dried shiitake mushrooms in 150ml water overnight until fully plump. If you’re short on time, soak them in hot water for 30 minutes. Squeeze out the excess liquid, then slice the mushrooms. Keep the soaking liquid for later.
Debone the chicken thighs and make a few shallow cuts on the meat side to even out the thickness. Lightly season the meat side with black pepper.
Place the chicken skin side down in a cold pan, then turn the heat to medium. You don’t need to add oil because the chicken skin will render its own fat.
Once the skin starts to sizzle, cook for 4-5 minutes until the skin is golden and crispy. Flip and pan-fry the meat side for about 2 minutes. The chicken doesn’t need to be fully cooked at this stage as we will continue to stir-fry later. Remove from the pan and chop into bite-sized pieces.
In the same pan, add the ginger slices, dried shiitake, fresh shiitake and shimeji mushrooms. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until softened and fragrant.
Add the sliced chicken back into the pan. Pour in Shaoxing wine, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, white pepper, rock sugar and sesame oil. Stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and everything is coated in a glossy sauce.
Add the washed and drained rice into your rice cooker. Top with the chicken and mushroom stir-fry, then pour in the reserved mushroom soaking liquid. Cook as you normally would for rice, usually around 30 minutes, depending on your rice cooker.
Once cooked, gently fluff the rice and garnish with chopped spring onions. Serve immediately. Enjoy!

18072419861292169.ingredients:
8 oz rice cooker chicken
3/4 cup rice
1/2 cup water
1/2 medium onion, sliced
1/2 cup corn (frozen or canned)
1 tbsp butter
1 scallion, chopped
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp dark soy sauce
1/2 tbsp oyster sauce
1 tbsp honey
1/2 tsp black pepper
1/4 tsp garlic powder
18072419861292169.method:
In your rice cooker bowl, wash and drain the rice. Add the water.
Place the sliced onions, chicken, and corn evenly on top of the rice. Close the lid and press “cook” on the rice cooker.
In a small bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients.
When the rice cooker is done, add the chopped scallion and butter, and pour on the sauce. Mix everything together. Enjoy!

17908638801476293.ingredients:
150g dark chocolate
4 tbsp cashew butter
25g popped quinoa
17908638801476293.method:
Break up the chocolate into small pieces and add to a heat-proof bowl. Microwave on high until melted, giving it a mix every few seconds to ensure it doesn't burn.
Add the cashew butter and mix until smooth.
Fold in the puffed quinoa, then spread into flat disks on a baking sheet/chopping board lined with parchment paper.
Refrigerate until set and enjoy!

17968128282406093.ingredients:
Medjool dates, pitted
caramelized onion goat cheese
chopped pecans
fresh rosemary
orange zest
honey
17968128282406093.method:
Stuff the pitted dates with caramelized onion goat cheese.
Top with chopped pecans, fresh rosemary and orange zest.
Bake until warm and gooey.
Drizzle with honey while still warm.

18132521275664010.ingredients:
thick white fish fillet
salt
Japanese milk loaf or white bread, crust removed
cornflour
egg white
oil
butter
lemon
creamy herb sauce
18132521275664010.method:
Lightly salt the fillet and pat completely dry.
Cut the crust off the bread, cube, freeze, then blitz into coarse, shardy breadcrumbs.
Dredge the fish in cornflour, then egg white, then press firmly into the breadcrumbs.
Heat oil and butter in a stainless steel pan and place the fish breadcrumb-side down.
Cook until golden and crisp, finishing with a squeeze of lemon, and serve over the creamy herb sauce.

18146739574604386.ingredients:
spaghetti
peeled garlic cloves
oil
butter
chopped fresh herbs
red chili flakes
pasta water
fresh cheese, grated
18146739574604386.method:
Fry the peeled garlic cloves in oil until golden brown, then transfer to a bowl.
Add butter, chopped fresh herbs and red chili flakes and mash into a paste.
Boil the spaghetti in salted water, drain, and toss in the pan with the garlic-butter mixture, adding pasta water to create a sauce.
Finish with grated fresh cheese over the pasta in the pan and again on the plated serving.

17907138795145330.ingredients:
biscuit dough
honey butter
aioli
scrambled eggs
Colby Jack cheese
bacon
17907138795145330.method:
Prepare the biscuit dough and bake the biscuits.
Cook the bacon and eggs.
Assemble the sandwiches with layers of flaky biscuit, honey butter, aioli, scrambled eggs, Colby Jack cheese and bacon.

18109237286187857.ingredients:
tofu
milk
coriander
kasuri methi
sesame seeds
spices
onions
bell peppers
18109237286187857.method:
Blend tofu, milk, coriander and kasuri methi for the gravy until super creamy.
Sauté sesame seeds, spices, cubed tofu, onions and bell peppers in a pan.
Combine the sautéed mixture with the blended gravy and serve, garnished with herbs.

17898574638393453.ingredients:
oil
chopped garlic
chopped ginger
onion
dried red chili
fresh drumstick leaves
turmeric powder
egg
water
garam masala
salt
cooked white rice
ghee
17898574638393453.method:
Heat oil in a kadai, add chopped garlic, chopped ginger, onion, dried red chili, fresh drumstick leaves and turmeric powder.
Crack in an egg, pour in water, add garam masala and salt.
Mix in cooked white rice and finish with a drizzle of ghee.

18120725257942422.ingredients:
jalapeños
creamy corn-cheese mixture
puff pastry
chili oil
candy eyeballs
18120725257942422.method:
Halve the jalapeños and scoop them out.
Fill with the creamy corn-cheese mixture.
Wrap in crisscrossed puff pastry strips to resemble mummy bandages.
Bake until golden, brush with chili oil and top with candy eyeballs.

17880336279544487.ingredients:
coconut milk
maple syrup
cinnamon
frozen mixed berries
17880336279544487.method:
Pour the coconut milk into a blender cup, add maple syrup and a generous amount of cinnamon, and blend.
Place frozen mixed berries in a bowl and pour the blended coconut-milk mixture over them.
Stir – the cold fruit freezes the mixture almost immediately, creating a creamy coating similar to ice cream.

17979593439092169.ingredients:
raspberries
chia seeds
pumpkin seeds
dates
almond flour
vanilla
salt
cinnamon
sea salt
dark chocolate
17979593439092169.method:
Wash the raspberries and cook them into a jam with chia seeds.
Roast the pumpkin seeds and blend them with dates, almond flour, vanilla, salt and cinnamon into pumpkin butter.
Layer melted dark chocolate, pumpkin butter and raspberry jam in muffin liners, top with more chocolate and sea salt, and freeze until set.

18187066312411128.ingredients:
almond flour
coconut oil
pumpkin seeds
sesame seeds
hemp seeds
maple syrup
super-dark unsweetened chocolate
Maldon sea salt
18187066312411128.method:
Press a base of almond flour and coconut oil into a pan.
Make the middle layer from pumpkin, sesame and hemp seeds mixed with coconut oil and maple syrup.
Top with melted super-dark unsweetened chocolate with a little coconut oil, sprinkled with pumpkin seeds, sesame seeds and Maldon sea salt.
Cut the slab into bars.

18104584310630560.ingredients:
store-bought dumplings
oil
red curry/chili paste
coconut milk
peanut butter
soy sauce or lime juice
chopped chives
sliced red chilies
chili oil
18104584310630560.method:
Add oil to a pan, stir in the red curry/chili paste, pour in coconut milk, then add peanut butter and soy sauce or lime juice to create the sauce.
Place frozen dumplings in a pot, pour over hot water and cook.
Transfer the cooked dumplings into the sauce pan and coat.
Plate, top with chives and chili slices, and drizzle with chili oil.
